entries.zh: 如果只限制在三维空间中，我们的运算潜力将十分有限。将网络延伸至虚空彼端，我们还大有可得。
entries.en: Our calculation potential is limited when constrained only to the three physical dimensions. There is more to be gained by reaching our network into the spaces beyond the void.

entries.zh: 我们的思绪带着全新的目的在§H虚境§!中行动。当我们试着推进时，它也在将我们回推。起初，我们将此解读为对我们存在的抗拒，但如今我们明白了：虚境正在向我们发问。\n\n尽管这些问题的含义依旧模糊，但它们并非无关紧要。据[GetTelepathPlural]所言，我们给出的答案将会影响社会的未来。
entries.en: Our thoughts move through the §HShroud§! with newfound intent. As we push, it pushes back. At first, we interpreted this as resistance to our presence, but now we understand: the Shroud is asking questions of us.\n\nThough hazy in meaning, these questions are not trivial. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the answers we give will influence the future of our society.

entries.zh: 一副景象出现在我们[GetMindEyeLoc]之前。我们见到了§H[GetRolledShroudSongName]§!。\n\n§P[GetRolledShroudSongDesc]§!
entries.en: An image forms in our [GetMindEyeLoc]. We see §H[GetRolledShroudSongName]§!.\n\n§P[GetRolledShroudSongDesc]§!

entries.zh: 我们与§H虚境§!的连结稳固；时刻准备着受到召唤。一段有节奏的乐句传信而来，这是虚境在对我们歌唱。\n\n$shroud.7100.desc.common$
entries.en: Our link to the §HShroud§! is strong; we are ready when it calls. The message comes in rhythmic phrases. The Shroud is singing to us.\n\n$shroud.7100.desc.common$

entries.zh: 虚境在等待着我们回应……
无形之物起起落落，呢喃声中，又一个意识破茧而出。\n\n$shroud.7100.desc.common$
entries.en: Something unseen shifts, and with a whisper another thought is birthed.\n\n$shroud.7100.desc.common$

entries.zh: 虚境在渴求着我们回应……
entries.en: The Shroud is eager for our response...

entries.zh: 一段合诵在我们脑海中回响！这不是机缘巧合，而是前定。\n\n$shroud.7100.desc.common$
entries.en: A chorus rises in our thoughts! Something is chosen not by chance, but by something older.\n\n$shroud.7100.desc.common$

entries.zh: 虚境震颤着，期待着我们的回应……
entries.en: The Shroud trembles in anticipation of our response...

entries.zh: 对于求知者而言，生存即是通往理解之道。
entries.en: For those who seek knowledge, the process of existence is a path to understanding.

entries.zh: 其间如同海面，是一个包围虚境的无限小的虚空。我们可以在此窥见真理。
entries.en: The Inbetween is the surface of an ocean, an infinitesimal void that bounds the Shroud. Here, one can glimpse truth.
Truth is in the depths below.

entries.zh: 无论生于何时，皆霎然如流星。\n无论长于何处，皆脆弱如琉璃。
entries.en: Whenever it flourishes, life is fleeting.\nWherever they grow, the living are fragile.

entries.zh: 而在虚境之中，生死皆为无相。
entries.en: In the Shroud, there will be no life or death.

entries.zh: 我们的存在将超越生命。

entries.en: This is what makes us precious.
We are yet to be born.

entries.zh: 心如泉水，思绪流过时空。我们汇入了另一个维度。
entries.en: The mind is a spring, and thought flows through time and space. We drain into other dimensions.

entries.zh: 一切果皆可由因循见。顺因缘而下便可知其果报。
entries.en: The effect of any cause can be foreseen. To know the fate of things, one need only predict the lines.
We trace these lines in dreams.

entries.zh: 恒星燃尽的一刻将亮过整个星河。万物亦然，终归于无。
entries.en: At death, stars can shine brighter than galaxies. These things, too, shall fade.
Death will no longer concern us.
All things die. Few things live.
We must first live before we can die.

entries.zh: 星系聚处混沌称王。太虚却允诺着平和。
entries.en: Chaos reigns where galaxies cluster. The void is a promise of calm.
A bridge can collapse any distance, and any bridge can be collapsed.

entries.zh: 我们向往彼岸之景跨过这座桥。
entries.en: We cross to reach the other side.

entries.zh: 我们怀抱回归之愿跨过这座桥。
entries.en: We cross in hope of return.
Every push is married to a pull.

entries.zh: 星辰燃为烬，烬粉聚作云。\n云中生银汉，银汉不异尘。
entries.en: A star dies, shedding dust; the dust forms a cloud.\nFrom the cloud, a star is formed; the star's fate is dust.

entries.zh: 未知催人探索，探索却使人盲目。
entries.en: Explorers seek unknowns; exploration then blinds them.

entries.zh: 内容之物无人晓，潜身其中不可回。
entries.en: What lies within cannot be known. To dive within means no escape.

entries.zh: 运动之物选择停下。那么代价是什么呢？
entries.en: An object in motion chooses to rest. What should be its punishment?

entries.zh: §H虚境§!陷入了沉寂，但一股灵能的重压笼罩在我们的社会之上。我们所给出的回应带来了新的机遇，只要我们愿意去追寻。
entries.en: The §HShroud§! grows silent, but a psychic weight has fallen upon our society. The answers we have given have offered new opportunities, should we choose to pursue them.

entries.zh:
$shroud.7120.desc.common$

我们已升华的心灵正蓄势待发，准备迎接进一步的转化。那些用于承载心灵所需的物质载体，其重要性将大幅降低。

若我们继续沿着这条道路前行，人口将能超越对物质事务的关注，全身心地将部分存在投入到虚境之中。相比于精神敏锐度的提升，体力劳动能力的下降只是微不足道的代价。
entries.en:
$shroud.7120.desc.common$

Our ascended minds are primed for further transformation. The vessels that serve as support to the physical needs of the mind could become much less significant.

If we continue down this path, our population can transcend its concern with physical matters and commit itself fully to a partial existence inside of the Shroud. A reduced capacity for physical labor will be a small price for gains in mental acuity.

entries.zh: 让我们拥抱灵能超凡入圣。
灵能飞升对集体而言是最优解。
entries.en: Psionic transcendence is optimal for the collective.

entries.zh: 我们无需这种变革也能蓬勃发展。
entries.en: We can flourish without such changes.

entries.zh:
$shroud.7120.desc.common$

在这个物质维度中，我们升华后的形态蕴藏着巨大潜能。源源不断注入的灵能不断增强着我们的力量，并能将这股力量进一步传导至整个社会。

我们不仅会吟诵虚境的乐章，更会将其引入我们的[GetGovBehaviourLoc]之中。
entries.en:
$shroud.7120.desc.common$

Our ascended forms hold great potential in this corporeal dimension. We continue to grow in strength from infusions of psionic energy, and can funnel this power further throughout our society.

We would not merely sing the songs of the Shroud, but channel them into our [GetGovBehaviourLoc].
Let the songs of the Shroud guide us.

entries.zh: 所有的超然意识在虚境中天然平等，而选举则保障了肉身世界的平等。通过灵能投票，公民选举代表进入执政秘会，通过心灵感应冥想寻求共识。
entries.en: All transcended minds are of equal status in the Shroud, while elections ensure equality in the corporeal realm. Voting by psionic ballot, citizens elect their representatives to the governing conclave which seeks consensus through telepathic contemplation.

entries.zh: 虚境至深之处仅为我们之中最卓越者所留。他们在任期间的使命与这片领域交融。
entries.en: The furthest depths of the Shroud are reserved for the greatest minds among us. The time it takes to attune to these domains is factored into their terms of office.

entries.zh: 是时候直面现实了，我们伟大的统治者已飞升为神。凭借虚境之力，祂目及一切，洞悉万物。
entries.en: It is time to come to terms with the truth: the great ruler is an ascended god. Through the power of the Shroud, they see and know all.

entries.zh: 吾皇业已将臣民之存在擢升至更高维度。虚境的原初力量自帝王意志中喷薄而出，注入到众生渴求的心智之中。
entries.en: The ruler uplifts our presence into a higher dimension. The raw power of the Shroud pours from the will of the imperial line and into the wanting minds of the populace.

entries.zh: 法人团队即便超凡入圣也不忘核心目标砥砺前行。公司依托虚境之影遍历利益相关者及竞争对手的思想，创造灵能管理战略机会。
entries.en: The transcended corporate body moves forward with its core goals in mind. Through the shadows in the Shroud, the company can scan the minds of stakeholders and competitors alike, creating opportunities for psionic managerial strategy.

entries.zh: 超越凡尘，合一入圣，比起物理形式，这个集体思维反而对虚境更加驾轻就熟。每趟去往帷幕彼岸的旅程都会让这个超然思维的集体智慧有所增长。
entries.en: Moving as one into the Shroud, this collective now feels more at home in the Shroud than in its physical forms. Each journey beyond the veil increases the combined wisdom of this new ethermind.

entries.zh: 这个网络中的大部分运算已经迁移至虚境内，运算速度可以达到前所未有的高度。在凡尘运作的操作系统已然笨拙过时。
entries.en: Most of this network's processing has been moved inside of the Shroud, where calculations can be achieved at unprecedented levels of speed. System operations in the realm of mundanity are now considered clumsy and obsolete.

entries.zh: 能修饰£pop£§H人口§!使其获得§H蜂巢思维§!
虚境的能量在整个帝国内平等地传播着，降低肉身的负担，将所有的公民拢入更伟大的现实团结感之中。
entries.en: The Shroud's energies are spread throughout the empire democratically, lessening the burdens of corporeal life and drawing all citizens into a greater sense of physical unity.

entries.zh: 让我们的领袖在年幼时就开始心灵训练，就可以塑造出精英灵能使骨干，获得我们现在不敢企及的强大灵能力。
entries.en: By beginning the psychic training of our leaders at a young age, they can be sculpted into a cadre of elite telepaths capable of psionic abilities we can only currently imagine.

entries.zh: 伟大的统治者以其肉身代表着虚境的力量，将灵能转化为统治权威。没有什么能够阻挡他的终极愿景。
entries.en: The great ruler embodies the Shroud's power in corporeal form, translating psionic energy into governing might. Nothing can stand in the way of their ultimate vision.

entries.zh: 帝国的血脉是虚境活力的通路。在子民的自愿慷慨下，这份力量被导向用于增强统治者及其子嗣的躯体存在。
entries.en: The imperial lineage is a conduit of vitality from the Shroud. This power is channeled to augment the physical forms of the ruler and their heirs, at the generosity of our willing populace.

entries.zh: 如果浪费虚境馈赠的脑力优势就太愚蠢了。该企业以在周围文明建立$building_psionic_offices$闻名，进一步提高了星际交易的利润。
entries.en: It would be foolish to squander the mental advantages the Shroud provides. This corporation is known for establishing $building_psionic_offices$ in neighboring civilizations, furthering the profitability of foreign trade deals.

entries.zh: 他们对虚境的调和能力强大到能在这个集体的物理形态中产生共鸣。
entries.en: The strength of their attunement to the Shroud resonates through this collective's physical forms.

entries.zh: 通过将它们的网络编穿进迷雾重重的灵能涌流——虚境之中，这些机器实现了近乎瞬时的数据传输。每一个字节都蕴含着强大的灵能意志，这种配置能够极大地影响周围的物理空间。
entries.en: By threading their networks through the veiled currents of the Shroud, these machines achieve near-instantaneous data transfer. Each byte imbued with a potent psionic will, this configuration is capable of greatly influencing the physical space around it.

entries.zh: 内阁议程提早颁行花费
灵能使集体与虚境的能量协调。他们的旋律在帝国的灵能人口中回响，将他们的努力汇聚提升。
entries.en: Telepaths gather to harmonize with the energies of the Shroud. Their melodies reverberate within the empire's psionic population, focusing and elevating their efforts.

entries.zh: 一首能够安抚心灵的灵能民谣。\n\n
entries.en: A psionic ballad that stills the mind.\n\n

entries.zh: 一首赞颂自然丰饶的灵能诗赋。\n\n
entries.en: A psionic ode to nature's abundance.\n\n

entries.zh: 一首称颂实业生产的灵能赞诗。\n\n
entries.en: A psionic hymn in praise of industry.\n\n

entries.zh: 一首充满幸福放纵的灵能民歌。\n\n
entries.en: A psionic lay of blissful indulgence.\n\n

entries.zh: 一股带有复杂节奏与旋律的灵能回响。\n\n
entries.en: A psionic resonance of complex patterns and rhythms.\n\n

entries.zh: 该政策控制在接管恒星系时，是否拆解可压制$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$的装置。
entries.en: This policy controls whether or not we will dismantle devices that suppress $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ when taking control of a system.

entries.zh: 压制$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$的装置将被自动拆解。
entries.en: Devices that suppress $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ will be automatically dismantled.

entries.zh: 压制$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$的装置将保留在原位。
entries.en: Devices that suppress $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ will remain in place.

entries.zh: 在接管§H[from.GetName]§!恒星系时，我们发现并随后拆解了可压制我等$PSIONIC_AURA$的机械装置。
entries.en: In taking control of the §H[from.GetName]§! system, we have discovered and subsequently dismantled machines capable of suppressing our $PSIONIC_AURA$.

entries.zh: 该物种表现出一种令人费解的能力，在第一次尝试时就能解决复杂的问题。
entries.en: This species exhibits an inexplicable ability to navigate through complex problems on its first attempt.

entries.zh: 需要有灵能天赋的物种
该物种用于容纳神经系统的外壳已经膨大到限制其身体机能的程度。
entries.en: The frame of this species' neural encasement has inflated to the point where its physical capabilities have become somewhat limited.

entries.zh: 该物种用于容纳神经系统的外壳膨大到了生物学极限。
entries.en: The frame of this species' neural encasement has inflated to its ultimate biological limit.

entries.zh: 来自其他维度的实体将令人疯狂的幻景送入该物种的意识中，影响其执行复杂任务的能力。
entries.en: Entities from other dimensions send maddening visions into the minds of this species, affecting their ability to perform complex tasks.

entries.zh: §C领袖特质§!\n\n这位领袖能引导自身能量，根据职责产生额外的增益效果。
entries.en: §CLeader Trait§!\n\nThis leader channels their energy into additional beneficial effects based on their role.

entries.zh: 鼓动其他帝国向§H[Recipient.GetName]§!发起战争。
entries.en: Incite other empires to engage in war against §H[Recipient.GetName]§!.
§H[Actor.GetName]§! has started a proxy war against §H[Recipient.GetName]§!.

entries.en: Declare attackers with a respective War Goal to begin the conflict.

entries.en: §GAdd or remove proposed attackers by clicking on them in the lists on the left.§!

entries.en: Selecting this §HCasus Belli§! will cost the following:

entries.zh: 利用恶意的流言蜚语发动战争。胜利时进攻方获得所宣称的恒星系，且因征服恒星系产生的§Y威胁§!降低§Y33%§!。
entries.en: War is waged from hostile rumors and hidden whispers. Upon victory the attacker gains control of any claimed systems and generates §Y33%§! less §YThreat§! for each conquered system.

entries.zh:
我们被骗了。

我们的情报人员截获了来自§H[from.GetName]§!的秘密通讯，发现他们密谋将我们拖入代理人战争。

他们极力否认任何牵涉，但我们与他们的关系已经受损。
entries.en:
We were fooled.

Our intelligence operatives intercepted covert communications from the §H[from.GetName]§!. These revealed their plot to plunge us into a proxy war.

They have vehemently denied any involvement, but the damage to our relationship is already done.

entries.zh: $shroud.5055.desc.common$他们的表里不一很快传遍整个星系，严重损害了[from.GetName]的声誉。
entries.en: $shroud.5055.desc.common$ News of their duplicity has spread rapidly, adversely affecting the reputation of the [from.GetName] throughout the galaxy.

entries.zh: 虽然我们成功挑起了冲突，但行动并未完全按照计划进行。我们的一个特工的通讯被截获，导致我们暗中的行动被所有相关方知晓。\n\n我们试图辩解，但毫无用处。
entries.en: Though we managed to incite a conflict, the operation did not go entirely to plan. One of our agents' communications was intercepted, revealing our covert actions to all parties involved.\n\nOur attempts to explain away the affair were ineffective.

entries.zh: $shroud.5060.desc.common$此事件不仅损害了我们与参战方的关系，还在星系范围内玷污了我们的声誉。
entries.en: $shroud.5060.desc.common$ Not only has this event harmed our relationships with the belligerents, but the scandal has damaged our reputation on a galactic scale.

entries.zh: $shroud.5060.desc.common$此事件严重损害了我们与参战方的关系。
entries.en: $shroud.5060.desc.common$ This event has significantly harmed our relationships with the belligerents.

entries.zh: 卷入§Y代理人战争§!的帝国对我们的评价改变：§R-200§!
entries.en: Empires involved in the §YProxy War§! have their opinion of us changed by: §R-200§!

entries.zh: 代理人战争准备遭曝光
挑起代理人战争的阴谋被参战各方揭露。这在广泛范围内损害了我们的声誉。
entries.en: The machinations that caused a proxy war were discovered by the parties involved in the conflict. This has caused widespread damage to our reputation.

entries.zh: 参战的对手发现是我们挑起了代理人战争。\n$shroud.5060.a.tt$
entries.en: The belligerents involved discovered that we caused the proxy war.\n$shroud.5060.a.tt$

entries.zh: 我们发现§H$INSTIGATOR$§!密谋将我们拖入代理人战争。\n我们对§H$INSTIGATOR$§!的评价改变：§R-200§!
entries.en: We discovered that the §H$INSTIGATOR$§! schemed to plunge us into a proxy war.\nOur opinion of §H$INSTIGATOR$§! changed by: §R-200§!
The Cycle of Fortune Has Begun
Each cycle lasts for a period of §H13§! years.

entries.zh: 在该占星循环中，将施加以下效果：
entries.en: During this astrological cycle, the following effects apply:
The Cycle of Omens Has Begun
The Cycle of Growth Has Begun
The Cycle of Prosperity Has Begun
The Cycle of Conflict Has Begun
The Cycle of Harmony Has Begun
The Cycle of Knowledge Has Begun

entries.zh: 我们现在可以潜入虚境更深处了。
entries.en: We are currently able to delve deeper into the Shroud.

entries.zh:
这里是§S虚境§!选项卡。左侧的面板展示了帝国在虚境中的位置，由归属于四个被称为§S超主§!的灵能实体的§S灵域§!所代表。

我们当前的位置由§S$concept_attunement$§!决定，可凭借在物质领域中的活动而获得某位超主的青睐获得。累积$concept_attunement$能够揭示超主的身份。一旦超主身份被揭示，即可点击超主的灵域打开这位超主的面板。

点击§S$DELVE$§!或左侧面板的中央即可进入虚境并探索灵能界。在探索过程中，领域内我们的$concept_attunement$位置可能影响发现结果。
entries.en:
This is the §SShroud§! tab. The left panel visualizes our empire's position in the Shroud, represented by the §Sdomains§! of four psionic entities known as §SPatrons§!.

Our position is determined by §S$concept_attunement$§!, which is gained when an action in the physical realm finds favor with a Patron. Gain $concept_attunement$ to begin the process of revealing a Patron's identity. Once revealed, click a Patron's domain to open the Patron panel.

Click §S$DELVE$§! or the center of the left panel to enter the Shroud and explore the psionic realm. While exploring, what we discover may be influenced by our $concept_attunement$ position within the domains.

entries.zh: §S超主§!面板展示了与虚境超主相关的信息与选项。完成§S$concept_callings$§!和§S$concept_deeds$§!即可提升对应超主的§S$concept_attunement$§!。\n\n提升$concept_attunement$可以解锁§S$PASSIVE_ACCORDS$§!，为帝国带来增益。当$concept_attunement$提升到一定程度后即可启动签订§S契约§!的流程，这会进一步获得更多强力效果。
entries.en: The §SPatron§! panel provides information and options relating to a Shroud Patron. Complete the objectives provided by §S$concept_callings$§! and §S$concept_deeds$§! to gain §S$concept_attunement$§! with this particular entity.\n\nIncrease $concept_attunement$ to unlock §S$PASSIVE_ACCORDS$§!, which provide advantages for our empire. Gain significant $concept_attunement$ to a Patron to begin the process of forming a §SCovenant§!, which will yield even more substantial effects.

entries.zh: 正式与一位虚境超主签订一份§S契约§!将解锁§S$ACTIVE_ACCORDS$§!。$tutorial.shroud_covenant.shared$
entries.en: Confirming a §SCovenant§! with a Shroud Patron grants access to §S$ACTIVE_ACCORDS$§!. $tutorial.shroud_covenant.shared$

entries.zh: 点击$ACTIVE_ACCORD$按钮可以消耗一定的£sr_zro£§S$sr_zro$§!来激活对应修正。在虚境面板或者超主面板均可执行这项操作。\n\n激活修正后，$ACTIVE_ACCORD$需要经过一段冷却时间才能再次激活。
entries.en: Click on a $ACTIVE_ACCORD$ icon to activate its effects at a cost of £sr_zro£ §S$sr_zro$§!. This can be done in the main Shroud panel or the individual Patron panel.\n\nAfter activation, a $ACTIVE_ACCORD$ requires a period of time to recharge before it can be activated again.

entries.zh: 我们现在有办法获得某些力量，这通常需要与§S超主§!签订§S契约§!。\n\n一旦我们解锁了超主的两个§S$PASSIVE_ACCORDS$§!，我们就能获得一个§S$ACTIVE_ACCORD$§!。$tutorial.shroud_covenant.shared$
entries.en: We now have the means to gain certain powers that normally require a §SCovenant§! with a §SPatron§!.\n\nOnce we have unlocked both of a Patron's §S$PASSIVE_ACCORDS$§!, we will then be granted access to a §S$ACTIVE_ACCORD$§!. $tutorial.shroud_covenant.shared$

entries.zh:
有灵能人口定居的殖民地能够散发§S$PSIONIC_AURA$§!。光环来源于我们当前§S$concept_attunement$§!最高的§S虚境超主§!。

$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$在为帝国提供多种多样的修正效果的同时，也能对友好或者敌对国家施加影响。我们如果想要扩大光环的范围，就需要通过与超主进一步调和来解锁£research£§S$tech_aura_intensification$§!科技。

打开§S虚境§!选项卡或者将鼠标悬停在正下方£interface£§S恒星系预览§!面板中的的光环图标上均可以查看$PSIONIC_AURA$的效果。
entries.en:
Our colonies with psionic populations now have the ability to emit a §S$PSIONIC_AURA$§!. This Aura is drawn from the §SShroud Patron§! with which we currently have the highest §S$concept_attunement$§!.

$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ have varying effects on our own empire, and can also affect friendly or hostile empires. To expand our Aura into more systems, we will need to more fully attune to a Patron in order to unlock £research£ §S$tech_aura_intensification$§! technology.

To observe the effects of our $PSIONIC_AURA$, open the §SShroud§! tab or hover over the Aura icon on the bottom-center panel in £interface£ §SSystem View§!.

entries.zh:
§S$PSIONIC_AURA$§!能够提高§S强度§!并向外扩散到其他恒星系。

$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$有三个强度等级，分别产生不同的效果。$PSIONIC_AURA$在提升强度等级或强度提升至最大值时，会试着向临近恒星系扩散。大多数$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$的扩散距离有上限。‘

有多种途径能够增强光环，例如繁衍更多$trait_psionic$人口、提升£happiness£§S幸福度§!、增加£job_telepath£[GetTelepathCap]岗位数量，以及在£sector£星域中雇佣具有灵能能力的总督或者£leader£领袖。
entries.en:
Our §S$PSIONIC_AURA$§! now has the ability to gain §SIntensity§! and spread into other systems.

$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ can reach three thresholds of Intensity, with scaling effects. If a $PSIONIC_AURA$ reaches a new level of Intensity, or maximizes its Intensity, it will attempt to spread to adjacent systems. Most $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ have a maximum range they can spread from their source.

Aura Intensity can be increased through various means, such as high $trait_psionic$ populations, £happiness£ §SHappiness§! levels, £job_telepath£ [GetTelepathCap] Jobs, and Psychic Governors or £leader£ Leaders of £sector£ Sectors.

entries.zh: §S$PSIONIC_AURA$§!可能会与另一个扩散到相邻星系的光环发生冲突。一旦出现这种情况，这两个光环就会相互对抗，并决出最终由哪个光环来实控该恒星系。\n\n对抗的结果取决于双方光环每月§S强度§!增长，可以将鼠标悬停在正下方£interface£§S恒星系预览§!面板中的光环图标来查看这一过程。
entries.en: Our §S$PSIONIC_AURA$§! has encountered another Aura in an adjacent connected system. When this occurs, the two Auras may compete to determine which will spread into the other system.\n\nThis process depends on the monthly §SIntensity§! gain of each opposing Aura, which can be observed by hovering over the Aura icon on the bottom-center panel in £interface£ §SSystem View§!.

entries.zh: 虚境中散发出的灵能能将实体的意欲带入现实世界。与虚境超主调和的帝国从灵能人口密集的地区释放$PSIONIC_AURA$。
entries.en: Psionic emanations from the Shroud bring an entity's favor into corporeal reality. An empire attuned to a Shroud patron will emit a $PSIONIC_AURA$ from where their psionic populations are concentrated.

entries.zh: 使与虚境超主调和的帝国从灵能人口密集的地区释放$PSIONIC_AURA$。
entries.en: Allow an empire attuned to a Shroud patron to emit a $PSIONIC_AURA$ from where their psionic populations are concentrated.

entries.zh: 虚境中溢出的灵能渴望扩张。理解了这一点后，帝国的$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$就能提升强度，并沿着恒星系传播，从而增强盟友削弱敌手。
entries.en: Psionic emanations from the Shroud long to expand. With this new understanding, an empire's $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ can increase in intensity and spread throughout star systems, bringing benefits to allies and disadvantages to foes.

entries.zh: 允许$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$向周边星系散播，最多可跨越§Y[Owner.GetAuraHyperlaneRange]§!条超空间航道。
entries.en: Allow $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ to spread to neighboring systems, up to §Y[Owner.GetAuraHyperlaneRange]§! hyperlanes from the emitting source.

entries.zh: 能够衰减灵能能量的装置，其建造难度与理解难度不相上下。处理跨维度力量便是如此复杂。
entries.en: Devices that attenuate psionic energy are as difficult to construct as they are to understand. Such is the complexity of dealing with extradimensional forces.

entries.zh: $i_unlocks_feature$解锁建造§Y虚境封印§!和§Y灵能抑制器§!的能力。
entries.en: $i_unlocks_feature$ Unlocks the ability to construct §YShroud Seals§! and §YPsionic Suppressors§!.

entries.zh: 有一种方法可以将$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$投射到人口稠密的星球以外。只要有$sm_aura_emitter$，即使是恒星基地也可以作为灵能从虚境溢出的渠道。
entries.en: There is a way to project $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ beyond populated worlds. With the addition of an $sm_aura_emitter$, even a starbase can become a conduit for psionic emanations from the Shroud.

entries.zh: 这些小巧灵活的舰载机专用于投放高浓度灵能弹药。目标越大，爆炸所能产生的共振就越强。
entries.en: These small and nimble craft specialize in delivering concentrated payloads of psionic energy. The larger the target, the greater resonance its explosions achieve.

entries.zh: 通过暂时在舰船之间建立灵能链接，可以直接释放一波心灵能量造成毁灭性影响。这种原始能量能够扰乱舰船系统，影响其中船员的思想。
entries.en: By establishing a temporary psionic connection between one ship and another, a direct charge of mental power can be discharged to devastating effect. Such raw energy is capable of confusing ship systems and influencing the minds of the crew within.

entries.zh: 概率使军用舰船['concept_terrify']£time£§Y5-10§!天，视目标舰船尺寸而定。
entries.en: Chance to ['concept_terrify'] Military Ships for £time£ §Y5-10§! Days, based on Target Ship Size.

entries.zh: 陷入恐惧的舰船将会停止攻击并逃离攻击者方向。
entries.en: Terrified ships will stop attacking and flee their attacker.

entries.zh: 这种极先进的裂解炮释放强力的灵能能量光矛刺穿船体，可以定向瘫痪敌军武器系统。
entries.en: These highly-advanced disruptors fire a powerful lance of psionic energy through enemy hulls, allowing for the targeted disabling of hostile weaponry.

entries.zh: 这种高浓度$zro_lower$弹丸可以在多重现实之间相移，从而不受干扰地透过敌军护盾。一旦与实物接触，其破坏效果将呈指数级增长。
entries.en: These highly concentrated pellets of $zro_lower$ can be dispersed through enemy shields unabated, shifting through multiple realities. Once contact is made with a physical object, the effects are exponential in devastation.

entries.zh: 这些小巧灵活的生物炸弹专用于投放高浓度的灵能弹药。目标越大，爆炸所能产生的共振就越强。
entries.en: These small and nimble biological explosives specialize in delivering concentrated payloads of psionic energy. The larger the target, the greater resonance its explosions achieve.

entries.zh: 由电流与以太能量构成的致命混合体。这些生物电腺体能够产生武器化的燃烧等离子束，并注入灵能属性。
entries.en: A deadly amalgamation of electrical charges and ethereal energy. These bioelectric glands generate weaponized bolts of burning plasma infused with psionic properties.

entries.zh: 这种极先进的裂解炮释放强力的灵能能量光矛刺穿船体，可以定向瘫痪敌军武器系统。
entries.en: These highly-advanced disruptors fire a powerful lance of psionic energy through enemy hulls, allowing for the targeted disabling of hostile weaponry.

entries.zh: 这些高度集中的$zro_lower$喷发物可以在多重现实之间相移，使得绝大部分能量可以不受干扰地穿透敌方护盾。一旦最终与实体物体接触，其破坏效果将呈指数级增长。
entries.en: These highly concentrated eruptions of $zro_lower$ shift through multiple realities, allowing most to be dispersed through enemy shields unabated. Once contact is eventually made with a physical object, the effects are exponential in devastation.

entries.zh: $sm_aura_emitter$可以建立灵能能量的投射通路，使得恒星基地也能释放$PSIONIC_AURA$。\n
entries.en: The $sm_aura_emitter$ establishes a fixed conduit for projected psionic energy, allowing a starbase to emanate a $PSIONIC_AURA$.\n

entries.zh: 该恒星系包含一座$SHROUD_SEAL$，会削弱附近的§Y$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!。它只能由恒星系所有者拆解。
entries.en: This system contains a $SHROUD_SEAL$, weakening nearby §Y$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!. It can only be dismantled by the system owner.

entries.zh: 这台复杂的机器释放可以中和灵能能量的低频率波，以此驱散并逐渐消除$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$。
entries.en: This sophisticated machine emits low-frequency waves capable of counteracting psionic energy, thereby dissipating and eventually nullifying $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$.

entries.zh: 该§Y$SHROUD_SEAL$§!能压制附近的§Y$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!并降低§Y灵能舰船组件§!的效能。
entries.en: The §Y$SHROUD_SEAL$§! attenuates nearby §Y$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§! and reduces the effectiveness of §YPsionic Ship Components§!.
$TRIGGER_FAIL$Cannot build due to existing $SHROUD_SEAL$ in the system.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$该恒星系中存在敌军，我们无法安全拆解$SHROUD_SEAL$。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Hostiles in this system prevent us from safely dismantling the $SHROUD_SEAL$.

entries.zh: 一群经历激烈实验治疗提高了进攻性和战斗能力的奴隶兵，几乎已经被改造为活体兵器。他们对主人卑躬屈膝，但在战斗中大开杀戒。
entries.en: Enslaved soldiers who have undergone drastic experimental treatments to increase their aggression and martial capabilities, transforming them into living weapons. They are as subservient to their masters as they are fierce in battle.

entries.zh: 这些特化单位接受了反灵能技术与战术的全面训练，因此成为对抗心灵入侵目标的强大对手。
entries.en: These specialized units have received extensive training in anti-psionic techniques and technologies, making them powerful opponents against mind-invading targets.

entries.zh: 向潜在利益相关者推广特许经营机会的殖民地办事处，负责授权建立独立的实验计划。打击犯罪，加强防御！
entries.en: A colonial office that promotes franchising opportunities to prospective stakeholders, empowering them to establish their own experimental testing programs. Bring down crime and scale up defense!

entries.zh: 在实地接触外国人士时，能更有效地理解他们的思维方式，从而为双方达成最有利的贸易协议。
entries.en: The complexities of foreign minds can be navigated more effectively while in their physical presence, allowing the most lucrative of trade deals to be established for both sides.

entries.zh:
恒星系效果：
$t$—$TRIGGER_BRANCH_OFFICE_OWNER$获得一个每月强度$@psionic_offices_intensity|0+$的§Y$PSIONIC_AURA$§!
$t$—§R殖民地拥有者释放的$PSIONIC_AURA$将优先于本建筑。§!
entries.en:
System Effects:
$t$- Emits a §Y$PSIONIC_AURA$§! for the $TRIGGER_BRANCH_OFFICE_OWNER$ with $@psionic_offices_intensity|0+$ Monthly Intensity
$t$- §RAny means of $PSIONIC_AURA$ emission from the colony's owner takes priority over this building.§!

entries.zh: 这些专家洞察本地市场的情感风向，通过捕捉当下思潮动态促成交易并举办领导力前沿研讨会。
entries.en: These experts attune to the emotional zeitgeist in the local markets, striking deals and hosting seminars on current trends in thought leadership.

entries.zh: 用于对无可救药的违法者进行实验的最高机密设施，里面大部分由牢房和研究实验室构成。
entries.en: A top-secret facility for experimenting on incorrigible lawbreakers, mostly comprising prison cells and research laboratories.

entries.zh: 最高机密科研及拘留设施构成的园区，以违法[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]作为对象，供帝国顶级[Owner.GetResearchers]进行实验研究。
entries.en: A campus of top-secret technology and internment facilities, where lawbreaking [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] are used as subjects in experiments led by the empire's top [Owner.GetResearchers].

entries.zh: 拥有最高安保等级的实验及拘留体系中枢。精英[Owner.GetResearchers]团队负责利用从帝国的下层社会抽选的[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]进行开创性实验。
entries.en: A network of maximum-security technology and internment centers. Teams of elite [Owner.GetResearchers] conduct pioneering experiments on [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] drawn from the empire's underworld.

entries.zh: 这些巨大的装置能从附近的特定人群中抽提多余的能量。这些指定个体穿着专门的设备，将生命力输送到中央管道中，再分配给地位更高的人。
entries.en: These monumental devices are capable of draining excess energies from dedicated populations in close proximity. Assigned individuals wear specialized equipment which funnel their life force into a central conduit where it can then be redistributed to those of higher status.

entries.zh: 这个名字可能让人产生误解，但灵魂虹吸装置确实是基于实用科学的。它们经过特殊校准，通过身体系绳从个体身上抽提能量，能在不危及生命的情况下抽调生物体的大量新陈代谢。
entries.en: While their name may imply otherwise, Soul Siphons are based in practical science. Calibrated specifically to harvest energies from individuals via physical tether, they are capable of sapping immense amounts of metabolism from organisms without endangering their lives.

entries.zh: 精髓管道的边界必须明确标记，对没有适当装备的人而言，在其影响范围内游荡是致命的。被指派的个体需要训练调节新陈代谢，以避免一次消耗过多的能量。
entries.en: The boundaries of Essence Conduits must be clearly marked, for wandering within its area of influence can be fatal to those without the proper equipment. Assigned individuals are trained to regulate their metabolisms so as not to donate too much of their energy at once.

entries.zh: 这些巨大的设备能够从近距离的专用无人机中抽提多余的运算能量。指派的工作者装有专用设备，将电池输送到中央管道中，再分配给更重要的部分。
entries.en: These monumental devices are capable of draining excess processing energy from dedicated drones in close proximity. Assigned workers wear specialized equipment which funnel their batteries into a central conduit where it can then be redistributed to those of higher purpose.

entries.zh: 这些装置经过特殊校准，通过身体系绳从无人机上抽提能量，能在不导致严重故障的情况下抽调大量剩余算力。
entries.en: Calibrated specifically to harvest energies from drones via physical tether, these devices are capable of sapping immense amounts of excess processing without inflicting critical faults.

entries.zh: 电池节点的边界必须明确标记，对没有适当绝缘装备的单元而言，进入其影响范围内是致命的。
entries.en: The boundaries of the Battery Nexus must be clearly marked, as entering within its area of influence can be fatal to units without the proper insulative equipment.

entries.zh: 这些巨大的装置能从附近的特定工蜂中抽提多余的能量。这些指定工蜂穿着专门的设备，将生命力输送到中央管道中，再分配给地位更高者。
entries.en: These monumental devices are capable of draining excess energies from dedicated drones in close proximity. Assigned workers wear specialized equipment which funnel their life force into a central conduit where it can then be redistributed to those of higher caste.

entries.zh: 这个名字可能让人产生误解，但灵魂虹吸装置确实是基于实用科学的。它们经过特殊校准，通过身体系绳从工蜂身上抽提能量，能在不危及生命的情况下抽调生物体的大量新陈代谢。
entries.en: While their name may imply otherwise, Soul Siphons are based in practical science. Calibrated specifically to harvest energies from drones via physical tether, they are capable of sapping immense amounts of metabolism from organisms without endangering their lives.

entries.zh: 精髓管道的边界必须明确标记，对没有适当装备的工蜂而言，在其影响范围内游荡是致命的。被指派的工蜂需要训练调节新陈代谢，以避免一次消耗过多的能量。
entries.en: The boundaries of Essence Conduits must be clearly marked, as entering within its area of influence can be fatal to drones without the proper equipment. Assigned workers are trained to regulate their metabolisms so as not to donate too much of their energy at once.

entries.zh: 这些巨大的装置能从附近的特定实习生中抽提多余的能量。这些指定个体穿着专门的设备，将生命力输送到中央管道中，再分配给职位更高的人。
entries.en: These monumental devices are capable of draining excess energies from dedicated interns in close proximity. Assigned individuals wear specialized equipment which funnel their life force into a central conduit where it can then be redistributed to those in senior positions.

entries.zh: 协同管理机构建筑经过特殊校准，通过身体系绳从实习生身上抽提能量，能在不危及生命的情况下抽调大量新陈代谢水平。
entries.en: Calibrated specifically to harvest energies from individuals via physical tether, the Synergy Administration buildings are capable of sapping immense amounts of metabolism from interns without endangering their lives to any appreciable degree.

entries.zh: 协同中枢的边界必须明确标记，对没有适当装备的人而言，在其影响范围内游荡是致命的。被指派的个体需要训练掌握先进的协同技术，以确保在该过程中幸存。
entries.en: The boundaries of the Synergy Nexus must be clearly marked, for wandering within its area of influence can be fatal to interns without the proper equipment. Assigned individuals are trained in advanced synergy techniques to ensure their ultimate survival throughout this process.

entries.zh: 这座复合体支持着一整座长程灵能衰减器，可以使整个恒星系内的$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$消散，并抑制其进一步传播。
entries.en: This complex supports an array of long-range psionic attenuators, which dissipate $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ throughout the star system and prevent their further spread.

entries.zh: 虚境的灵能能量毗邻着物理宇宙的每一个点。$building_materiality_engine$正是利用这种位面交界处，使其可以触及其他维度，将有用的部件和资源进行物质具现化。
entries.en: The psionic energy of the Shroud adjoins every point in the physical galaxy. The $building_materiality_engine$ exploits this interface, making it possible to reach across dimensions and materialize valuable components and resources.

entries.zh: 发起§Y特殊项目§!，从§H虚境§!中衍生出灵能['concept_component']科技。项目完成时，将提高该建筑的技术以及所能建造的§H$building_materiality_engine_plural$§!数量。
entries.en: Initiates a §YSpecial Project§! to derive psionic ['concept_component'] technology from the §HShroud§!. When this project is complete, it increases the output of this building and the amount of §H$building_materiality_engine_plural$§! that can be built.

entries.zh:
我们的怀疑得到了确认。[first_neighbor.GetAdjective]与[second_neighbor.GetAdjective]的文明证实，他们在正式进行外交之前，曾通过非正式渠道开展过联系。

这些§H派系§!如今从我们的阴影中现身，承认了他们的存在。它们被称为§H$pft_the_curtain$§!、§H$pft_the_masquerade$§!以及§H$pft_the_grand_dance$§!。这群曾经的秘密组织如今正公开请求与我们展开正式对话。

至于它们想要什么，以及它们是如何知晓所知之事，我们也许永远无法真正知道。但为了我们的最佳利益，也许我们应当遵循他们的命令行事。
entries.en:
Our suspicions have been justified. The [first_neighbor.GetAdjective] and [second_neighbor.GetAdjective] civilizations have confirmed they have been contacted through unofficial channels before more formal communications began.

These §HFactions§! now emerge from our own shadows and acknowledge their existence. Known as §H$pft_the_curtain$§!, §H$pft_the_masquerade$§! and §H$pft_the_grand_dance$§!, these once-secret organizations are now openly requesting formal dialogue with us.

What they want, and how they know what they know, may never truly be understood by us. It may be in our best interest to operate within their demands.

entries.zh:
在我们之中，有些人暗中操纵着外交事务。现在我们怀疑，他们的触角已不仅仅局限于我们的母星。

尽管我们才刚开始探索星空，却以惊人的速度与其他生命形式建立了联系。这似乎不仅仅是巧合。我们怀疑，这些星际关系源于几个秘密的§H派系§!的幕后运作，而这些派系已经深深扎根于我们的社会之中。

也许当我们对这些生物了解更多之后，隐匿于暗影中的势力自会显露真容。
entries.en:
There are those among us who operate behind the curtains of diplomacy. Now we suspect their reach is not limited to our homeworld.

Despite only recently venturing into the stars, we have entered communications with other life forms with remarkable ease. This seems like more than coincidence. We suspect that these interstellar relationships originate behind the closed doors of several secret §HFactions§! that have deeply embedded themselves within our society.

Perhaps once we know more about these beings, those within our shadows will reveal themselves.

entries.zh: 他们是支持我们？还是反对我们？
entries.en: Are they with us, or against us?

entries.zh:
与一个既无法定义也无法理解的实体间的空灵联系……我们一直都了然于心。

[This.GetTheChosenP2]

在我们刚有历史记录以来，这个神秘的事物便一直存在于此。显然，祂选中了我们……但是，原因不得而知。

我们应该如何描述这种[This.GetSensation]呢？
entries.en:
We have always known it... an ethereal connection with an entity we can neither define nor understand.

[This.GetTheChosenP2]

For as long as we have historical records, this mysterious thing has been there. That it has chosen us is clear... But, for what remains unknown.

By what name should we call this [This.GetSensation]?

entries.zh: 我们可以在思绪的最深处感受到祂的存在。祂徘徊不去，又遥不可及。祂在我们的脑中是一个既确定又不可能的存在。
entries.en: We feel its presence in our deepest thoughts. It lingers, always somehow out of reach. It is both a certainty and an impossibility in our minds.

entries.zh: 我们在最复杂演算中检测到其存在。祂徘徊不去，又遥不可及。祂在我们的电路中是一个既确定又不可能的存在。
entries.en: We detect its presence in our most complex calculations. It lingers, always somehow out of reach. It is both a certainty and an impossibility in our circuits.

entries.zh: 在历史长河中，被称为§H[GetChosenPatron]§!的难以名状的存在一直与我们同在。如今，宽广的星系等待着我们，我们愈发深刻地在[GetMindPhysicalLoc]中[GetFeelLoc]到祂的存在。\n\n祂徘徊不去，招徕着我们。随着距离的接近，我们第一次注意到[GetMindLogicLoc]深处这个神秘空间的真实轮廓。[GetChosenPatron]呼唤着我们进去，
entries.en: Throughout our history, the ineffable entity we know as the §H[GetChosenPatron]§! has been with us. Now, as the vast expanse of the galaxy awaits, we [GetFeelLoc] its presence in our [GetMindPhysicalLoc] like never before.\n\nIt lingers, drawing us closer. With the proximity, we notice - for the first time - the true contours of this deep and mysterious void within our own [GetMindLogicLoc]. The [GetChosenPatron] beckons us in

entries.zh: 终于，我们理解了如何依靠自己的意志造访这片虚幻领域。
entries.en: Finally, we understand how to visit this ethereal domain of our own volition.

entries.en: $shroud.5110.desc_common$, tempting us with experiences beyond our comprehension.\n\n$shroud.5110.desc_common_2$

entries.en: $shroud.5110.desc_common$, streamlining our parameters in line with some as yet unknown principles.\n\n$shroud.5110.desc_common_2$

entries.zh: 我们的视野向内扩展了。
获得该实体的§Y调和度§!：$@chosen_patron_attunement_gift|0G$\n可以通过§Y通讯§!菜单访问§Y虚境§!面板。
entries.en: Gain §YAttunement§! with this entity: $@chosen_patron_attunement_gift|0G$\nThe §YShroud§! panel is accessible via the §YContacts§! menu.

entries.zh:
虚境。它潜藏于我们已知的现实之下，如同黑暗投下的阴影。

虽然我们早已涉足这个灵能领域，但早期的尝试只是试探性的。现在，经过多年用我们集体的意志消磨维度之间的帷幕，我们已经能够清晰地感知到它，从而有目的地探索。

在帷幕的另一侧，我们的努力并非无人知晓。§H[GetChosenPatron]§!正等待着我们。
entries.en:
The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, a shadow cast by darkness.

Though we have long ventured into this psionic realm, our earlier forays were only tentative. Now, after years spent wearing down the veil between dimensions with our combined minds, we sense it clearly enough to explore with purpose.

On the other side, our efforts have not gone unnoticed. The §H[GetChosenPatron]§! awaits us.

entries.zh: 在这无数实体的漩涡中，它的清晰是一种承诺。
entries.en: In this maelstrom of countless entities, its clarity is a promise.

entries.zh: 我们，被选中者，乃是超主灵能恩典的传导之器。
entries.en: We, the chosen, are conduits of our patron's psionic grace.

entries.zh: 我们的§Y[GetChosenCivicName]§!国民理念§P将被移除§!。
该社会的成员在专门的生物溶液罐中度过一生。因此他们严重依赖辅助设备，无法直接从事体力劳动。
entries.en: This society's members live out their existences suspended in vats of specialized bio-fluids. As such, they are heavily reliant on assistive equipment and incapable of engaging directly in physical work.

entries.en: Proxy Wars can be initiated through §HDiplomacy§!. To start a Proxy War, you must have sufficient §HTrust§! or §HInfiltration§!.

entries.en: Secret Society Factions increase §HDiplomatic Weight§!, §HInfiltration Speed§!, and §HTrust Growth§! instead of $i_unity$.

entries.zh: §H召唤§!是一种时间敏感的任务，如果顺利完成将会提高与虚境中的一位§H超主§!的§H调和度§!。
entries.en: §HCallings§! are time-sensitive tasks that, if completed successfully, will increase §HAttunement§! with a §HPatron§! in the Shroud.

entries.zh: §H行契§!是用于提升或降低帝国与虚境中的一位§H超主§!的§H调和度§!的行为。
entries.en: §HDeeds§! are actions that increase or decrease an empire's §HAttunement§! with a §HPatron§! in the Shroud.

entries.zh: 一颗壮丽的彗星激励了我们的人民。
entries.en: A majestic comet inspires our population.

entries.zh: 这颗有威胁的彗星对我们的人口产生了负面的影响。
entries.en: The menacing comet has a negative influence on our population.

entries.zh: 虚境吞噬了这片土地的一部分。
entries.en: The Shroud has consumed a portion of this land.

entries.zh: 尝试刺穿虚境导致了当地野生动物的袭击。我们暂时封存了这片区域，但只要投入适当资源可以永久封上这个传送门。
entries.en: Attempting to pierce the Shroud caused a rash of attacks by local wildlife. We have temporarily sealed the area, but can permanently close this portal with proper resources.

entries.zh: 这座残破的高塔曾是宏伟神殿，如今依然巍然矗立，令人追忆当年盘踞于此的灵能教派的总部。
entries.en: Once a high temple, this ruined tower is an imposing reminder of the psionic cult that was headquartered therein.

entries.zh: 将$PATRON$设置为$COUNTRY$偏好的虚境超主
§L该选择将影响我们灵能飞升的结果。§!
entries.en: §LThis choice will affect the outcome of our psionic ascension.§!

entries.zh: 假面舞会在星系剧场的舞台中央。聚光灯下是他们的最耀眼的表演，而幕后则是更黑暗的创作。
entries.en: The Masquerade sits center stage in the galactic theater. The spotlight shines brightest on their performance while darker works unfold behind the scenes.

entries.en: The Curtain opens and closes as necessary, allowing the people to see only what needs to be seen.

entries.en: The Grand Dance exercises a carefully choreographed series of steps and turns designed to weave their way through political environments while remaining untouched.

entries.zh: $TITLE$负责把从广大人口中收集到的能量进行妥善分配。需要精心平衡才能避免下层社会的效率底下。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ is responsible for the proper allocation of energy collected from the general population. Careful balance is required in order to prevent inefficiency at the lowest levels of society.

entries.zh: $TITLE$负责把从自愿的实习生中收集到的能量进行妥善分配。这些能量可以在高层及的业务经理手里获得充分利用。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ is responsible for the proper allocation of metabolism collected from willing interns. These energies can be put to better use in the higher levels of business management.

entries.zh: $TITLE$暗中管理着许多帝国的政治事务，但明面上的职位是副协调官。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ secretly manages various political aspects of the empire, but carries the official title of Deputy Coordinator.

entries.zh: $TITLE$暗中管理着许多帝国的政治事务，但明面上的职位是协调官助理。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ secretly manages various political aspects of the empire, but carries the official title of Assistant Coordinator.

entries.zh: $TITLE$是帝国的最高精神权威，倡导国家对神秘主义者的需求，促进占卜应用在生活的方方面面。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ is the supreme spiritual authority of the empire, who advocates for the needs of state mystics and promotes the use of divination in all spheres of life.

entries.zh: $TITLE$致力于统一全帝国的唯心主义信仰，按照众星的允诺提高占卜效率、加速吉兆显现。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ works to unify spiritual practices throughout the empire, cutting visionary inefficiencies and accelerating fortuitous outcomes as the stars allow.

entries.zh: $TITLE$负责确保研究机构遵守规章制度，以延长活体研究对象的有效使用年限。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ ensures that research institutions adhere to regulations, helping prolong the usefulness of live test subjects.

entries.zh: $TITLE$负责确保各研究机构遵守规章制度，以提高活体测试对象的产出。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ ensures that research centers adhere to corporate policies, enhancing the productivity of live test subjects.

entries.zh: $TITLE$是遏止灵能敌意和犯罪思想的最高权威。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ is the highest authority in staunching the blight of psionic hostility and criminal thoughts.

entries.zh: $TITLE$负责通过与虚境内的感官紧密调和来指导我们祭司的工作。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ guides the work of our Priests by attuning closely to the sensations from within the Shroud.

entries.zh: $TITLE$负责确保我们的祭祀的福音工作服务于最佳经济利益。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ ensures the evangelical work of our Priests serves the best interests of our economy.

entries.zh: $TITLE$负责最大化自动设施的效率，并拥有使用我们社会中最大容器的特权。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ is responsible for maximizing the efficiency of our automated facilities, and is given the privilege of occupying one of the largest containment units in our society.

entries.zh: $TITLE$负责最大化自动设施的效益，并拥有使用我们企业中最大容器的特权。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ is responsible for maximizing the profits of our automated facilities, and is given the privilege of occupying one of the largest executive containment suites in our society.

entries.zh: 人口需要定期安装和检查精华采集植入体，确保能够在接到通知后立即启动。
entries.en: The population is required to have essence harvesting implants installed and inspected on a regular basis. They must be capable of being activated at a moment's notice.
§YLeaders§! will never die of old age.\n

entries.zh: 所有人都必须定期进行体液测试，从中提取关键能量，以供帝国统治内阁使用。
entries.en: Regular fluid tests are mandated for the whole population, through which vital energy is extracted for the benefit of the empire's governing council.

entries.zh: 勘探者在常规的地质分析中加入占卜方法，就能发现更丰富的矿藏。
entries.en: When prospectors add divinatory practices to their conventional geological analyses, they will discover richer veins of resources.

entries.zh: 每一粒尘埃投向火焰，遗忘的炽焰便燃烧得愈加明亮。
entries.en: With each scrap of dust thrown to the flame, the heat of oblivion burns ever brighter.

entries.zh: 熵之舞在其壮丽被我们察觉前，便已旋转了很久。而我们现在只是加快了它的节奏。
entries.en: The dance of entropy has been spinning long before we were aware of its magnificence. We only now raise its tempo.

entries.zh: 在与我们世界所交织的维度中，除了虚境这一维度之外，还存在其他维度。那些维度的力量同样会随着时间而揭开其面纱。
entries.en: There are dimensions other than the Shroud entwined with our own. Their power, too, will unravel with time.

entries.zh: 在精神层面付出的巨大努力使得我们能够唤醒领袖体内的强大力量。
entries.en: With significant mental effort, we can awaken even greater power within our leaders.

entries.zh: $the_animator_of_clay_color_article_cap$为我们的舰队注入了新的活力；它们仿佛拥有了自己的意志。
entries.en: $the_animator_of_clay_color_article_cap$ sparks new life within our fleets; it is as if they have wills of their own.

entries.zh: 那位$the_outsider_color_article$的意图提醒我们前方潜藏的危险。
entries.en: The will of $the_outsider_color_article$ alerts us to the dangers lurking ahead.

entries.zh: $the_golden_dream_color_article_cap$向我们展示了更高层次的休闲形式。
entries.en: $the_golden_dream_color_article_cap$ reveals to us ascended forms of leisure.

entries.zh: $the_endless_tide_color_article_cap$提升了我们对时间本身的看法。
entries.en: $the_endless_tide_color_article_cap$ enhances our perspectives on time itself.
$the_pale_mountain_color_article_cap$ makes, so that it may unmake.
$the_vacant_throne_color_article_cap$ knows the order of all things.
The velocity of $the_black_river_color_article$ sweeps us along the void.

entries.zh: 要新建一座$ENCLAVE_MINDWARDEN$，需要将一支有$commander$领导且规模足够的军事舰队派遣到可用的恒星系中，然后在§H舰队界面§!中选择相关命令。
entries.en: To establish a new $ENCLAVE_MINDWARDEN$, send a $commander$-led military fleet of sufficient size into an eligible system and select the command in §HFleet View§!.

entries.zh: 该§H$end_aura$§!正受到能衰装置的挑战，这些外来机械可衰减灵能。我等受其主宰之意志所驱，必须拆解这些亵渎之器。
entries.en: The §H$end_aura$§! is being challenged by foreign devices capable of psionic attenuation. The will of our patron compels us to dismantle these blasphemous machines.

entries.zh: 位于[prev.GetName]恒星系的$SHROUD_SEAL$挑战了§H$end_aura$§!的伸展。\n\n§R必须将其拆解。§!
entries.en: A $SHROUD_SEAL$ in the [prev.GetName] system challenges the reach of the §H$end_aura$§!.\n\n§RIt must be dismantled.§!

entries.zh: 位于[prev.GetName]的$building_psionic_suppressor$挑战了§H$end_aura$§!的伸展。\n\n§R我们必须摧毁它。§!
entries.en: The $building_psionic_suppressor$ on [prev.GetName] challenges the reach of the §H$end_aura$§!.\n\n§RWe must destroy it.§!

entries.zh: 位于[prev.GetName]的所谓$building_ancient_ward_2$挑战了§H$end_aura$§!的伸展。\n\n§R我们必须摧毁它。§!
entries.en: A so-called $building_ancient_ward_2$ on [prev.GetName] challenges the reach of the §H$end_aura$§!.\n\n§RWe must destroy it.§!

entries.zh: 我们领先机构在富有前景的新研究中取得了意想不到的突破。这纯属意外收获，我们在仪器例行标准化过程中证明了一个长期被认为是误算的理论。现在该重新审视这个曾经被认为是边缘科学的东西了。
entries.en: Promising new research from our leading institutions has reached an unexpected breakthrough. By pure chance, the routine standardization of our instruments proved a theory that was long thought to be a fundamental miscalculation. We can now revisit what was once thought to be fringe science.
Insight gained on a random technology: §G$@good_luck_event_1_insight|0%$§!

entries.zh: §H[mining_planet.GetName]§!上有个此前认为已经完全坍塌的富矿的天然洞穴系统被意外地重新发掘出来。\n\n经过谨慎的风险评估，我们确信在扩大开采作业规模后，这些坑道可以产出极大量的矿物。
entries.en: A system of ore-rich natural caverns previously thought to have collapsed entirely, has been fortuitously rediscovered on §H[mining_planet.GetName]§!.\n\nAfter a careful hazard assessment, we are confident that these tunnels can support significant mineral exploitation with the expansion of existing mining efforts.

entries.zh: 在例行土地探察时意外地发现了§H[This.GetName]§!上大片土地的土壤质量近年来急剧提高。\n\n我们相信许多此前认为不适合耕种的土地现在可以用来扩张农业活动了。
entries.en: A routine land survey has revealed that the soil quality on §H[This.GetName]§! has drastically improved in recent years across large swathes of the planet.\n\nWe believe that many areas once thought incapable of supporting agriculture can now be used to expand our farming efforts.

entries.zh: 一艘渔船在§H[This.GetName]§!的海洋里发现了一处隐蔽的珊瑚礁。过去曾以为这片区域了无生机，但事实上却暗含着一个欣欣向荣的生态系统，满是鱼获。
entries.en: A fishing vessel has discovered a concealed reef in the oceans of §H[This.GetName]§!. The region, previously believed to be deserted and infertile, is in fact supporting a thriving ecosystem of harvestable fauna.

entries.zh: 在一场§H[This.GetName]§!上的地质活动后，有一处大型地下水库之下打开了一道裂口。行星地幔的热量加热着其中贮藏的水，在地表形成了地热喷口。\n\n该自然现象让我们有机会用地热发电站和热泵来拓展殖民地的能源基础设施。
entries.en: Following a tectonic shift, a fissure has opened under a large groundwater reservoir on §H[This.GetName]§!. The heat from the planet's mantle is boiling the trapped water deposit, causing geothermal vents to form on the surface.\n\nThis natural phenomenon provides us with an opportunity to expand the colony's energy infrastructure with new geothermal power plants and heat pumps.

entries.zh: 一个由亚原子元素构成的异常回路已在§H[physics_planet.GetName]§!附近自发形成。该量子粒子流每时每刻都在呈现出多种罕见的亚粒子相互作用，能产出令人瞠目结舌的关于量子动力学固有性质的数据。\n\n对该量子场的重点研究将使我们增进对本宇宙基础构建单元的理解。
entries.en: An anomalous loop of subatomic elements has spontaneously appeared near §H[physics_planet.GetName]§!. This quantum particle stream displays a variety of rare sub-particulate interactions every second, providing astonishing data on the innate nature of quantum dynamics.\n\nFocused study of this quantum field would allow us to better understand the fundamental building blocks of our universe.

entries.zh:
我们的[From.GetResearchers]在§H[society_planet.GetName]§!系发现了一处等时信号的集中点。

初步分析表明这些信号是从其他维度传输而来。初步翻译表明这些信息与逻辑原理和哲学困境有关。也许这是一种从我们无法理解的实体中获取知识丰富的尝试。

如果能源源不断地收集这些信号我们就能继续监视他们的发现。
entries.en:
Our [From.GetResearchers] have detected a concentration of isochronal signals near §H[society_planet.GetName]§!.

Initial analysis indicated that these signals have been transmitted from a dimension beyond our own. Early translations suggest that these messages relate to logical principles and philosophical quandaries. Perhaps this is an attempt at intellectual enrichment from entities beyond our comprehension.

If we establish a direct feed with these signals we can continue to monitor their revelations.

entries.zh: §H[lucky_wreckage_system.GetName]§!出现了一艘废弃舰船。[This.GetQuantumParticleStreamDiscoveredExtra]\n\n我们推断这艘舰船之所以在该恒星系中漂泊了前年直至现在才因为恒星能发电装置故障才显形。船上没有任何生命迹象，而我们也开始了对舰船的小心拆解，希望能从中尽可能学到东西。
entries.en: A derelict ship has appeared in §H[lucky_wreckage_system.GetName]§!. [This.GetQuantumParticleStreamDiscoveredExtra]\n\nWe have deduced that the ship remained undetected in this system for millennia, only revealing itself after its solar energy generator malfunctioned. No life signs are onboard, and we have already begun careful disassembly of the vessel to learn as much as we can.

entries.zh: 这艘损坏严重无法修复的舰船可以产生一些隐形场，而且总体而言比我们自己的舰队更加先进。
entries.en: The irreparably damaged vessel was able to generate some form of invisibility field and is generally far more tactically advanced than our own fleets.

entries.zh: 这艘损坏严重无法修复的舰船使用了无可比拟的隐身科技。
entries.en: The irreparably damaged vessel was using unparalleled levels of cloaking technology.

entries.zh: §H[mining_planet.GetName]§!的地表下地热活动变得非常剧烈。地下熔岩喷流顶穿行星地壳流入一些未开发的矿脉中。\n\n该地质现象使一部分未开发的矿物受到高温，将其中的金属矿脉精炼成为坚固的合金。因此，在该行星上的矿物开采能够产出可用的金属碎片了。
entries.en: Geothermal activity has become extremely volatile deep below the surface of §H[mining_planet.GetName]§!. Underground discharges of magma have risen up through the planetary crust into a series of unexcavated ore deposits.\n\nThis geological phenomenon has superheated some of the unexploited minerals, refining veins of metallic ore into solid alloys. As such, mining operations on the planet will now produce fragments of workable metal.

entries.zh: 在§H[From.GetName]§!恒星系探测到一艘废弃的战舰缓缓飘过。舰船的设计和任何已知帝国都不同，也没有任何可辩识的旗帜或徽记。\n\n在深度的评估和一些小修小补之后，我们的[This.GetEngineerPlural]认为这艘船现在已经符合服役条件了。
entries.en: A deserted combat vessel has been detected drifting through the §H[From.GetName]§! system. The ship's design does not resemble that of any known empire, bearing no recognizable flag or insignia.\n\nAfter an extensive appraisal and some minor repairs, our [This.GetEngineerPlural] have declared that the ship is now fit for active service.

entries.zh: 在该恒星系内获得一艘巡洋舰级舰船。
entries.en: Gain a cruiser class ship in the system.

entries.zh: 一种难以言喻的乐观主义席卷了[This.GetAdjective]各星。大众们对自己的生活感到更加满足、舒适和惬意。这种集体情绪的波动毫无疑问是由天象吉兆引起，而且对§H[This.GetName]§!而言必须是一个好兆头。
entries.en: An inexplicable air of optimism is washing throughout [This.GetAdjective] worlds. The population is that bit more content, comfortable, and satisfied with their own existence. This collective mood swing is certainly due to optimal celestial alignments, and can only be a good omen for the future of the §H[This.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: §H[This.GetName]§!正在焦点明确的指引下实现了真正和谐的运转。这种万众一心的团结肯定是由于最佳的天象引起的，是伟大的事情即将到来的征兆。
entries.en: The §H[This.GetName]§! is functioning in true harmony under a directive of unequivocal focus. This unilateral cohesion is certainly due to optimal celestial alignments and is a sign of great things to come.
The stars shine brightly upon us.

entries.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!恒星系内的三个天体排列成了完美的三位一体构型；即§H[favorable_trine_planet_1.GetName]§!、§H[favorable_trine_planet_2.GetName]§!和§H[favorable_trine_planet_3.GetName]§!。\n\n这种有利天象为我们在§H[This.GetName]§!的殖民地带来了宁静与和谐。
entries.en: Three celestial bodies in the §H[From.GetName]§! system have aligned to form a favorable trine; §H[favorable_trine_planet_1.GetName]§!, §H[favorable_trine_planet_2.GetName]§! and §H[favorable_trine_planet_3.GetName]§!.\n\nThis beneficial astrological alignment brings a sense of tranquility and harmony to our colony on §H[This.GetName]§!.
A once in a lifetime event.

entries.zh: §H[auspicious_position_planet.GetName]§!在§H[root.capital_scope.GetName]§!的夜空中升上吉位，入主天回星宫。\n\n该天象代表[root.GetName]内在循环的新开端，是增长和发展的重大机遇。
entries.en: §H[auspicious_position_planet.GetName]§! is occupying an auspicious position in the skies above §H[root.capital_scope.GetName]§!, residing in the astrological House of Celestial Return.\n\nThis represents the commencement of a new internal cycle for the [root.GetName] and a prime opportunity for growth and improvement.

entries.zh: 所有定量占星矩阵都表明[This.GetName]目前处于完美的元素平衡。\n\n利用精确的能量线管理可以将这种有益平衡维持很长时间，为我们领袖的繁盛提供理想的形而上环境。
entries.en: All quantifiable astrological metrics indicate that the [This.GetName] is in perfect elemental balance.\n\nWith precise ley line management this beneficial equilibrium can be maintained for an extended period, providing an ideal metaphysical environment in which our leaders can flourish.

entries.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!恒星系内的首要光耀体正在发出非凡的祥光。占星专家对此进行讨论后，我们理解了其能量的盈余将会增强§H[This.GetName]§!上各种各样的发电活动。
entries.en: The primary luminary in the §H[From.GetName]§! system is shining with extraordinary luster. After discussing this phenomenon with astrological specialists, we understand that its excess of energy will enhance all manners of power generation on §H[This.GetName]§!.
May the stars shine brightly upon us.

entries.zh: 我们的两位内阁成员，§H[councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetTitle][councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetName]§!和§H[councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetTitle][councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetName]§!发现他们的占星结果高度互补。\n\n因此，他们的政治伙伴关系在以尊重和效率为名将我们的政府凝聚了起来，加快了各种立法程序的推进。
entries.en: Two of our council members, §H[councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetTitle] [councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetName]§! and §H[councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetTitle] [councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetName]§! recently discovered that their astrological signs are perfectly complementary.\n\nTheir subsequent political partnership has since united our government under a banner of mutual respect and efficiency, accelerating various legislative processes.

entries.zh: 在一次例行编目中，一个没固定好的的标本掉在了§H$grand_archive$§!的地上，随后被及时送到保管员那里进行进一步检查。\n\n因为这场事故我们意外得发现，该标本中的一个秘密隔间松动了。里面藏着各种各样的有趣的文物可以丰富我们的馆藏，而此事之前完全未被注意到。
entries.en: During a routine cataloging exercise, an unsecured specimen was dropped on the floor of the §H$grand_archive$§! and was swiftly delivered to a conservator for closer examination.\n\nSurprisingly, a secret compartment was found to have been loosened in the accident. Previously unnoticed, it contained a wide variety of interesting artifacts we can add to our collection.

entries.zh: 在我们的各个星球上，一种难以言喻的恐惧笼罩着所有人。人们对自己的生活感到愈发苦恼、烦躁和不满。这种集体情绪的波动毫无疑问是由天象凶兆引起的。
entries.en: There is an inexplicable sense of looming dread throughout the population on our worlds. The people are feeling more distressed, distracted, and dissatisfied with their own existence. This collective mood swing must be due to suboptimal celestial alignments.

entries.zh: 有一种不和谐的感觉笼罩着§H[This.GetName]§!。这种协调匮乏正在使我们集体的多方面陷入停滞，这肯定是由于不佳的天象引起的。
entries.en: There is a feeling of disharmony throughout the §H[This.GetName]§!. This lack of coordination is leading to stagnation throughout our collective, and must be due to suboptimal celestial alignments.

entries.zh: 在位于§H[This.System.GetName]§!的例行海军演习中因为通讯失误导致§H[This.GetName]§!的多艘战舰发生高速碰撞事故。\n\n[This.GetNavalCollisionLeader]通报，对这次事故负主要责任的[From.GetIndividualNamePlural]已经按条例处分。
entries.en: A miscommunication during routine naval maneuvers has caused a high-speed collision between multiple combat ships of the §H[This.GetName]§! in §H[This.System.GetName]§!.\n\n[This.GetNavalCollisionLeader] has confirmed that the [From.GetIndividualNamePlural] responsible for this error have been disciplined appropriately.

entries.zh: §H[silo_fire_planet_targeted.GetName]§!上一处资源储仓的电力故障导致了该仓储设施发生严重火灾。\n\n$shroud.710.desc$
entries.en: An electrical malfunction in a resource silo on §H[silo_fire_planet_targeted.GetName]§! resulted in a massive fire within the storage facility.\n\n$shroud.710.desc$

entries.zh: §H[silo_fire_starbase_targeted.Fleet.System.GetName]§!中[silo_fire_starbase_targeted.GetStarbaseOrWayStation]的恒星基地上一处资源储仓的电力故障导致了该仓储设施发生严重火灾。\n\n$shroud.710.desc$
entries.en: An electrical malfunction in a resource silo on the [silo_fire_starbase_targeted.GetStarbaseOrWayStation] of §H[silo_fire_starbase_targeted.Fleet.System.GetName]§! resulted in a massive fire within the storage facility.\n\n$shroud.710.desc$

entries.zh: 灭火措施临时发生了故障，储存在此处的大部分资源付之一炬。储仓也受损得无法修复了。
entries.en: The fire suppression measures had temporarily malfunctioned, and a significant proportion of the resources stored within were damaged in the blaze. The silo itself is damaged beyond repair.

entries.zh: 一位我方的[This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]代表无意中做出了与地位不相称的行为。在发表旨在为我们的利益争取支持的演讲时，所使用的翻译设备故障导致了其对[diplomatic_faux_pas_victim.GetName]进行尖酸刻薄的羞辱。这场意外事件很快通过星系媒体广为传播，让我们一时臭名远扬。\n\n虽然这种事情不至于立即解雇，但我们在[This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的地位也因此受到了影响。
entries.en: One of our representatives in the [This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has inadvertently behaved in a manner unbecoming of their position. While delivering a speech intended to raise support for our interests, a translator malfunction resulted in delivering vitriolic and hateful insults to the [diplomatic_faux_pas_victim.GetName]. The unfortunate incident has been spread across the galactic media and disparaged our reputation.\n\nWhile these actions do not warrant immediate dismissal, our standing within the [This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has been weakened as a result of this indiscretion.

entries.zh: §H[extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName]§!发生了一场史无前例的恒星耀斑，将该恒星系内的所有轨道空间站都毁坏了。\n\n这种有强伽马射线的异常耀斑远远超出了以前对该天体的测量。通过对日冕层的分析得知，这颗恒星的预期寿命至少减少了300万年。
entries.en: An unprecedented solar flare from §H[extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName]§! has functionally destroyed all orbital stations in the system.\n\nThis aberrant flare of concentrated gamma rays is far beyond anything that has been previously measured from this celestial body. Our analysis of the star's coronal layer shows that its predicted lifespan has been reduced by over three million years.

entries.zh: 释放出的能量还在该恒星系中引发了一场$celestial_storm$。目前已经采取紧急应对措施。
entries.en: The resulting discharge of energy has triggered a $celestial_storm$ in the system. Emergency measures are currently underway.
Every $observation_station$, $research_station$ and $mining_station$ in §H[extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName]§! has been destroyed.

entries.zh: 意料之外的气候变化扰乱了我们在§H[high_profile_traffic_accident_planet.GetName]§!的交通系统。该局面除了导致大规模的延误以外，还造成了许多交通事故，其中一场甚至涉及[This.GetClass]§H[This.GetName]§!。
entries.en: Unexpected climatic shifts have disturbed our transit networks on §H[high_profile_traffic_accident_planet.GetName]§!. Alongside widespread delays, the conditions have caused a significant number of traffic accidents, one of which involved [This.GetClass] §H[This.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: $shroud.725.desc$\n\n尽管我们的应急措施响应及时，[This.GetHisHer]的伤还是太重了，不治身亡。
entries.en: $shroud.725.desc$\n\nDespite the swift response of our emergency services, [This.GetHisHer] injuries ultimately proved fatal.

entries.zh: $shroud.725.desc$\n\n不幸的是，其系统损伤过重无法修复。
entries.en: $shroud.725.desc$\n\nUnfortunately, their systems were damaged beyond repair.

entries.zh: $shroud.725.desc$\n\n[This.GetName]虽然得以幸存，但也受了不可逆损伤。
entries.en: $shroud.725.desc$\n\n[This.GetName] survived the collision, but not unscathed. The damage done is irreversible.

entries.zh: §H[This.GetName]§!地表上出现了巨大的陷坑，严重损坏了当地的基础设施。其中一处裂沟出现在一座建筑物的地基下，导致建筑部分倒塌。所幸受灾地区都已成功撤离。\n\n我们无法得知这种突发的地陷具体是什么引起的，但已开始进行进一步维护检查，检测地表裂损情况。
entries.en: Enormous sinkholes have appeared on the surface of §H[This.GetName]§!, causing significant infrastructure damage. One of the fissures opened underneath the foundations of one of the planet's buildings, causing it to partially collapse. Fortunately, all affected areas were evacuated successfully.\n\nWe cannot determine the exact cause of the sudden appearance of these geological cavities, but additional maintenance checks have been implemented to monitor surface erosion.

entries.zh: 有一栋建筑成为了废墟。
entries.en: A building now lies in ruins.

entries.zh: §H[This.GetName]§!上四处爆发了危险的骚乱。一种关于[From.GetAdjective]政府操纵天象的无端阴谋论激起了强烈的民愤。狂热示威很快演变成暴力冲突，煽动者在殖民地各处大肆破坏。\n\n暴力游行很快被安全部队镇压，但对我们基础设施的损伤仍需要时间来修复。
entries.en: Dangerous riots have erupted across §H[This.GetName]§!. The population is fueled with fervor in protest of an unsubstantiated conspiracy about the [From.GetAdjective] government's control of celestial alignments. What began as a zealous demonstration soon devolved into violence, with agitators causing mass destruction throughout the colony.\n\nThe violent demonstrators were neutralized by security forces, but the damage to our infrastructure will take time to repair.

entries.zh: 一大群反常的子个体在§H[This.GetName]§!殖民地引发暴乱，造成了大规模破坏。尽管这些分子非常疯狂，防御部队还是迅速镇压了这些煽动者。然而，基础设施所遭受的损伤仍需时间来修复。
entries.en: A large pod of deviant drones led a revolt in the §H[This.GetName]§! colony, causing widespread destruction. Despite their fervor, defense forces were able to neutralize the agitators, but the damage to our infrastructure will take time to repair.

entries.zh: §H[This.GetName]§!上有一小群无人机感染了一种神秘的病毒，开始反抗并试图摧毁殖民地。尽管他们非常疯狂，防御部队还是将这些故障单元迅速解决，但我们基础设施受到的损伤仍需要时间来修复。
entries.en: A significant minority of the drones on §H[This.GetName]§! were infected by a mysterious virus, causing them to rebel and attempt to destroy the colony. Despite their fervor, defense forces were able to neutralize the malfunctioning units, but the damage to our infrastructure will take time to repair.

entries.zh: §H[This.GetName]§!上一种高致病性病毒突然变异，传染了大部分人口。为控制疾病传播、避免当地医疗基础设施过载，目前已经采取了如接触者追踪和行动限制等隔离措施。
entries.en: A highly transmissible virus has mutated on the surface of §H[This.GetName]§!, infecting a large portion of the population. Quarantine measures have been put in place, such as contact tracing and movement restrictions, in order to hopefully restrict the disease's spread and avoid overwhelming local medical infrastructure.

entries.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!恒星系内的四个天体排列成了预兆灾难的四连星；即§H[calamitous_quartile_planet_1.GetName]§!、§H[calamitous_quartile_planet_2.GetName]§!、§H[calamitous_quartile_planet_3.GetName]§!和§H[calamitous_quartile_planet_4.GetName]§!。\n\n这种灾难性天象在§H[This.GetName]§!殖民地播下怀疑的种子，让[FromFrom.GetDissent]得以在人群中制造分歧。
entries.en: Four celestial bodies in the §H[From.GetName]§! system have aligned to form a calamitous quartile; §H[calamitous_quartile_planet_1.GetName]§!, §H[calamitous_quartile_planet_2.GetName]§!, §H[calamitous_quartile_planet_3.GetName]§! and §H[calamitous_quartile_planet_4.GetName]§!.\n\nThis disastrous astrological phenomenon will sow the seeds of doubt on the §H[This.GetName]§! colony, encouraging [FromFrom.GetDissent] by sowing disharmony among the population.

entries.zh: §H[planet_in_retrograde_home.GetName]§!上的居民发现§H[planet_in_retrograde_planet.GetName]§!正在发生退行。是时候重新斟酌我们的行为，对[This.GetName]不完美表示遗憾。愿这段时间的沉重反思让我们可以在未来更靠近理想。
entries.en: Inhabitants of §H[planet_in_retrograde_home.GetName]§! have observed that §H[planet_in_retrograde_planet.GetName]§! is now in retrograde. This is a time to reconsider our actions and express regret towards the imperfections of the [This.GetName]. May this burdensome period of reflection bring us closer to our ideals in future.

entries.zh: 很不幸，所有的定量矩阵均表明[This.GetName]上的元素已经完全失衡了。\n\n尝试重新组织精妙的平衡需要许多时间也颇为困难。在当前的混沌状态下，我们的领袖无法获得形而上学冥想环境，阻碍了他们的发展。
entries.en: Unfortunately, all quantifiable metrics indicate that the [This.GetName] is in complete elemental discord.\n\nAttempting to realign this delicate equilibrium will be time-consuming and difficult. In its current chaotic state, our leaders will be unable to access a metaphysical meditative environment, impeding their development.

entries.zh: 不可接受。我们必须做点什么。
§H[From.GetName]§!恒星系内的首要光耀体正异常地变暗了。占星专家对此进行讨论后，这种发光减少预计将会影响§H[This.GetName]§!上的能源基础设施。
entries.en: The primary luminary in the §H[From.GetName]§! system has anomalously dimmed. After discussing this phenomenon with our astrological specialists, this decline in luminosity is predicted to have a negative effect on the energy infrastructure of §H[This.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 我们的两位内阁成员，§H[discordant_council_leader_1.GetTitle][discordant_council_leader_1.GetName]§!和§H[discordant_council_leader_2.GetTitle][discordant_council_leader_2.GetName]§!近来发现他们的占星结果相冲。\n\n因此，他们的政治敌手关系在我们的政府中形成了紧张和怨恨的氛围，例行的立法程序都因此频繁延期。
entries.en: Two of our council members, §H[discordant_council_leader_1.GetTitle] [discordant_council_leader_1.GetName]§! and §H[discordant_council_leader_2.GetTitle] [discordant_council_leader_2.GetName]§! recently learned that their astrological signs are diametrically incompatible.\n\nTheir subsequent political rivalry has since created an atmosphere of animosity and tension within our government, causing frequent delays to routine legislative processes.

entries.zh: 我们一位地方官员对其他帝国的个人观点意外地广播给了该国的附属国。在一次关于超空间航道监视的艰难讨论之后，一名通信人员忘记关闭传输频道，让[careless_talk_empire.GetName]听到了随后那一连串的咒骂。\n\n$shroud.770.desc_end$
entries.en: One of our regional administrators' personal opinions about another empire were accidentally broadcast to their subject. Following a difficult discussion about hyperlane surveillance, a communications operative forgot to close the transmission channel, allowing the [careless_talk_empire.GetName] to hear the stream of expletives that followed.\n\n$shroud.770.desc_end$

entries.zh: 我们一个管理单元关于其他帝国未经过滤的陈述意外地广播给了该国的附属国。在一次关于超空间航道监视的艰难讨论之后，通讯单元未能关闭传输频道，让[careless_talk_empire.GetName]听到了随后那一连串的咒骂。\n\n$shroud.770.desc_end$
entries.en: One of our admin units' unfiltered statements about another empire were accidentally broadcast to their subject. Following a difficult discussion about hyperlane surveillance, a communications unit forgot to close the transmission channel, allowing the [careless_talk_empire.GetName] to hear the stream of expletives that followed.\n\n$shroud.770.desc_end$

entries.zh: 我们一个行政工蜂对其他帝国的贬损之词意外地广播给了该国的附属国。在一次关于超空间航道监视的艰难讨论之后，一个通讯工蜂忘记关闭传输频道，让[careless_talk_empire.GetName]听到了随后那一连串的咒骂。\n\n$shroud.770.desc_end$
entries.en: One of our admin drones' disparaging remarks about another empire were accidentally broadcast to their subject. Following a difficult discussion about hyperlane surveillance, a communications drone forgot to close the transmission channel, allowing the [careless_talk_empire.GetName] to hear the stream of expletives that followed.\n\n$shroud.770.desc_end$

entries.zh: [careless_talk_empire.GetAdjective]大众对[This.GetName]的观点不可避免地下降了。
entries.en: The [careless_talk_empire.GetAdjective] population's opinion of the [This.GetName] has inevitably declined.

entries.zh: 一个行政过失导致我们一件珍贵的文物不见了踪影。尽管进行了广泛的搜索，但它似乎要么消失在我们迷宫一般的§H$grand_archive$§!中，要么就是被转移到没有记录的地方去了。\n\n因此，对展出标本的跟踪手续正在进行彻底改革。
entries.en: An administrative error has led to the misplacement of one of our precious cultural artifacts. Despite extensive search efforts, it is seemingly either lost in the labyrinth that is our §H$grand_archive$§! or transferred to an unrecorded location.\n\nThe procedures in place for tracking our specimens on display are being overhauled as a result.

entries.zh: 展示的标本随机损失：§R1个§!
[Root.GetResearchers]已经完成了一系列以活体为对象的实验，为我们提供了许多宝贵的知识，推动了科技的进一步发展。
entries.en: Our [Root.GetResearchers] have completed a series of groundbreaking experiments on live subjects, providing us with valuable knowledge that can stimulate further technological advances.

entries.zh: $shroud.1015.desc.intro$现在我们需要考虑在何处开展下一阶段的研究。
entries.en: $shroud.1015.desc.intro$ We must now consider the area in which to conduct the next phase of research.

entries.zh: $shroud.1015.desc.intro$最近的对囚犯的批量处决为[Root.GetResearchers]提供了大量实验材料，进而带来了一项技术突破。
entries.en: $shroud.1015.desc.intro$ The recent series of mass prisoner executions has given our [Root.GetResearchers] plenty of material for a new technological breakthrough.

entries.zh: 获得一项随机£physics£§Y$PHYSICS$§!科技的洞见。
entries.en: Gain insight in a random £physics£ §Y$PHYSICS$§! technology.

entries.zh: 获得一项随机£society£§Y$SOCIETY$§!科技的洞见。
entries.en: Gain insight in a random £society£ §Y$SOCIETY$§! technology.
Gain insight in a random £engineering£ §Y$ENGINEERING$§! technology.

entries.zh: 我们的实验已经产生了一些前景可观的成果。\n$TECH|Y$：进度§G+$VAL$%§!
entries.en: Our experimentation has produced some promising results.\n$TECH|Y$: §G+$VAL$%§! progress

entries.zh: 一大批高价值实验对象借助挖掘的隧道从§H[root.GetName]§!上的一座设施内逃了出来。\n\n这条隧道是用简陋的工具和赤裸的 [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] 挖掘而成，必定耗费了多年时间。我们无法确定有多少人知晓它的存在，也不清楚为什么这么长时间也没人能发现。
entries.en: A number of our valuable test subjects have fled from a facility on §H[root.GetName]§! via a makeshift escape tunnel.\n\nFashioned using improvised tools and bare [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural], the tunnel must have taken years to build. We cannot be sure how many knew of its existence, and how it remained undetected for so long.

entries.zh: 此类事件一再发生，需要对此做出坚决的应对以防止类似事件重演。我们此前在这一问题上的仁慈，反倒似乎成了对于剩余个体的鼓励。
entries.en: Such developments necessitate a firm response in order to prevent repeat offenses. Our previous leniency on this issue seems to have served as encouragement to the remaining population.

entries.zh: 此类事态发展需要采取坚决措施，以防止此类事件再次发生。
entries.en: Such developments necessitate a firm response in order to prevent repeat offenses.
Half of the §Y$job_test_subject_plural$§! on §H[root.GetName]§! will depart as refugees.

entries.zh: 暂停所有运营活动，直至找到他们。
entries.en: Shut down operations until we can find them.
Execute those that remain as an example.
All of the §Y$job_test_subject_plural$§! on §H[root.GetName]§! will be lost.

entries.zh: 在逃实验对象被围捕期间，测试暂停。
entries.en: Testing is temporarily suspended while escaped subjects are rounded up.

entries.zh: 对之前的一次逃跑企图采取了严厉的镇压措施，确保了试验对象群体现在保持顺从。
entries.en: A brutal response to a previous escape attempt ensures the test subject population now remains compliant.

entries.zh:
[Owner.GetThoughtTransmissionIntro]

这种信息可以有多种形式：具体的语言或视觉材料、宽泛的概念或广义的情绪感知。关键在于，精心策划的传输过程可以让受众在毫无感觉的情况下完成这个流程。

[Owner.GetThoughtTransmissionOutro]
entries.en:
[Owner.GetThoughtTransmissionIntro]

This information can take various forms: specific linguistic or visual material, broad concepts, or generalized emotive sensations. Crucially, a carefully performed transmission leaves its subject completely unaware of the procedure.

[Owner.GetThoughtTransmissionOutro].

entries.zh: §H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的灵能[Owner.GetResearchers]们开发出了一种单向心灵感应法，让我们可以向易感意识传输认知信息。
entries.en: Psionic [Owner.GetResearchers] on §H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§! have developed a unidirectional form of telepathy, allowing us to transmit cognitive information to any susceptible consciousness.

entries.zh: §H[Capital.GetName]§!上的灵能[Owner.GetResearchers]们开发出了一种单向心灵感应法，让我们也能向集体以外的易感意识传输认知信息。
entries.en: Psionic [Owner.GetResearchers] on §H[Capital.GetName]§! have developed a unidirectional form of telepathy, allowing us to transmit cognitive information to any susceptible consciousness, not only to our own collective.

entries.zh: 这项技术为心灵感应交流开辟了许多新的可能性，对我们与[Owner.GetName]内外各方的互动都产生了深远的影响。
entries.en: This technique opens up many new possibilities for telepathic communication, with widespread implications for our interactions within and beyond the [Owner.GetName].

entries.zh: 这项技术为心灵感应交流开启了许多新的可能性，可供[Owner.GetName]内部及外部利用。
entries.en: This technique opens up many new possibilities for telepathic communication, which could be exploited both within and beyond the [Owner.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们发展中符合逻辑的下一步。
entries.en: The logical next step in our development.

entries.zh: 我们演化中合乎逻辑的一步。
entries.en: The logical next step in our evolution.

entries.zh: 一种施加我们意志的新方式。
entries.en: A new way to impose our will.
A means to ensure social order.

entries.zh: 让社会来决定最佳用法。
entries.en: Let society determine its best use.

entries.zh: 我们的许多[Owner.GetCitizenPlural]在§H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!各地看到了怪异的幻影。这些幻象大多数情况下都是偶发的，不会重复，但有一个地方因频繁出现而引起了注意。[Owner.GetPhantomPresenceExtra]\n\n人们发现这个幻象出现在一处富矿洞穴系统的入口。
entries.en: A number of our [Owner.GetCitizenPlural] have perceived uncanny apparitions at various locations on §H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!. In most cases, these have been chance sightings without repetition, but one site has drawn attention for frequent visitations. [Owner.GetPhantomPresenceExtra]\n\nIt has been discovered that the phantom appears near the mouth of a mineral-rich cavern system.

entries.zh: 这个地方吸引了越来越多想要一睹幽灵的游客。
entries.en: The location has started to attract crowds of visitors who are eager to catch a glimpse of the ghostly figure.

entries.zh: 据称出现在那里的幻象类似于我国古代传统宗教中的神明。
entries.en: The ghostly figure that appears there is purported to resemble a sacred entity described in our ancient religious traditions.

entries.zh: 一个值得研究的灵能现象。
entries.en: A psionic phenomenon to be studied.

entries.zh: 不要打扰这个文化资产。
entries.en: Do not disturb this cultural asset.
Do not disturb this sacred site.

entries.zh:
§H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上发生了一次意外的气候事件——一场类似风暴的扰动横扫了一片灵能水平极高的地区。随后我们在其途径之地发现一些当地的动物感染了奇怪的寄生虫，它们会钻入大脑器官并将其慢慢吃掉。

随着这种寄生虫感染的加剧，宿主动物会暂时获得基本的念动力，很多便开始将其用于狩猎和进食，直至被寄生虫杀死。

[Owner.GetShroudParasitesEnding]
entries.en:
An unpredicted climatic event occurred on §H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§! - a storm-like disturbance that swept through an area with particularly elevated levels of psionic energy. In its wake, we found some of the local fauna infected with a strange parasite that burrows into and slowly consumes the cerebral organ.

As this parasitic infection progresses, the host animals temporarily develop basic telekinetic abilities which they then use for hunting and feeding before they inevitably expire.

[Owner.GetShroudParasitesEnding]

entries.zh: 有趣的是，这些寄生虫在仔细处理后是可以安全食用的。它富含多种营养，可以为公民提供物美价廉的食物。
entries.en: Interestingly, these parasites are safely edible after careful processing. As rich sources of various nutrients, they might provide a healthy, inexpensive foodstuff for our citizens.

entries.zh: 有趣的是，这些生物分泌大量富含有机化合物的物质，因此或能提供矿物合成的新方法。
entries.en: Interestingly, these creatures secrete high volumes of a substance rich in inorganic compounds. They might therefore provide a novel method of mineral synthesis.

entries.zh: 有趣的是，这些生物分泌大量高度可燃物质，因此或能提供生物能源产出的新方法。
entries.en: Interestingly, these creatures secrete vast quantities of a highly combustible substance. They might therefore provide an efficient method of bioenergy production.

entries.zh: 又发现了一种令人惊叹的新生命形式。
entries.en: A fantastic new life form has been revealed.

entries.zh: 在实验新的灵能科技的过程中，我们在集体冥想时观察到了意料之外的具现化现象。将我们的集体注意力聚焦在空间中的一个点上时会短暂出现一些怪异但值得注意的物体。\n\n所耗费的精神力非常巨大，但我们有可能将这些努力转化为合意的具现化对象。这些物体从何而来，以及可能导致什么后果我们不得而知。
entries.en: While experimenting with new psionic techniques, we observed unexpected materializations during group meditation. Narrowing our collective focus on a single point in space resulted in the fleeting appearance of strange and remarkable objects.\n\nThe psychic toll involved is significant, but it is possible we could direct these efforts into manifesting objects to fit our purposes. Where these objects come from and what consequences may result are unknown.
Let us make wishes come true.

entries.zh: 关于灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]有二重身能力的传言沸沸扬扬，据信这是一种可以同时以肉身出现在两个地方的能力。我们派出了[Owner.GetResearchers]去调查这种不太可能的说法；结果这种现象竟然是真的。[Owner.GetPsionicDoublingExtra]\n\n目前，只有很小一部分人口具有这种强大的能力，进一步研究也许能找到训练方法。
entries.en: Rumors had spread of psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] capable of bilocation, the ability to be physically present in two different locations at the same time. We dispatched [Owner.GetResearchers] to investigate these improbable claims; astonishingly, they have proven to be true.[Owner.GetPsionicDoublingExtra]\n\nPresently, only a fraction of our population possesses this remarkable skill, but further study might yield methods of training others.

entries.zh: \n\n物理距离似乎不是障碍。专家们反复验证了这些人他们可以同时在两个不同的星系中短暂地出现
entries.en: \n\nPhysical distance seems to be no impediment, as these adepts have repeatedly shown that they can briefly locate themselves in two different star systems at once

entries.zh: $shroud.2320.extra$，并且在两具身体之间维持心灵链接以进行不同行为。
entries.en: $shroud.2320.extra$, maintaining a psychic link between two bodies that perform independent actions.

entries.zh: $shroud.2320.extra$，并且在两具身体之间维持灵能处理链接以进行不同行为。
entries.en: $shroud.2320.extra$, maintaining a psionic processing link between two units that perform independent actions.

entries.zh: 一种全新的跨星系合作方式。
entries.en: A new avenue for intragalactic cooperation.

entries.zh: 这才是真正的力量投射。
entries.en: A true form of power projection.

entries.zh: 一种全新的跨行星统治方式。
entries.en: A new method of multiplanetary governing.

entries.zh: [Owner.GetAdjective]的一小部分人身上出现了一种奇妙的灵能能力：心灵遥感，一种从超出正常感知范围的距离感知实体的能力。这些千里眼无需经过任何专门训练，就能非常精确地描绘出远处物体的细节。\n\n如果这种能力可以加以控制和增强，§H[Owner.GetName]§!就能获得可观的回报。利用我们最强大的[Owner.GetTelepathPlural]的能力，就可以尝试磨练这项技术，将其应用在重要的事情上。
entries.en: A wondrous psionic faculty has emerged in a small proportion of the [Owner.GetAdjective] population: telesthesia, the ability to sense entities from distances beyond the ordinary range of perception. Without any kind of specialized training, these remote viewers can accurately describe distant objects in remarkable detail.\n\nThe §H[Owner.GetName]§! stands to reap significant rewards if these powers can be controlled and strengthened. By drawing on the abilities of our most powerful [Owner.GetTelepathPlural], we can try to hone this technique and focus it on an important enterprise.
Discover the secrets of those around us.
Discover the far reaches of the universe.

entries.zh: 我们的原材料正在以危险的速率减少。储存在工厂和仓库里的无机材料正在以超过常理的速度消耗，[Owner.GetMatterInFluxExtra]。这些地区的损失也与灵能活动增加有关。\n\n为此我们可以减少在物资仓库附近区域的灵能活动，但也将拖慢灵能研究的步伐、限制其工业应用。我们还可以按照建议开发灵能场衰减器来抑制这种物灭现象。如果什么都不做，我们的灵能研究能力也会被削弱。
entries.en: We are losing raw materials at an alarming rate. Stores of inorganic matter in factories and warehouses are depleting faster than they are being used, [Owner.GetMatterInFluxExtra]. These losses correlate with increased psionic activity in the affected locations.\n\nWe could respond by halting psionic activity in the vicinity of material stores, but this will slow the pace of our psionic research and limit its industrial applications. Alternatively, we could follow proposals to develop a psionic field attenuator that should halt the dematerialization process. If we do nothing, our psionic research capabilities will be attenuated.

entries.zh: 据报道称这是由自发物灭现象而不是犯罪或失察引起的。
entries.en: reportedly caused by spontaneous dematerialization rather than crime or incompetence

entries.zh: 据报道称这是由自发物灭现象而不是反常行为或失察引起的。
entries.en: reportedly caused by spontaneous dematerialization rather than deviant or incompetent behavior
Material goods are of little concern.

entries.zh:
我们的大众对灵能日益增长的好奇心催生了一种奇怪的活动：私下储存死去的[Owner.GetSpeciesBrainPlural]并试图与之交流。
