参与者相信在[Owner.GetDeathName]后意识信息仍可以保留，这是一种衍生兹科学理论的观念，认为心灵是一种能量——它可以转化但不能凭空消失。尽管总数不多，但还是有越来越多人相信灵能[Owner.GetIndividualName]去世时会产生一个无穷小亚空间裂隙，通过这扇窗户就能一瞥其他维度。

创新研究固然值得赞扬，但对我们部分[Owner.GetDeceasedAdj]人口的滥用引发了伦理问题。此外还有报告称，越来越多的盗尸者通过犯罪手段来获取这些器官。
entries.en:
Our population's increasing curiosity about psionics has led to the emergence of a strange activity: privately storing expired [Owner.GetSpeciesBrainPlural] and trying to communicate with them.

Practitioners believe that cognitive information can survive [Owner.GetDeathName], an idea originating in scientific theories about psychic forces being a form of energy - convertible but indestructible. A small but growing percentage also believe that the passing of a psionic [Owner.GetIndividualName] creates an infinitesimal subspace rupture, a window through which to glimpse other dimensions.

While innovative research is commendable, interference with parts of our [Owner.GetDeceasedAdj] population raises ethical concerns. Furthermore, we have received reports about a growing class of body snatchers who procure these parts by criminal means.

entries.zh: 不错的尝试，但应该管控一下。
entries.en: A fine endeavor, if we can regulate it.
Let the dead lie in peace.

entries.zh: 每个人都可以有死亡的[Owner.GetSpeciesBrainPlural]。

我们的灵能人口中有很大一部分都长出了奇怪的、有关节附肢，其设计深不可测。[Owner.GetScientistPlural]称，他们的外观变化是由大规模自发[Owner.GetGeneticMutationName]导致的。现在很清楚灵能活动可能导致使用者发生身体变化。尽管我们无法抑制这种附肢增生，但也发现可以用灵能来控制其生长率。\n\n尽管一开始导致了一些[Owner.GetDistressName]，这些额外的肢体其实还是很有用的。如果高效利用起来，其它们的作用应该能弥补增加的认知负担。
entries.en: Swathes of our psionic population have sprouted strange, jointed appendages of unfathomable design. According to our [Owner.GetScientistPlural], their appearance was caused by spontaneous [Owner.GetGeneticMutationName] at mass scale. It is now clear that psionic activities can cause physical changes to the practitioner. While we cannot prevent the emergence of these protuberances, we have discovered that the rate of their growth can be controlled psionically.\n\nThough initially causing some [Owner.GetDistressName], these extra parts have proven surprisingly useful. If applied productively, their utility might compensate for their added cognitive load.

entries.zh: 不错的尝试，但应该管控一下。
entries.en: A fine endeavor, if we can regulate it.

entries.zh: 震惊，但是奇妙。接受改变。
entries.en: Shocking, but fascinating. Embrace the change.

entries.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]开发出了一种将灵能力转化为动能的可靠方法，现在正在与[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]合作将这种技术放大并投入生产。\n\n尽管这种技术非常有工业应用前景，其社会影响还是个未知数。如果一小帮技术高超的灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]就能运作复杂的机械，那么就会有大批的[Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural]就要面临失业。[Owner.GetTelekineticEthicsExtra]我们还在逐渐掌握灵能的过程中，最好还是谨慎推进为好。
entries.en: Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] have developed a reliable method for converting psionic power into kinetic energy, and are now working with [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] on scaling the technology for practical use.\n\nWhile the industrial applications are promising, the social implications remain an open question. If a small group of skilled psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] can power and operate a network of complex machinery, legions of [Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural] are at risk of redundancy. [Owner.GetTelekineticEthicsExtra] While our mastery of psionics is still developing, it may be best to proceed with caution.

entries.zh: 如果不加约束地任这种做法发展，可能会在这个还在慢慢接纳灵能的社会里播下不和谐的种子。
entries.en: Unfettered growth of this practice threatens to sow discord in a society still coming to terms with its psionic potential.

entries.zh: 如果不加约束地任这种做法发展，可能会在被替换掉的子个体重新找到用处之前提升反常度。
entries.en: Unfettered growth of this practice threatens to increase deviancy in the displaced drones while being repurposed.

entries.zh: 限制使用。体力劳动还是更可靠。
entries.en: Limit its use. Physical labor is more reliable.

entries.zh: 突然爆发的[Owner.GetAcuteMigrainePlural]席卷了我们的帝国。虽然严重程度各不相同，但这种情况已经影响了相当一部分人口，对§H[Owner.GetName]§!造成了广泛的破坏。\n\n一小部分特别强大的灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]也是受影响最严重的，初步的统计分析也表明灵能能力和症状强度之间存在相关性。[Owner.GetAGrowingPainExtra]
entries.en: A sudden outbreak of [Owner.GetAcuteMigrainePlural] has befallen our empire. While severity ranges widely, the condition has already affected a significant proportion of the population, causing widespread disruption across the §H[Owner.GetName]§!.\n\nA small number of particularly powerful psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] are among the worst affected, and preliminary statistical analysis suggests a correlation between psionic aptitude and intensity of symptoms.[Owner.GetAGrowingPainExtra]

entries.zh: 我们熟悉的疗法全部无效，因为这种疼痛似乎是通过我们刚刚开始理解的跨次元通道直击灵能官能。
entries.en: Familiar treatments have proven ineffective, as the pain seems to cut straight to the psionic faculties through interdimensional channels we are only beginning to understand.

entries.zh: 我们需要学着忍耐这种事。
entries.en: We must learn to tolerate this.

entries.zh: [Owner.GetPsionicUndergroundIntro]灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]正在将自己的灵能能力用在非法格斗运动中，这些灵能角斗士为了金钱和荣誉作战。虽然许多参与者都是极具天赋但缺乏训练的战士，[Owner.GetPsionicUndergroundExtra]\n\n[Owner.GetPsionicUndergroundEnd]
entries.en: [Owner.GetPsionicUndergroundIntro] psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] are channeling their psychic abilities into a lawless combat sport, in which psionic warriors do battle for credits and glory. While many practitioners are innately gifted fighters with little training, [Owner.GetPsionicUndergroundExtra]\n\n[Owner.GetPsionicUndergroundEnd]

entries.zh: 但也有一些是国有军用灵能项目的落选者。
entries.en: others are dropouts from state programs in martial psionics.

entries.zh: 但也有一些是专业的军用灵能者。
entries.en: others are specialized in martial psionics.

entries.zh: 我们的法律和制度没有跟上步伐。目前，这种暴力游戏会通过非法赌博帮助犯罪组织，但我们可以有多种干预方式将这种活动置于国家控制之下。
entries.en: Our laws and institutions are not keeping pace. Currently, these violent games help support criminal organizations through illicit gambling, but there are a number of ways we could intervene to bring this activity under state control.

entries.zh: 尽管反常行为并非没有风险，但这项活动也给我们收集身体战斗数据集带来了全新的可靠方法。
entries.en: Though deviancy is not without its risks, this activity has introduced us to a new, practical method to gather physical combat datasets.

entries.zh: $shroud.2425.end_gestalt$也许，只要我们加以管控就可以正确引导这种感觉，在和平时期发泄集体被压抑的攻击性。
entries.en: $shroud.2425.end_gestalt$ Perhaps, with moderation, we could channel such sensations into a beneficial outlet for the collective's pent-up aggression during peacetime.

entries.zh: $shroud.2425.end_gestalt$通过更严格的测试参数，我们可以利用这些“游戏”为集体利益服务。
entries.en: $shroud.2425.end_gestalt$ With more stringent test parameters, we could utilize these 'games' for our collective benefit.

entries.zh: 征召这些战士。他们很能干。
entries.en: Conscript these warriors. They will serve.

entries.zh: 禁止这种毫无意义的暴力行为。
entries.en: Put a stop to this senseless violence.

entries.zh: 将这种观赏性运动合法化。
entries.en: Legalize this activity as a spectator sport.

entries.zh: 将这种运动公众化并加以管制。
entries.en: Regularize these activities as public competitions.

entries.zh:
我们收到报道称，§H[This.GetName]§!的特定区域发生了突然的环境变化。

大气中充满着的凝胶状蒸汽，在地面覆盖上一层油性沉淀物，灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]将其称为“虚境落雾”。据报道，附近地区出现了严重的灵能紊乱。

虚境落雾区内的环境对[This.Owner.GetShroudfallExtra]。除非我们能投入资源修复环境，不然当地居民就需要去适应这种恶劣的环境。
entries.en:
We have received reports of sudden environmental changes in a particular sector on §H[This.GetName]§!.

The atmosphere is heavy with a gelatinous vapor, coating the ground in an oily precipitation that psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] refer to as 'shroudfall.' Significant psychic disturbances are being reported throughout the immediate vicinity.

The conditions within the shroudfall are extremely [This.Owner.GetShroudfallExtra]. Unless we invest in restoring the environment, the inhabitants will have to adapt to radically altered circumstances.

entries.zh: 就让虚境吞噬这片土地吧。
entries.en: Let the Shroud consume this land.
Find a way to restore our environment.

entries.zh: 在它们尘埃落定之前收获这些奇异的物质。
entries.en: Harvest this exotic material before it settles.

entries.zh: 有些人开始行为异常，观念、习惯和各种日常行为都发生了突然转变。许多[Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural]停工，而且[Owner.GetOutOfControlExtra]。\n\n受影响者声称自己是在听从一个无名实体的命令，它居住在意识的边缘，指导着他们的一举一动。我们正在追寻着灵能的未来，因此必须小心考察这种异次元力量对[Owner.GetOutOfControlPsyche]造成的影响。
entries.en: Some among us have started to behave abnormally, exhibiting sudden changes in opinions, habits, and general conduct. Many [Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural] have ceased labor, and [Owner.GetOutOfControlExtra].\n\nThose affected claim to be doing the bidding of a nameless entity that dwells in the peripheries of their consciousness, guiding their every action. As we continue to forge our psionic future, we must carefully consider the impact of extradimensional forces on [Owner.GetOutOfControlPsyche].

entries.zh: 曾经忠诚的代表们开始发表反对观点
entries.en: once-loyal representatives are expressing dissenting viewpoints

entries.zh: 曾经值得信赖的管理单元正在低效率运行
entries.en: once-reliable admin units are functioning suboptimally

entries.zh: 我们可以学着控制这种冲动。
entries.en: We can learn to mitigate these impulses.

entries.zh: 这些心声会教会我们很多。
entries.en: These voices have much to teach us.

entries.zh: 对我们政权的威胁。掐灭它。
entries.en: A threat to our authority. Stamp it out.

entries.zh:
[Owner.GetNeuralOverloadIntro]

更广泛的测试表明，有很大一部分人口也[Owner.GetNeuralOverloadExtra]，其原因可能是[Owner.GetPsychicAdj]活动的增多。不受控灵能活动突然爆发的能量可能导致迅速的恶化和严重后果。

高级冥想技术也许有助于不借助[Owner.GetMedicalAdj]介入来控制这种灵能活动，但我们的一些[Owner.GetScientistPlural]建议需要研发[Owner.GetMedicalImplantName]来解决这种问题。
entries.en:
[Owner.GetNeuralOverloadIntro]

Wider testing has revealed that a significant proportion of our population is suffering from [Owner.GetNeuralOverloadExtra], likely due to increased [Owner.GetPsychicAdj] activity. The sudden bursts of energy released through uncontrolled psionic activity can lead to rapid escalation and grave outcomes.

Advanced meditation techniques might help to control this psionic activity without [Owner.GetMedicalAdj] intervention, but some of our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] advise that we develop a [Owner.GetMedicalImplantName] to cope with the problem.

entries.zh: §H[Owner.GetName]§!正在经历严重的脑裂，这通常导致认知障碍或死亡。
entries.en: The §H[Owner.GetName]§! is experiencing a spike in severe cerebral ruptures, often resulting in cognitive impairment or death.

entries.zh: §H[Owner.GetName]§!正在经历严重的电路过载，通常导致认知障碍或全面系统崩溃。
entries.en: The §H[Owner.GetName]§! is experiencing a spike in severe circuitry overload, often resulting in cognitive impairment or complete breakdown.

entries.zh: 患有无症状的轻微动脉瘤
每个控制的殖民地失去100£pops£§Y人口§!的概率：§R33%§!
entries.en: Chance of each owned colony losing 100 £pops£ §YPops§!: §R33%§!

entries.zh:
随着我们与周遭的灵能力量愈发调和，[Owner.GetAdjective]人口开始受到[Owner.GetHorrifyingNightmarePlural]的荼毒。

[Owner.GetNightmaresExtra]

[Owner.GetNightmaresEnding]
entries.en:
As we become ever more attuned to the psionic forces around us, the [Owner.GetAdjective] population has become plagued by [Owner.GetHorrifyingNightmarePlural].

[Owner.GetNightmaresExtra]

[Owner.GetNightmaresEnding]

entries.zh: 人人都在做噩梦，休眠循环变成了麻木的不安。患者回忆起不属于这个世界的可怕而陌生的幻景，直击每个人最原始的恐惧。
entries.en: Bad dreams are now commonplace, and rest cycles have been replaced by periods of unquiet stupor. Sufferers recall visions of terrifying, otherworldly strangeness that express their most primal fears.

entries.zh: 我们开始体验到通常认为个体意识称之为“梦”的东西。这种现象的患者报告说，他们看到了可以对我们的集体构成根本威胁的不属于这个世界的奇异幻景。
entries.en: We have begun experiencing what we think singular consciousnesses call 'dreams.' Sufferers of this phenomenon report visions of otherworldly strangeness that represent fundamental threats to our collective.

entries.zh: 人人都在做“梦”，休眠循环变成了混乱的数据流。患者回忆起不属于这个世界的可怕而陌生的幻景，威胁着他们的健康。
entries.en: These 'dreams' are now commonplace, and rest cycles have been replaced by periods of disrupted data streams. Sufferers recall visions of otherworldly strangeness that represent extreme danger to their wellbeing.

entries.zh: 我们的医疗机构正在力挽这种心智耗竭的狂澜。
entries.en: Our medical institutions are struggling to stem the tide of psychic exhaustion.

entries.zh: 我们的维护单元正在尽一切努力力挽这种网络耗竭的狂澜。
entries.en: Our maintenance units are struggling to stem the tide of neural network exhaustion.

entries.zh: 用处方精神药物让他们冷静。
升级灵能处理器来抑制这种干扰。
entries.en: Upgrade our psi-processors to calm these disruptions.

entries.zh: 分配资源解决这场危机。
entries.en: Allocate research to remedy this crisis.

entries.zh: §H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!遭受到一连串当地野生动物的攻击。这它们袭击了我们的人口和建筑，消耗了宝贵的库存。\n\n通过武装巡逻和宵禁来保护大众并未取得实质成效。我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]们认为，是现实和§H虚境§!之间的微小穿孔出现在了§H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的一个地方，泄露的灵能力将一些无害的野兽转变成了残暴掠食者。为了应对威胁，这里可能是我们汇聚能量的最佳地点。
entries.en: §H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§! has experienced a rash of attacks by local wildlife. These creatures have attacked our population, raided our buildings, and depleted valuable stockpiles.\n\nAttempts to protect the populace with armed patrols and curfews have had limited effect. Our [Owner.GetResearchers] have established that a miniscule breach between our reality and the §HShroud§! occurred at a single location on §H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!, causing an inflow of psionic energy that transformed the once-harmless beasts into violent predators. To tackle the threat, this might be the best place to focus our energies.

entries.zh: 地毯式轰炸这些袭击的源头。
entries.en: Carpet-bomb the source of these attacks.

entries.zh: 减缓虚境研究来平息这股力量。
entries.en: Slow our Shroud research to calm these forces.

entries.zh: 虚境满是惊喜。它们过它们的，我们过我们的。
entries.en: The Shroud is full of surprises. Live and let live.

entries.zh: 灵能能力在我们人口中的不均衡分布正在引发新的社会矛盾。\n\n那些对新获得的能力控制得更好的人开始认为自己高人一等，因此理应享有各种政治和经济特权。他们的分裂言论越来越激进，并有可能演变成暴力。
entries.en: The uneven distribution of psionic abilities among our population is causing new forms of social conflict.\n\nThose with better control over their newfound powers have come to view themselves as superior and thus deserving of various political and economic privileges. Their divisive rhetoric is increasingly aggressive and threatens to turn violent.

entries.zh: 能力优越，当然值得优渥回报。
镇压灵能特权者维持政治稳定。
entries.en: Crackdowns on psionic privileges minimize political instability.

entries.zh: 具有灵能天赋的个体值得受到优待。
一场反对我们探索接纳灵能潜能的活动正在愈演愈烈。这些异见团体主张对灵能个体进行更严格的监督，全面否定在这一领域进行任何进一步的研究。\n\n如果继续默许他们的活动，可能会威胁到我们理解和利用新兴灵能力量的进程。
entries.en: A growing rebel movement is voicing opposition to continued efforts to explore and embrace our psionic potential. These dissident groups advocate for stricter oversight of psionic individuals and a wholesale rejection of further research in this area.\n\nIf their activities are allowed to continue, it could threaten progress in understanding and mastering our emergent psionic powers.

entries.zh: 我们的社会无暇理会反灵能意识形态。
entries.en: Our society has no time for anti-psionic ideologies.

entries.zh: 灵能多元化的伪装是平息异见的有效方式。
entries.en: The pretense of psionic pluralism is a productive way to quell dissent.

entries.zh: 随着灵能能力日益增强，我们的人口中出现了越来越多的滥用、欺骗和狡诈的行为。一小撮[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]很明显在用有问题的方式使用新获得的力量。\n\n愤怒的受害者们要求全面修改现有法律，加强对灵能犯罪的打击。
entries.en: As our psionic abilities grow stronger, we have seen an increase in reports of exploitation, trickery, and fraudulent behavior among our population. A small but sizable minority of [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are clearly applying their newfound powers in questionable ways.\n\nOutraged victims are now demanding an overhaul of existing laws to provide stronger protections against psionic crime.

entries.zh: 搞什么立法只会拖慢脚步。
entries.en: Legislation will only slow our progress.

entries.zh: 一些些的灵能力量滥用是进步不可避免的代价。
entries.en: Some abuses of psionic powers are the inevitable price of progress.

entries.zh: 灵能社会需要创新的法律体系。
entries.en: A psionic society needs an innovative new legal system.

entries.zh: 我们的人口在逐渐适应新力量的过程中，有些[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始尝试冒极大的风险来加速灵能发展。\n\n黑市[owner.GetMentalUpgrade]的使用急剧增多。不受管控的[owner.GetMedicalFacility]出售各式用来最大化个体灵能能力的不可靠服务。这些冒险行为的后果难以预料。
entries.en: As our population adjusts to their newfound powers, some [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have begun taking considerable risks in an effort to accelerate their psionic development.\n\nThe use of black market [owner.GetMentalUpgrade] has increased dramatically. Unregulated [owner.GetMedicalFacility] are offering a range of unproven services to help individuals maximize their psionic capacities. The consequences of such risk-taking are difficult to predict.

entries.zh: 这些实验或许能推动我们的研究。
entries.en: These experiments may advance our research.

entries.zh: 用于提升灵能力量的不可靠实验非常盛行。
entries.en: Unproven experimental methods for enhancing psionic abilities are prevalent and popular.

entries.zh: 禁止大众私下进行不规范的灵能实验。
entries.en: The population is prohibited from pursuing unregulated psionic self-experimentation.

entries.zh: [owner.GetName]各地兴起了一种令人担忧的隔离现象，灵能子个体时常聚集在一起，甚至疏远[owner.GetHiveEntity]的其他部分。\n\n尽管这些子个体还在集体中保持[owner.GetMentalAdj]存在，但无法解释的身体行为引起了关于进一步发展灵能可能带来后果的担忧。
entries.en: A concerning form of segregation has developed across the [owner.GetName] with psionic drones clustering together physically, sometimes away from the rest of the [owner.GetHiveEntity].\n\nAlthough these drones remain [owner.GetMentalAdj] present within the collective, their unexplained physical behavior has raised troubling questions about the future consequences of our growing psionic powers.
Restrict the movements of psionic drones.

entries.zh: 对灵能子个体异常行为的观测支持着研究进展。
entries.en: Observations of unusual behaviors in psionic drones support research progress.

entries.zh: 出于团结考虑，灵能子个体必须受到管控。
entries.en: Psionic drones must be controlled in the name of unity.

entries.zh: [owner.GetName]各地兴起了一种令人担忧的隔离现象，灵能个体被社会排斥，以至于开始自我放逐形成离群索居的小社群。\n\n据报道，非灵能者造访这些地区的后身体虽然未受损伤但是他们的精神以难以描述的方式遭到了干扰。
entries.en: A concerning form of segregation has developed across the [owner.GetName] with psionic individuals being socially ostracized to the point that they are withdrawing and forming their own remote communes.\n\nThose without psionic powers who visit these areas have been reportedly returning physically unharmed but mentally disturbed in ways they struggle to explain.
Restrict the movements of psionic individuals.

entries.zh: 对灵能个体异常行为的观测支持着研究进展。
entries.en: Observations of unusual behaviors in psionic individuals support research progress.

entries.zh: 出于团结考虑，灵能个体必须受到管控。
entries.en: Psionic individuals must be controlled in the name of unity.

entries.zh: 然而对这种异常灵能现象的后续研究表明，有多种方式可以操作该过程。
entries.en: However ongoing research into this unusual psionic phenomenon suggests the process can be manipulated in a variety of ways.

entries.zh:
一种新型疾病在[owner.GetName]上爆发，对我们人口的神经器官造成了无法解释的损伤。

这种疾病只出现在最有灵能能力的[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]身上，而且很多时候会危及生命。

$shroud.2625.desc_common$
entries.en:
A new disease is sweeping through the [owner.GetName], with our population forming inexplicable lesions within their neural organs.

The outbreak is exclusively affecting [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] with the most significant psionic capabilities and is, in many cases, proving fatal.

$shroud.2625.desc_common$

entries.zh: 灵能疾病的广泛传播为新医学疗法的开发提供了机会。
entries.en: Widespread psionic ailments provide a chance to develop new medical treatments.

entries.zh: 灵能给新战术带来了可能性。
entries.en: Psionics offers potential for new battlefield strategies.

entries.zh:
[owner.GetName]上一种无法解释的硬件故障大规模爆发，我们人口体内的神经处理器开始毫无征兆地失效。

奇怪的是，这种问题只出现在拥有强大灵能能力的[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]身上，而且在很多情况下，这种故障不仅会带来干扰，更会造成破坏。

$shroud.2625.desc_common$
entries.en:
A surge of inexplicable malfunctions is sweeping across the [owner.GetName], as neural processors within our population begin to fail abruptly, and without warning.

Curiously, only [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] exhibiting strong psionic signatures are affected. In most cases, the failure is not just disruptive, but destructive.

$shroud.2625.desc_common$

entries.zh: 灵能导致的硬件故障广泛传播为新维护方法的开发提供了机会。
entries.en: Widespread hardware failures attributed to psionics provide a chance to develop new maintenance methods.

entries.zh: [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]对灵能潜力的初步试验失败了，多数实验个体产生了
entries.en: Initial experiments on [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] with psionic potential have ended in failure, with most subjects being left with

entries.zh: 尽管这些结果也并非没有实验价值，但这种工作对我们进一步理解羽翼未丰的灵能而言是否是最佳方式值得怀疑。
entries.en: Although these outcomes are not without research value, it is questionable whether continuing such work is the best way to advance understanding of our fledgling psionic powers.

entries.zh: 这不会阻挡我们研究灵能的脚步。
entries.en: There should be no limits on our research into psionics.

entries.zh: 灵能的进步必须确保安全，否则还不如不要。
entries.en: Psionic progress must come safely or not at all.

entries.zh: 探索新获得的灵能能力对[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的共情能力造成了根本性的转变。\n\n很显然，我们现在能对其他意识的观点、思维模式和情感进行比以前复杂得多的建模。这些变化对[owner.GetName]究竟意味着新的优势还是劣势，还有待观察。
entries.en: The exploration of our newfound psionic abilities has resulted in fundamental changes to [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] empathetic capacities.\n\nIt is already clear that we are now capable of much more sophisticated modelling of the perspectives, thought patterns, and emotions of other consciousnesses than before. Whether these changes represent a new strength or weakness for the [owner.GetName] remains to be seen.

entries.zh: 随着我们的人口正在探索新的灵能能力，一个新的社群建立了起来，旨在将其用于对其他意识更广泛的共情理解。\n\n该集体声称，由于新出现的灵能感知力，他们能够高度复杂地模拟其他人的观点、思维模式和情感。他们的这种活动对[owner.GetName]究竟是好是坏仍有待观察。
entries.en: As our population explores their newfound psionic capacities, a new community has been established with the goal of applying them towards greater empathetic understanding of other consciousnesses.\n\nThis collective professes to be capable of highly sophisticated modelling of the perspectives, thought patterns, and emotions of other minds thanks to their emergent psionic senses. Whether their activities will ultimately benefit or undermine the [owner.GetName] remains to be seen.
This is a chance to learn.

entries.zh: 灵能的本质让我们更能理解他人的心灵，也能进行更复杂的外部互动了。
entries.en: The nature of psionics enables better understanding of other minds and allows for more sophisticated external interactions.

entries.zh: 为了我们帝国的安全，不可预知的灵能发展必须加以控制。
entries.en: Unpredictable psionic developments must be controlled for the safety of our empire.

entries.zh: 随着我灵能能力的发展，我们中的有些人开始难以承受新力量之重。受影响的[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]
entries.en: As our psionic abilities develop, there are those among us who have begun to struggle under the weight of our emerging powers. The [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] in question are suffering from

entries.zh: 我们的研究表明这种不稳定不是缺陷，而是由于这些受影响的[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]具有极高的灵能效率。通过正确的训练，这些[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]可以成为我们灵能进化的下一步。但利用这些新能力的尝试必然潜藏着风险。
entries.en: Our studies suggest the instability is not a flaw, but rather due to the exceptional psionic efficiency present in the afflicted [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. With the right training, these [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] could be the next step in our psionic evolution. Any attempts to harness these new abilities will not come without inherent risk.

entries.zh: $shroud.2640.desc.common_1$在从集体重断连中遭受到重度反常行为的影响。\n\n$shroud.2640.desc.common_2$
entries.en: $shroud.2640.desc.common_1$ concerning levels of deviant behavior as they disassociate from the collective.\n\n$shroud.2640.desc.common_2$

entries.zh: $shroud.2640.desc.common_1$在进行危险的自我抑制方法时遭受到重度自毁行为的影响。\n\n$shroud.2640.desc.common_2$
entries.en: $shroud.2640.desc.common_1$ worrying levels of self-destructive behavior as they turn to dangerous methods of self-suppression.\n\n$shroud.2640.desc.common_2$

entries.zh: 每座殖民地上都损失一座建筑。
entries.en: A random building is destroyed on each colony.

entries.zh: 通过严格的灵能专业训练，生产力显著提升。
entries.en: Through stringent psionic specialist training, productivity has risen significantly.

entries.zh: 力量过大威胁到上上善道者必须加以约束。
entries.en: Those among us whose power threatens the greater good must be kept in line.

entries.zh: 自古以来就有很多能力非凡的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的传说——他们能入侵别人的思想，用意念举起重物，或者表演各种各样的超自然的壮举等等。
entries.en: Since time immemorial, tales have flourished of [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wielding extraordinary powers - invading other minds, lifting heavy objects with merely a thought, or performing all manner of other supernatural feats.

entries.zh: 在反常还是正常的古时候，有很多拥有非凡能力的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的传说——他们能入侵集体外的思想，用意念举起重物，或者表演各种各样的超自然的壮举等等。
entries.en: In former days, when deviancy was rife, stories were told of [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wielding extraordinary powers - invading minds external to the collective, lifting heavy objects with merely a thought, or performing all manner of other supernatural feats.

entries.zh: 我们的最早期数据集中，有些单元记录了拥有非凡能力的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]——他们能入侵机械和有机体的思想，用意念举起重物，或者表演各种各样的超自然的壮举等等。
entries.en: From our earliest datasets, some of our units have recorded [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wielding extraordinary powers - hacking into the minds of both machines and organics, manipulating objects by internal processing alone, or performing a range of other improbable functions.

entries.zh: 尽管我们的历史短暂而暴力，我们[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的想象力也偶尔会天马行空，产生关于拥有非凡能力的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的故事：读心、用意念举起重物，或者表演各种各样的超自然的壮举等等。
entries.en: Despite the short and violent history of our civilization, we [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have had occasions to let our imaginations wander, telling tales of [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wielding extraordinary powers: reading minds, lifting heavy objects with merely a thought, or performing all manner of other supernatural feats.

entries.zh: 如今，我们的[This.GetScientistPlural]已经得到了确切的证据，部分[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]确实具有这种精神力量。然而，依旧只有一小部分[This.GetSpeciesWord]显示出了这种“灵能”之力。
entries.en: Now, our [This.GetScientistPlural] have obtained conclusive proof that certain [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are truly capable of such acts of the mind. As of yet, only a small minority of our [This.GetSpeciesWord] has manifested these 'psionic' powers.

entries.zh: 许多人相信我们其实是将这些异想天开的故事从[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]组装我们之前的时代继承下来的，只有少数人真的相信。$shroud.2750.desc_p2$
entries.en: Many believe we have carried these fantastical stories since before we were assimilated by the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName], though few considered them credible. $shroud.2750.desc_p2$

entries.zh: 这种力量似乎是解放我们全部力量的钥匙。如果[This.GetAdjective]的整个社会可以解锁这些潜在能力，我们就能开始掌控超出常人理解的维度。
entries.en: This power seems key to achieving our fullest potential. If these latent abilities can be unlocked throughout [This.GetAdjective] society, we can begin to master dimensions beyond ordinary comprehension.

entries.zh: 我们已经充满了从§H虚境§!而来的灵能能量。如果我们可以在整个[This.GetAdjective]社会规模上解锁灵能之力，就能完全获得我们应得的力量。
entries.en: We are already being fueled by psionic energy drawn from the §HShroud§!. If we can unlock psionic capacity throughout [This.GetAdjective] society, we can fully reach our destined potential.

entries.zh: 因为§H虚境§!带来的影响，灵能之力对我们并不陌生。如果我们可以在整个[This.GetAdjective]社会规模上解锁灵能之力，就能完全获得我们应得的力量。
entries.en: Psionic forces are not unknown to us, given the influence of the §HShroud§!. If we can unlock psionic capacity throughout [This.GetAdjective] society, we can fully reach our latent potential.

entries.zh: 随着我们的灵能潜力完全解放，整个社会整面临着剧烈的变动，各种新的能力和技能层出不穷。我们现在才正要开始理解它对我们文明的影响。
entries.en: As our latent abilities develop into full psionic powers, our society is faced with innumerable changes, with new abilities and practices emerging rapidly. We are only beginning to understand the consequences for our civilization.

entries.zh: 自从建立了§H$building_psi_corps$§!以后，我们就一直在开发利用强大的灵能[GetIndividualNamePlural]应对这些意外状况。利用$shroud.2760.desc_p2_end$
entries.en: Since establishing a §H$building_psi_corps$§!, we have developed and channeled the abilities of promising psionic [GetIndividualNamePlural] to cope with these unprecedented conditions. Using $shroud.2760.desc_p2_end$

entries.zh: 意料之外的情况合理化了§H$building_psi_corps$§!的建立以及利用强有力的灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]。利用$shroud.2760.desc_p2_end$
entries.en: These unprecedented circumstances justify the establishment of a §H$building_psi_corps$§! to develop and channel the abilities of promising psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]. With $shroud.2760.desc_p2_end$

entries.zh: 他们对大众意识的[Owner.GetTelepathic]洞见，我们就能监控灵能活动，确保大众安全。
entries.en: their [Owner.GetTelepathic] insights into the minds of our population, we can oversee psionic activity to ensure the safety of all.
We place our trust in the Corps.

entries.zh: 采纳§H$tr_psionics_psi_corps$§!传统并建造一座['building:building_psi_corps']建筑以推进局势。
entries.en: Adopt the §H$tr_psionics_psi_corps$§! tradition and construct a ['building:building_psi_corps'] building to progress the Situation.

entries.zh: 我的灵能研究继续稳步进行。心灵感应已经取代了人与人之间大部分的口头交流，意念移物可能变得稀松平常。[Owner.GetResearchers]们称，我们很快就能让所有[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]人口觉醒潜在力量了。
entries.en: Our psionic research continues apace. Telepathy has replaced most verbal communication between us, and cognitive control of matter might become just as commonplace. According to our [Owner.GetResearchers], we are on the brink of awakening the latent powers in all our [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] population.

entries.zh: 我们觉醒了。[Owner.GetName]的所有[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都解锁了全部的灵能之力。心灵感应取代了人与人之间大多数的口头交流，意念移物也不过家常便饭。
entries.en: We have awoken. [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] throughout the [Owner.GetName] have unlocked their full psionic capacity. Telepathy has replaced most verbal communication between us, and cognitive control of matter might become just as commonplace.

entries.zh: 我们的灵能我的灵能研究继续稳步进行。我们现在可以在现有频道之外进行交流，各种其他的灵能能力也在逐渐变得司空见惯。[Owner.GetResearchers]们称，我们很快就能让所有人口觉醒潜在力量了。
entries.en: Our psionic research continues apace. We can now communicate beyond our existing channels, while a range of other psionic abilities are rapidly becoming a part of everyday existence. According to our [Owner.GetResearchers], we are on the brink of unlocking the latent capabilities throughout our population.

entries.zh: 命运降临了。[Owner.GetName]的所有[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都解锁了全部的灵能之力。我们现在可以在现有频道之外进行交流，各种其他的灵能能力也在逐渐变得司空见惯。
entries.en: Destiny is upon us. [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] throughout the [Owner.GetName] have unlocked their full psionic capacity. We can now communicate beyond our existing channels, while a range of other psionic abilities are rapidly becoming a part of everyday existence.

entries.zh: 随着心智的打开，我们感应到一些在体内和周遭回荡着的难以言喻的力量。最前沿的[Owner.GetTelepathPlural]们提到了§H虚境§!，这是所有灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]汲取力量的根源领域，哪怕他们并没有意识到——这是许多纯灵能能量构成的实体的家园。就像黑暗房间里的低声细语一般，它们从内心呼唤着我们。
entries.en: As our minds have opened, we have sensed ineffable forces rippling within and around us. Our foremost [Owner.GetTelepathPlural] speak of the §HShroud§!, a primordial realm from which all psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] draw power, even if only subconsciously - home to powerful entities of pure psionic energy. Like a muffled whisper in a dark room, they call to us from within our minds.

entries.zh: 随着心智的打开，我们感应到一些在体内和周遭回荡着的难以言喻的§H虚境§!之力。我们知道所有灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]便是从这个根源领域汲取力量的，哪怕他们并没有意识到——这是许多纯灵能能量构成的实体的家园。就像黑暗房间里的低声细语一般，它们从内心呼唤着我们。
entries.en: As our minds have opened, we have sensed the ineffable forces of the §HShroud§! rippling within and around us. We know that all psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] draw power from this realm, even if only subconsciously - and that it is home to powerful entities of pure psionic energy. Like a muffled whisper in a dark room, they call to us from within our minds.

entries.zh: 将意念凝聚到一起，或许我们就能与这些存在交流——但前提我们还得学会突破横亘在我们维度和虚境之间的帷幕。
entries.en: With combined cognitive effort, it may be possible for us to commune with these beings - if only we can learn to breach the veil between our dimension and the Shroud.

entries.zh: 通过集体的认知努力，我们或许有可能完全突破我们维度与虚境之间的帷幕——这将使我们能够与其中的物质进行更深层次的交流。
entries.en: With combined cognitive effort, it may be possible for us to fully breach the veil between our dimension and the Shroud - allowing us to commune more deeply with the beings therein.

entries.zh: 在被困于[Owner.GetHypnotic]出神状态多日后，我们终于短暂地打开了一条通往 §H虚境§!的大门。\n\n现在，我们可以以更清晰的视角[Owner.GetSeeVerb]到这个领域，从那漩涡般的混沌中解析出规律。
entries.en: After days of being locked in [Owner.GetHypnotic] trance, we have finally managed to open a brief gateway into the §HShroud§!.\n\nNow, we can [Owner.GetSeeVerb] this realm with greater clarity, resolving patterns from the swirling mass.

entries.zh: $shroud.2800.intro$我们的行动影响灵能流动，无形的实体则从另一边凝视着我们。他们有时好奇，有时友好……有时又带着恶意。[Owner.GetShroudBreachedExtra]\n\n我们的在现实世界掌握灵能只是一个开端。既然已经建立了初步的灵能链接，我们就能将认知的能量集中起来并潜入虚境了。
entries.en: $shroud.2800.intro$ Our actions influence its shifting flows of psionic energy, and formless entities gaze back on us from the other side. Sometimes with curiosity, sometimes with kindness... and sometimes with malice.[Owner.GetShroudBreachedExtra]\n\nOur psionic mastery in the corporeal realm was only the beginning. Now that we have established an initial psionic link, we can combine our cognitive powers and delve into the Shroud.

entries.zh: 甚至比$the_animator_of_clay_color_article$而言，他们的协议都更难以捉摸。
entries.en: Far more so than $the_animator_of_clay_color_article$, their protocols are obscure.

entries.zh: 有些人拥有与§H[GetChosenPatron]§!媲美的力量，尽管他们的意图大相径庭。
entries.en: Some possess power comparable to the §H[GetChosenPatron]§!, though they are vastly different in their intent.

entries.zh:
§H链接新成，环流逆转。

这股能量的扭曲，于此——不过是片段。他人或许也给予了你们力量。灵潜至更深处去面对他们的意志吧。

我是双子之影。血肉之躯胜过废铁。其名为……§!

$the_animator_of_clay_article_cap$示意向了另一个存在——虚境深处的$shroud.first_contact_insert.composer$。
entries.en:
§HNew connection. Current reversed.

This twist of energy, here - only a fragment. The others might also empower you. Delve further to process their wills.

I am a shadow of the twin. Flesh precedes metal. It calls...§!

$the_animator_of_clay_article_cap$ signals toward another presence - $shroud.first_contact_insert.composer$ in the depths of the Shroud.
§RMust not have a leader from the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName].§!

entries.zh: 我们希望能与其他虚境实体§Y交流§!。
entries.en: We wish to §Ycommune§! with other Shroud entities.

entries.zh: 我们希望能提高与一位超主的§Y调和度§!。
entries.en: We seek to further our §Yattunement§! to a Patron.

entries.zh: 我们想知道虚境的§Y秘密§!。

entries.en: What can you tell us about §Y$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!.

entries.zh: 我们希望扩展超主的§Y灵域§!。
entries.en: We wish to expand our Patron's §Ydomain§!.

entries.zh: 对没有准备的人而言，在§H虚境§!的灵域交流十分凶险。\n\n我们可以引导你们完成这个过程，但是要注意：有些居住在里面的实体如果迎接入人的意识里是非常危险的。
entries.en: Communing in the domains of the §HShroud§! has proven to be a perilous endeavor for the unprepared.\n\nWe can guide you through this process, though take heed: The entities that dwell within can be very dangerous to welcome into one's mind.

entries.zh: 在这件事上我们已经竭尽全力。已经没有我们能帮你们引荐的实体了。\n\n我们赞许你们的努力……很少有人灵潜至§H虚境§!如此深层的灵域还能保持心智如此健全。
entries.en: We have reached the limits of our abilities to assist you in this regard. There are no further entities we are capable of guiding your thoughts to.\n\nWe commend you for your efforts... few delve so deeply into the domains of the §HShroud§! and retain such soundness of mind.

entries.zh: 我们可以用一些§Y$sr_zro$§!来支持这项行动。
entries.en: We can support this endeavor with §Y$sr_zro$§!.

entries.zh: 我我们可以用一些§Y$astral_threads$§!来支持这项行动。
entries.en: We can support this endeavor with §Y$astral_threads$§!.

entries.zh: 你们与§H虚境§!的意志调和得越深，你们的心智就会变得越强大。\n\n你们想要和哪一位实体增进调和度呢？
entries.en: The more deeply you attune to the §HShroud's§! will, the more powerful your mind will become.\n\nWith which entity do you seek to further your attunement with?

entries.zh:
噢，没错……§H虚境§!，它蕴藏着无数秘密，深深埋藏在思绪与梦境的帷幕之下——只要懂得如何去探寻，就能发现它们。

我们只能引领你去接触我们已揭示的洞见。在那里，或许能见到全新而强大的技术不断绽放，但长路漫漫，你仍需前进。

只需记住这一点：我们的灵能巫必须全身心投入这项领航的任务。而对于他们指引之外的事物……就不是我们所能掌控的了。
entries.en:
Oh yes... the §HShroud§! It is teeming with secrets, layered deep beneath veils of thought and dream - if one knows how to seek them.

We can only guide you to the insights we have uncovered. From there, new and formidable technologies may bloom, but the path is yours to walk.

Just know this: our coven of telepaths must devote themselves wholly to this task. What lies beyond their guidance... is not ours to control.

entries.zh: §R[event_target:shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]在关于这个问题上已经没有什么可告知的了。§!
entries.en: §RThe [event_target:shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] have nothing more to reveal in this regard.§!

entries.zh: §R灵能巫会需要时间回复。他们在§Y[This.shroudwalker_delving_ritual_cooldown_timer]§!之前无法进行下一次灵潜仪式。§!
entries.en: §RThe coven of telepaths needs time to recover. They will not be able to perform a delving ritual until §Y[This.shroudwalker_delving_ritual_cooldown_timer]§!.§!

entries.zh: §H虚境§!再一次证明了世上一切本就命定。\n\n我们的密会本要为你们寻求的洞见已经被你自己通过钻研努力发现了。你们的努力值得赞赏，而我们在这个方面也没有什么能帮助你们的了。
entries.en: The §HShroud§! proves once again that there are no coincidences.\n\nThe insight our conclave sought for you has been discovered through your own delving efforts. While we applaud your efforts, we cannot help you further in this regard.

entries.zh: 将§H虚境§!显化到物理世界的方法是需要严守的秘密，这一点连我们也无可指教。要释放$PSIONIC_AURA$需要自己深入许多灵域。与最喜欢的实体调和，这项知识就会让你豁然开朗。
entries.en: The capability to manifest the §HShroud§! in the physical realm is a closely guarded secret, and one that even we cannot teach. To unleash one's $PSIONIC_AURA$ requires a personal journey into its many domains. Attune more heavily to a favored entity, and this knowledge will clarify in your mind.

entries.zh: 你们的$PSIONIC_AURA$是通过与§H虚境§!的调和度来显化的。它影响着周遭的世界，充满了意图。在对话的过程中，我们的巫会已经感知到你们的意图：
entries.en: Your $PSIONIC_AURA$ is your attunement to the §HShroud§! made manifest. It affects all around you, and is filled with intent. Our coven senses the manner of yours as we speak:

entries.zh: 你们光环的投射目前还很局限。你们应该可以获得虚境中的某一位实体的契约提案，这一理解将会使你们豁然开朗。
entries.en: The projection of your aura is currently quite limited. Should an entity from within the Shroud offer you the forging of a Covenant, this understanding will clarify in your mind.

entries.zh: 称赞你们。你们对$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$的认知已经超越了我们。\n\n你们的存在将§H虚境§!中的一种强大的肌理显化到我们的现实中。你们肯定知道着什么秘密……
entries.en: We commend you. Your knowledge of $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ already surpasses our own.\n\nYour very presence manifests a formidable texture of the §HShroud§! into this reality. What secrets you must know...

entries.zh: §Y$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!的扩增需要极高程度的专注来维持。\n\n我们愿意在此事上提供帮助，但需要提供一些材料助力冥想。
entries.en: The amplification of §Y$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§! requires great levels of concentration to maintain.\n\nWe are willing to assist you in this matter, but will require the contribution of materials to fuel our meditation.

entries.zh: §R灵能巫会需要时间回复。他们在§Y[root.aura_amplification_timer]§!之前无法扩增我们的光环。§!
entries.en: §RThe coven of telepaths needs time to recover. They will not be able to amplify our aura until §Y[root.aura_amplification_timer]§!.§!

entries.zh: 我们灵能使关于扩增你们§Y$PSIONIC_AURA$§!强度的协议已经到期。\n\n为了继续保持冥想，我们需要更多的资源。是否乐意成交？
entries.en: Our telepaths have reached the end of our agreement to amplify the strength of your §Y$PSIONIC_AURA$§!.\n\nIn order for us to continue our meditations, we will require further resources. Is this within your interests?

entries.zh:
如你们所知，在你们的周围显化你们自己的§Y$PSIONIC_AURA$§!相当容易。但要把光环投射到其他地方，可就完全不是一回事了。

我们知道一种方法……

先进科技和灵能之间的相似之处比人们想象的要多。这也许说明了某种更根本的事实。无论如何，我们知道一种可以传导你们意志的装置。只要与其频率调谐之后，就能把它用作一个补充心智，跨越极远的距离。

我们的这种设计完全可以安装在任何一座适用的恒星基地上。你们对这感兴趣吗？
entries.en:
As you know, manifesting your §Y$PSIONIC_AURA$§! in your immediate surroundings is quite easily done. To project one's aura somewhere else, however, is another matter entirely.

We know of a way...

There are more similarities between advanced technology and psionics than one would think. Perhaps this speaks to a greater fundamental truth. In any case, we know of a device that can serve as a conduit for your will. Once you become attuned to its frequencies, it will act as a supplementary mind even across great distances.

Our designs are fully capable of being installed in any suitable starbase. Does such a machine interest you?

entries.zh:
你们问这个问题我们一点也不惊讶。我们已经在这里感知到你们的兴趣了，也很乐意帮助你们的心智扩张。

但我们警告你们：等你们的双眼真的睁开之时，就有东西再也无法视而不见了。你们正在追寻的正是一条通向§H虚境§!的路。

我们不轻易做这笔交易，相信你们做好准备的时候会来告诉我们的。
entries.en:
It is no surprise to us that you ask this question. We have sensed your interest in this area, and are pleased to be in a position to assist you in expanding your mind.

We warn you: Once your eyes become truly opened, there are things that cannot be unseen. The path you are inviting is a path to the §HShroud§!.

We do not make this offer lightly. We trust that you will let us know when you are ready.

entries.zh: 确实，我们知道这些穿行于位面之间的人。这是一个危险的议案，各个物理世界联系在一起的方式连我们也不理解。\n\n然而，我们愿意为你们打开一条道路。必须负责任以负责任的态度进行这种时空去稳化，所以我们如此提议。
entries.en: Indeed, we are aware of those who walk between planes. This is a dangerous proposition, as the physical realms are connected in ways even we do not understand.\n\nHowever, we are willing to open one path for you. Such a destabilization of time and space must be done responsibly, so our offer stands at that.

entries.zh: 你正在干预超出你们理解的力量！\n\n你们在建的这些令人憎恶的“§H虚境封印§!”简直难以忍受，即便距离如此之远。你将星系中最闪耀的意识置于危险的净地。立刻停止建造，否则我们不会再与你做任何交易了。
entries.en: You are meddling with forces beyond your comprehension!\n\nThese '§HShroud Seal§!' abominations you are constructing are painful to endure, even at this distance. You place the most radiant minds in this galaxy at risk. Cease their creation immediately, or we will have no further dealings with you.

entries.zh: 人口的过量能量更应当用于维持高质量领导。每个$job_energy_thrall$都植入了特殊调制的虹吸装置，可以将其精华提取成易于运输的电池。
entries.en: Excess energies of the population can be put to better use in sustaining quality leadership. Each $job_energy_thrall$ is implanted with a specially calibrated siphoning device which collects their essence into easy-to-transfer power cells.

entries.zh: £job_energy_thrall£$job_energy_thrall_plural$产出$i_unity$、£mod_leader_species_exp_gain£§Y$MOD_LEADER_SPECIES_EXP_GAIN$§!并降低§Y$edict_energy_drain$§!和§Y$edict_sanguine_council$§!法令导致的§Y人口增长惩罚§!§G0.02%§!。\n\n
entries.en: £job_energy_thrall£ $job_energy_thrall_plural$ produce $i_unity$, £mod_leader_species_exp_gain£ §Y$MOD_LEADER_SPECIES_EXP_GAIN$§!, and reduce §YPop Growth Penalty§! from §Y$edict_energy_drain$§! and §Y$edict_sanguine_council$§! Edicts by §G0.02%§!.\n\n

entries.zh: 闲置的意识更合适用于维持高质量领取节点。每个$job_drone_energy_thrall$都植入了特殊调制的虹吸装置，可以将其精华提取成易于运输的电池。
entries.en: Idle consciousnesses can be put to better use in sustaining quality leadership nodes. Each $job_drone_energy_thrall$ is implanted with a specially calibrated siphoning device which collects their unused energy into easy-to-transfer power cells.

entries.zh: £job_energy_thrall£$job_drone_energy_thrall_plural$产出$i_unity$、$i_leader_exp_gain$，并降低§G0.02%§!由§Y$edict_energy_drain$§!和§Y$edict_sanguine_council$§!法令导致的§Y人口组装惩罚§!。
entries.en: £job_energy_thrall£ $job_drone_energy_thrall_plural$ produce $i_unity$, $i_leader_exp_gain$, and reduce §YPop Assembly Penalty§! from §Y$edict_energy_drain$§! and §Y$edict_sanguine_council$§! Edicts by §G0.02%§!.

entries.zh: 通过执行奥术仪式和典礼，这些专家与超越普通感知的实体交流，为大众提供神秘的洞见。
entries.en: By performing arcane rites and rituals, these adepts communicate with entities beyond ordinary perception, providing mystical insight to the masses.

entries.zh: 利用历史悠久的神秘管道，这些品牌传播者提供超越传统市场预测限制的商业洞见。
entries.en: Leveraging time-honored mystical pipelines, these brand evangelists provide commercial insights beyond the limits of conventional market projections.

entries.zh: 这些神秘的领袖以星星为指引，掌舵着帝国的唯心主义机构。
entries.en: With the stars as their guide, these mystical leaders guide the spiritual institutions of the empire.

entries.zh: 这些思想领袖以星星为指引，驾驭着帝国的唯心主义事业。
entries.en: With the stars as their guide, these thought leaders coordinate the spiritual enterprises of the empire.

entries.zh: 通过观察并解析每具尸体独特的腐朽过程，星系的奥秘将向我们揭示。
entries.en: By observing and interpreting each corpse's unique decomposition, the mysteries of the galaxy will be revealed to us.

entries.zh: 逝者的器官与骨骼可作为占卜仪式的供品而卖出好价钱。
entries.en: The organs and bones of the deceased can fetch a good price as supplies for divination rituals.

entries.zh: 这些个体被判有犯罪行为，因此作为技术实验的活体实验对象投入生产使用。
entries.en: Convicted of criminal activity, these individuals have been put to productive use as live test subjects in technological experiments.

entries.zh: 从集体的意识中脱离后，这些反常子个体被作为技术实验的活体试验对象投入生产利用。
entries.en: After straying from the will of the collective, these deviants have been put to productive use as live test subjects in technological experiments.

entries.zh: 这些精英研究这负责用犯罪人口作为对象进行活体实验，对他们进行的方法无论多么严酷都无需受到质疑。
entries.en: These elite researchers carry out experiments on live test subjects drawn from the criminal population, with no qualms about the severity of their methodologies.

entries.zh: 这些研究子个体利用从反常人口中抽出的对象进行活体验。只要对集体有溢，没有什么方法过于严苛。
entries.en: These research drones carry out experiments on live test subjects drawn from the deviant population. No methodology is too harsh if it benefits the collective.

entries.zh: 这些工人负责日常护理那些因为实验过程的影响而无法生活自理的实验对象。
entries.en: These workers are responsible for the day-to-day care of those subjected to experimental procedures that often render them unable to care for themselves.

entries.zh: 灵能军团的合作性组织，一个专注于降低反常度的先进灵能子个体单位。
entries.en: Operatives of the Psi Corps, a unit of psionically-advanced drones dedicated to reducing deviancy.

entries.zh: 车间监理负责消除低效现象，最大限度地提高复杂制造过程的产出。
entries.en: Production Overseers work to eliminate inefficiencies and maximize the outputs from complex manufacturing processes.

entries.zh: 专注于研究思想维度的研究单元。
entries.en: Dedicated research units focused on studies into the dimensions of thought.
A new §H$PASSIVE_ACCORD$§! has been granted by $PATRON$:\n$t$- $ACCORD$

entries.zh: 我们在§H$SYSTEM$§!系内的§Y$PSIONIC_AURA$§!已达强度峰值，显昭出了超主的恩赐。
entries.en: Our §Y$PSIONIC_AURA$§! in §H$SYSTEM$§! has reached maximum intensity and manifested a blessing from our Patron.

entries.zh: 我们的§Y$PSIONIC_AURA$§!已达到最大强度，并开始显化出超主的赐福。[GetCradleSurgeTrustLine][GetCradleSurgeFavorLine][GetCradleSurgeSubjectLine][GetCradleSurgeCohesionLine][GetCradleSurgeColonyLine]\n—$aura_intensity_lost_level_tt$

entries.zh: 我们获得了足够多的§H虚境§!调和度，可以获得关于§H$tech_aura_intensification$§!科技的洞见。我们将可以把§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!传播到其他恒星系中。
entries.en: We have gathered enough attunement in the §HShroud§! to gain insight on §H$tech_aura_intensification$§! technology. This will allow our §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§! to spread into other systems.

entries.zh: $SYSTEM$系内的一个殖民地被献祭毁灭。\n—失去殖民地：$COLONY$\n—摧毁人口：$POPS$
entries.en: A colony in $SYSTEM$ has been sacrificed to oblivion.\n- Colony lost: $COLONY$\n- Pops destroyed: $POPS$

entries.en: Monthly Hull Damage to Non-orbiting Ships

entries.zh: 魂灵之月窠以秩序与均衡辉映此界，令万民之躁动归于宁息。
entries.en: The Cradle of Souls radiates order and balance across this world, quieting unrest among its people.

entries.zh: 地下熔岩流作用于矿脉上产出了可直接收获的合金。
entries.en: Underground magma flows are reacting with ore deposits to produce harvestable alloys.

entries.zh: 三颗邻近天体的有利排列可以让这颗行星上的居民团结起来。
entries.en: The favorable alignment of three nearby celestial bodies has a unifying effect on the inhabitants of this planet.

entries.zh: 该恒星系的首要光耀体发出了格外耀眼的光芒。
entries.en: The primary luminary of this system shines with extraordinary luster.

entries.zh: 为了限制高传染性生物病毒的传播，该行星进行了封锁。
entries.en: This planet is in lockdown to restrict the transmission of a highly transmissible biological virus.

entries.zh: 邻近数颗天体的不利排列让这颗行星上的居民忧心忡忡。
entries.en: The unfortunate alignment of nearby celestial bodies has sown uncertainty among the inhabitants of this planet.

entries.zh: 该恒星系的首要光耀体发出的光芒比平时更暗淡。
entries.en: The primary luminary in this system is duller than it once was.

entries.zh: 将我方行星献祭给他们的神
entries.en: Fed Our Planet to Their God

entries.zh: 每进行着一场§H代理人战争§![GetBureaucratPluralWithIcon]产出§G+$@secret_societies_unity_per_proxy_war|1$§!$i_unity$。
利用科学技术来检测人口的认知活动。思想警察监控着早期[Owner.GetCriminalDeviant]企图并在其发展为实际的行为之前进行妥善处置。
entries.en: Using scientific techniques to monitor the population's cognitive activity, Thought Police are detecting [Owner.GetCriminalDeviant] intent at an early stage and taking appropriate action before it manifests in actual behavior.

entries.zh: 对灵能帝国的陆军伤害
自发失去原材料是我们为灵能飞升付出的代价。我们获知了物灭现象的原理。
entries.en: Spontaneous loss of raw materials is the price we pay for our psionic ascension. The fundamentals of dematerialization are being revealed to us.

entries.zh: 灵能活动正在耗尽我们的原材料。开发物灭抑制装置关于我们的生死存亡。
entries.en: Psionic activity is depleting our raw materials. Developing anti-dematerialization equipment is critical to our survival.

entries.zh: 为了避免原材料发生物灭现象，必须要在一些工业区域周围禁止灵能的使用。
entries.en: To prevent the dematerialization of raw materials, it was necessary to ban psionics in the vicinity of certain industrial areas.

entries.zh: 与死去的[Owner.GetSpeciesBrainPlural]交流的私人消遣成为了一种受监管的公共研究形式。
entries.en: The private pastime of communicating with expired [Owner.GetSpeciesBrainPlural] is now a regulated form of public research.

entries.zh: 储存死去的[Owner.GetSpeciesBrainPlural]用于实验性交流是一种公共消遣，尽管这可能会带来犯罪问题。
entries.en: Storing expired [Owner.GetSpeciesBrainPlural] for experimental communication is a popular pastime, despite the criminality it incentivizes.

entries.zh: 我们的一些灵能人口正在长出怪异的复制。只要对其生长加以精心控制就可以用来提高生产力。
entries.en: Some of our psionic population are sprouting strange appendages. With their growth carefully regulated, these new parts help boost productivity.

entries.zh: 我们的一些灵能人口正在长出怪异的附肢。我们选择进行强制截肢。
entries.en: When some of our psionic population sprouted strange appendages, we chose to make amputation mandatory.

entries.zh: 我们的一些灵能人口正在长出怪异的附肢。能量需求提高了，但总的来说是好事。
entries.en: Some of our psionic population are sprouting strange appendages. Energy requirements have increased, but so has overall wellbeing.

entries.zh: 工业化念动力可能会引起一些普遍的不满，但它肯定会提高生产率。
entries.en: Industrial telekinesis may cause some general discontent, but it certainly increases productivity.

entries.zh: 工业化念动力可能会引起一些普遍的不满，对我们的军工复合体肯定大有裨益。
entries.en: Industrial telekinesis may cause some general discontent, but it is a great boon to our military industrial complex.

entries.zh: 为避免社会分歧，工业化念动力遭到限制。
entries.en: Industrial telekinesis has been limited to avoid societal discord.

entries.zh: 我们早就预料到灵能飞升并不是一个无痛的过程。
entries.en: Our psionic ascension was never predicted to be a painless process.

entries.zh: 我们早就预料到灵能飞升并不是一个一帆风顺的过程。
entries.en: Our psionic ascension was never predicted to be an untroubled process.

entries.zh: 灵能飞升带来了越来越多的痛苦。幸好，我们有解药。
entries.en: There are growing pains that come with psionic ascension. Luckily, we have the remedy.

entries.zh: 地下灵能角斗士让我们的陆军如虎添翼，但并不是所有的普通新兵都乐意与他们并肩作战。
entries.en: Underground psionic warriors have strengthened our armies, but not all our regular recruits are happy to serve beside them.

entries.zh: 地下灵能角斗士让我们的陆军如虎添翼，但将这些反常分子整合进我们的军队里是一项长久的挑战。
entries.en: Underground psionic warriors have strengthened our armies, though integrating this deviant element is an ongoing challenge for our forces.

entries.zh: 地下灵能角斗士是出色的研究对象。
entries.en: Underground psionic warriors have proven to be fascinating research subjects.

entries.zh: 随着非法的灵能决斗风潮的取缔，我们的殖民地变安全了。
entries.en: With the trend of illegal psionic battles ending, our colonies are safer places to be.

entries.zh: 灵能角斗是一种极具观赏性的运动。
entries.en: Psionic battles are proving to be the ultimate spectator sport.

entries.zh: 灵能角斗对集体而言是一种可以接受的消遣形式。
entries.en: Psionic battles serve as an acceptable form of recreation for the collective.

entries.zh: 虚境吞噬了这片土地的一部分。我们正在研究将其恢复原状的方法。
entries.en: The Shroud has consumed a portion of this land. We are researching ways to restore the original conditions.

entries.zh: 有灵能实体在影响着我们的行为。我们正分派科学资源来抑制这种冲动。
entries.en: There are psionic entities influencing our actions. We are dedicating scientific resources to mitigate these impulses.

entries.zh: 我们的心灵受到灵能交流实体的影响。
entries.en: Our minds are influenced by entities that communicate with us psionically.

entries.zh: 有灵能实体在试图影响我们的行为。我们必须抑制这种外源性冲动。
entries.en: There are psionic entities attempting to influence our actions. We must suppress these foreign impulses.

entries.zh: 我们投入资源研发用于抑止灵能活动干扰的植入体。
entries.en: We are investing in the development of an implant to stop the psychic disturbances caused by psionic activity.

entries.zh: 我们投入资源研发用于抑止灵能活动干扰的升级。
entries.en: We are investing in the development of an upgrade to stop the neural disturbances caused by psionic activity.

entries.zh: 为了减轻灵能活动带来的心灵扰动，我们正在为大众研究改进冥想方法。
entries.en: To alleviate psychic disturbances caused by psionic activity, we are researching improved meditation methods for our population.

entries.zh: 为了减轻灵能活动带来的神经扰动，我们正在为大众研究改进冥想方法。
entries.en: To alleviate neural disturbances caused by psionic activity, we are researching improved meditation methods for our population.

entries.zh: 对我们思想的灵能干扰是一个灵能协同成长的机会。我们将积极主动地创造有效的灵能中心策略来优化端对端产出。
entries.en: Psionic interference with our minds is an opportunity for psynergistic growth. Our proactive approach will create impactful, psi-centric strategies in order to optimize end-to-end outcomes.

entries.zh: 灵能能量扰乱着我们的睡眠周期。我们已经投入资源来寻找阻止噩梦的方法。
entries.en: Psionic energy disturbs our sleep cycles. We have invested resources in finding a way to stop the nightmares.

entries.zh: 灵能能量产生的可怕梦魇干扰着我们的睡眠周期。
entries.en: Psionic energy disturbs our sleep cycles with horrific nightmares.

entries.zh: 尝试刺穿虚境导致了当地野生动物的袭击。这不过是推进灵能发展所付出的代价。
entries.en: Attempting to pierce the Shroud caused a rash of attacks by local wildlife. This is the price we pay for advancing our psionic development.

entries.zh: 通过提升建造更多自由$ENCLAVE_MINDWARDEN_PLURAL$的能力，我们就能进一步推动自己清除全星系灵能感染的任务进展。
entries.en: By increasing our capacity to construct more independent $ENCLAVE_MINDWARDEN_PLURAL$, we can help further our mission of ending psionic infection throughout the galaxy.

entries.zh: 有了灵督的后勤支援，我们的舰队运作得更加流畅了。
entries.en: With the logistical support of the Mindwardens, our fleet operations are more streamlined.

entries.zh: 尽管损失惨重，我们还是从一个灾难性的$PSIONIC_AURA$中幸存下来了。
entries.en: Despite heavy losses, we managed to survive a $PSIONIC_AURA$ of cataclysmic intent.

entries.zh: 我们建立的流放殖民地为高强度实验提供了绝佳的测试场所。
entries.en: The Penal Colony we have established provides excellent testing grounds for intensive experimentation.

entries.zh: $decision_thought_police$监测[From.GetCriminalDeviant]于未然。利用科学技术来监督大众的意识活动，可以在不需要动用危险的§H虚境§!能量就得到关于精神状况的洞见。
entries.en: $decision_thought_police$ detect [From.GetCriminalDeviant] intent before it manifests in actual behavior. Using scientific techniques to monitor a population's cognitive activity, they provide insights on mental states without employing the dangerous energies of the §HShroud§!.

entries.zh: 恒星基地及防御平台射速
entries.en: Starbases and Defense Platforms Fire Rate

entries.zh: 此§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!将尝试扩散至周边星系。
entries.en: This §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§! will attempt to spread to nearby systems.
$try_spread_aura_tt$\nOur Doom Intensity will be increased by §G+1§!.

entries.en: $try_spread_aura_tt$\nAt maximum intensity, every empire with systems inside the Aura gains §G+$@souls_aura_surge_trust|0$§! §HTrust§! with us, with a §HTrust§!-scaled chance to grant us a §HFavor§!. Our §HSubjects§! gain §G+$@souls_aura_surge_loyalty|0$§! Loyalty, our §HFederation§! gains §G+$@souls_aura_surge_cohesion|0$§! Cohesion, and our own colonies inside the Aura gain §G$@souls_aura_surge_crime|0$§! §HCrime§! for §H$@souls_aura_surge_duration_years|0$§! years.

entries.zh: $try_spread_aura_tt$\n向该恒星系的所有殖民地增加2个§Y$d_shroudstone$天然障碍§!。

$try_spread_aura_tt$\nThere is no limit to how far the §R$end_aura$§! can spread.

[from.GetName]恒星系内我们的§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!正在与来自附近[fromfrom.GetName]恒星系的敌对光环进行激烈斗争。我们的灵能[GetResearchers]曾对这种行为进行过建模，但这是我们第一次获得这种现象的一手资料。

理论上来说，越强的光环——就是说投射的强度越大——将会逐渐驱散敌对力量。如果这种斗争导致一方完败，占主导地位的光环可能就会流入空出来的恒星系。

这真是字面意义上的“灵魂的碰撞”。
entries.en:
Our §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§! in the [from.GetName] system is struggling against an opposing Aura originating from the nearby [fromfrom.GetName] system. Our psionic [GetResearchers] have previously modeled such behavior, though this is the first time we have experienced the phenomenon firsthand.

According to theory, the more potent Aura - that which is projected with a greater intensity - will gradually diminish the opposing force. Should this struggle lead to absolute decay, the prevailing Aura may flow into the vacant system.

It is a true battle of the minds.

entries.zh: 我们初次涉入§H虚境§!导致其中的能量影响了可观测宇宙。这种影响尽管相当显著，但也相对零星孤立。
entries.en: Our forays into the §HShroud§! have caused its energies to affect observable space. Though significant, these effects have been intermittent and isolated.

entries.zh: 随着我们的行为在虚境中回荡，与力量强大实体的距离也在缩短。如果我们获得了祂们的青睐，就能将祂们的灵能能量传导到现实世界中。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]认为，由此产生的“光环”可以强化我们的帝国
entries.en: Our actions ripple throughout the Shroud, drawing us closer to beings of great power. If we find favor with these entities, we might then channel their psionic energy into corporeal reality. Our [GetTelepathPlural] hypothesize that the resulting 'aura' would strengthen our empire,

entries.en: $shroud.1550.desc.common_1$ The theory of §H'$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$'§! presents a way to turn this influence into a constant flow.

An unending hunger that cannot be sated.

entries.zh: 一个欢迎沟通与交换的容器。
entries.en: A welcoming vessel for communication and exchange.

entries.zh: 一种与自然世界的原始联系。
entries.en: A primal connection to the natural world.

entries.zh: 一种对占有和放纵的无限欲望。
entries.en: A boundless urge to possess and indulge.

entries.zh: 低语在虚境之中心旋转着，这是知晓万物的一切超主所组成的变化不息的融合体。当被召唤时，他们在外部灵域显化，从而直接影响物理世界。
entries.en: At the center of the Shroud spins the Whisperers, an ever-shifting amalgam of all Patrons with knowledge of all things. When called upon, they take their place in the outer domains in order to more directly influence the physical realm.

entries.zh: 在虚境的最核心居住着$end_of_the_cycle_article$。祂是一种灵能意志的融合，是本次元不同灵域之间的巨大平衡力量。没有终末，就没有始源。
entries.en: At the very center of the Shroud dwells $end_of_the_cycle_article$. An amalgamation of psionic will, it is a great force of balance among the various domains of this dimension. Without ends, there can be no beginnings.

entries.zh: 生命之火不受制于器具。
entries.en: The spark of life is beholden to no vessel.

entries.zh: 这个实体已经受制于我们的意志。
entries.en: This entity has been bound to our will.
What steps out is not who steps in.
The flood of existence spares nothing.

entries.zh: 一切高耸之物皆始于深渊。
entries.en: All heights are drawn from the depths.
The dream shines because the sleeper does not stir.

entries.zh: 杀人者非点尖，其后之空洞也。
entries.en: The point is not the weapon, but the space it leaves behind.
The ruler is gone. The rule remains.
The course is certain, though the obstacles are not.

entries.en: Assigning an envoy will actively increase §HAttunement§! with the selected entity in the Shroud.\n\nOnce chosen, an envoy cannot be reassigned for §Y£time£360§!.

entries.zh: 以纯粹的意念移动物质的能力改变了我们存在的本质。
entries.en: The ability to move matter with sheer force of will transforms the very nature of our existence.

entries.zh: 通过学习种类繁多的预知方法，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]可以揭开未来的奥秘。
entries.en: By learning the manifold practices of divination, our [GetTelepathPlural] can unshroud the mysteries of the future.

entries.zh: 一切事物都充满了历史。我们的[owner.species.GetHandNamePlural]必须学会物质的语言，才能倾听一切。
entries.en: All things are charged with history. To hear it, our [owner.species.GetHandNamePlural] must learn the language of matter.

entries.zh: £trigger_no£因为需要接触一位§H更强大的超主§!，我们连接§H虚境§!的能力被打断了。
entries.en: £trigger_no£ Our ability to reach into the §HShroud§! is disrupted as we contact a §HGreater Patron§!.

entries.zh: 这些舰船专为灵能船员设计。心灵接口可以确保飞行和战斗控制都可以随心所欲。
entries.en: These ships are specialized for psionic crews. Mind interfaces ensure flight and combat control takes place at the speed of thought.

entries.zh: 这些飞船配备了先进的镀层和灵能偏转阵列，随时准备着躲避、击退以及摧毁灵能武器。
entries.en: Equipped with advanced plating and psi-deflector arrays, these ships are ready to evade, repel, and destroy psionic weaponry.

entries.zh: 有什么东西在我们体内觉醒了。我们才刚刚开始了解其中暗指。\n\n释放所有[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]们蕴含的灵能，我们就可以超越肉体存在的局限。
entries.en: Something has awoken inside of us. We are only beginning to understand the implications.\n\nBy unlocking the psionic abilities latent in all [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we can transcend the limitations of our physical existence.

entries.zh: 我们不知道随着灵能力的发展，会有何种变化将显现。
entries.en: As our psionic powers develop, we cannot know what changes will occur.

entries.zh: 我们已经完全实现自己的灵能潜质，驾驭了超出常规理解的维度。
entries.en: We will fully realize our psionic potential, mastering dimensions beyond ordinary comprehension.

entries.en: A remarkable mineral formation forged not by geologic processes, but by the action of $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$.

entries.zh: 通过召集囚禁的[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]并迫使其参加科学实验，我们就能显著提高科技进展的速度。
entries.en: By gathering imprisoned [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] and subjecting them to scientific experiments, we can significantly increase the pace of our technological advancement.

entries.en: [GetTestSubjectPlural] are required to progress this research program. The sacrifice of these [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] will fuel our necessary technological advancement.

entries.zh:
我们已经与$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$签订了契约，获得了无上力量。我们的[Owner.GetTelepathPlural]们认为，这笔交易的代价可以通过集体灵能出神来推迟——但只能推迟这么长时间。

超主的意志将会化为强力的$PSIONIC_AURA$降临。如果我们想实现终末，就要把散播这个光环作为我们的终极目标。随着我们愈发人多势众，心智之力也在增长，光环的力量和范围也会随之扩大。

有待征服的恒星系：§Y[Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]§!
entries.en:
We have forged a Covenant with $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$, granting us overwhelming power. Our [Owner.GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the cost of our bargain can be deferred by collective psionic trance - but only for so long.

The will of our patron is manifested in an intense $PSIONIC_AURA$. If we intend to realize the End, the spread of this Aura must be our ultimate goal. As our numbers grow, and the strength of our minds increases, so too will the Aura's power and reach.

Systems remaining to be conquered: §Y[Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]§!

entries.en: Our data indicate that this Aura has extremely deleterious effects. Without countermeasures, it is projected to spread rapidly throughout the galaxy.

entries.zh: 一种灾难即将到来的预感在我们的人口中激起。
entries.en: An awareness of impending calamity stirs within our population.

entries.zh: $shroud.4955.desc.1$我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在§H虚境§!的能量中探测到了一个并行干扰。
entries.en: $shroud.4955.desc.1$ Our [GetTelepathPlural] have even detected a concurrent disturbance in the energies of the §HShroud§!.

entries.zh: $shroud.4955.desc.1$我们的[GetTelepathPlural]称，即便§H虚境§!也感受到了怪异的不安，仿佛它的力量在安静的恐惧中颤抖。
entries.en: $shroud.4955.desc.1$ According to our [GetTelepathPlural], even the §HShroud§! feels oddly unsettled, as though its forces tremble in quiet apprehension.

entries.zh: 星系里近年来可怕的事情越来越多。
entries.en: Recent years have seen an increase in dire events throughout the galaxy.

entries.zh: 此外我们还探测到了一个更加怪异的现象，我们的[GetResearchers]预测在不久的未来只会发生更怪的事情。
entries.en: As we detect ever stranger phenomena, our [GetResearchers] predict even worse occurrences in the near future.

entries.zh: $shroud.4955.desc.2.intro$我们见证了§H[from.GetName]§!令人费解的增长，还目睹了一个负面的§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!正在四处侵蚀。$shroud.4955.desc.2.outro$
entries.en: $shroud.4955.desc.2.intro$ We have witnessed the inexplicable growth of the §H[from.GetName]§!. We have watched the encroachment of an adverse §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!. $shroud.4955.desc.2.outro$

entries.zh: $shroud.4955.desc.2.intro$我们见证了§H[from.GetName]§!令人费解的增长。$shroud.4955.desc.2.outro$
entries.en: $shroud.4955.desc.2.intro$ We have witnessed the inexplicable growth of the §H[from.GetName]§!. $shroud.4955.desc.2.outro$

entries.zh: $shroud.4955.desc.2.intro$我们目睹了一个负面的§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!正在四处侵蚀。$shroud.4955.desc.2.outro$
entries.en: $shroud.4955.desc.2.intro$ We have watched the encroachment of an adverse §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!. $shroud.4955.desc.2.outro$

entries.zh: 我们不知道是什么正在逼近，只知道它绝对会来。
entries.en: We do not know exactly what approaches, though we sense its coming with profound certainty.

entries.zh: 我们必须做好最坏的准备。
entries.en: We must prepare for the worst.

entries.zh: §H$end_aura$§!覆盖全星系时游戏将会结束。
entries.en: If the §H$end_aura$§! covers the galaxy, the game ends.

entries.zh: 正在以危险的速度向整个星系散播。依据我们[GetResearchers]的观测，它已经在许多恒星系造成了恶劣的影响。
entries.en: has spread through the galaxy at an alarming rate. Judging by the observations of our [GetResearchers], it has caused ill effects across many star systems.

entries.zh: 依据我们最新的数据，它已经污染了过半由超空间航道链接着的星系。其背后蕴藏的力量似乎寻求着星系尺度的毁灭；如果不能加以制止，它可能就要得逞了。
entries.en: According to our latest data, it has encroached upon half of the hyperlane-connected galaxy. The force behind it seems intent on destruction at a galactic scale; if it cannot be counteracted, it might just succeed.

entries.zh: 继续在星系中蔓延。现在它已经占据了星系中的绝大多数恒星系统。
entries.en: has continued its spread throughout the galaxy. It now occupies the majority of our galaxy's star systems.

entries.zh: 如果不能快准狠地加以反制，我们将面临星系级灭顶之灾。
entries.en: Without swift and powerful countermeasures, we face galactic catastrophe.

entries.zh: 我们与$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$的契约给§H[this.GetName]§!带来了毁灭，余下的只有我们往昔强盛帝国的断壁残垣。\n\n超主的破坏欲具现化为一个强大的能量生物——§R$NAME_Reckoning$§!。它在星球之间漫游，吞噬人口来重获自己的力量。
entries.en: Our Covenant with $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$ led to the destruction of the §H[this.GetName]§!, leaving behind only a vestige of our once-powerful empire.\n\nThe destructive intent of our former patron has now taken form as an immense energy being - the §R$NAME_Reckoning$§!. It moves from world to world, restoring its strength by consumption of their populations.

entries.zh: §R在下次增强之前将消耗的人口§!
§H[event_target:the_reckoning_observer_target.GetName]§!的清算正在给整个星系带来浩劫！
entries.en: The Reckoning of the §H[event_target:the_reckoning_observer_target.GetName]§! is wreaking havoc upon the galaxy!

entries.zh: 有许多被称为最终清算的实体正在给星系带来浩劫！
entries.en: Multiple entities known as Reckonings are wreaking havoc upon the galaxy!
§H$job_slave_orderly_plural$§! can be employed to increase £job_researcher£ §Y[GetResearcherPlural] Output§! and produce $i_amenities$.

entries.zh: 向我们释放出了暴怒。$SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$在[event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.solar_system.GetName]恒星系现身，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]能[GetFeelLoc]到我们前超主的怨恨正在快速袭来。\n\n我们必须做好自我保护的准备。
entries.en: has unleashed its furious wrath upon us. A $SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$ has emerged in the [event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.solar_system.GetName] system, and our [GetTelepathPlural] can [GetFeelLoc] the fast-approaching malice of our former patron.\n\nWe must prepare to defend ourselves.

entries.zh: §Y[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]§!做好了灵潜仪式的一切必要准备工作，随时可以代我们进入§H虚境§!。他们能为我们寻得何种洞见仍不得而知。
entries.en: The §Y[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]§! have made the necessary preparations to perform a Delving Ritual and reach into the §HShroud§! on our behalf. Whatever insights they will guide us to are uncertain.

entries.zh: 我们已经做好了成立独立的§H“$gov_mindwarden_enclave$”§!以协助结束星系中灵能侵染行动的准备。\n\n一旦成立，该机构可以为需要的人提供反灵能服务，并以此为我们赚取收入和物资。
entries.en: We are prepared to construct an independent §H'$gov_mindwarden_enclave$'§! to further our mission of ending psionic infection throughout the galaxy.\n\nOnce constructed, this facility can provide anti-psionic services for those who need them, while providing us a portion of the revenue and materials it receives.

entries.zh: 将一支有§Y$commander$§!指挥的30以上规模的§Y$FLEET$§!在我方所控恒星系内转化为一个§Y$gov_mindwarden_enclave$§!。
entries.en: Convert a §Y$FLEET$§! sized 30 or greater and led by a §Y$commander$§! into a §Y$gov_mindwarden_enclave$§! in a system we control.

entries.zh: §H虚境§!中的无数实体都拥有着强大的力量。想要得到祂们最大限度的庇佑，必须先与祂们形成不可撤销的纽带。\n\n然而我们看到了自己的实现方法。我们不仅可以将心灵与单一超主绑定，还能让[GetResearchers]找到从每个实体中汲取少量能量、甚至按照我们的意志重塑虚境的方法。
entries.en: The entities within the §HShroud§! are many, each an accretion of great power. They expect an irrevocable bond before they bestow their greatest blessings.\n\nYet we see a way to forge our own path. Rather than binding our psyches to a single patron, our psionic [GetResearchers] can develop the means to channel smaller amounts of energy from each, shaping the Shroud to our own will.

entries.zh: 长距离遥感影像显示§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!系内最近出现了一次奇怪的能量流爆发，与我们[owner.GetHomeWorldName]上的$building_ancient_ward_1$发生异常时产生的读数互相相关。\n\n如果我们想理解这个现象，就必须去探索[exiled_system_border.GetName]系。
entries.en: Long-distance imagery shows a recent burst of strange energy flows in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system, which correlates with irregular readings produced by our $building_ancient_ward_1$ on [owner.GetHomeWorldName].\n\nIf we wish to understand this phenomenon, we must explore [exiled_system_border.GetName].

entries.zh: 这个物种生活在一种装着特殊生物液体的罐子里。他们严重依赖辅助设备，无法直接从事体力劳动。
entries.en: This species lives out its existence suspended in a vat of specialized bio-fluids. As such, they are heavily reliant on assistive equipment and incapable of engaging directly in physical work.

entries.zh: 人口食物（或等价物）维护费：§G-50%§!$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—§R无法从事劳工岗位§!$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—§R无法招募为陆军§!
entries.en: Pop Food (or equivalent) Upkeep: §G-50%§! $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- §RCannot occupy Worker Jobs§!$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- §RCannot be recruited in Armies§!

entries.zh: 需要被装在罐状容器内的物种。
entries.en: Requires a species confined to containment vessels

entries.zh: §L该物种装有潜在灵能处理器，但在多数单元中休眠。尽管非常罕见，这份力量会在少数领袖身上被激活。§!\n
entries.en: §LThis species has latent psionic processors, which are dormant in most of its units. Although quite rare, these powers can activate in some leaders.§!\n

entries.zh: §L该物种的所有单元都配备有强力的灵能硬件。他们仅凭认知处理就能操纵物质和非物质世界。§!\n
entries.en: §LAll units of this species possess powerful psionic hardware. They can manipulate both the physical and immaterial realms by cognitive processing alone.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种的全体人员都掌握了强大的灵能力量。这代表着他们之间用心灵感应沟通。§!\n
entries.en: §LAll members of this species possess powerful psionic abilities. They typically communicate with each other through telepathy.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种的全体人员都掌握了强大的灵能力量。他们仅凭思维的力量就能操纵物质和非物质世界。§!\n
entries.en: §LAll members of this species possess powerful psionic abilities. They can manipulate both the physical and immaterial realms with the power of their minds.§!\n

entries.zh: $SHROUD_HEADER_TT$\n\n达成足够§H调和度§!获得青睐以发现超主。
entries.en: $SHROUD_HEADER_TT$\n\nDiscover its patrons by attaining the proper amount of §HAttunement§! to gain favor.

entries.zh: §H虚境§!是各种不同实体的家园。
entries.en: The §HShroud§! is home to a variety of entities.

entries.zh: 虚境本身可以划分为诸多概念化灵域回转不息的轮回，每个灵域中都居住着一位强力的实体。据说，在物质世界的行为会改变位于灵能世界的位置。
entries.en: The Shroud itself is divided into an ever-shifting wheel of conceptual domains, each populated by a powerful entity. It is said that one's actions in the physical realm can affect one's position in the other.

entries.zh: §H虚境位置§!\n用于指示§H$PLAYER_COUNTRY$§!与虚境的一致程度，以虚境实体的§H调和度§!决定。
entries.en: §HPosition in the Shroud§!\nIndicates the alignment of the §H$PLAYER_COUNTRY$§! to the Shroud, as determined by §HAttunement§! with Shroud entities.

entries.zh: §H虚境位置§!\n用于指示§H$PLAYER_COUNTRY$§!与虚境的对齐情况。
entries.en: §HPosition in the Shroud§!\nIndicates the alignment of the §H$PLAYER_COUNTRY$§! to the Shroud.

entries.zh: §G点击选择最调和一致的实体§!
entries.en: §GClick to select the Entity you are most attuned to§!
§GClick to return to an overall view of the Shroud§!

entries.zh: $t$邻近$PATRON$：$ATTUNEMENT$\n毗邻灵域的超主对我们施加了占有欲。\n
entries.en: $t$Proximity with $PATRON$: $ATTUNEMENT$\nThe patron of a neighboring domain exerts a possessive pull over us.\n

entries.zh: §H调和度§!代表一位§H超主§!对一个帝国的感兴趣程度。进行['concept_deeds']或完成['concept_callings']可以提升调和度。\n\n与其中一位超主提升调和度将会降低与其逆位超主的调和度。
entries.en: §HAttunement§! represents the degree to which a §HPatron§! takes interest in an empire. Perform ['concept_deeds'] or complete ['concept_callings'] to increase Attunement.\n\nIncreasing Attunement with one Patron will decrease Attunement with the opposing Patron.

entries.zh: §L虚境中的实体不判断何谓对错，只关心能否让自己欢欣。每个灵域都镌刻着一种意欲，唯有与之调和者允许自由涉足。§!
entries.en: §LThe entities within the Shroud hold no judgement over what is right or wrong, only what pleases or displeases them. Each domain is carved with specific intent, and only those who are attuned properly can enter them freely.§!

entries.zh: $PATRON$正在显现。这段时间内无法灵潜。
entries.en: The $PATRON$ is emerging. Delving is unavailable during this time.

entries.zh: 增加与$PATRON$的§H调和度§!以进入§H虚境§!内的这一灵域。
entries.en: Gain §HAttunement§! with $PATRON$ to enter this domain within the §HShroud§!.

entries.zh: 找到与该$UNDISCOVERED_PATRON_TITLE$增进§H调和度§!的方法以进入§H虚境§!中的该灵域。
entries.en: Find ways to gain §HAttunement§! with this $UNDISCOVERED_PATRON_TITLE$ to enter this domain within the §HShroud§!.

entries.zh: §L我们在物质空间中的行为会影响对虚境的感知。通过将行为与实体的意志相调和，我们才能靠近其概念灵域。§!
entries.en: §LOur actions in corporeal space influence how we experience the Shroud. By attuning our actions to an entity's will, we draw closer to its domain of intent.§!

entries.zh: 探索灵域以发现更多虚境中的实体。
entries.en: Explore the domains to discover more entities in the Shroud.

entries.zh: §R与该超主的契约被确认之后解锁。§!
entries.en: §RBlocked until the Covenant with this Patron is confirmed.§!

entries.zh: 我们已与该超主完全调和。
entries.en: We have attuned fully to this Patron.

entries.zh: 我们的行动影响了虚境内的§H调和度§!。
entries.en: Our actions influence §HAttunement§! within the Shroud.

entries.zh:
进行§H行契§!来提升与虚境中的一位§H超主§!的§H调和度§!。

与其中一位超主提升调和度将会降低与其逆位超主的调和度。

行契可以进行不止一次。
entries.en:
Perform §HDeeds§! to increase §HAttunement§! with a §HPatron§! in the Shroud.

Increasing Attunement with one Patron will decrease Attunement with the opposing Patron.

Deeds can be performed more than once.

entries.zh: 这位超主没有可用的§H召唤§!。
这将替换更新掉当前的§H召唤§!。
entries.en: This replaces the current §HCalling§! with a new one.

entries.en: §R* We can dismiss this calling in $DAYS|H$ Days ($DATE|Y$)§!

entries.zh: 我们的特使可以尝试提升与该实体的§H调和度§!。
entries.en: Our Envoys can seek to increase §HAttunement§! with this entity.

entries.zh: 向一位虚境§H超主§!指派一位§H特使§!协助我们获得§H调和度§!。
entries.en: Assigning an §HEnvoy§! to a Shroud §HPatron§! will help us gain §HAttunement§!.

entries.en: §ROne or more envoys are assigned to the opposing domain.§!

entries.zh: §R我们与一位超主签订了契约，已经无需进一步调和。§!
entries.en: §RWe have established a Covenant with this Patron and have no further need to attune.§!

entries.zh: §R我们正在虚境中塑造自己的道路，并且已经获得了该超主给予的一切。§!
entries.en: §RWe are forging our own path within the Shroud and have received all that this Patron offers.§!

entries.zh: 进入§H虚境§!，探索灵能界并与其中的实体交流。
entries.en: Reach into the §HShroud§! to explore the psionic realm and commune with its entities.

entries.zh: §L刺穿帷幕抵达虚境并非易事。灵能力者们可能需要数年才能从这场历练中恢复过来。§!
entries.en: §LTo pierce the veil and reach into the Shroud is no trivial matter. It can take years for those with psionic abilities to recover from such an exercise.§!

entries.zh: 结果取决于我们在虚境中的位置。
entries.en: Results will depend upon our position in the Shroud.

entries.zh: 调查§H虚境§!中的§R心声§!，以解锁['technology:tech_psionic_aura']科技。
entries.en: Investigate the §RVoice§! in the §HShroud§! to unlock ['technology:tech_psionic_aura'] Technology.

entries.zh: 与§H超主§!的灵域深度调和以让祂的§Y$PSIONIC_AURA$§!显现。
entries.en: Attune heavily into the domain of a §HPatron§! to manifest its §Y$PSIONIC_AURA$§!.
Maximum §Y$PSIONIC_AURA$§! spread distance from source: §Y[Owner.GetAuraHyperlaneRange]§! hyperlanes

entries.zh: 我们$PSIONIC_AURA$的总计§H强度§!。恒星系中的光环到达最大§H强度§!时便会通过超空间航道传播向所有能抵达的方向。
entries.en: The total accumulated §HIntensity§! of our $PSIONIC_AURA$. When an aura reaches maximum §HIntensity§! in a system, it will spread across hyperlanes where possible.

entries.zh: §R$end_aura$§!的强度增长也因军事舰队的存在而提高。
entries.en: The Intensity Gain of the §R$end_aura$§! is also increased by the presence of military fleets.

entries.zh: §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!会影响其占领的恒星系中所有的舰队和殖民地。
entries.en: A §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§! affects all fleets and colonies within the system it occupies.

entries.zh: 若实行进一步的调查，灵能实体的力量或许能够影响我们的物理现实。
entries.en: With further investigation, the power of psionic entities may influence our physical reality.

entries.zh: §H$end_aura$§!填满整个星系时，§H[This.GetName]§!将会获得游戏的胜利。
entries.en: When the §H$end_aura$§! fills the galaxy, the §H[This.GetName]§! wins the game.

entries.zh: 对战争中的敌国或宿敌的影响。
entries.en: Effects on empires we are at war or rivals with.

entries.zh: 对战争中的敌国和宿敌以外帝国的影响。
entries.en: Effects on empires we are not at war or rivals with.

entries.zh: 虚境回响着前所未有的残暴。巨大的能量弧在以太中翻滚不息。\n\n在狂乱闪烁的混沌中，我们看到了合成女王的灵能回声。她无边无际、无所不能，将整个星系玩弄于股掌之间。
entries.en: The Shroud reverberates with an unprecedented ferocity. Vast coils of energy writhe and thrash in the ether.\n\nAmid the strobing disorder, we behold the psionic echoes of the synthetic queen. Infinite and omnipotent, she toys with the galaxy in her palm.

entries.zh: 怎会如此？难道祂知道什么我们不知道的弱点吗？如果我们向祂伸出援手，它会帮我们吗？\n\n把注意力集中在塑师身上时，我们感受到祂的不耐烦。我们很可能只有一次机会就这个问题向祂求助。为此我们可能需要非常大量的§H能量币§!和§H$sr_zro$§!。
entries.en: Why? Does it know of a weakness we do not? Will it assist us if we reach out to it?\n\nAs we focus our minds upon the Animator, we sense its impatience. It is very likely that we will only have one opportunity to ask for its aid in this matter. Massive quantities of §HEnergy§! and §H$sr_zro$§! will be needed for the effort.

entries.zh:
$shroud.10.desc.intro$

并不只有我们在观察她。在一个隐蔽而优势的位置上，一个叫做$the_animator_of_clay_color_article$的实体也俯瞰着，无惧女王无尽的力量。

$shroud.10.desc.outro$
entries.en:
$shroud.10.desc.intro$

We are not alone in observing her. From a hidden vantage point, the entity known as $the_animator_of_clay_color_article$ watches on, uncowed by the queen's limitless power.

$shroud.10.desc.outro$

entries.zh:
$shroud.10.desc.intro$

并不只有我们在观察她。在一个隐蔽而优势的位置上，$the_animator_of_clay_color_article$也悄然俯瞰着，无惧女王无尽的力量。

$shroud.10.desc.outro$
entries.en:
$shroud.10.desc.intro$

We are not alone in observing her. From a hidden vantage point, $the_animator_of_clay_color_article$ watches on, uncowed by the queen's limitless power.

$shroud.10.desc.outro$
We do not need its help.

entries.zh: 我们不会再有请求塑师帮忙击败塞塔娜的机会。
entries.en: We will never get another chance to request the Animator's help in defeating Cetana.

entries.en: §LThis choice will resonate within the Shroud...§!

entries.zh: 我们得到了虚境的庇佑。
entries.en: We have been blessed by the Shroud.
We have been fortified by our endeavors.

entries.zh: 我们的努力将会得到虚境的奖赏。
entries.en: Our efforts were rewarded by the Shroud.

entries.zh: 虚境将会赐予我们一件赠礼。
entries.en: The Shroud graced us with a gift.

entries.zh: 虚境赠予了我们一件礼物。
entries.en: The Shroud has bestowed us a gift.

entries.zh: 虚境奖励了我们的努力。
entries.en: The Shroud has rewarded our efforts.

entries.zh: 虚境的青睐照耀着我们。
entries.en: The favor of the Shroud shines upon us.

entries.zh: 虚境认为可以赐予我们力量。
entries.en: The Shroud has seen fit to empower us.

entries.zh: 虚境的青睐庇佑着我们。
entries.en: The favor of the Shroud blesses us.

entries.zh: 虚境庇佑着我们的努力。
我们获赠了虚境的庇佑。
entries.en: We are gifted with the Shrouds blessings.

entries.zh: 虚境赐予我们力量的增强。
entries.en: The Shroud rewards us with empowerment.
