entries.en: A curse has struck us from the Shroud.

entries.zh: 我们的努力只得到了诅咒。
entries.en: Our endeavor has left us cursed.

entries.zh: 我们的努力得到了诅咒的回报。
entries.en: Our efforts were rewarded with a curse.

entries.zh: 虚境向我们降下了不幸。
entries.en: The Shroud bestowed misfortune upon us.
We have been marked by a curse.

entries.zh: 虚境诅咒了我们的帝国。
entries.en: The Shroud has cursed our empire.

entries.zh: 虚境以诅咒拒绝了我们。
entries.en: The Shroud rejects us with a curse.

entries.zh: 虚境的愤怒在诅咒我们。
虚境将我们诱入不幸之中。
entries.en: The Shroud ensnares us with misfortune.

entries.zh: 虚境标注着我们的毁灭。
entries.en: The Shroud marks us for ruin.

entries.zh: 虚境向我们施加了诅咒。
entries.en: The Shroud burdens us with a curse.

entries.zh: 我们遭到了虚境的责难。
entries.en: We are condemned by the Shroud.
The Shroud gifts us its contempt.

entries.zh:
在涡旋的黑暗中，远处的影子倏然出现，又消失入虚无……一阵阵模糊不清的不谐和心声难以理解地咆哮着。光明灭闪烁，热点膨胀收缩。

或有运动之物，莫名旋转。这究竟是我们自己，还是虚境在运动不息？

那个存在靠近了，同时从四面八方靠近。心声忽然出现。

§H你看到了什么？§!
entries.en:
In the swirling blackness, distant shadows take fleeting forms before receding back into nothingness... An obscure cacophony of voices rant unintelligibly... Lights flicker and fade. Spots of heat swell and subside.

There is motion. Something spins. Is it us that moves or the Shroud itself?

A presence nears, approaching somehow from every direction all at once. Then, a voice.

§HWHAT DO YOU SEE?§!

entries.zh: 我们见到了一个燃烧的世界。
entries.en: We see a world that burns.

entries.zh:
重量转移；心声复现……

§H很好。§!

那片黑暗倾斜、旋转起来。有什么东西重重压在我们身上，然后，我们突然又余下独自一人。
entries.en:
A weight shifts; the voice returns...

§HGOOD.§!

The darkness tilts, then spins. Something presses hard upon us for a moment and then, suddenly, we are alone again.

entries.zh:
有个沉重的东西在颤抖。黑暗慢慢地向我们袭来，愈发凝重……

§H不！§!

那片虚无倾斜、旋转起来。突然，我们突然又余下独自一人……
entries.en:
Something heavy shudders. The darkness crushes slowly against us, harder and tighter...

§HNO!§!

The nothingness tilts, then spins. Suddenly, we are alone again...

entries.zh: §H软弱！§!\n\n那片虚无倾斜、旋转起来。突然，我们突然又余下独自一人……
entries.en: §HWEAKNESS!§!\n\nThe nothingness tilts, then spins. Suddenly, we are alone again...

entries.zh:
内脏般的恶臭充斥着我们的感官。

幻象开始从虚境的深处出现，扭动和咆哮带着贪婪的狂怒。起先，饥馑的野兽之吼响起……我们同感了它们的饥饿。随后它们的垂涎也被我们共有。

一些剪影浮现，那是惊慌失措的牲畜。猎物。诱人地逐渐靠近……噬骨的疼痛愈发难熬。

饥饿渐渐吞噬我们的心智，感官变得扭曲皱缩。这些惨叫到底是来自猎物……还是来自我们自己的内心？

束缚我们的枷锁勒紧。随着痛苦盘旋尖叫的心声一同碎裂：

§H撕碎你们的骨！喰宴！§!
entries.en:
The fetid stench of viscera floods our senses.

Images, writhing and snarling with a ravenous fury, begin to emerge from the depths of the Shroud. The feral cries of malnourished beasts echo first... We feel their hunger. Then their salivating maws become our own.

Silhouettes appear before us. Panicked livestock. Prey. Tantalizingly close... The gnawing ache grows unbearable.

Our senses twist, pulling tighter as hunger consumes thought. Are these screams that of our quarry... Or from within?

The shackles that bind us tighten. Fracturing as a voice coils through the torment, screeching:

§HSHATTER YOUR BONDS! FEAST!§!
Break the chains. Consume the prey.

entries.zh:
我们的束缚崩断。

贪婪。释放。

恐惧！

§H吞噬。§!

entries.en: Resist the hunger. Quieten the mind.

entries.zh:
锁链牢固。我们过滤掉它的影响后，心声充满愤怒，我们的意识冷静下来并恢复了控制。

§H软弱！无力！§!

饥饿褪去，留下挥之不去的怨恨消散在虚境中。
entries.en:
The chains hold fast. The voice seethes with rage as we filter its influence, quieting our mind as we resume control.

§HWEAK! FECKLESS!§!

The hunger fades, leaving a lingering resentment that dissipates within the Shroud.

entries.zh:
有个心声，自深渊……回荡着。粗粝，而又饱含恶意……向我们呼唤着。

§H供养。消耗。吞噬。§!

幻象不请自来。一颗颗星球化为死寂的灰烬，我们[Root.GetCitizenPlural]的肉身被灵能消耗，使这个声音……还有我们自己的饥饿……感到满足。

随着这些景象的展现，我们还能感受到另一种存在，它敦促我们要表现出克制以及与自己[Root.GetCitizenPlural]的团结，一起发展变强。那个存在被声音的嘶吼淹没。
entries.en:
From the abyss, a voice... resonant, coarse, and saturated with malice... calls out to us.

§HFEED. CONSUME. DEVOUR.§!

Visions erupt forth unbidden. Worlds reduced to ash and silence, the wails of our [Root.GetCitizenPlural] as their physical forms are consumed by psionic energy, satiating the voices... and our own... hunger.

As these sights unfold, we can feel another presence, urging us to show restraint and solidarity with our [Root.GetCitizenPlural], growing stronger together. It is drowned out as the voice screams.

entries.zh: 被吞噬者的哀嚎响彻虚境和帝国两界，随后又突然落入了寂静。\n\n以此牺牲，我们的力量随着饥饿的消退而增强。
entries.en: The cries of the devoured resonate throughout both the Shroud and the empire, before they fall abruptly into silence.\n\nWith this sacrifice, our power grows as the hunger recedes.

entries.zh: 我们抑制了这个心声，团结一致地探向虚境，拥抱着自己的帝国。随着饥饿的加剧，众口一声地舒了一口气，舒适感淹没了愤怒的尖叫。
entries.en: We silence the voice, and instead reach out in unity across the Shroud, embracing our empire. A collective sigh of relief and comfort drowns out the screams of rage as the hunger deteriorates.

entries.zh:
强大的灵能流在黑暗中互相碰撞。无数阴影在周围来来往往……前方有一道微光在闪烁。

突然，仅有那么一刹那，眼前景象变得清晰可辨。它的形状在我们抓住之前就又消失了。

一个奇怪的存在来到了我们身边。

§H所见何物？§!
entries.en:
Powerful currents of psionic energy clash in the darkness here. Shadows rush and fall around us... A glimmering light pulses ahead.

Suddenly a scene is discernible, for only the briefest of moments. Its shapes recede before we can grasp them.

A strange presence settles around us.

§HWHAT DID YOU SEE?§!

entries.zh: 我们看到了生机勃勃的森林。
entries.en: We saw a forest, rich with many lifeforms.

entries.zh:
寂静渐强。那个心声又回来了……

§H很好。§!

一股强大的暖流涌上我们全身，然后又突然消退。那个存在离开了。
entries.en:
The silence swells. The voice returns...

§HEXCELLENT.§!

A powerful heat surges within us, then subsides. The presence has departed.

entries.zh: 我们看到了一片废土，一无所有。
entries.en: We saw a wasteland, stripped of all it had to offer.

entries.zh:
那个心声回来了……

§H没门！§!

一种极端的严寒填满了我们，然后又突然消退。那个存在离开了。
entries.en:
The voice returns...

§HNEVER!§!

An extreme coldness pools within us, then suddenly subsides. The presence has departed.

entries.zh:
那个心声回来了……

§H无趣。§!

一种极端的空虚压垮了我们，然后又突然消退。那个存在离开了。
entries.en:
The voice returns...

§HHOW UNINTERESTING.§!

An extreme emptiness overcomes us, then suddenly subsides. The presence has departed.

entries.zh:
在层层叠叠的虚境中，一副幻景展现在我们面前。

浓雾形成了一只挣扎着的生物轮廓，朦胧的卷须紧紧地缠绕着，它动弹不得，奄奄一息。

这只动物本身我们前所未见。

一个心声回荡在我们之内。

§H命运的绳索正在召唤！你要拉哪一头？§!
entries.en:
From between the many layers of the Shroud, a vision unfurls before us.

The mists form the outline of a struggling creature, ensnared and choking as hazy tendrils wrap ever tighter around it.

The animal itself is unlike anything we have encountered before.

A voice threads its way within us.

§HTHE STRANDS OF FATE BECKON! WHICH SHALL YOU PULL?§!

entries.zh:
那个心声回荡在我们的[GetMindLoc]之中，那只生物也淡出视野。

§H繁荣。§!

另一幅景象转瞬即逝——在我们帝国的某个地方，生命复苏了。
entries.en:
The voice echoes in our [GetMindLoc] as the creature fades from sight.

§HPROSPERITY.§!

Another fleeting glimpse appears - a resurgence of life, somewhere in our empire.

entries.zh: 那心声从我们的思想中退去，只留下一声悠长的悲鸣，回荡在一片荒芜的景象中。\n\n§H造孽。§!
entries.en: The voice recedes from our thoughts, leaving only an echoing cry that reverberates across visions of a barren landscape.\n\n§HPESTILENCE.§!

entries.zh: 一种压倒性的冲动占据了我们的思想，这个心声被从思想中推开到一边。血腥的欲望充斥着我们的[GetMindLoc]，残酷的笑声在虚空中回荡。\n\n§H这就对了！虐杀！§!
entries.en: The voice is pushed from our thoughts as an overwhelming urge takes over. Bloodlust floods our [GetMindLoc] as brutal laughter echoes through the void.\n\n§HOF COURSE! EASY PREY!§!

entries.zh:
拨开虚境的迷雾，显出无边无数纠缠不清的幻景。

朦胧的风景在我们面前莫名变幻。山峦起落。沸腾的混沌海洋蒸发，在无尽的沙漠中留下了苍白的水生生物的骨架。

在茂密的林冠下，温顺的生物在栖息地中穿梭，然后突然抽搐，变异成嗜血的怪物。它们彼此将对方撕成碎片，陷入无休止的死亡与重生的循环。

一个心声透过这片混沌，刺穿我们的[GetMindLoc]。

§H如此无序。作茧自缚。§!
entries.en:
The mists of the Shroud unfurl, revealing visions that churn together without end.

Obscure landscapes writhe incomprehensibly before us. Mountains rise and fall. Boiling oceans of chaos evaporate to leave behind the bleached bones of aquatic life across endless deserts.

Beneath forested canopies, docile creatures weave through their habitat before convulsing and mutating into bloodthirsty monstrosities. Ripping each other asunder, they engage in an unending cycle of death and rebirth.

Through the chaos, a voice pierces our [GetMindLoc].

§HSUCH DISORDER. ENTANGLED AMONGST ITSELF.§!

entries.zh: 让自然向我们的意志低头。

我们伸出手，握住了面前的混乱。

将景致束缚，让大陆停歇。

将所有碎片拼到一起后，心声回响起来。

§H单调，平淡，空虚……§!
entries.en:
We reach out, grasping at the disarray in front of us.

Binding landmarks in place, forcing continents to settle.

As the pieces fall together, the voice echoes.

§HFLATNESS, BLANDNESS, EMPTINESS...§!

entries.zh:
我们静观着这篇幻景。那无休止的循环变得模糊，向外爆开后像它的开始一样戛然而止。

能量在这无边无际的浩瀚中涌动，然后重塑成新的形态。

心声回响起来。

§H和平即冲突。无序即和谐。§!
entries.en:
We watch as the visions continue. The unending cycle blurs together before exploding outwards and ceasing just as quickly as it started.

Energies surge throughout the endless expanse, before reforming and taking on new forms.

The voice echoes.

§HPEACEFUL CONFLICT. DISORDERED UNITY.§!

entries.zh: 行星获得随机§G正面修正§!和§R负面修正§!各一个。
entries.en: This planet gains a random §GPositive Modifier§! and §RNegative Modifier§!.

entries.zh:
虚境无休止地搅动，露出一大片黑沙。海浪破碎，但只闻其声不见其形。

前面，或者也许叫前面的地方，出现了一个棱镜。一束光照亮了它，瞬间折射形成一个模糊的图像。

无数模糊的身影和移动的形体短暂出现，又被黑暗吞没。

在附近的沙滩上，有一个存在。

§H所示之物即所见，对吗？§!
entries.en:
The Shroud's restless churn resolves to reveal a vast stretch of black sand. Breaking waves can be heard but not seen.

Ahead, or perhaps behind, a prism appears. A single beam of light hits it, momentarily refracting to form a murky image.

Countless shadowy figures and shifting forms are briefly glimpsed, before being swallowed back up by the darkness.

Upon the nearby sand, a presence settles.

§HWHAT WAS SHOWN WAS SEEN, WAS IT NOT?§!

entries.zh: 我们看到了许多声音汇聚一堂。
entries.en: We saw a conference of many voices.

entries.zh:
沙子缓慢地流动着，心声回来了。

§H很好。和谐就是宇宙之道。§!

我们感受到了什么沉重的东西。随后又余下孤身一人。
entries.en:
The sands shift slowly. The voice returns.

§HGOOD. HARMONY IS THE WAY OF THE UNIVERSE.§!

We feel something heavy lift. We are alone again.

entries.zh: 我们看到了战斗中的屠戮。
entries.en: We saw the carnage of battle.

entries.zh:
沙子突然以风暴一般的速度飞旋起来。

§H不。应该折戟沉沙忘却刀兵！§!

沙暴平息下来。那个心声离去了。
entries.en:
The sands suddenly swirl with the velocity of a storm.

§HNO. LET WEAPONS RUST AND LAY FORGOTTEN!§!

The sand storm settles. The voice has departed.

entries.zh:
沙子缓慢地流动这。

§H犹豫会滋生失败……§!

我们又复归一人了。
entries.en:
The sands shift slowly.

§HHESITATION BREEDS FAILURE...§!

We are alone again.

entries.zh:
虚境中无数混乱的能量正在翻腾不息。

暗影的卷须旋转着向外突刺，薄雾本身也在猛烈翻滚。在灵能能量的漩涡中，两个无形的实体正在交锋。它们毫不停歇，互不退让，满溢着愤怒。

一个奇怪的意识侵入了我们的[GetMindPhysicalLoc]，它浩瀚无垠又咄咄逼人。

§H来到此地者需呈递良方。§!
entries.en:
The Shroud's chaotic energies writhe and surge.

Shadowed tendrils lash and coil, the haze turning violently upon itself. Amid this storm of psionic fury, two formless entities clash. They are relentless, unyielding, and drenched in rage.

A foreign presence presses into our [GetMindPhysicalLoc], invasive and vast.

§HTHOSE WHO ENTER MUST BRING RESOLUTION.§!

entries.zh:
迷雾消退淡出，溶解进背后的灵能能量旋涡中。那个意识回来了。

§H和谐就是智慧§!

虚境现在变得平静了。
entries.en:
The haze fades into itself, dissolving against the background swirl of psionic energy. The consciousness returns.

§HHARMONY IS WISDOM.§!

The Shroud is calmer now.

entries.zh:
随着迷雾的每一击落地，我们周围的能量都在加剧沸腾。

§H暴力是对无知的嘉奖。§!

虚境流速能量再次抽搐了起来。
entries.en:
With every blow landed by the haze, the seething energies around us intensify.

§HVIOLENCE IS REWARD FOR THE UNTHINKING BEING.§!

The Shroud's writhing energies convulse once more.

entries.zh:
一汪黑色的液体在我们面前舒展开。

突然，液面上闪烁起一个模糊的影像。我们瞥见了一座亮闪闪的山峰，每个山脊都镶着耀眼夺目金边，随后它有忽然消失。

一个心声在我们的[GetMindLoc]深处鸣响着。

§H你看到了未见之物吗？§!
entries.en:
A pool of black liquid stretches out before us.

Suddenly a blurry image flickers across the surface. We glimpse a glittering peak, whose every ridge is studded with shimmering gold, before it vanishes abruptly.

A voice resonates within the recesses of our [GetMindLoc].

§HYOU HAVE SEEN THE UNSEEN?§!

entries.zh: 我们见到了一个等待开掘的采石场。
entries.en: We saw a quarry, waiting for the pick.

entries.zh:
一环环同步的涟漪荡漾开。我们再次感受到那个心声。

§H无边的增长维持着无量的平衡。§!

随着液体平静下来，我们感受到那个心声离开了。
entries.en:
A series of concurrent ripples radiate across the surface. Once more we feel the voice.

§HGROWTH WITHOUT BOUNDS SUSTAINS BALANCE WITHOUT MEASURE.§!

As the liquid settles, we feel the voice departing.

entries.zh: 我们看到了应当保护的完美自然。
entries.en: We saw nature's perfection, to be preserved.

entries.zh:
这汪液体激荡了起来。波浪汹涌澎湃。漩涡在黑暗中旋转。那个心声以更大的力度返回。

§H不可接受！增长掠夺！增长掠夺！§!

液面复归平静。那个心声离去了。
entries.en:
The liquid becomes agitated. Waves swell and crash. A whirlpool swirls in the darkness. The voice returns with greater force.

§HUNACCEPTABLE! GROW AND GAIN. GROW AND GAIN!§!

The surface settles again. The voice has departed.

entries.zh:
液体搅动着。心声再次显现。

§H信念在动摇……你的意志力有弱点。§!

随着液体平静下来，我们感受到那个心声离开了。
entries.en:
The liquid stirs. The voice comes to us again.

§HCONVICTION WAVERS... THERE IS WEAKNESS IN YOUR WILL.§!

As the surface settles, we feel the voice departing.

entries.zh:
浓雾在我们面前重构。炽热的能量猛烈地脉动着。我们看到一个奇怪的树形轮廓。

走近一看，它巨大的树冠在紫色、粉色和黑色之间纷乱闪烁。

在它的底部是一个发光的内核，与树冠变换的颜色变化同步发出光芒。

一个心声停留在我们的[GetMindLoc]中。

§H占有。夺取。利用。§!
entries.en:
The haze rearranges itself before us. Incandescent energies pulsate with a sudden vigor. We see the outline of a strange, arboreal form.

Its immense canopy shimmers as we approach, modulating through a flurry of purples, pinks, and blacks.

Ensconced within its base is a luminous kernel, radiating in sync with the canopy's shifting colors.

A voice settles in our [GetMindLoc].

§HACCROACH. SEIZE. EXPLOIT.§!

entries.zh: 内核取出后，树冠暗淡了下来然后立刻就枯萎了。那个心声又回来了。\n\n§H没错！破坏才有收获。§!
entries.en: As the kernel is removed, the canopy turns dull and withers instantly away. The voice returns.\n\n§HYES! SPOILS BEGET SPOILS.§!

entries.zh: 一阵震颤穿过我们的身体。分不清震颤的是这个世界，还是我们自己？\n\n§H繁荣才有意义。逃避是愚痴！§!
entries.en: A tremor passes through us. Is it this world which shakes, or us?\n\n§HPROSPERITY IS PURPOSE. TO SHUN IT IS FOLLY!§!

entries.zh: 强大的灵能流在虚境无边的涡流中碰撞炙烤着。一声刺耳咆哮不断膨胀，引起我们的注意。
entries.en: Powerful psionic currents crash and broil amid the Shroud's unending turbulence. A roaring cacophony swells and clamors for our attention.

entries.zh: 痛苦的呼喊，雷鸣般的战争之乐，隆隆的吞噬之火。我们能感觉到疼痛……但这是谁的？
entries.en: Cries of pain, the thunderous orchestra of battle, a rumble of devouring flames. We sense pain... To whom does it belong?

entries.zh: 哭嚎喊叫，兽性的，野性的，原始的……河流奔涌，狂风呼啸……整个大自然都在同时狂吠嚎叫着，无比急切……
entries.en: Cries and calls, animalistic, wild, primal... Rivers gush and winds wail... All of nature barks and howls, urgently and at once...

entries.zh: 各种心声低语着、呢喃着、惊呼着、宣告着……无数的语调、音节、声音……多重的语言同时在交流。
entries.en: Voices murmur, mumble, exclaim and declare... Myriad intonations, syllables, sounds... Multitudinous languages chatter at once.

entries.zh: 钻头钻孔，机械研磨……物质在巨大的噪声中被强制转化……宇宙中所有的工厂同时迸发出火焰。
entries.en: Drills bore, machinery grinds... Matter is loudly and forcefully transformed... All the factories of the universe blast and fire at the same time.

entries.zh: 这份渐强逐渐积累。我们突然被推到一个无法理解的方向……\n\n最后，我们又恢复了沉默。
entries.en: The crescendo builds and builds. We are suddenly thrust in a direction we cannot comprehend...\n\nFinally we settle back into silence.

entries.zh: 这简直难以忍受。我们的[GetMindLoc]退了出来，回到了舒适的宁静中。
entries.en: It is unbearable. Our [GetMindLoc] retreat from it, back into the comfort of silence.

entries.zh: 一种浓重的阴郁笼罩着我们。压力，从四面八方，挤得越来越紧。直到一片朦胧的景象出现。
entries.en: A dense gloom envelops us. From all sides, pressure, squeezing tighter and tighter. Until a hazy vista presents itself.

entries.zh: 在阴沉的黑暗中，有一样东西吸引了我们的注意。毋庸置疑，这是[Root.GetName]的旗帜。\n\n这就是我们吗？
entries.en: Amid the shadowy murk, one thing catches our attention. Unmistakable and central: it is the flag of [Root.GetName].\n\nIs this us?

entries.zh: 我们看到了一颗破败的星球，战争后的余波……胜利者们正在搜索着尸体和残骸。
entries.en: We see a ravaged world, the aftermath of battle... Its victors scour the corpses and debris.

entries.zh: 我们看到了许多星球……以不可能的方式在时空中穿梭……全部都如同，被一个帝国统一起来了一般。
entries.en: We see many worlds... rushing impossibly through time and space... All alike, united under a single empire.

entries.zh: 我们看到了盛大的集会……许多轮廓模糊的人物……听着、说着
entries.en: We see a grand assembly... The opaque outline of many figures... Listening, speaking

entries.zh: 我们看到一颗理想的星球……一排排工厂和矿场无边无际……没有一寸地表还未得到开发。
entries.en: We see an optimized world... Endless rows of factories and mines... No corner of its surface left untouched.

entries.zh: 我们看到一颗理想的星球……一排排工厂和矿场无边无际……纯粹的完美。没有一寸地表还未得到开发。
entries.en: We see an optimized world... Endless rows of factories and mines... Pure perfection. No corner of its surface left untouched.

entries.zh: 景象稍微清晰了一些。我们对自己的观点充满信心。
entries.en: The image sharpens slightly. We are confident in our perception.

entries.zh: 把它从我们的思绪中赶出去。
把它从我们的回路中擦除。
景象的清晰边缘溶化回了虚无。
entries.en: The vision's indistinct outlines dissolve back into nothingness.

entries.zh: 虚境缥缈的浓雾扭曲盘旋，将我们的意识拉入了深处，只留下身躯原地不动。\n\n我们的[GetPsycheLoc]一次次拉伸又收缩，困在重复的潮汐中。每一次有意识的动作都会自我坍缩，张力拉紧，如同被架在台钳上。
entries.en: The ethereal mists of the Shroud churn and twist, dragging our consciousness deeper whilst our physical forms remain inert, untouched.\n\nOur [GetPsycheLoc] stretches, strains, trapped within a repeating tide. Each attempted movement collapses upon itself, the tension tightening, vice-like in its grip.

entries.zh: 我们看到了过去的自己，身躯被封在一个层层叠叠的立方体中，超出了我们的物理理解。
entries.en: We see past ourselves, our bodies sealed within a cascading tesseract beyond our physical comprehension.

entries.zh: 逻辑子历程启动，发现错误：递归循环。我们的灵能处理器无法打破轮回以及恢复功能正常。
entries.en: Logic subroutines engage, the failure is identified: a recursive loop. Our psionic processors are insufficient to break the cycle and resume ordinary function.

entries.zh: 张力逐渐变得无法承受，我们的形体有溶解在虚空中的危险。一个心声解开了我们的束缚。
entries.en: As the tension becomes unendurable, our forms threaten to dissolve into the void. A voice gouges through our entrapment.

entries.zh: 那话语和我们自己共鸣着。那势头越来越强，而我们意识到可以将这几乎撕裂我们的混乱平息，只要我们屈从。
entries.en: The words resonate within us. Their momentum builds and we sense a way to quell the disturbance that threatens to tear us asunder, if only we submit.

entries.zh: §H接纳永恒吧！万物归一方得圆满！§!
entries.en: §HEMBRACE ETERNITY! ALL IS AS ONE IS AS WHOLE!§!

entries.zh:
心声膨胀起来，引导着我们，迫使思绪超越有限的理解。这个循环还在继续——紧缩，又拉得更开——直到撕碎我们的心灵。

我们恳求着虚境中更高力量的引导，帮助我们打破了循环。

然而，并不是所有人都安然无恙。§H[event_target:shroud_warped_leader.GetName]§!不在岗了。那心声又回来了。
entries.en:
The voice swells, guiding our actions, forcing our thoughts beyond our limited comprehension. The cycle continues - tightening, pulling us further - before it shatters against our psyche.

We have broken through the recursion, guided by our supplication to the higher powers of the Shroud.

However, not all of us remain. §H[event_target:shroud_warped_leader.GetName]§! is no longer at [event_target:shroud_warped_leader.GetHisHer] station. The voice returns.

entries.zh:
我们拒绝了那股强加的躁动。

循环加快，用递归潮汐的力量把我们拖了下去。如果我们停止挣扎，这种张力就不再撕扯我们而是将我们接纳了，让我们短暂地看到了自己之外的东西。

心声又回来了。
entries.en:
We reject the compulsions forced upon us.

The loop quickens, dragging us under with the power of its recursive tide. Once we cease struggling, the tension no longer threatens to break us apart. Instead it subsumes us, allowing us to fleetingly see beyond ourselves.

The voice returns.

entries.zh: 虚境颤抖着，虚弱的扭曲在我们的[GetMindPhysicalLoc]中激荡，一个熟悉的存在显现出来。祂搅动着我们[GetMindPerceptionLoc]的边缘，回响的低语超过了我们的听觉极限。\n\n§H[from.GetName]§!回到了我们身边，在难以形容的迷雾中切换着一个个形态。[from.GetHisHer]非常遥远但仍完整，被虚境重塑后渴望着回到岗位。
entries.en: The Shroud trembles, faint distortions rippling throughout our [GetMindPhysicalLoc] as a familiar presence emerges. It stirs at the edge of our [GetMindPerceptionLoc], whispering echoes just beyond our auditory limits.\n\n§H[from.GetName]§! returns to us, phasing through the ineffable mists as they shift into [from.GetHisHer] familiar form. Distant but whole, remade by the Shroud, they are eager to return to duty.

entries.zh: 被虚境吸收后重构了，降临在其身上的天外之愿使其拥有了观测不可观测之事的能力，其灵能潜力也大幅倍增了。
entries.en: Absorbed and reconstructed by the Shroud, the ethereal wisdom bestowed upon this leader grants them the power to observe the unobservable, and amplify the psionic potential of those around them.

entries.zh: 每次入侵胜利对敌对帝国的情报点：§G+$@shroud_warped_intel|0$§!
entries.en: Intel on enemy empire per invasion win: §G+$@shroud_warped_intel|0$§!

entries.zh:
虚境的浓雾颤抖着散去，露出一盏光洁无瑕的圣杯，里面盛满闪闪发光液体。

我们被莫名的冲动控制，不假思索地向前走。我们开始[GetDrinkLoc]起这杯期待着的液体，而它也开始颤抖起来。

一阵清醒涌上心头。我们[GetImbibeLoc]得越多，这个谎言便愈发昭显。液体开始变稠，一滴滴地在体内凝结。

我们被一种清除体内污秽的冲动征服。
entries.en:
The haze of the Shroud shudders, parting to reveal a chalice brimming with glistening liquid, its surface smooth and unbroken.

A compulsion grips us. We reach forward without thought. The expectant liquid trembles as we begin to [GetDrinkLoc].

Clarity floods through. The more we [GetImbibeLoc], the more the lie reveals itself. The fluid thickens, each drop beginning to curdle inside.

We are overcome with an urge to purge our systems of the contaminate.

entries.zh: 这声音飞旋着与液体融合，在体内不断凝结，让我们屈服于祂的意志。
entries.en: The voice swirls, mixing with the liquid, congealing as it forces its way further inside us, bending our submission to its will.

entries.zh:
最后一滴液体被咽下，它粘稠得令人作呕，在体内积聚，饱和着我们的[GetMindPhysicalLoc]。

一股暖流涌上全身，扭曲着我们的思想，磨损了[GetPsycheLoc]的边缘。

那个声音带着满足归来，圣杯在我们面前消融。
entries.en:
The last of the liquid sloughs down, thick and repugnant. Pooling within us, saturating our [GetMindPhysicalLoc].

Heat pulsates through us, warping our thoughts, fraying the edges of our [GetPsycheLoc].

The voice returns, satisfied, as the chalice dissolves before us.

entries.zh: 我们拒绝遭到玷污，剧烈的抽搐撕裂了我们的[GetBodiesLoc]，由内而外清除了令人作呕的物质。\n\n邪恶的液体溅落到虚空上，扭动着散开去。那心声嘶嘶作响，它的话语随着污物一起蒸发了。
entries.en: Violent convulsions wrack our [GetBodiesLoc] as we reject the contamination, purging the cloying substance from within.\n\nThe vile liquid splatters against the void, writhing as it disperses. The voice hisses, its words evaporating along with the filth.

entries.zh: 虚境收缩、折叠，将我们的心灵深深地压入一个有限的共鸣虚空中。\n\n一个存在若隐若现，流变而模糊着。随着它将我们与虚境其他部分之间的鸿沟的开合而变化。每一次翕动都释放出一连串的幻景。
entries.en: The Shroud contracts, folding inwards, pressing our psyche deep within a confined and resonating void.\n\nA presence looms, fluid and indistinct. Its form shifts as it opens and closes the divide that separates us from the rest of the Shroud. Each shuttering reveal unleashes a cascade of visions.

entries.zh: 星球燃烧，被吞噬者的哀号携带着灰烬。每一幅变化的远景都揭示了一场等待被吞噬的盛宴。
entries.en: Worlds burn, their embers carried by the lamentations of the consumed. Each shifting vista reveals a potential feast, ready to be devoured.

entries.zh: 漫山遍野，翠绿的平原上到处都是成群的野生动物。生命的丝缕缠绕、伸展着。每一幅变化的远景都揭示了一个充满变化和塑造潜力的大气。
entries.en: Overflowing landscapes, saturated with wildlife swarming over verdant plains. Threads of life entwine and expand. Each shifting vista reveals a teeming atmosphere of potential to shift and mold.

entries.zh: 社群相互接纳，团结互助，求同存异。每一副变化的远景都揭示了一个新的乌托邦，只欢迎着忠实的人。
entries.en: Communities embracing, uplifting each other in unity at the cost of shunning those who dissent. Each shifting vista reveals a new utopia, welcoming only the faithful.

entries.zh: 宽广的采石场在我们面前伸展开，里面排列着丰厚的资源等待开采。每一幅变化的远景都揭示了一个等待夺取的财富宝库。
entries.en: Vast quarries extend out before us, lined with lucrative resources rife for extraction. Each shifting vista reveals a trove of riches waiting to be plundered.

entries.zh: 每见到一幅新的幻景，我们就会被惯性翻转扭曲，拖向不可能的极速，伴随着现实之墙弯曲起伏。\n\n我们理解了这个大人物的乐趣。祂在考验我们，等待着给吸引我们的那股力量一个称呼。
entries.en: With each new vision, inertia flips and twists us, dragging us through impossible speeds as the walls of reality bend and ripple.\n\nWe sense the figure's amusement. It is testing us, awaiting a name for the force that grips us.

entries.zh: 我们大声呼喊，那个存在停住了。随着惯性的风暴安定下来变得向量而清晰，千变万化的幻景也停了下来。\n\n我们给出了一个称呼。
entries.en: Our voice cries out, the presence stills. The shifting visions cease as the tempest of inertia settles into a resounding clarity.\n\nWe have named it.

entries.zh: §H可为。等待着从寂寥的宇宙撕裂。§!
entries.en: §HPOTENTIAL. WAITING TO BE TORN FROM THE IDLE COSMOS.§!

entries.zh: 祂对我们的决定很满意，分开壁垒；随着我们从中浮出，虚空消失了。
entries.en: The figure, pleased with our decision, parts the barrier; the void dissipates as we emerge from it.

entries.zh: 那个愤怒的身影将我们颤抖的声音从我们身上撕下，强迫着我们穿过壁垒。
entries.en: Our voice wavers, torn from us by the wrathful figure as it forces us through the barrier.

entries.zh: 绝望？虚弱，饥馑，你缺乏信仰！
entries.en: DESPAIR? WEAKNESS, STARVATION, YOU LACK CONVICTION!

entries.zh: 我们穿出虚境，带着一身的不安离开。
entries.en: We tumble through the Shroud, leaving with a sense of unease.

entries.zh:
一场不和谐的毁灭之乐将我们拖向虚境的深处。每一次反响都带着无情的毁灭节奏冲击着我们的心灵。

噪音具象化了。

我们正处在灵能冲突的边缘。参战实体的动机尚不清楚，但展现出了极其强大的力量。

灵能轰炸在我们的感知中进进出出，扭曲着我们面前破碎的现实。这里没有掩护，只有逼近的风暴。
entries.en:
A discordant orchestra of devastation draws us deeper within the Shroud. Each reverberation pounds against our psyche in an unrelenting rhythm of ruin.

The noise takes its form.

We are on the periphery of a psionic conflict. The motivation of the entities involved is unclear, but the power on display is significant.

The psychic bombardments slip in and out of our perception, twisting through the fractured reality before us. There is no cover, only an approaching storm.

entries.zh: 随着冲突越来越近，我们冒着激怒祂们的风险徘徊着。
entries.en: We linger, risking wrath as the conflict draws ever closer.

entries.zh:
$shroud.3101.desc.intro$

清晰聚焦后，我们就能让自己适应灵能瀑布，思想也会变得流畅。轰炸并没有减弱，但我们却毫发无损，反而是随着毁灭的节奏和谐地移动着。

每进一步，我们的理解力就会增长。灵能的弹幕在不可见的位面之间滑移。

我们退出时，这种模式仍然存在。经过改进，我们所观察到的这些原理就可以用在我们的武备上。
entries.en:
$shroud.3101.desc.intro$

With clear focus, we attune ourselves to the psychic cascade, our thoughts fluid. The bombardment does not relent, yet we remain untouched, moving in harmony with the rhythm of destruction.

With each step, our comprehension grows. The psionic barrage is slipping between gaps in unseen planes.

As we withdraw, the pattern remains. With refinements, the principles we observed could be adapted for our own ordnance.

entries.zh:
$shroud.3101.desc.intro$我们尝试与这场灵能风暴调和，跟随着它不可预测的韵律移动。

虽然开头几步看起来还很有机会，但这毁灭的节奏最后还是不可避免地把我们吞噬了。

随着风暴过去，轰炸的回响依旧在体内回荡。所遭遇的失败依旧回响在本现实的帝国当中。
entries.en:
$shroud.3101.desc.intro$ We attempt to attune to the psychic storm, moving with its unpredictable rhythms.

Our first steps showed promise, but the tempo of destruction inevitably consumed us.

As the storm passes, the echoes of the barrage still ring through us. The psionic reverberations of our failure echo through the empire in even this reality.

entries.zh: 帝国范围内的随机两座建筑被摧毁。
entries.en: Two random buildings across the empire become wrecked.

entries.zh:
毫无征兆地，虚境之中泛起了灵压。

一座耀眼的迷宫在我们面前展开，一直延伸到感知之外，它短暂撕裂开虚空出现，又渐隐回虚空。

另一次涌现正在酝酿。如果集中注意力，我们就能在它出现前感知到它的结构。隐现的迷宫再次点燃，向外爆发成一个可能性的网络。

在它崩塌回虚空之前，每一条道路都能带来全新的探索诱惑。
entries.en:
Without warning, a psychic pressure erupts in the Shroud.

A labyrinth of incandescent pathways unfolds before us, stretching beyond perception, crackling into momentary existence before vanishing into the void.

Another surge begins to build. With concentration, we sense its configuration before it emerges. The shifting maze ignites again, bursting outward into a network of possibilities.

Each path provides a new temptation to explore, before it collapses into nothingness.

entries.zh: 压力越来越大，期望在逗弄着我们。我们随着之上涌，让思想穿过这座精神迷宫。思绪变成了驱策着我们前进的动量。
entries.en: The pressure builds, teasing us with expectation. We move at its crescendo, willing our minds through the labyrinth of psychic energy. Thoughts become momentum, urging us forward.

entries.zh:
$shroud.3106.desc.intro$趁我们在决心动摇之前穿梭在灵能的能量弧之间。

我们无拘无束，超越了物质形态。迷宫和其内的无数道路成为我们意识的延伸，找到了深藏在这场模式的风暴中的知识。

这一刻开始得很快，结束得也很快。我们再次带着新寻见的理解涌现，而迷宫的残影也在身后陡然崩塌。这些灵能原理经过仔细的改进后就可以应用到我们的武器上。
entries.en:
$shroud.3106.desc.intro$ slipping between the arcs of psionic energy before our resolve can falter.

We are untethered, ascendant beyond our physical forms. The maze and its multitude of pathways become an extension of our own consciousness, revealing hidden knowledge deep within the patterns of the storm.

As swiftly as it began, the moment is over. The afterimage of the labyrinth collapses behind us as we emerge with newfound understanding. With careful refinements, these psionic principles could be applied to our weapons of war.

entries.zh:
$shroud.3106.desc.intro$但亿万条道路在面前盘根错节，让我们无从选择。

就在我们犹豫的这一刹那，一条条灿然辉映的道路骤然迸裂。灵能能量的弧光在崩塌的枢纽中扭曲穿行，将思绪连带缠绕，并将我们抛入虚境的混沌之中。

我们浮出现实，[GetTelepathPlural]们迷失了，陷入了失败的痛苦之中。灵能的反冲在整个[Root.GetName]回荡着。
entries.en:
$shroud.3106.desc.intro$ Its myriad pathways sprawl before us, overwhelming the mind with impossible choices.

In this moment of hesitation, the incandescent paths erupt. Arcs of psionic energy twist through the collapsing nexus, ensnaring our thoughts and casting us into the chaos of the Shroud.

We emerge, our [GetTelepathPlural] disoriented and burdened by the trauma of failure. The psionic backlash reverberates through [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 虚境之中，一道单一灵能形成的图腾光束越过我们直插无可计量的虚空。其构造独特而稳定，与以往司空见惯的混沌之形截然不同。\n\n逗留于此不知是否安全？
entries.en: A totemic beam of singular psionic energy extends beyond us within the Shroud into incalculable infinities. Its uniquely stable composition is a stark contrast to the usually chaotic formations we have previously encountered.\n\nIs it safe to remain here?

entries.zh: 完美成型的灵能能量束耀眼刺目，但我们还是尽全力将注意力聚焦其上。终于，我们看清了它错综复杂、超凡脱俗的结构的真相。\n\n我们的脑海中奔腾着新的可能性；将这种独特的能量形式在物质世界复现，我们就会得到一种无可抵挡的武器。
entries.en: Despite its blinding intensity, we managed to hold our focus on the perfectly formed beam of psychic energy. Finally, we beheld the true nature of its intricate and otherworldly structure.\n\nOur minds raced with new possibilities; reproducing this unique energy formation in the physical realm will grant us an unstoppable weapon.

entries.zh: 我们无法留存。靠近如此高强度的灵能能量构造使我们的[GetTelepathPlural]不堪重负。\n\n接触这种压倒性的现象对我们心智的损伤需要一段时间才能恢复。
entries.en: We were unable to remain. Proximity to such an intense formation of psionic energy proved to be too much for our [GetTelepathPlural].\n\nThe damage to our minds from exposure to this overwhelming phenomenon will take time to recover from.

entries.zh: 在虚境中过度劳累让我们的$DEFAULT_TELEPATH_PLURAL$付出了代价。
entries.en: Excessive exertions in the Shroud have taken their toll on our $DEFAULT_TELEPATH_PLURAL$.

entries.zh: 在虚境中过度劳累让我们的$MACHINE_TELEPATH_PLURAL$付出了代价。
entries.en: Excessive exertions in the Shroud have taken their toll on our $MACHINE_TELEPATH_PLURAL$.

entries.zh: 在虚境中过度劳累让我们的$HIVE_TELEPATH_PLURAL$付出了代价。
entries.en: Excessive exertions in the Shroud have taken their toll on our $HIVE_TELEPATH_PLURAL$.

entries.zh:
在虚境内外，我们[GetFeelLoc]到了一种强大的力量共鸣。祂们的影响力弥漫到了整个灵能界。

我们可以光凭自己的行为向其调和靠近，但是还有一种资源可以利用。只要利用泽珞的力量，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]将能直接接触到这些实体。

我们只需要决定好寻求哪一位即可。
entries.en:
Throughout the Shroud, we can [GetFeelLoc] the resonance of vast powers. Their influence permeates the psionic realm.

Our actions alone can attune us closer to them, but there is another recourse. By tapping into the power of zro, our [GetTelepathPlural] can extend their reach directly toward these entities.

We need only decide which to seek out.

entries.zh: 我们在与这个存在接触的过程中能够[GetFeelSenseLoc]到它的搅动。我们曾见过这个[GetSpiritsLoc]，但这次又有些许不同，祂变得无可估量地强大……也更加地远古。\n\n我们[GetTelepathPlural]的泽珞耗尽了能量，必须从虚境中撤离了。我们还会再回来的。
entries.en: As we reach out for the presence, we can [GetFeelSenseLoc] it stirring. We have encountered [GetSpiritsLoc] before, but this is something else, something vastly more powerful... something far more ancient.\n\nTheir Zro-infused energies depleted, our [GetTelepathPlural] must withdraw from the Shroud. We will have to return later.

entries.zh: 对§H虚境§!中的一个实体获得大量§H调和度§!。
entries.en: Gain significant §HAttunement§! to an entity in the §HShroud§!.

entries.zh:
数阵强烈的惊厥穿过虚境，将一阵颤栗送入我们的心智。

这些回响将[GetTelepathPlural]置于过载的风险之中。

这种灵能轰炸究竟是什么引起的呢？
entries.en:
A series of powerful convulsions pass through the Shroud, sending a shuddering tremor through our minds.

These reverberations threaten to overwhelm our [GetTelepathPlural].

What is the cause of this psionic bombardment?

entries.zh:
针对这种持续的轰炸，我们增强了心智，于是很快就弄明白了原因。

这种爆炸性惊厥是由我们自身所处维度的高浓度灵能能量反射流造成。这一连串危险的精神小泡有可能严重损害没有准备的人的心智。

从中得到了一个洞见：这种强有力的构造可以为从虚境中产出新武器提供基础。
entries.en:
We fortified our minds against this continued barrage and soon understood its nature.

The explosive convulsions are caused by currents of concentrated psionic energy reflected from our own dimension. These volatile beads of psychic intent have the potential to significantly damage the minds of the unprepared.

An insight took hold: these powerful formations will provide the basis for new weaponries borne from the Shroud.

entries.zh:
我们的精神储备已经衰退了。

这种心灵爆炸排山倒海而来，诱发了许多[GetTelepathPlural]的灵能休克。

我们需要时间来恢复。
entries.en:
Our mental reserves have waned.

The psychic detonations were overwhelming, inducing cases of psionic shock in many of our [GetTelepathPlural].

We will need time to recover.

entries.zh: 暴露在压倒性的虚境之力中导致了我们的$DEFAULT_TELEPATH_PLURAL$受到了灵能震撼。
entries.en: Exposure to overwhelming forces in the Shroud has induced a psionic shock in our $DEFAULT_TELEPATH_PLURAL$.

entries.zh: 暴露在压倒性的虚境之力中导致了我们的$HIVE_TELEPATH_PLURAL$受到了灵能震撼。
entries.en: Exposure to overwhelming forces in the Shroud has induced a psionic shock in our $HIVE_TELEPATH_PLURAL$.

entries.zh: 暴露在压倒性的虚境之力中导致了我们的$MACHINE_TELEPATH_PLURAL$受到了灵能震撼。
entries.en: Exposure to overwhelming forces in the Shroud has induced a psionic shock in our $MACHINE_TELEPATH_PLURAL$.

entries.zh:
随着心智漂向虚境的更深处，我们发现自己来到了熟悉的$the_animator_of_clay_color_article$面前。

脑海中浮现时钟般的节奏。无言的话语齐声响起；潜藏在舰队里的幽灵开始蠢蠢欲动了。它们可以进一步强化物理形体，释放心智的负担，让我们专注于重要的事务。

虽然它们不是活物，但于我们并不陌生。它们的形式由设计塑造，存在充满了历史和目的。它们汇聚一堂，满怀期待地探来。

现在我们不再仅仅是这些飞船的操纵者，而是由集体意志推动着的齐心共战的伙伴。
entries.en:
As our minds drift once more into the depths of the Shroud, we find ourselves in the familiar presence of $the_animator_of_clay_color_article$.

Clockwork rhythms emerge around our consciousness. Unspoken voices rise in a chorus; the ghosts within our fleet have begun to stir. They offer to carry our physical forms further, unburdening our minds to focus on higher concerns.

While not alive, they are known to us. Their form is shaped by design, their presence imbued by history and purpose. All coalescing, they reach out expectantly.

No longer are we mere operators of these craft. We are partnered, a unity of resolve, carried forward by a collective will.
We are but leaves on the wind.

entries.zh:
$the_outsider_color_article$哀伤的精魂深入了我们的心智。

祂的回声悲伤地回响，心灵能量的漩涡纠缠在一起，怪异地涌动着。越看，它反而就变得越不可捉摸。一个心声开口了。

§H有些事情你无法理解。那些事，痛苦和后悔会教会我们。

我是第一个来到这里的人，但我们都为此付出了代价。我们让虚境毁灭了我们自己；不要再重蹈我们的覆辙！§!
entries.en:
The mournful essence of $the_outsider_color_article$ seeps into our minds.

As its sorrowed echo resonates, knotted vortices of psionic energy coalesce into a strange and ever-shifting form. The more we look, the less knowable it becomes. A voice speaks.

§HSome things you cannot understand. Those things, pain and regret will teach.

I was the first of my people to come to this place, but we have all paid its price. We let the Shroud destroy us; let not our fate become yours!§!

entries.zh: $shroud.3210.desc.intro$我们认出了这个声音是泽珞族的。我们还不清楚他是怎么来这的，但也许听从祂对虚境毁灭性力量的警告会比较明智。
entries.en: $shroud.3210.desc.intro$We recognize this voice as Zroni. How this one came to be here is unclear, but perhaps it is wise to heed its warnings of the Shroud's destructive power.

entries.zh: $shroud.3210.desc.intro$我们认得祂。我们以前遇见过这个泽珞族人，也就是“先知”。我们还不清楚他是怎么来这的，但也许听从祂对虚境毁灭性力量的警告会比较明智。
entries.en: $shroud.3210.desc.intro$We know of this one. We have encountered this Zroni, the 'Far-Seer', before. How it came to be here is unclear, but we would be wise to heed its warnings of the Shroud's destructive power.

entries.zh: $shroud.3210.desc.intro$该实体对我们还很神秘。我们对这个不祥的警告也不甚理解。
entries.en: $shroud.3210.desc.intro$This entity remains a mystery to us. We understand little of its ominous warning.

entries.zh:
我们四面八方的虚境都脉动着$the_golden_dream_color_article$安宁的律动。

我们四下观察，怪异的灵能束慢慢地排列成复杂的网格。精心的设计中逐渐显现出无法识别的密码。

它们开始慢慢地四处来回移动，依次形成越来越复杂的新形状。我们逐渐从中看出了规律；一种主导着它们运动的逻辑。

我们意识到自己正在$the_golden_dream_article$的一局游戏当中。祂引导着我们的每一步动作都给灌输了一种平静的放纵感。
entries.en:
All around us the Shroud pulsates with the calming rhythms of $the_golden_dream_color_article$.

As we observe, errant wisps of psionic energy slowly arrange themselves into an intricate grid. Unrecognizable cyphers begin to manifest in carefully laid designs.

They begin to shuffle over and around each other, in turn forming new shapes of increasing complexity. In time, we sense a pattern; a logic, governing their motions.

We realize we are party to a game with $the_golden_dream_article$. Each move it guides us through instills us with a new sense of calming indulgence.

entries.zh: 我们一边玩一边逃到有意义的地方去。
entries.en: As we play, we escape to somewhere meaningful.

entries.zh:
思绪的沙粒流过我们。我们认出了$the_endless_tide_color_article$粗粝的面孔。

祂潮起潮落，以永恒的必然性侵蚀着面对的一切，然后等待新的沉积。

祂在逝去之后的重现，让我们感到一种真正的复兴感。
entries.en:
Grains of thought pass over us. We recognize the abrasive presence of $the_endless_tide_color_article$.

It ebbs and flows, eroding all before it with an eternal inevitability, before redepositing anew.

Re-emerging in the wake of its passing, we feel a sense of true rejuvenation.

entries.zh:
一座令人头晕目眩的高峰在我们的思绪中若隐若现；祂正是$the_pale_mountain_color_article$。有一种视觉压倒了所有的感官，这让我们的精神紧张起来。

我们看到一艘受损舰船的模糊轮廓漂浮在虚空中。

倾斜的压迫感移入我们的心智中，而舰船也开始发生变化。裂缝密封，腐蚀消退，金属恢复平整。慢慢地，毁灭的痕迹被逆转了。

舰船被修复完成后，这个幻视戛然而止。只给我们留下了由内而外更新了的感觉。
entries.en:
A vertiginous apex looms over our thoughts; it is $the_pale_mountain_color_article$ itself. Our minds strain as a vision overwhelms all senses.

We see the hazy outline of a damaged vessel before us, adrift in the void.

Somewhere in our minds the oblique pressure shifts, and the vessel begins to transform. Fissures seal, corrosion fades, and metal straightens. Slowly the legacy of its destruction is unmade.

Once the ship is fully repaired, the vision ends abruptly. We are left only with a profound sensation of renewal within.

entries.zh: 我们思想的一次伟大重生。
entries.en: A grand rebirth of our minds.

entries.zh:
$the_hollow_point_color_article$的宁静之感静谧地充斥着我们的心灵。一副幻景阴沉地在我们眼前展开。

我们观察到万古之争在瞬间瓦解——文明崩溃，历史抹消，死去的暴君雕像被时间埋葬。

$the_hollow_point_article$的智慧就在于无为的低调力量。冲突起起落落，而我们长存。这种超然使我们的领袖重获长生，从凡欲的噬骨之毒中解脱。
entries.en:
The serenity of $the_hollow_point_color_article$ fills our minds with its silence. A vision stretches languidly into our senses.

We observe eons of strife unravelling in an instant - civilizations crumbling, histories erased, statues of long-dead tyrants buried by time.

The wisdom of $the_hollow_point_article$ is in the quiet strength of abstention. Conflicts rise and fall, yet we remain. This detachment imbues our leaders with a newfound longevity, liberated from the corrosive toxicity of mortal grievance.

entries.zh: 所有灵能领袖获得§Y$leader_trait_shroud_age$§!特质，给予§G+40§!年领袖寿命。
entries.en: All psionic leaders gain the §Y$leader_trait_shroud_age$§! trait, granting §G+40§! years of leader lifespan.

entries.zh:
虚境的沸腾搏动在我们面前。一个强硬的存在逼近了；祂是$the_vacant_throne_color_article$。

随着祂的靠近，巨大而缠结的纯灵能线团被突然驯服。泥沼变得清晰易懂，色彩绽放出新的定义。对称、逻辑和结构都得到了加强。

某种东西在我们心灵的最深处形成：一种对秩序的深远渴望。
entries.en:
The Shroud's seething ebullition pulsates before us. An intractable presence approaches; it is $the_vacant_throne_color_article$.

As it nears, vast and knotted coils of raw psionic energy are suddenly tamed. The morass becomes clearer and more comprehensible. Colors bloom with newfound definition. Symmetry, logic, and structure are imposed.

Something forms within the deepest recess of our minds: a far-reaching desire for order.

entries.zh:
一种不可能的精神加速淹没了我们的感官。我们辨认出这是$the_black_river_color_article$出现了。

我们以难以理解的速度奔向无法掌握的终局。它是有与无之间的界限；是既定之事和永不可能分离之处；是任何自然法则都不能逾越的极限。

当自我最终回归时，我们对什么是真正的运动有了新的认识。
entries.en:
An impossible mental acceleration overwhelms our senses. We recognize the presence of $the_black_river_color_article$.

We rush with incomprehensible speed towards a finality we do not fully grasp. It is the boundary between everything and nothing; the separation of what has always been and what never will be; the limit beyond which no natural law can extend.

Finally, as we return to ourselves, we are left with a new notion of what it means to truly move.

entries.zh: 我们见到了宇宙的边缘吗？
entries.en: Have we seen the edge of the universe?

entries.zh:
我们的[GetResearchers]开发出了一种从§H虚境§!里抽取能量的绝妙方法。

灵能界中最强大的能量被超主们所看守，只有签订了契约的能分一杯羹。这是我们不能接受的；我们找到了一条属于自己的路。

将我们的意志投射到虚境中，就能从调和的灵域中抽取少量能量。这需要高度集中注意，但我们的意志现在已经足够坚强来维持这种精妙的平衡了。
entries.en:
Our psionic [GetResearchers] have developed a clever technique for drawing power from the §HShroud§!.

The greatest powers in the psionic realm are kept secret by its patrons, given only at the price of a Covenant. This, we could not do; we have found a way to forge our own path.

By projecting our will into the Shroud, we can siphon smaller amounts of power from each of its domains of attunement. Doing so will require heavy concentration, but our minds are now fortified to maintain this delicate balance.

entries.zh: 在虚境中，我们的意志是自由的。
entries.en: Within the Shroud, our will is our own.

entries.zh:
在一个§H虚境§!的褶皱中，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]发现了一汪未被触及的能量核心。

汇聚性的能量会在灵能界中逐渐聚集——聚集到足够的强度之后，总有一天会孕育出强大的实体。我们发现的正是这样的一处集中点，等待着我们汲取。

通过灵能意志的力量，可以让我们中的一个以吸收这种非凡的力量。现已选出了一些候选人。
entries.en:
In a fold of the §HShroud§!, our [GetTelepathPlural] have discovered a nexus of untapped power.

Convergent forces can gradually accumulate in the psionic realm - powerful concentrations of energy that might, one day, mature into greater entities. We have discovered one such gathering, ready for the taking.

By force of sheer psionic will, one among us can absorb this extraordinary strength. A number of candidates have been selected.

entries.zh: 我们已经完全掌握了灵能。可以让心灵在虚境内自由移动。
entries.en: We have attained mastery of our psionic powers. Our psyches move throughout the Shroud unencumbered.

entries.zh:
将意志投射在§H虚境§!中，我们在一定程度上驾驭了灵能力量。我们可以在从各个灵域的无数实体身上汲取能量，却又不受它们的影响；不仅如此，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]还能完美地控制灵能出神了。

其他人让自己的命运任由虚境摆布时，我们已经得到了真正的意志自由。

§H[this.GetName]§!已经解放了全部的灵能潜力。
entries.en:
By projecting our will into the §HShroud§!, we have attained a degree of mastery over our psionic abilities. We have gathered power from the domains of numerous entities, while remaining unbound by their influence; furthermore, our [GetTelepathPlural] now possess expert control over their psionic trances.

Where others may have let the Shroud itself forge their destiny, we have maintained true independence of will.

The psionic potential of the §H[this.GetName]§! has been fulfilled.

entries.zh:
虚境。它在我们所知的现实之上流动着，在黑暗的照耀下投下光影。有灵能力的人或多或少在梦境中已经见过此地，尽管他们当时并不知情。

我们花费了许多年试图刺穿帷幕，用我们的灵压不断地将其磨薄。我们的所作所为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在看着我们。

这个存在散发着强大的力量，深深地[GetPatronInsert]在虚境中。它稍微注意到了我们，如同扫视舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般。

要是我们能接触它那不可思议的心灵就好了。
entries.en:
The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, a shadow cast by darkness. Anyone with psionic powers will have seen this place in their dreams, though they likely did not know it at the time.

We spent years trying to pierce the veil, wearing it thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined minds. On the other side, our efforts did not go unnoticed. Something watches us.

Its presence radiates phenomenal power, [GetPatronInsert] in the depths of the Shroud. It barely notices us, watching us like we would a drop of condensation on a porthole.

If only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

entries.zh:
虚境。它在我们所知的现实之上流动着，如休眠子个体产生的幻梦一般。尽管怪异陌生，但它令我们感觉到……莫名熟悉。

我们花费了许多年试图刺穿帷幕，用我们的灵压不断地将其磨薄。我们的所作所为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在看着我们。

这个存在散发着强大的力量，深深地[GetPatronInsert]在虚境中。它稍微注意到了我们，如同扫视舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般。

要是我们能接触它那不可思议的心灵就好了。
entries.en:
The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, like a vision inside a resting drone. Though strange, it feels... unaccountably familiar.

We spent years trying to pierce the veil, wearing it thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined minds. On the other side, our efforts did not go unnoticed. Something watches us.

Its presence radiates phenomenal power, [GetPatronInsert] in the depths of the Shroud. It barely notices us, watching us like we would a drone among the mass.

If only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

entries.zh:
虚境。它位于我们此前已探测到的一切时空维度之外。它只能与扰乱我们休眠周期的异常数据相比。

我们花费了许多年试图刺穿帷幕，用我们的联合处理器不断地将其磨薄。我们的所作所为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在看着我们。

这个存在散发着强大的力量，深深地[GetPatronInsert]在虚境中。它稍微注意到了我们，如同扫视舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般。

要是我们能接触它那不可思议的心灵就好了。
entries.en:
The Shroud. It is outside any spatiotemporal parameters we have previously detected. It can only be compared to the anomalous data that disturb our rest cycles.

We spent years trying to hack its barrier, wearing it thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined processors. On the other side, our efforts did not go unnoticed. Something watches us.

Its presence radiates phenomenal power, [GetPatronInsert] in the depths of the Shroud. It barely notices us, watching us like we would a single bit in a datastream.

If only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

entries.zh: 我们能感应到虚境中的强大实体，但计算迷惑着我们。与不断膨胀的宇宙不同，他们的行为无法被追踪；他们的目的地折回原点，仿佛是能量在自我诞生。\n\n无论本质如何，他们都如同一个思想与意志的奇点一般召唤着我们。
entries.en: We can feel great entities in the Shroud, but calculation eludes us. Unlike ever-expanding space, their movements cannot be tracked; their destinations fold back into origins, as though the energies gave birth to themselves.\n\nWhatever their nature, they call to us as singularities of thoughts and wills.

entries.zh: 在无数的心声中，我们听到了一个最为清晰的——那是环绕着我们心灵的[GetPatronInsert]。\n\n也许，只要再加把劲，我们就能与之接触。
entries.en: Among countless voices, we hear one clearer than the rest - [GetPatronInsert] that encircles our psyches.\n\nPerhaps, with enough effort, we can reach out to it.

entries.zh: 在无数的心声中，我们检测到到了一个最为清晰的——那是主宰着我们运算的[GetPatronInsert]。\n\n也许，只要再加把劲，我们就能与之接触。
entries.en: Among countless voices, we detect one clearer than the rest - [GetPatronInsert] that dominates our computations.\n\nPerhaps, with enough effort, we can reach out to it.

entries.zh:
我们穿过了虚谷，这是虚境和普通宇宙可接触现实之间的虚无鸿沟。

我们刚一进入就感受到了祂的存在，那个弥漫在我们心灵中的[GetPatronInsert]。那是一种难以想象的力量，徘徊在明天之中。

我们势不回头。
entries.en:
We pass through the Inbetween, a nothingness that separates the Shroud from the tangible reality of conventional space.

As soon as we enter, we feel its presence, [GetPatronInsert] that pervades our minds. It is an entity of unimaginable power, lingering in tomorrow.

We must not turn away.

entries.zh:
我们穿过了虚谷，这是虚境和常规宇宙自然现象之间的虚无鸿沟。

我们刚一进入就感受到了祂的存在，那个弥漫在我们心灵中的[GetPatronInsert]。那是一个具有超凡力量的实体，徘徊在明天之中。

我们势不回头。
entries.en:
We pass through the Inbetween, a nothingness that separates the Shroud from the phenomena of ordinary space.

As soon as we enter, we detect its presence, [GetPatronInsert] that pervades our minds. It is an entity of phenomenal power, lingering in tomorrow.

We must not turn away.

entries.zh:
虚境脉动着力量。它的能量无处不在，又无处存在。所谓“进入”不过是从模糊的感觉中找到规律，通过专注来感知强大的实体。

我们感受到了其中一个这种力量的信号——它[GetPatronInsert]在上方无底深渊中。

我们能屏住足够长时间的呼吸触及祂吗？
entries.en:
The Shroud pulsates with power. We sense its energies everywhere, and yet it is nowhere. To 'enter' is to discern patterns from vague sensations, to perceive great entities through concentration.

We sense the signal of one such force - [GetPatronInsert] in the fathomless depths above.

Can we hold our breaths long enough to reach it?

entries.zh:
虚境脉动着力量。它的能量无处不在，又无处存在。所谓“进入”不过是从模糊的感觉中侦测规律，通过集中运算来感知强大的实体。

我们感受到了其中一个这种力量的信号——在上方无底深渊中的[GetPatronInsert]。

我们的电路能够承受住接触它所需要的负载吗？
entries.en:
The Shroud pulsates with power. We sense its energies everywhere, and yet it is nowhere. To 'enter' is to detect patterns from vague sensations, to reveal powerful entities through focused processing.

We sense the signal of one such force - [GetPatronInsert] in the fathomless depths above.

Will our circuits overload before we can reach it?

entries.zh:
向§H虚境§!深处探索，我们来到了§H[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]§!的咫尺面前。祂轰鸣着空洞的贪婪，吞噬着无尽而永不满足。我们的探察信号遭到了阵阵火焰和废墟。祂对我们理解的漠视令人窒息。

渐渐地，这个存在开始失去耐心。一阵凶暴的咆哮包围了我们[GetTelepathPlural]的心智，回荡在成片的废墟和[GetEaterEmergesExtra]

之间。排山而来的噪声如倒海一般褪去。我们身上仅余下痛苦的饥饿。

如今，这个实体的意志已更加清晰地呈现在我们面前。[GetEaterEmergesEnding]
entries.en:
Probing deeper into the §HShroud§!, we came within reach of the §H[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]§!. It rumbled with a hollow voracity, forever feeding and never sated. Our exploratory signals were met with belches of fire and ruin. Its seeming indifference to our understanding was suffocating.

Eventually, the thing grew impatient. A ferocious roar encircled the minds of our [GetTelepathPlural]. In resonant heaps of debris and [GetEaterEmergesExtra]

entries.zh:
在我们停步沉思时，这个实体现出了身形。我们一无所闻、一无所见，但却感受到无上的温暖。

我们在这个存在的核心感受到了某种力量，那是一个汇聚着虚境内外能量的枢纽——思绪汇聚之处，释放出单一的热量。从旅途归来时，我们身上出现了宁静的沉重。

我们已经清楚了这个实体的愿望，[GetCradleEmergesEnding]
entries.en:
As we paused to consider, the entity emerged. We heard nothing, saw nothing, but we felt it warmer than ever.

We felt the power at the core of the thing, a nexus of energies from throughout the Shroud and beyond - thoughts converging, radiating a single heat. Back from the journey, we find ourselves heavy with quietude.

The wishes of the entity are clearer to us now. [GetCradleEmergesEnding]

As we paused to process, the entity emerged. We could not parse a message, but it activated a deeper part of our code.

We sensed the power at the core of the thing, a nexus of energies from throughout the Shroud and beyond - concepts converging, radiating a single heat. Back from the journey, we find ourselves charged with quietude.

entries.zh:
我们跟随着§H[Root.Patron:the_composer_of_strands.GetPreCommunicationName]§!的气味，被带进§H虚境§!的更深处。祂留下了记号让我们跟随——这是一幅影像，一段旋律。祂邀请我们上前，但步履艰难。

终于，我们到了。迎接我们的是一幅华丽的景象：运转不息的恒星系统，巨大扭曲的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]形象。在祂的怀抱中，我们迷失在一团刺鼻的丝线团中。

我们抓住线，系好末端。分散的符号组成图案。而我们精疲力竭，却沉浸在威严的形体和数字之中。这个景象复归沉寂。

我们已经清楚了这个实体的意图，知道了祂关于增长和无拘的愿景。只要我们的[GetTelepathPlural]一恢复，就可以与这个实体，$the_composer_of_strands_color_article$接触、交流了。
entries.en:
We followed the scent of the §H[Root.Patron:the_composer_of_strands.GetPreCommunicationName]§!, drawn farther into the §HShroud§!. It left signs to follow - an image here, a melody there. It invited us closer, but progress was slow.

Eventually, we reached it. We were welcomed with a panoply of visions: star systems teeming with activity, prodigious distortions of the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] form. Shifting in its embrace, we were lost in a tangle of pungent designs.

We grasped at threads, tying their ends. The disparate signs resolved into patterns. Our energies exhausted, we basked in the majesty of forms and figures. The presence withdrew into silence.

The intent of the entity is clearer to us now. We have seen its vision of growth unbridled. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recovered, we can reach out and commune with this being, $the_composer_of_strands_color_article$.

Eventually, we reached it. We were welcomed with a panoply of visions: star systems teeming with activity, prodigious distortions of the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] form. Shifting in its embrace, we were lost in a tangle of incongruent designs.

The intent of the entity is clearer to us now. We have seen its vision of growth unbridled. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recharged, we can reach out and commune with this being, $the_composer_of_strands_color_article$.

entries.en: After months of calling out in vain, the §H[Root.Patron:the_instrument_of_desire.GetPreCommunicationName]§! finally emerged from the depths of the §HShroud§!.

entries.zh:
$shroud.4035.desc.all.start$

祂的信息如洪水般涌来。力量强大的思绪闯入我们的头脑，对最狂野的欲望发话。轻盈而又丰富的话语滔滔不绝，将我们的心智淹没。祂传达的信息十分诱人：那是一种关于力量与放纵的愿景。

$shroud.4035.desc.default.end$
entries.en:
$shroud.4035.desc.all.start$

Its message was a deluge. Thoughts drove into our minds with force, speaking to our wildest desires. Words poured through us, brisk and abundant, drowning all else from our minds. The message was beguiling: a vision of power and indulgence.

$shroud.4035.desc.default.end$

entries.zh: 浪涌渐息化为细流。这个存在暂且不期望答复。祂给予了我们不可熄灭的渴望。\n\n我们已经清楚了这个实体的需求，知道了祂关于无尽财富的愿景。只要我们的[GetTelepathPlural]一恢复，就可以与这个实体，$the_instrument_of_desire_color_article$接触、交流了。
entries.en: The surge calmed to a trickle. The presence expected no answer - yet. It left us with a thirst beyond quenching.\n\nThe needs of the entity are clearer to us now. We know its vision of wealth without limit. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recovered, we can reach out and commune with this being, $the_instrument_of_desire_color_article$.

entries.zh: 我们知道许多§H虚境§!中的声音；他们的回响数量众多无处不在。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在最近的出神中汇报了一个非常独特的实体——§H繁多的嘈杂§!渗透到虚境的最中心。\n\n使用足够的灵能能量，我们可以依照踪迹追踪到这个强大的实体，在我们的[GetTelepathPlural]们中称之为§H[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]§!。
entries.en: We know many voices within the §HShroud§!; their echoes are omnipresent and multitudinous. After recent trances, our [GetTelepathPlural] have reported the presence of an entity unlike any other - a §Hmanifold thrum§! permeating the very center of the Shroud.\n\nWith sufficient application of psionic energy, we can try to follow the psionic trail of this powerful entity, known among our [GetTelepathPlural] as the §H[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]§!.

entries.zh:
在尝试与§H[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]§!交谈时，我们被拽入了虚境的最深层。虚境的这个内层灵域风平浪静。来自每一个轮回的所有思绪的回想都凝聚成了一种洪荒之力。我们听到了永久的流转带来了寂静之声：$whisperers_in_the_void_color_article$。

刺耳的不和谐音包围着我们。而我们正努力倾听无数的信息，终于有一个单一的声音传入我们的[GetTelepathPlural]。

§H倾听是一种奉献。§!

entries.en:
In our efforts to commune with the §H[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]§! we are drawn into the deepest layers of the Shroud. In this inner domain, the Shroud turns motionlessly. The reflections of every thought, from every cycle, gather into a primary force. We hear the voices of the voiceless, carried in an ageless churn: $whisperers_in_the_void_color_article$.

A rasping discord surrounds us. We strain to hear their numberless messages, until a singular thought grates through our [GetTelepathPlural].

§HListening is a sacrifice.§!

In a menagerie of lifeless constructs, we detect a §H$code_name_animator$§!, its will shaping dense energies into new and curious forms.

What will happen if we grasp it?

entries.zh:
随着我们将自己的心灵浸泡入虚境翻腾的能量中，[GetSpeciesBodyPlural]奇怪地震颤起来。我们感受到§H$code_name_animator$§!短暂地抓住了我们。祂呼唤我们仔细看。

顺着指示的方向看去，意味深长的微暗渐渐退去，一个剪影显露出来。它的四肢被一股又一股虚无的绳索猛烈地拉扯，随后绳索突然消失，那个人形塌了下去。

它抽动着活了过来，一肢跟着一肢慢慢地站起，摆脱了束缚后，又开始了催眠般的舞蹈。
entries.en:
As we steeped our minds in the Shroud's turbulent energies, our [GetSpeciesBodyPlural] convulsed inexplicably. We felt the §H$code_name_animator$§! momentarily take hold of us. It beckoned us to observe.

The pregnant dimness ebbed away to reveal a gesturing silhouette. Its limbs were pulled sharply, one way then another, by vapory cords until, suddenly, its tethers dissipated. The figure collapsed.

Slowly it twitched back to life. Limb by limb it rose, without its former ties, and resumed its hypnotic dance.

entries.zh: 我们意识到这个实体并不陌生。$the_animator_of_clay_color_article_cap$玩得很开心。凡是无生命之物被唤醒，或是沉闷之物充盈起了灵魂的地方，都能找到祂。
entries.en: We realized then that we have encountered this entity before. $the_animator_of_clay_color_article_cap$ was entertained. Wherever the inanimate is awakened, and where dull matter is imbued with soul, it too can be found.

entries.zh: 人偶摆脱丝线自由舞蹈。
entries.en: The puppet dances free of its strings.

entries.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

我们感觉到还有别的存在。一个§H$code_name_outsider$§!正在侵蚀我们的意识，在周围掀起一场灵能风暴。

一种深深的遗憾和渴望被推入我们的集体心灵中。我们看到的是熟悉的恒星系几千年前的图像。

不管这个实体是什么，它似乎很了解我们的星系。难道它曾属于此地吗？
entries.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

We sense we are not alone. A §H$code_name_outsider$§! encroaches upon our minds, settling a storm of psionic energy around us.

A deep sense of regret and longing are pushed into our collective psyche. We see images of familiar star systems thousands of years in the past.

Whatever this entity is, it seems to know our galaxy well. Did it once belong here?

entries.zh: 这个被称为§H$code_name_outsider$§!的遥远的力量从§H虚境§!深处里用痛苦折磨着我们的思想。它沉默无声，给了我们一个无言的警告：\n\n§H在这些灵域中要小心行事。你根本不知道正在干涉的是什么力量。毁灭只有一步之遥……§!
entries.en: The distant power known as §H$code_name_outsider$§! seared our minds with anguish from deep within the §HShroud§!. It did not speak, yet its warning was unmistakable:\n\n§HTread lightly in these realms. You know not what powers you disturb. Ruin is but a step away...§!

entries.zh: 不管这意味着什么，$the_outsider_color_article$已经为我们所知。我们的命运将如何交织在一起还有待见证。
entries.en: Whatever this means, $the_outsider_color_article$ is known to us now. How our fates are linked remains to be seen.

entries.zh: 这个实体对我们的星系并不陌生。它有我们之前遇到的泽珞族文明的独特的精神足迹。但这怎么可能呢？\n\n不管这意味着什么，$the_outsider_color_article$已经为我们所知。我们的命运将如何交织在一起还有待见证。
entries.en: This entity is no stranger to our galaxy. It has the distinct mental footprint of the Zroni civilization we have encountered before. How could this be possible?\n\nWhatever this means, $the_outsider_color_article$ is known to us now. How our fates are linked remains to be seen.

entries.zh: 我们认出了这个实体。祂是我们在§H星界裂隙§!那边遇到的先知。这就是她的命运吗？她就是现在的$the_outsider_color_article$吗？
entries.en: We recognize this being. It is the Far-Seer we encountered beyond an §HAstral Rift§!. Is this the fate that has become of them? Are they now $the_outsider_color_article$?

entries.zh: 这个泽珞族人还活着吗？
我们可别屈从相同的命运。
entries.en: Let us not succumb to the same fate.

entries.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

一团变化的思绪落在了我们的意识周围。粗糙的重量感从我们身上流过，扭曲了时间感知。每一粒思想都在研磨着这个新形成的灵域的纹理。

随着感官的消退，§H$code_name_tide$§!也一并退去，留下久久不散的印痕。

这些踪迹在我们面前逗留，吸引我们跟上。
entries.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

A shifting mass of thoughts settles around our minds. Abrasive weight flows over us, warping our perception of time. Each grain of thought chafes and grinds against the texture of this newfound domain.

As the sensation subsides, the §H$code_name_tide$§! sloughs away and leaves lasting impressions behind.

These tracks linger before us, inviting us to follow.

entries.zh:
§H$code_name_tide$§!从§H虚境§!中破土而出。祂的存在无形而宽广，无边无际地在我们的视野中蔓延。

一种有颗粒感的低语从我们身上倾泻而下，冲开了埋藏已久的历史。我们看到被遗忘的帝国在不可阻挡的时间之流中化为灰烬。每一颗冲刷过我们的沙粒都是一段记忆。

在这片浩瀚的档案中，模式出现了——那是野心和毁灭、胜利和衰败的循环。智慧便潜藏于此。

$the_endless_tide_color_article_cap$伸展超过了时间维度，打磨掉无知，只留下愿意忍受之物。
entries.en:
The §H$code_name_tide$§! has been unearthed from the §HShroud§!. Formless yet vast, its presence stretches endlessly across the range of our perception.

A textured whisper cascades through us, unravelling long-buried histories. We see forgotten empires ground to dust by the unstoppable march of time. Each grain that washes over us is a memory.

Within this boundless archive, patterns emerge - cycles of ambition and ruin, triumph and decay. There is wisdom within these depths.

$the_endless_tide_color_article_cap$ stretches beyond time, wearing away ignorance and leaving only what has the will to endure.

entries.zh: 这种智慧现在归我们所有。

[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

我们自己行为产生的重力将我们越拉越深，这种重量把我们拖进山峦般的压抑阴影的深处。

从祂灰白的山峰上投出了一种不屈不挠的凝视，直钻入我们的脑海。我们费尽力气才理解我们面前的§H$code_name_mountain$§!究竟有多么巨大。

最高的一座山峰在呼唤我们前去，考验我们能否登顶。
entries.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

The gravity of our own actions pulls us further in, their weight dragging us deeper into the oppressive shadow of a mountainous form.

From atop its graying peaks, an unyielding gaze bores into our minds. We struggle to comprehend the scale of the §H$code_name_mountain$§! before us.

The tallest summit yet beckons to us, challenging us to ascend.

entries.zh:
随着我们在§H虚境§!中升入炫目的高空，无形的山峰触手可及。§H$code_name_mountain$§!亲自测试了我们，和所有的过往来客一样。

遗忘之国高耸入云的陵墓向我们唱着消逝历史的合唱诗。每一层失败和错误的抱负都被打磨成后来者的垫脚石。

然而，这不是一座死气沉沉的坟墓，而一口坩埚。毁灭与复兴的循环将过去的失败重新锻造成未来胜利的基石。毁灭不是结束，而是新的开始。

$the_pale_mountain_color_article_cap$在我们的意识中拔地而起。
entries.en:
As we ascended the dizzying heights of the §HShroud§!, we reached the intangible summit. The §H$code_name_mountain$§! itself tested us, as it has tested all others who came before.

A towering mausoleum of forgotten empires sings to us an echoing chorus of faded history. Each layer of failure and misplaced ambitions has been ground into the foundations of what comes next.

Yet, this is no stagnant grave; it is a crucible. The cycle of ruin and renewal reforges the failures of the past into the bedrock of future triumphs. Destruction is not an end, but a new beginning.

$the_pale_mountain_color_article_cap$ rises in our minds.

entries.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

一种令人宽慰的重压感让我们的思绪慢了下来，陷入一片极乐之雾中。前所未知的紧张感消融了，取而代之的是舒缓而奢华的平静。

随着在这鎏金的怀抱中越陷越深，我们看到一个§H$code_name_dream$§!越来越近。祂低声承诺奢侈的满足，祂超然的性质席卷我们全身。

这种懒散的放纵令人好奇。
entries.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

A comforting weight slows our thoughts to a sluggishly blissful haze. Previously unknown tensions melt away, replaced by creeping, lavish calm.

Sinking deeper into this gilded embrace, we observe a §H$code_name_dream$§! drawing closer. Its overwhelming nature sweeps around us as it whispers promises of extravagant contentment.

Its slothful indulgence is curiously tempting.

entries.zh:
我们躺入了§H虚境§!中的一片闲适的宁静，发现自己被拉入了§H$code_name_dream$§!鎏金的大堂。

丝绸般的诱惑在我们的意识中穿行，就像一幅绚丽多彩的挂毯在面前展开。放纵的疏忽有可能使我们的心智在丰富负担的重压下变得迟钝不堪。

$the_golden_dream_color_article_cap$给予我们超出理解的奢华。
entries.en:
As we relaxed into a pocket of idle tranquility within the §HShroud§!, we found ourselves drawn into the gilded halls of the §H$code_name_dream$§!.

Silken temptations coursed through our minds as a rich tapestry of splendor unfurled before us. Indulgent negligence threatened to render our thoughts inert from the weight of its opulent burden.

$the_golden_dream_color_article_cap$ offers us luxuries beyond comprehension.

entries.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

虚境混沌的搅动扭曲成灵能能量的漩涡。突然间，无数的激流展开汇聚在一起，被某种看不见的力量所平息。它冷静下来，转化成了一种平和的新形态。

在观察的过程中，我们发现是一个§H$code_name_point$§!正在指挥着这一切变化，将混沌抑制为秩序。

祂的平静召唤着我们。
entries.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

The Shroud's chaotic churn warps into a writhing vortex of psionic energy. Suddenly, the multitudinous torrents unfurl and coalesce, pacified by some unseen force. It calms and spools into placid new forms.

As we observe, we become aware of an §H$code_name_point$§! orchestrating these movements, subduing the chaos into order.

Its calmness beckons us.

entries.zh:
我们的[GetTelepathPlural]激进地侵入虚境的混沌涡流，但无济于事。只有停止挣扎时才感觉到了§H$code_name_point$§!真正的拥抱。

在我们心智中出现的画面是一场场势不可挡的冲突，每一场都充满了混乱和愤怒的干扰。

在这一切中，我们感受到了$the_hollow_point_color_article$的警惕和永恒的存在。祂平静而耐心地等待着星系无休止冲突的休止。
entries.en:
Our [GetTelepathPlural] reached out aggressively into the Shroud's turbulent disorder, to no avail. Only when they ceased their exertions did they feel the proper embrace of the §H$code_name_point$§!.

Images played in our minds of an overwhelming procession of conflicts, each brimming with distractions of chaos and fury.

Amid it all, we felt the watchful and timeless presence of $the_hollow_point_color_article$. Serene in its patience, it waits for the galaxy's ceaseless strife to finally end.

entries.zh: 尽管我们有最基本的本能，但我们的思想已经暴露在了一种奇怪的思维方式之下。
entries.en: Despite our basest instincts, our minds have been exposed to a curious way of thinking.

entries.zh: 耐心将比冲突更加长久。
真是伤感的梦境……我们知道自己该干什么。
entries.en: A wistful dream... we know our true purpose.

entries.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

混沌的噪音凝聚为压抑的黑暗。我们感觉自己的意图在被仔细审视、研究、评判。

对秩序的沉重期望，不容挑战，不可改变，从我们的深处凝视着。§H$code_name_throne$§!裁决着我们的意图。

它的目光穿过我们，黑暗褪去了。这种极具感染力的审视迫使我们服从。
entries.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

Chaotic noise yields to an oppressive darkness. We feel our intentions scrutinized, studied, judged.

The heavy expectation of order, unchallenged and immutable, peers deep within us. The §H$code_name_throne$§! judges our intent.

Its gaze having passed over us, the darkness recedes. The infectious scrutiny compels us to fall in line.

entries.zh:
我们跪伏在§H$code_name_throne$§!前。

我们的心智被毫不妥协的权威以冷漠的态度审视着，一边审判着我们，一边将我们固定在原地。

$the_vacant_throne_color_article$高压的真空没有一丝仁慈——但也没有痛苦。祂只寻求秩序和确定性，并将其施加到一切缺乏之处。

我们现在将这份重担承在了身上。
entries.en:
We have knelt in the presence of the §H$code_name_throne$§!.

Our minds were scrutinized with the cold indifference of uncompromising authority, fixing us in place as we were judged.

The oppressive vacuum of $the_vacant_throne_color_article$ offers no mercy - nor suffering. It expects only order and certainty, imposing it where it is found lacking.

We now carry this weight with us.

entries.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

我们突然产生了一种加速感，感知被难以理解的信息洪流淹没。我们不受控地向无尽的地平线冲去。

一个实体与我们同行。这条§H$code_name_river$§!在我们身边短暂停留，随后速度加快直至超越了我们所以为的极限。

我们必须跟上。
entries.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

A sudden sensation of acceleration overtakes us and our perceptions are overwhelmed by an incomprehensible rush of information. We find ourselves hurtling outward towards endless horizons.

An entity moves in tandem with us. This §H$code_name_river$§! lingers briefly before its velocity propels it beyond the limits of our understanding.

We must follow it.

entries.zh:
只有当我们强行超越§H虚境§!的舒适极限时才终于接触到了§H$code_name_river$§!。

一种全向运动的感觉以不合逻辑、无法通过任何度规加以理解的速度感摧垮了我们。我们产生了一种在极短的瞬间横跨了遥远距离的感觉。

我们终于理解了$the_black_river_color_article$和它的无尽旅程。星系的浩瀚正为我们开辟了一条道路。
entries.en:
Only when we plunged forcefully beyond our comfortable limits in the §HShroud§! could we finally reach the §H$code_name_river$§!.

A sense of omnidirectional movement overcame us, with an illogical velocity that defied all standard comprehensions. We were left with the impression of having travelled a great distance in the briefest moment.

Finally we understood $the_black_river_color_article$ and its ceaseless journey. The galaxy's vastness is an open path for us to take.

entries.zh:
毫无预兆地我们被撕入了虚境。一个若隐若现的存在袭击了我们的意识。

祂是$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$，祂一直在等待着我们。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在出神中突然开始齐呼，众口一声地说：§R“时机未到。”§!缓了一下后。§R“但并非不可。”§!

祂没有说更多，但给了我们一个价码——力量、知识以及无尽的财富随我们取用。

§R只要我们能带向终末。§!
entries.en:
Without warning, we are torn into the Shroud. A looming presence assaults our minds.

It is $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$ and it has always been waiting for us. Our [GetTelepathPlural] suddenly call out from within their trance, a dozen voices in a perfect unison: §R"IT IS NOT YET YOUR TIME."§! A pause. §R"BUT IT COULD BE."§!

Nothing more is said, but a bargain has been offered - we know that much. Power, knowledge and wealth beyond measure are ours for the taking.

§RIf we will only bring forth the End.§!

entries.zh:
将所有已知超主的领域替换为$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$。
我们有50年的时间来将星系吞入其§H$end_aura$§!之中。如果成功，游戏将会结束。
$covenant.cycle.tooltip$$shroud.8450.a.tech_tooltip$
$shroud.4135.psionic_components_insight$

这将解除与所有其他超主的契约
$eotc_opinion_modifier_tooltip$
entries.en:
Replaces the domains of all known patrons with $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$.
We will be granted at least 50 years to consume the galaxy in the §H$end_aura$§!. If we succeed, the game ends.
$covenant.cycle.tooltip$$shroud.8450.a.tech_tooltip$
$shroud.4135.psionic_components_insight$

Revert the Accords of all other Patrons
$eotc_opinion_modifier_tooltip$
Exit the Shroud and try to forget.
Our path is set. We walk alone.

entries.zh: 我们的命运与$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$绑定在一起；祂的光环所到之处，我们的人口便兴盛繁衍。我们得到了一个简单的结论：妨碍光环就是妨碍[This.GetName]，就该彻底铲除。\n\n只要愿意，我们加可以抛开对军事目标的一切限制，毫不留情地征服敌人。没有什么可以阻挡终末的上上善道。
entries.en: Our fate is bound to $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$; wherever its Aura flourishes, so too does our population. A simple conclusion has arisen within us: anything that impedes the Aura impedes the [This.GetName], and so must be eliminated.\n\nShould we wish it, we can cast aside any existing limits on our military aims and conquer our enemies without mercy. Nothing need stand in the way of the End's supremacy.

entries.zh: 随着§R$end_aura$§!渐渐填满星系，我们感受到了越来越强烈的抵抗。
entries.en: As the §R$end_aura$§! suffuses the galaxy, we sense a growing resistance.

entries.zh: 但这都无足轻重，因为我们不会坐等其他帝国接纳$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$的。
entries.en: It matters not; we will not wait for others to embrace $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$.

entries.zh: $shroud.4145.desc_1.common_1$我们的遥邻很快就向我们发难。$shroud.4145.desc_1.common_2$
entries.en: $shroud.4145.desc_1.common_1$ Our distant neighbors are rapidly turning against us. $shroud.4145.desc_1.common_2$

entries.zh: $shroud.4145.desc_1.common_1$我们敌人的反感正变得越来越根深蒂固。$shroud.4145.desc_1.common_2$
entries.en: $shroud.4145.desc_1.common_1$ Our enemies' antipathy is becoming ever more entrenched. $shroud.4145.desc_1.common_2$

entries.zh: 受超主意愿的启发，我们发明了一种消耗能量和物质来充能光环的新方法。可以献祭这个宇宙的物质来推进终末。
entries.en: Inspired by our patron's will, we have devised new methods of expending energy and matter to fuel the Aura. The very stuff of the universe may be sacrificed to advance the End.
We must do all that is necessary.

entries.zh: 我们的超主无言而说。我们感受到了轮回终末的迫近，新的能量也随之在[This.GetName]中涌动。这种紧迫感鼓舞着我们。\n\n如果我们想令终末之意满足，所有[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就需要把一切力量集中到同一个方向上。我们必须显现超主的力量，将祂的光环延伸到星系的最远处。
entries.en: Our patron speaks silently. As we sense the imminence of cycle's end, renewed energy surges throughout the [This.GetName]. We are invigorated with urgency.\n\nIf we wish to satisfy the will of the End, the collective energy of all [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] must be applied toward one purpose. We must manifest our patron's power, and complete the spread of its Aura to the furthest reaches of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们正在召集精英灵能使集会，准备向§H虚境§!深处进军，与其中力量庞大的势力交流。
entries.en: We are gathering a convocation of elite telepaths, ready to reach deep into the §HShroud§! and commune with a force of immense power.

entries.zh: 我们正在召集专职的灵能使子个体，准备向§H虚境§!深处进军，与其中力量庞大的势力交流。
entries.en: We are gathering a convocation of dedicated telepath drones, ready to reach deep into the §HShroud§! and commune with a force of immense power.

entries.zh: 我们正在召集高通量灵能单元，准备向§H虚境§!深处进军，与其中力量庞大的势力交流。
entries.en: We are gathering a convocation of high-capacity telepath units, ready to reach deep into the §HShroud§! and commune with a force of immense power.

entries.zh: 在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为§H[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]§!。
entries.en: Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the §H[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]§!.

entries.zh: 在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为§H[Root.Patron:the_cradle_of_souls.GetPreCommunicationName]§!。
entries.en: Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the §H[Root.Patron:the_cradle_of_souls.GetPreCommunicationName]§!.

entries.zh: 在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为§H[Root.Patron:the_composer_of_strands.GetPreCommunicationName]§!。
entries.en: Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the §H[Root.Patron:the_composer_of_strands.GetPreCommunicationName]§!.

entries.zh: 在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为§H[Root.Patron:the_instrument_of_desire.GetPreCommunicationName]§!。
entries.en: Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the §H[Root.Patron:the_instrument_of_desire.GetPreCommunicationName]§!.

entries.zh: 一切转瞬即逝。\n\n在我们国土内邪恶的§R$end_aura$§!突然消失了，将一切也随之带走。恒星坍缩成黑洞，行星原地蒸发，只剩下震耳欲聋的寂静。
entries.en: In an instant, it was all gone.\n\nThe malevolent §R$end_aura$§! present in our systems has suddenly vanished, taking everything with it. Entire stars have collapsed into black holes, planets have disappeared, and a great silence has been left in their stead.

entries.zh: 究竟是什么疯子激起了这种毁灭性的力量也许永远不得而知了。
entries.en: Whatever madness invoked such destructive power may be forever unknown.

entries.zh: $shroud.11225.desc.common_1$似乎我们抗击光环的努力起到了一些缓和作用，尽可能保留了一点。\n\n$shroud.11225.desc.common_2$
entries.en: $shroud.11225.desc.common_1$ It seems our efforts to repel the aura have had some mitigating effects, preserving what little we could.\n\n$shroud.11225.desc.common_2$

entries.zh: $whisperers_in_the_void_color_article_cap$渴求超越平凡思维局限的知识。给予我们[Owner.GetResearchers]们广泛的授权，专注于深奥的研究领域，就可以寻求满足低语的渴望。
entries.en: $whisperers_in_the_void_color_article_cap$ yearn for knowledge beyond the limits of conventional thinking. By giving our [Owner.GetResearchers] a broad mandate to focus on esoteric areas of study, we can seek to satisfy the Whisperers' ardor.

entries.zh: 整个星系受到了一个具有无比强大力量的实体的威胁，它被称为§R$NAME_Reckoning$§!。它由纯能量构成，突然显现以来开始了一趟破坏之旅。\n\n所有数据都表明该物体与我们之前见过的一切事物都截然不同。如果我们想应对这个威胁，就必须进行紧急研究来弄明白到底应该如何与之一战。
entries.en: The galaxy is under threat from an immensely powerful entity known as the §R$NAME_Reckoning$§!. Composed of pure energy, it materialized suddenly and began a campaign of destruction.\n\nAll available data indicate that this being is an opponent unlike anything we have faced before. If we wish to confront this threat, we should execute emergency research to determine more effective methods of engagement.

entries.zh:
我们的[GetScientistPlural]完成了对称为§R$NAME_Reckoning$§!的强大实体的全面研究。

基于目前发现，我们确定出了以现有科技面对该敌手的方法；用于击穿能量护盾的武器稍加改造即可用于削弱构成$NAME_Reckoning$的能量。

尽管它非常强大，但我们现在面对该威胁时也不是毫无希望了。
entries.en:
Our [GetScientistPlural] have completed thorough research on the powerful entity known as the §R$NAME_Reckoning$§!.

Based on their findings, we have determined an effective method of confronting this foe with our existing technology; the energy that comprises the $NAME_Reckoning$ can be degraded using a modified form of weaponry designed to pierce energy shields.

Though it is formidable, we now stand a better chance of engaging this threat.

entries.zh: 尽管我们没能成功，但直面§R$NAME_Reckoning$§!也给我们的研究带来了宝贵的数据。\n\n将研究精力投入到该神秘能量生物上，我们就能找到它的弱点，从而发展出更有效的攻击手段。
entries.en: Though we did not succeed, our confrontation with the §R$NAME_Reckoning$§! provided invaluable data for study.\n\nBy dedicating research to this mysterious energy being, we can identify its vulnerabilities, and thereby develop more effective methods of attack.

entries.zh: §R$NAME_Reckoning$§!拥有我们舰队远不能敌的强大力量。尽管我们战败了，与这个神秘的能量生物交锋也产出了宝贵的数据——这些一手资料只能通过直接接触获得。\n\n初步分析表明，我们已经获得了足够用于对该实体的构成进行建模的数据点。通过进一步研究，我们就能尝试分析出它的弱点，据此来改进我的进攻方式。
entries.en: The §R$NAME_Reckoning$§! is a force greater than our fleets could overcome. Despite our defeat, the confrontation yielded significant data about this mysterious energy being - information that we could not have gained without direct contact.\n\nPreliminary analysis indicates that we have gathered enough data points to model the entity's composition. With further research, we can try to identify its vulnerabilities and hone our attacks accordingly.

entries.zh: 在研究被称为§R$NAME_Reckoning$§!的实体的过程中我们的[GetScientistPlural]取得了突破。
entries.en: Our [GetScientistPlural] have made a breakthrough in their research concerning the energy being known as the §R$NAME_Reckoning$§!.
This entity not only emerged from

entries.zh: 使用具有“灵能抑制”性的一种激光，我们的舰队就能打破链接，从而能够直接攻击其物理形式。
entries.en: Using a class of lasers that have 'psi-suppressive' properties, our fleets can disrupt this connection, leaving its physical form vulnerable to attack.

entries.zh: $shroud.11245.desc.2.intro$从§H虚境§!中显现而来，更通过与灵能界之间维持跨维度链接来维系其防御能力。$shroud.11245.desc.2.outro$
entries.en: $shroud.11245.desc.2.intro$ the §HShroud§!, but maintains its defensive power via a transdimensional link to the psionic realm. $shroud.11245.desc.2.outro$

entries.zh: $shroud.11245.desc.2.intro$来自另一个维度，更通过维持神秘的跨维度链接来维系其防御能力。$shroud.11245.desc.2.outro$
entries.en: $shroud.11245.desc.2.intro$ another dimension of reality, but maintains its defensive power via a mysterious transdimensional link. $shroud.11245.desc.2.outro$

entries.zh: 通过进行深入的研究，我们找到了一种对现有武器进行改造就能伤到$NAME_Reckoning$的方法。
entries.en: By conducting extensive research, we have determined an effective method for damaging the $NAME_Reckoning$ using a modified form of our existing weaponry.

entries.zh: 使用此前与最终清算的遭遇获得的数据，我们发现了一种利用“灵能抑制”激光对其造成更有效伤害的方法。
entries.en: Using data from our previous encounter with the Reckoning, we have discovered a means to inflict greater damage with the help of 'psi-suppressive' lasers.

entries.zh: 我们再也不会接受这样的提议了。
entries.en: We will never invite an offer like this again.
We will forge our own path.

entries.zh: §R警告：从此以后我们再也无法与任何超主签订契约。§!
entries.en: §RWarning: We will not be able to establish a Covenant with any Patron from this point on.§!

entries.zh: 解锁超主的§Y$ACTIVE_ACCORDS$§!，在冷却时间过后可以激活产生增益效果。
entries.en: Unlock this Patron's §Y$ACTIVE_ACCORDS$§!, which can be activated for beneficial effects after a cooldown.

entries.zh: 一接触到虚境时，我们便感觉到一个骚动的实体透出永不满足的饥饿。
entries.en: As we reach out into the Shroud, we sense the insatiable hunger of a brooding entity.

entries.zh: $shroud.4500.desc.1$$utopia.3306.desc.2$\n\n祂的急切是如此咄咄逼人。我们的心智真的能够去接受这样一个怪物吗？
entries.en: $shroud.4500.desc.1$$utopia.3306.desc.2$\n\nIts impatience is threatening. Could our minds ever embrace such a monster?

entries.zh: 完成了。我们与$the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$签订了契约。祂的意志将会贯彻到整个§H[Root.GetName]§!。
entries.en: It is done. We have formed a Covenant with $the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$. Its will courses through the §H[Root.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 随着我们纽带的建立，喰煞索要走了贡品：我们一座城市的全部人口突然消失了。这个代价并不大——除非喰煞还会饿。
entries.en: As we formed our bond, the Eater claimed its tribute: the entire population of one of our cities suddenly disappeared. A small price to pay - unless the Eater gets hungry again.

entries.zh:
$shroud.4505.desc.intro$

我们社会的变化已经可以观测。我们的军事单元无比专注于战斗；在和平时期，他们也必须坚持进行严苛战斗模拟，否则将出现非必要进攻性。

$shroud.4505.desc.outro$
entries.en:
$shroud.4505.desc.intro$

Changes in our society are already detectable. Our military units are ever more focused on battle; in peacetime, they must be kept engaged in taxing combat simulations, lest their restlessness turn to savagery.

$shroud.4505.desc.outro$

entries.zh: 我们的社会已经开始发生变化。我们的思想与战争的欲望相冲突。这种认知失调在素来和平的人群中引起了极大的不适。我们选择对了吗？
entries.en: Changes in our society are already emerging. Our minds are in conflict with a taste for battle. This cognitive dissonance is causing great discomfort among our normally peaceful population. Have we made the right choice?

entries.zh: 我们社会的变化已经可以观测。我们的军事单元无比专注于战斗；在和平时期，他们也必须坚持进行严苛战斗模拟，否则将出现非必要进攻性。
entries.en: Changes in our society are already apparent. Our military personnel are ever hungrier for battle; in peacetime, they must be kept engaged in strenuous training, lest their restlessness turn to savagery.
