entries.en: Changes in our society are already detectable. Our military [GetIndividualNamePlural] are ever more focused on battle; in peacetime, they must be kept engaged in taxing combat simulations, lest they turn to needless aggression.
Some time has passed since we established the foundation of a Covenant with the

entries.zh: 签订契约以来又过了些许时日。我们之间联系的纽带仍旧脆弱，因此仍有将其打破亦或是增强的机会。\n\n我们的[GetTelepathPlural]确定，有了这一正式承诺就能主动地利用超主所提供的力量，增强我们的舰队和$PSIONIC_AURA$。
entries.en: . Our bond is still weak, so we still have a chance to break it - or to strengthen it.\n\nOur [GetTelepathPlural] have determined that confirming the pledge will allow us to actively draw on powers provided by our patron, as well as providing enhancements to our fleets and $PSIONIC_AURA$.

entries.zh: 我们与一位名为$the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着贪婪的感觉，它索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。\n\n我们的[GetTelepathPlural]总结道，如果与我们的超主保持一致，这条纽带可以被加强。
entries.en: We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named $the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$. Insatiable, it grants us crumbs of its power for a price.\n\nOur [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

entries.zh: $shroud_eater_covenant_chain_desc.intro$\n\n喰煞无厌而饥渴。祂渴望战争、以及冲突和哀嚎的甜美。
entries.en: $shroud_eater_covenant_chain_desc.intro$\n\nThe Eater hungers impatiently. It craves war, the sweet taste of strife and lament.

entries.zh: $shroud_eater_covenant_chain_desc.intro$\n\n喰煞无厌而饥渴。祂渴望战争、以及烈火和废墟的甜美。
entries.en: $shroud_eater_covenant_chain_desc.intro$\n\nThe Eater hungers impatiently. It craves war, the sweet taste of fire and ruin.

entries.zh:
我们刚一跃入虚境，一个存在就主动找了上来。祂的思想在我们[GetTelepathPlural]的意识中纠结缠绕，软磨硬泡，讨价还价。这是$the_instrument_of_desire_color_article$，祂将赐予我们财富、力量、威望……一切我们渴望的事物。一切我们将渴望的事物。

代价？小意思，不过是一笔服务费。祂一心为我们好，祂将帮助我们、指导我们，引导我们的野心和梦想。

§H只要我们将祂纳入我们的心灵。§!

它很确信我们会答应，我们怎么可能会不答应呢？
entries.en:
As soon as we plunge into the Shroud, a presence reaches out for us. Its thoughts coil and twist themselves around the minds of our [GetTelepathPlural], bargaining, cajoling. It is $the_instrument_of_desire_color_article$ and it will grant us wealth, power, prestige... all that we have ever desired. All that we will ever desire.

The cost? A small matter, little more than a cover fee. It only wants what is best for us. It will help us, guide us, direct our ambitions and dreams.

§HIf we will only accept it into our hearts.§!

It is confident that we will say yes. How could we possibly not say yes?

entries.en:
As soon as we plunge into the Shroud, a presence reaches out for us. Its thoughts coil and twist themselves around the circuits of our [GetTelepathPlural], bargaining, cajoling. It is $the_instrument_of_desire_color_article$ and it will grant us wealth, power, prestige... all that we have ever desired. All that we will ever desire.

The cost? A small matter, little more than a cover fee. It only wants what is best for us. It will help us, guide us, direct our ambitions and dreams.

§HIf we will only accept it into our mainframes.§!

It is confident that we will say yes. How could we possibly not say yes?

entries.zh: 完成了。我们与$the_instrument_of_desire_color_article$签订了契约。祂的意志将会贯彻到整个§H[Root.GetName]§!。
entries.en: It is done. We have formed a Covenant with $the_instrument_of_desire_color_article$. Its will courses through the §H[Root.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 这就是我们纽带的代价。据[GetTelepathPlural]称，器具最强的庇佑还没到来。
entries.en: Such is the price of our bond. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the Instrument's greatest blessings are yet to come.

entries.zh:
$shroud.4555.desc.intro$

这笔买卖的代价很明显了。我们等待着繁荣富饶的黄金时代到来，大众也不再满足于生存的必须。[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在渴望各种各样的物质财富——这是我们新的经济负担。

$shroud.4555.desc.outro$
entries.en:
$shroud.4555.desc.intro$

The cost of the bargain is already apparent. As we await the promised golden age of wealth and prosperity, the populace is no longer satisfied by the bare necessities of existence. [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] now crave all manner of material goods - a new burden on our economy.

$shroud.4555.desc.outro$

entries.zh:
$shroud.4555.desc.intro$

这笔买卖的代价已经可见了。我们等待着无上产出的黄金时代到来，子个体的基础需求也提高了。各地的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始需要各种各样非必要物资——这是我们的一个新的经济负担。

$shroud.4555.desc.outro$
entries.en:
$shroud.4555.desc.intro$

The cost of the bargain is already detectable. As we await the promised golden age of matchless output, the basic necessities of our drones have increased. [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] everywhere now require a range of inessential goods - a new burden on our economy.

$shroud.4555.desc.outro$
Let us hope they are right.

entries.zh: 我们与一个名为§H渴求之器具§!的虚境实体建立了纽带。祂索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。这样的交换应该还会有更多。\n\n我们的[GetTelepathPlural]推论，只看我们的行为与超主的意志相调和，这条纽带就会进一步加强。
entries.en: We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the §HInstrument of Desire§!. Pampering, it grants us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.\n\nOur [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

entries.zh: $shroud_instrument_covenant_chain_desc.intro$\n\n器具渴求着渴求本身。沉溺享乐、腐化和奴役便是器具的别名。
entries.en: $shroud_instrument_covenant_chain_desc.intro$\n\nThe Instrument longs for yearning. Indulged pleasures, decadence, and slavery spell the name of the Instrument.

entries.zh: $shroud_instrument_covenant_chain_desc.intro$\n\n器具渴求着渴求本身。无拘束地消耗、利用和奴役便是器具的别名。
entries.en: $shroud_instrument_covenant_chain_desc.intro$\n\nThe Instrument longs for yearning. Unbridled consumption, exploitation, and slavery spell the name of the Instrument.

entries.zh:
随着我们沉入虚境，一个存在开始炙烤我们的内心幻景。弥漫的光芒笼罩了一切。这是$the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$正在灼烧着我们的内心。

它要求的不只是星系尺度的妥协、劣等异种之间的卑鄙和平。祂向我们许诺伟大的力量，只要我们肯接受这种可憎的愿景。

§H只要我们任其塑造新的视野。§!

月窠的光芒不屈不挠，祂的力量不可抵抗。
entries.en:
As we sink into the Shroud, a presence sears our inner vision. The pervading glow obscures all else. It is $the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$ and it burns within our core.

It demands no less than compromise on a galactic scale, an abject peace of incompatible beings. Great power awaits us, it promises, if we accept this detestable vision.

§HIf only we will let it shape new horizons.§!

The Cradle's light is relentless, and its power is undeniable. Could our minds ever embrace such a thing? Will it weaken our resolve?

entries.zh:
随着我们的心智沉入虚境，一个存在在我们的内心开始绽放。我们感受到了它的光芒点亮了一切，释放出秩序和平衡。这是$the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$，正在触动着我们的最深处。

祂想要的不仅仅是持久的和平——而是让星系摆脱混沌。如果我们共享祂的愿景，就可以使我们成为和谐的使者。祂承诺了牢不可破的信任。

§H只要我们任其塑造新的视野。§!

月窠的期望重重地落在我们身上。
entries.en:
As our minds sink into the Shroud, a presence blooms within us. We sense a glow that touches all things, radiating order and balance. It is $the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$ and it stirs us to our core.

It wants no less than enduring peace - a galaxy cured of its chaos. If we share its vision, it can forge us into bringers of harmony. It promises a bond of unbreakable trust.

§HIf only we will let it shape our horizons.§!

The hopes of the Cradle press upon us.

entries.zh: 完成了。我们与$the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$签订了契约。祂的意志将会贯彻到整个§H[Root.GetName]§!。
entries.en: It is done. We have formed a Covenant with $the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$. Its will courses through the §H[Root.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 对[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]心灵的影响已经无可否认。许多[Root.GetIndividualPlural]的思想被所谓的星系和平所荼毒，在我们社会中产生了深刻的认知失调。\n\n据我们的[GetTelepathPlural]称，交易的庇佑还没到来。而我们必须忍受这种可怕的思想冲突的困扰直到它到来为止。我们究竟对自己做了什么？
entries.en: The impact on the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] psyche is already undeniable. The minds of many [Root.GetIndividualPlural] are poisoned by thoughts of galactic peace, causing profound dissonance throughout our society.\n\nAccording to our [GetTelepathPlural], the blessings of this bargain are yet to come. Until that time, a terrible conflict plagues our minds. What is it that we have done to ourselves?

entries.zh: 对[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]心灵的影响已经可以探测。由于我们以全星系的和平关系为目标，任何与邻国的不友好都会对集体意识产生干扰。\n\n这种小干扰就是我们建立纽带的代价。据我们的[GetTelepathPlural]称，月窠最强的庇佑还没到来。
entries.en: The impact on the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] psyche is already detectable. As we aim for peaceful relations throughout the galaxy, any discord with our neighbors causes disturbance in the collective consciousness.\n\nThis small disturbance is the price of our bond. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the Cradle's greatest blessings are yet to come.

entries.zh: 对[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]心灵的影响已经显而易见。由于我们以全星系的和平关系为目标，任何与邻国的不友好都会对大众造成痛苦。\n\n这种小干扰就是我们建立纽带的代价。据我们的[GetTelepathPlural]称，月窠最强的庇佑还没到来。
entries.en: The impact on the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] psyche is already apparent. As we yearn for peaceful relations throughout the galaxy, any discord with our neighbors causes distress throughout the populace.\n\nThis small disturbance is the price of our bond. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the Cradle's greatest blessings are yet to come.
Let us hope they are right.
For now, we can only endure.

entries.zh:
我们与一位名为$the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着和谐的感觉，它索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]总结道，如果与我们的超主保持一致，这条纽带可以被加强。

月窠渴求着星系摆脱混沌和冲突，所有住民都致力于实现同一个和平。只有完美的平衡才足够。
entries.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named $the_cradle_of_souls_color_article$. Harmonious, it grants us crumbs of power for a price.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

The Cradle aches for a galaxy free from chaos and conflict, with all its denizens bent towards the unifying goal of peace. Only perfect balance will suffice.

entries.zh:
一个存在在虚境中等待着，亲切地欢迎我们。祂不费言辞，而是以幻景、概念和想法来表达。祂滑入我们[GetTelepathPlural]的思维中，温柔而丝滑，宛如一开始便在一般。一连串的画面在他们面前闪过。

这个存在即是$the_composer_of_strands_color_article$，祂认为我们的有机形态具有有趣的性质。祂展示了许多我们的身躯可以加以生长、变化、改进、演化的方向。

§H只要我们愿意将其纳入肉身。§!

祂耐心而亲切地等待着回答，就像温柔的父母等待着最亲爱的孩子一般。
entries.en:
A presence awaits us in the Shroud, welcoming us with genial familiarity. It speaks not so much in words but in visions, concepts, ideas. It seeps into the minds of our [GetTelepathPlural], so gently and smoothly that one might think it had always been there. A flurry of images flash before them.

This presence, $the_composer_of_strands_color_article$, regards our organic forms with curious interest. It shows us a variety of ways in which they can be grown, changed. Improved. Evolved.

§HIf we will only take it into our flesh.§!

It waits for our answer patiently, affectionately. Like a doting parent waiting on their favorite child.

entries.zh:
一个存在在虚境中等待着，亲切地欢迎我们。祂不费言辞，而是以幻景、概念和想法来表达。祂滑入我们[GetTelepathPlural]的回路中，温柔而丝滑，宛如一开始便在一般。一连串的画面在他们面前闪过。

这个存在即是$the_composer_of_strands_color_article$，祂认为我们的有机形态具有有趣的性质。祂展示了许多我们的身躯可以加以适应、变化、改进、演化的方向。

§H只要我们愿意将其纳入组成。§!

祂耐心而亲切地等待着回答，就像温柔的父母等待着最亲爱的孩子一般。
entries.en:
A presence awaits us in the Shroud, welcoming us with genial familiarity. It speaks not so much in words but in visions, concepts, ideas. It seeps into the circuits of our [GetTelepathPlural], so gently and smoothly that one might think it had always been there. A flurry of images flash before them.

This presence, $the_composer_of_strands_color_article$, regards our mechanical forms with curious interest. It shows us a variety of ways in which they can be adapted, changed. Improved. Upgraded.

§HIf we will only take it into our components.§!

It waits for our answer patiently, affectionately. Like a doting parent waiting on their favorite child.

entries.zh: 完成了。我们与$the_composer_of_strands_color_article$签订了契约。祂的意志将会贯彻到整个§H[Root.GetName]§!。
entries.en: It is done. We have formed a Covenant with $the_composer_of_strands_color_article$. Its will courses through the §H[Root.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 很显然我们放弃了一些[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]形体的控制，我们的超主现在可以随意将其改变。\n\n这种小小的牺牲就是我们新结纽带的代价。据[GetTelepathPlural]称，织缕最强的庇佑还没到来。
entries.en: It is clear that we have relinquished some control over the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] form, which our patron is now free to change at will.\n\nThis is a small sacrifice for our newfound bond. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the Composer's greatest blessings are yet to come.

entries.zh: $shroud.4655.desc.intro$\n\n我们的[GetScientistPlural]在[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的测试样本中检测到了基因结构的异常模式，简直像许多代的演化在一夜之间发生。$shroud.4655.desc.outro$
entries.en: $shroud.4655.desc.intro$\n\nOur [GetScientistPlural] have already detected anomalous patterns in the genetic structure of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] test samples, as though many generations of evolutionary change had occurred overnight. $shroud.4655.desc.outro$

entries.zh: $shroud.4655.desc.intro$\n\n我们的[GetScientistPlural]在[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的测试回路中检测到了分子结构的异常模式，简直像许多代的系统升级在一夜之间发生。$shroud.4655.desc.outro$
entries.en: $shroud.4655.desc.intro$\n\nOur [GetScientistPlural] have already detected anomalous patterns in the molecular structure of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] test circuits, as though many generations of system upgrades had occurred overnight. $shroud.4655.desc.outro$
Such is the cost of power.

entries.zh: 我们与一位名为$the_composer_of_strands_color_article$的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着荫蔽的感觉，祂索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。这样的交换应该还会有更多。\n\n我们的[GetTelepathPlural]推论，只看我们的行为与超主的意志相调和，这条纽带就会进一步加强。
entries.en: We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named $the_composer_of_strands_color_article$. Sheltering, it grants us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.\n\nOur [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be further deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

entries.zh: $shroud_composer_covenant_chain_desc.intro$\n\n织缕渴求基因操控和将血肉从进化的桎梏中解脱。祂教导我们对敬畏生命和自然，以及血肉的神圣性。
entries.en: $shroud_composer_covenant_chain_desc.intro$\n\nThe Composer yearns for genetic manipulations and flesh set free from the constraints of evolution. It tells us about respect for life and nature, and the sanctity of the flesh.

entries.zh: $shroud_composer_covenant_chain_desc.intro$\n\n织缕渴求物理形态的操控和让增长摆脱常规的桎梏。祂教导我们对敬畏生命和自然，以及血肉的神圣性。
entries.en: $shroud_composer_covenant_chain_desc.intro$\n\nThe Composer yearns for manipulations of the physical form, and growth set free from conventional restraints. It tells us about respect for life and nature, and the sanctity of the flesh.

entries.zh: 完成了。我们与$whisperers_in_the_void_color_article$签订了契约。祂的意志将会贯彻到整个§H[root.GetName]§!。\n\n新超主的影响出现得非常迅速。
entries.en: It is done. We have formed a Covenant with $whisperers_in_the_void_color_article$. Their will courses through the §H[root.GetName]§!.\n\nThe influence of our new patron has taken hold swiftly.

entries.zh: 这就是强大纽带的代价。据[GetTelepathPlural]称，低语最强的庇佑还没到来。我们与这种强大的灵能实体直接交流毫无疑问非常值得。
entries.en: Such is the price of this powerful bond. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the Whisperers' greatest blessings are yet to come. Our direct communion with such a magnificent psionic entity will surely have been worth it.

entries.zh: $shroud.4705.desc.intro$随着我们的集体等待着隐秘知识的汇入，我们感觉到了自己的思想分支成了不同的模式。[GetNetworkName]的稳态和谐被内心越来越不统一的声音所覆盖。\n\n$shroud.4705.desc.outro$
entries.en: $shroud.4705.desc.intro$ As our collective awaits an influx of hidden knowledge, we sense our thoughts splintering into divergent patterns. The steady harmony of the [GetNetworkName] is overlaid with a growing discord of inner voices.\n\n$shroud.4705.desc.outro$

entries.zh: $shroud.4705.desc.intro$随着我们的渴望着隐秘知识的汇入，我们社会中的理念和观点已经变得分歧重重。不和谐的声音损伤着心神，妨害了所有[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的精神健康。\n\n$shroud.4705.desc.outro$
entries.en: $shroud.4705.desc.intro$ As we thirst for hidden knowledge, the ideas and opinions within our society have grown more divergent. A discord of inner voices abrades our psyches, threatening the mental wellbeing of all [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].\n\n$shroud.4705.desc.outro$

entries.zh: 完成了。我们与$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$签订了契约。我们一达成交易，[GetTelepathPlural]便齐声说：§R“时日已到。”§!
entries.en: It is done. We have formed a Covenant with $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$. As we took its bargain, our [GetTelepathPlural] spoke again: §R\"THE END BEGINS.\"§!

entries.zh:
$shroud.4715.desc.intro$

接着就是寂静。深不可测的寂静，填满了所有[root.GetSpeciesAdj]的心智。曾经§H虚境§!的众多能量在我们的每一个意识中翻滚，而灵能界现在安静得像死去了一样。

我们不得不开始思考自己种下的恶果。
entries.en:
$shroud.4715.desc.intro$

Then, silence. Fathomless silence, filling the minds of all [root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind. Where once the multitudinous energies of the §HShroud§! roiled within our every consciousness, the psionic realm is now quiet as death.

We were left to contemplate the consequences of what we have brought upon ourselves.

entries.zh:
$shroud.4715.desc.intro$

接着就是寂静。深不可测的寂静，填满了所有[root.GetSpeciesAdj]的心智。曾经§H虚境§!的众多能量在[GetBrainName]之中翻滚，而灵能界现在静滞得如同不存在了一样。

我们不得不开始估算自己给自己带来的后果。
entries.en:
$shroud.4715.desc.intro$

Then, silence. Fathomless silence, filling the minds of all [root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind. Where once the multitudinous energies of the §HShroud§! roiled throughout the [GetBrainName], the psionic realm is now inert as nonbeing.

We were left to estimate the consequences of what we have brought upon ourselves.

entries.zh:
我们与一位名为$whisperers_in_the_void_color_article$的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着莫测的感觉，它索取一定代价承诺赐予我们零星力量。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]总结道，如果将我们的行为与超主保持一致，这条纽带将更容易被加强。

低语享受新的知识、沉默的秘密和阴谋。祂们陶醉于一种简单的快乐，这种快乐充满了头脑，在接缝处开裂。
entries.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named $whisperers_in_the_void_color_article$. Unfathomable, it promises to grant us crumbs of power for a price.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

The Whisperers enjoy new knowledge, silent secrets, and conspiracies. They revel in the simple joy of a mind filled to the brim, cracking at the seams.

entries.zh: §H低语§!尖锐地变化着，祂们的声音覆盖了脑海中的一切。祂们渴望与我们交流，向我们灌输知识。\n\n我们必须做出不可改变的选择。
entries.en: The §HWhisperers§! shift piercingly, their voices obscuring all else within our minds. They are eager to commune with us, to crowd our minds with knowledge.\n\nWe have an irrevocable choice to make.

entries.zh: 随着[GetTelepathPlural]们浮出§H虚境§!，我们发现自己的背叛引来了[GetBetrayedPatronColour]的强力反噬。\n\n§H[event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.GetName]§!附近出现了一道$SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$，而它现在也变成了一片无尽废墟的荒芜。我们在隧道的另一头[GetFeltLoc]到了显而易见的愤怒；前超主毫无疑问正在准备复仇。
entries.en: As our [GetTelepathPlural] emerged from the §HShroud§!, we discovered that our betrayal had caused a powerful backlash from [GetBetrayedPatronColour].\n\nA $SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$ has emerged near §H[event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.GetName]§!, which is now a world of endless wastes. We have [GetFeltLoc] a palpable fury beyond the tunnel; our former patron is no doubt preparing its revenge.

entries.zh: 我们必须做好自卫的准备。
entries.en: We must prepare to defend ourselves.

entries.zh: §H[event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.GetName]§!转变成了一颗§Y$pc_shrouded$§!。\n该行星附近出现了一个$SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$。
entries.en: §H[event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.GetName]§! turns into a §Y$pc_shrouded$§!.\nA $SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$ appears near this planet.

entries.zh: 一个§Y$NAME_Psionic_Avatar$§!从[event_target:spawn_system.GetName]恒星系的$SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$上出现。这是[GetBetrayedPatronColour]之怒的显化，现在正向[capital_scope.GetName]袭来。
entries.en: A §Y$NAME_Psionic_Avatar$§! has emerged from the $SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$ in the [event_target:spawn_system.GetName] system. A manifestation of the wrath of [GetBetrayedPatronColour], it is now traveling in the direction of [capital_scope.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们成功地召集了力量反击出现的威胁。我们的舰船向$SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$中放出灵能能量波，在敌意实体穿入本现实时削弱了它。
entries.en: We were successful in gathering our forces against the emerging threat. Our ships emitted waves of psionic energy into the $SHROUD_TUNNEL_GALACTIC$, weakening the hostile entity as it breached into our reality.

entries.zh:
我们陷入出神时，意识卡入了寂静。我们从未见过如此死寂的虚境。

虚空无声。

万物皆灭。
entries.en:
As we tilt into trance, our minds are struck with silence. We have never known the Shroud so still.

The void is voiceless.

Everything is gone.

entries.zh: 自从$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$带来毁灭之后，我们付出了巨大的努力进行重建。为此，我们在§H[solar_system.Star.GetStarName]§!系重建了一座§H$starbase_outpost$§!，这标志着[owner.GetName]的一个新的开始。
entries.en: We have made great efforts to recover since the destruction wrought by $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$. To this end, we have rebuilt an §H$starbase_outpost$§! in the §H[solar_system.Star.GetStarName]§! system, marking a new beginning for the [owner.GetName].

entries.zh: 自从$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$带来毁灭之后，我们付出了巨大的努力进行重建。在将幸存者集结于一艘仓促建造的方舟舰上之后，我们便启程，为[Root.GetName]缔造一个新的开始。
entries.en: We have made great efforts to recover since the destruction wrought by $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$. Gathering our survivors aboard a hastily assembled Arkship, we set out to forge a new beginning for the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 该领袖是一位拥有难以匹敌的灵能力量的永恒存在，能够将虚境按我们的意志进行塑造。
entries.en: This leader is an everlasting being that wields incredible psionic power, helping shape the Shroud to our own will.

entries.zh: 我们与$the_eater_of_worlds_article$的契约使我们对征服和摧毁变得欲壑难填。
entries.en: Our Covenant with $the_eater_of_worlds_article$ fills us with an insatiable appetite for conquest and destruction.

entries.zh: 我们与$the_cradle_of_souls_article$的契约照亮着全星系，潜移默化地使他人对我们温柔以待。
entries.en: Our Covenant with $the_cradle_of_souls_article$ radiates through the galaxy, influencing others to treat us warmly.

entries.zh: 在我方§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!范围内评价低于中立的帝国中的岗位维护费：§R+[GetCradleCovenantUpkeepMult]%§!
entries.en: Jobs Upkeep when an Empire within our §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§! has an opinion below Neutral: §R+[GetCradleCovenantUpkeepMult]%§!

entries.zh: 我们与$the_instrument_of_desire_article$的契约让我们的精神充盈着纵欲，引诱着我们深入心灵的极乐之境。
entries.en: Our Covenant with $the_instrument_of_desire_article$ saturates our minds with visions of indulgence, luring us deeper into a mental paradise.

entries.zh: 我们与$the_composer_of_strands_article$的契约生长在体内，却让我们的根扎遍全星系带去变化。
entries.en: Our Covenant with $the_composer_of_strands_article$ grows within us, spreading forth our roots to transform the galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们与$whisperers_in_the_void_article$的契约以其在虚境的核心领域日积月累的秘密智慧滴灌着我们。
entries.en: Our Covenant with $whisperers_in_the_void_article$ instills us with the accumulated wisdom of their acquired secrets from the centermost domains in the Shroud.

entries.zh: $the_eater_of_worlds_article_cap$在我们的军队中点燃了狂怒。
entries.en: $the_eater_of_worlds_article_cap$ kindles a frenzied rage within our forces.

entries.zh: 我们将向仇敌释放$the_eater_of_worlds_article$的毁灭之意。
entries.en: We will unleash the destructive will of $the_eater_of_worlds_article$ upon our enemies.

entries.zh:
显昭§Y$Name_Doom_Eater_Fleet$§!舰队。

该舰队的强度与§Y末日强度§!成正比。
当前末日强度：§Y[GetEaterOfWorldsDoomIntensity]/50§!

可用舰级：[GetEaterOfWorldsShipClasses]

§R现存所有§Y$Name_Doom_Eater_Fleet$§!将会被解散。§!
entries.en:
Manifests the §Y$Name_Doom_Eater_Fleet$§! fleet.

The strength of this fleet scales with §YDoom Intensity§!.
Current Doom Intensity: §Y[GetEaterOfWorldsDoomIntensity]/50§!

Avaliable Ship Classes: [GetEaterOfWorldsShipClasses]

§RAny existing §Y$Name_Doom_Eater_Fleet$§! fleet will be dismissed.§!
The limitless appetite of $the_eater_of_worlds_article$ must be sated.

entries.zh: 我方§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!内的敌对行星增加§Y$DEVASTATION$§!：§G+$@accord_digest_devastation|0$§!\n我方§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!内的敌对舰船损失§Y$HULL$§!和§Y$ARMOR$§!：§G$@accord_digest_ship_malus|0%$§!\n$ACCORD_LOOSE_INTENSITY$
entries.en: §Y$DEVASTATION$§! on war opponents' planets within our §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!: §G+$@accord_digest_devastation|0$§!\n§Y$HULL$§! and §Y$ARMOR$§! of war opponents' ships within our §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!: §G$@accord_digest_ship_malus|0%$§!\n$ACCORD_LOOSE_INTENSITY$

entries.zh: $the_cradle_of_souls_article$富有感染力的仁慈拉近了我们对他人的信任。
entries.en: The infectious charity of $the_cradle_of_souls_article$ pulls others closer to our trust.

entries.zh: $the_cradle_of_souls_article_cap$以万口共言，而如今我们与之共声。
entries.en: $the_cradle_of_souls_article_cap$ speaks with many mouths, and we now share its voice.
$the_cradle_of_souls_article_cap$ measures diplomacy with a heavy power of worth.

entries.zh: 消耗我们§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!范围内的帝国的所有外交支持，并获得相应的凝聚力和影响力。\n$ACCORD_LOOSE_INTENSITY$
entries.en: Consume all Favors from other empires within our §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§! and gain Unity and Influence for each.\n$ACCORD_LOOSE_INTENSITY$
$the_composer_of_strands_article_cap$ bears fruit, and we yet seed.

entries.zh: 在境内一颗随机的非宜居星球转变为一颗§G$@accord_transformation_gaia_world_size|0$§!规模的§H$pc_gaia$§!。
entries.en: A random uninhabitable world within our borders is transformed into a size §G$@accord_transformation_gaia_world_size|0$§! §H$pc_gaia$§!.

entries.zh: 我们的一艘§H方舟舰§!已臻至完美，化为生命繁茂的理想乐土。
entries.en: One of our §HArkships§! is perfected into an ideal environment for life to flourish.

entries.zh: §R要求境内存在一颗不宜居星球§!
entries.en: §RRequires an uninhabitable world within our borders§!

entries.zh: §R要求拥有一艘尚未完美升级的§H方舟舰§!§!
entries.en: §RRequires an §HArkship§! that has not yet been perfected§!
The will of $the_composer_of_strands_article$ blossoms in our presence.

entries.zh: 我们§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!覆盖下的所有殖民地增加$@accord_generation_pop_gain|0$主体物种£pop£§Y人口§!\n$ACCORD_LOOSE_INTENSITY$
entries.en: $@accord_generation_pop_gain|0$ £pop£ §YPop§! from our main species are added to all colonies within our §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!\n$ACCORD_LOOSE_INTENSITY$

entries.zh: $the_instrument_of_desire_article_cap$让我们沉溺于腻味的幸福中。
entries.en: $the_instrument_of_desire_article_cap$ saturates us with a cloying bliss.
The prosperity of $the_instrument_of_desire_article$ is held by no worldly limitations.

entries.zh: 免除下次§Y行星飞升§!的花费。
entries.en: Remove the cost from our next §YPlanetary Ascension§!.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R上次激活以来还未飞升过行星§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RHaven't ascended a planet since last activation§!

entries.zh: $the_instrument_of_desire_article_cap$渴望的不只是足够；祂渴望着产出大大过量。
entries.en: $the_instrument_of_desire_article_cap$ yearns for more than needs met; it longs for output in overabundance.

entries.zh: §H$@accord_duration|0$§!年内所有殖民地的每$pop_group_unit$$job_entertainer_name_plural_with_icon$提升所有岗位产出的资源：§G+$@accord_exploitation_resources_from_jobs|0%$§!\n$ACCORD_LOOSE_INTENSITY$
entries.en: Resources from Jobs per $pop_group_unit$ $job_entertainer_name_plural_with_icon$ in all owned colonies for §H$@accord_duration|0$§! years: §G+$@accord_exploitation_resources_from_jobs|0%$§!\n$ACCORD_LOOSE_INTENSITY$

entries.zh: $whisperers_in_the_void_article_cap$与我们共享不可告人的秘密。
entries.en: $whisperers_in_the_void_article_cap$ share their hushed secrets with us.

entries.zh: $whisperers_in_the_void_article_cap$饱含着虚境每一个领域的知识。
entries.en: $whisperers_in_the_void_article_cap$ contain the knowledge of all domains within the Shroud.
Add §G$@foresight_tech_progression|0%$§! progress to currently researched Technologies

entries.zh: $whisperers_in_the_void_article_cap$知道陌生时空的世界法典。我们只需要翻开其中一页。
entries.en: $whisperers_in_the_void_article_cap$ hold a codex of worlds from times and spaces unknowable to us. We need only turn one of its pages.

entries.zh: 选择你的§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!覆盖下的一个殖民地，使其变成§H遗落星球§!且移除所有障碍。\n$ACCORD_LOOSE_INTENSITY$
entries.en: Choose a colony you own inside of your §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!, it becomes a §HRelic World§! with all blockers removed.\n$ACCORD_LOOSE_INTENSITY$

entries.zh: 选择一艘位于§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!之内的方舟舰，令其获得§H$d_relic_arkship$§!。\n$ACCORD_LOOSE_INTENSITY$
entries.en: Choose an Arkship you own inside of your §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!, it gains §H$d_relic_arkship$§!.\n$ACCORD_LOOSE_INTENSITY$

entries.zh: $end_aura$将我们物理现实的一部分扭进了虚境中，产生向外螺旋放射的可用体积。一旦这些射线建立起来，它们就会一直存在，直到终末到来。
entries.en: The $end_aura$ twists portions of our physical reality into the Shroud, granting unexplored volumes with which to spiral outward. Once these threads are established, they remain in place until the End arrives.

entries.zh: 在这些消沉的岁月里，$end_of_the_cycle_article$对本现实越抓越牢。来自其他维度的整颗星球都可能被带到这里，而更多的则会被喂给无可逃避的虚无。
entries.en: In these waning years, $end_of_the_cycle_article$'s grip on this reality strengthens. Whole worlds from other dimensions can be brought into this one, feeding even more into inevitable nothingness.

entries.zh: 在£system£§Y首都星系§!中创造一颗拥有§H1000§!£pop£§Y$POPS$§!的§H$pc_gaia$§!。
entries.en: Create a §H$pc_gaia$§! with §H1000§! £pop£ §Y$POPS$§! in our £system£ §YCapital System§!.

entries.zh: 在我们§H首都方舟§!所在£system£恒星系中创造一艘全新的拥有§H1000§!£pop£§Y$POPS$§!的§H方舟舰§!
entries.en: Materialize a new §HArkship§! with §H1000§! £pop£ §Y$POPS$§! in the £system£ system of our §HCapital Arkship§!.

entries.zh: $end_of_the_cycle_article_cap$的影响力扭曲了时空本身的织构，打开了一条新散播意志的通路。
entries.en: $end_of_the_cycle_article_cap$'s influence warps the very fabric of space and time, opening new pathways with which to spread its will.

entries.zh: 我方舰队在未来的§H$@distortion_accord_duration|0$§!年内可以超空间跳跃到两倍距离而不受负面效应影响。
entries.en: Our fleets can Hyper Jump at twice the range without suffering negative effects for the next §H$@distortion_accord_duration|0$§! years.

entries.zh: 一切抵抗在$end_aura$面前都是螳臂当车。强大意志涌动之处，终焉之路已为万物开启！
entries.en: Nothing can stifle the inevitability of the $end_aura$. With great surge of will, the path to oblivion is laid open for all!

entries.zh: 提升§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!强度§G+50§!并禁用星系内所有§H$SHROUD_SEAL_PLURAL$§!3年。
entries.en: Increase §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§! Intensity gains by §G+50§! and disable all §H$SHROUD_SEAL_PLURAL$§! in the galaxy for 3 years.

entries.zh: 终焉永远不会被填满，但它的大口永远敞开。
entries.en: Oblivion can never be sated, but its maw lies ever open.

entries.zh: 献祭生命会使$end_of_the_cycle_article$满足一段时间。无可避免之事就是无可避免，充其量只能延后。
entries.en: The sacrifice of life will appease $end_of_the_cycle_article$ for a time. What is inevitable can only be delayed, never averted.

entries.zh: 各殖民地£pop£人口死亡：§R$@extermination_pop_loss|0$§!\n§Y$situation_end_of_the_cycle$§!§H局势§!进展：§G-120§!
entries.en: £pop£ Pops killed throughout owned colonies: §R$@extermination_pop_loss|0$§!\n§Y$situation_end_of_the_cycle$§! §HSituation§! Progress: §G-120§!

entries.zh: 家园只是暂栖，$end_of_the_cycle_article$的青睐才是永恒。无可躲避的虚无暴露了生命的多余。
entries.en: Homes are temporary; the favor of $end_of_the_cycle_article$ is eternal. The inevitability of nothingness exposes the redundancy of life.

entries.zh: 所拥有的一个至少§Y$@destruction_planet_pop_min|0$§!£pop£§H人口§!的£colony£成为§H$pc_shrouded$§!。\n§Y$situation_end_of_the_cycle$§!§H局势§!进展：§G-180§!
entries.en: An owned £colony£ colony with at least §Y$@destruction_planet_pop_min|0$§! £pop£ §HPops§! becomes a §H$pc_shrouded$§!.\n§Y$situation_end_of_the_cycle$§! §HSituation§! Progress: §G-180§!

entries.zh: £trigger_no£§R拥有一个至少§Y$@destruction_planet_pop_min|0$§!£pop£§H人口§!的殖民地§!
无法理解终焉之必要性者应当以不可妥协之力加以启蒙。
entries.en: Those unable to see the necessity of oblivion shall be enlightened with uncompromising force.

entries.zh: 以['concept_total_war']§H宣战理由§!向所有非失落帝国宣战。\n§Y$situation_end_of_the_cycle$§!§H局势§!进展：§G-240§!
entries.en: Declares war with a ['concept_total_war'] §HCasus Belli§! against all non-Fallen Empires.\n§Y$situation_end_of_the_cycle$§! §HSituation§! Progress: §G-240§!
Intensity of our §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§! in all systems: §R$@accord_aura_intensity_loss|0$§!

entries.zh: 每$pop_group_unit$$job_entertainer_name_plural_with_icon$提升所有岗位产出的资源：§G+$@accord_exploitation_resources_from_jobs|0%$§!
§H飞升契约§!提供的免费§Y行星飞升§!
§R需要一个可以宣战的有效邻国§!
entries.en: §RRequires a valid neighboring empire with which we can declare war§!

entries.zh: §R需要我方当前的§Y$PSIONIC_AURA$§!能影响到一个正在交战的帝国§!
entries.en: §RRequires that our §Y$PSIONIC_AURA$§! is currently affecting an empire we are at war with§!

entries.zh: §R需要我方的§Y$PSIONIC_AURA$§!当前能影响到至少一个我方拥有的殖民地§!
entries.en: §RRequires that our §Y$PSIONIC_AURA$§! is currently affecting at least one of our owned colonies§!

entries.zh: §R需要我方的§Y$PSIONIC_AURA$§!当前能够影响到一艘还未链接至阿卡西记录的§H方舟舰§!§!
entries.en: §RRequires that our §Y$PSIONIC_AURA$§! is currently affecting an §HArkship§! that has not yet been linked to the Akashic Records§!

entries.zh: 受影响人口被献祭予$the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$，作为回报将赐予我们$i_zro$与$i_unity$。
entries.en: Affected Pops are offered in sacrifice to $the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$, which repays us in $i_zro$ and $i_unity$.

entries.zh: §L吞噬者渴望的不止于战斗。敌者的尸体是心仪的贡品。§!
entries.en: §LThe Eater craves more than conflict alone. The bodies of our enemies are fitting tribute.§!

entries.zh: 发动战争来填饱$the_eater_of_worlds_article$无尽的饥饿。
entries.en: War is waged to sate the endless hunger of $the_eater_of_worlds_article$.

entries.zh: 发动战争，清扫一切胆敢反对$end_of_the_cycle_article$者。
entries.en: War is waged until those who oppose $end_of_the_cycle_article$ are no more.

entries.zh: 发动战争，将$end_of_the_cycle_article$从这个星系清除出去。
entries.en: War is waged until $end_of_the_cycle_article$ is purged from the Galaxy.

entries.zh: $ENEMY$的§Y$PSIONIC_AURA$§!释放了一股负能量脉冲。我方影响范围内的殖民地与舰队遭到了破坏。\n—受损舰队：§Y$FLEETS$§!\n—受损殖民地：§Y$COLONIES$§!
entries.en: The §Y$PSIONIC_AURA$§! from $ENEMY$ have released a pulse of negative energy. Our colonies and fleets inside of its influence have taken damage.\n- Fleets damaged: §Y$FLEETS$§!\n- Colonies devastated: §Y$COLONIES$§!

entries.zh: 舰队不受§Y超空间跃迁§!后的负面效应影响。
entries.en: Fleets suffer no negative effects after a §YHyper Jump§!.

entries.zh: 摧毁所有遗落的舰船§Y残骸§!。

$the_eater_of_worlds_article$可以显灵到舰队武器之上，但完全不顾及其他舰船的安全。

§E$debris_destruction_name$
§!
entries.en:
The presence of $the_eater_of_worlds_article$ can be manifested into fleet weaponry itself, with no regard for the safety of the rest of the ship.

§E$debris_destruction_name$
§!

entries.zh: $the_eater_of_worlds_article$的饥饿驱使我们的舰队狂热地进行近距离作战。所有在大屠杀后仍能正常运作的舰船都归我们所有。\n\n
entries.en: The hunger of $the_eater_of_worlds_article$ drives our fleets into frenzied close quarter engagements. Whatever vessels remain functional in the aftermath of the carnage we claim as our own.\n\n

entries.zh: 圣所是专门用于同魂灵之月窠进行沟通的地方。[GetCradleSanctumDesc]
entries.en: The Sanctum is a place dedicated to communion with the Cradle. [GetCradleSanctumDesc]

entries.zh: 在这里，人们汇聚一堂，共同理解我们和平超主的异世之志。
entries.en: Here, minds meet to comprehend the foreign will of our peace-nurturing patron.

entries.zh: 在这里，人们汇聚一堂培植平静，塑造着跨星系合作。
entries.en: Here, calm is cultivated by the meeting of minds, fostering intragalactic cooperation.

entries.zh: $the_composer_of_strands_article$的花园，这些密林里长满了注入$zro_lower$的植被。
entries.en: Gardens of $the_composer_of_strands_article$, these dense forests are packed with $zro_lower$-infused vegetation.

entries.zh: 异常植被构成的浓密丛林，它们的正常生长周期中会分泌§H$zro_lower$§!。
entries.en: A dense thicket of unusual vegetation that secretes §H$zro_lower$§! as part of its normal growth cycle.

entries.zh: 一个灵能极乐的纵欲天堂。由心灵增强所带来的奇幻享受展现出了一个超然快乐的世界。
entries.en: An indulgent paradise of psionic bliss. Exotic pleasures enabled by psychic enhancements manifest a world of transcendent pleasure.

entries.zh: 可以将§Y$col_resort$§!升级为§Y$col_pleasure$§!，允许建造§H圣所§!以及['building:building_psi_corps']并提升§Y$i_trade_value$§!§G5%§!。\n解锁£building£§Y$BUILDING$§!：['building:building_instrument_sanctum']
entries.en: Gain the ability to upgrade a §Y$col_resort$§! to a §Y$col_pleasure$§!, allowing the building of §HSanctums§! and ['building:building_psi_corps'] and increasing §Y$i_trade_value$§! by §G5%§!.\nUnlock £building£ §Y$BUILDING$§!: ['building:building_instrument_sanctum']

entries.zh: 我们的[GetTelepathPlural]向超主祈求力量，祂慷慨回应。
entries.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural] called upon the power of our patron, and it responded with a bounty.

entries.zh: $shroud.4862.shared$$the_composer_of_strands_color_article_cap$将§H[From.GetName]§!转变成了一颗$pc_gaia$，使其成为[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的一片理想家园。
entries.en: $shroud.4862.shared$ $the_composer_of_strands_color_article_cap$ has transformed §H[From.GetName]§! into a $pc_gaia$, making it an ideal habitat for [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind.

entries.zh: $shroud.4862.shared$$the_composer_of_strands_color_article_cap$将§H[From.GetName]§!重塑为[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]繁茂生长的理想之境，那是一方与我们同航的乐土。
entries.en: $shroud.4862.shared$ $the_composer_of_strands_color_article_cap$ has reshaped §H[From.GetName]§! into an ideal environment for [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind to flourish, a paradise that sails onward with us.
The planet §H[From.GetName]§! has been transformed into a §H$pc_gaia$§!.

entries.zh: 方舟舰§H[From.GetName]§!已臻至完美，化为生命繁茂的理想乐土。
entries.en: The Arkship §H[From.GetName]§! has been perfected into an ideal environment for life to flourish.

entries.zh: 生命之织缕已将这艘方舟舰化为完美家园，令人们繁盛成长，舰上生活安适无忧。
entries.en: The Composer of Strands has perfected this Arkship into an ideal environment for its people to flourish, quickening their growth and easing life aboard.

entries.zh: 我们的[GetTelepathPlural]向超主祈求力量，祂呢喃着给出提案。$whisperers_in_the_void_color_article_cap$打算将我们的一个殖民地重塑成$pc_relic$；我们只需要做出决定即可。
entries.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural] called upon the power of our patron, and it murmurs with an offer. $whisperers_in_the_void_color_article_cap$ will reimagine one of our colonies as a $pc_relic$; we need only make our choice.

entries.zh: 我们的[GetTelepathPlural]向超主祈求力量，祂呢喃着给出提案。$whisperers_in_the_void_color_article_cap$将在阿卡西记录与我们的一艘方舟舰之间建立链接，低声地讲述出一切曾经存在或终将存在之物的记忆；我们只需要做出决定即可。
entries.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural] called upon the power of our patron, and it murmurs with an offer. $whisperers_in_the_void_color_article_cap$ will open a link between the Akashic Records and one of our Arkships, whispering memories of all that has ever been or ever will be; we need only make our choice.

entries.zh: 选中的殖民地转变为§H遗落星球§!，并清除所有障碍地块。
entries.en: The chosen colony becomes a §HRelic World§! with all blockers removed.

entries.zh: 阿卡西记录的低语在这艘方舟舰的甲板间回荡。
entries.en: Whisperings of the Akashic Records resonate within the decks of this Arkship.

entries.zh: 这位领袖的心智里充满了无数低语，各有不同的意图。他交流着的不是一个而是数千个实体。
entries.en: This leader's mind is flooded with whispers, each with unique intent. They commune with not one entity, but thousands.

entries.zh: $shroud.4862.shared$$end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$在我们§H[capital_scope.solar_system.GetName]§!系中具现化了一颗$pc_gaia$，为[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]提供了一片理想家园；这是一个用来拥抱万物终结的转瞬即逝的乐园。
entries.en: $shroud.4862.shared$ $end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$ has materialized a $pc_gaia$ in our §H[capital_scope.solar_system.GetName]§! system, providing an ideal habitat for [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind; a fleeting paradise with which to embrace the end of all things.

entries.zh: $shroud.4862.shared$$end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$已经在§H[capital_scope.solar_system.GetName]§!系中显现了一艘全新的§H方舟舰§!，其上载满了[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]；这是一艘飞驰的天堂之船，用以拥抱万物的终结。
entries.en: $shroud.4862.shared$ $end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$ has materialized a new §HArkship§! teeming with [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind in the §H[capital_scope.solar_system.GetName]§! system; a fleeting vessel of paradise with which to embrace the end of all things.

entries.zh: 不同维度之间的帷幕短暂消失了，虚境的灵能力突然被一整个驱逐到可接触现实中。
entries.en: The veil between dimensions briefly disappeared, expelling the entirety of the Shroud's psionic power into tangible reality.

entries.zh:
所有的有意识众生，无论是生物还是机械体都被抹除了。所有的行星都变成了荒芜的空壳。即便恒星也熄灭了最后一道光芒。

尽管如此，在最后一刻，我们所能感受到的只是脑海中的一个心声……

§R“此为万终之末。”§!
entries.en:
All conscious beings, living or mechanical, were eradicated. Every planet became a barren husk. Even the stars gasped out their final light.

Despite this, in our final moments, all we could perceive was a voice within our minds...

§R"THE END OF ENDS."§!

entries.zh:
$end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$降临了。

$end_aura$吞噬了整个星系。随着最后一个恒星系的沦陷，一道无法计量的能量潮爆发而出。$shroud.4970.desc.1$

$shroud.4970.desc.2$
entries.en:
$end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$ is upon us.

The $end_aura$ has consumed the galaxy. As the final star system yielded to its power, an incalculable surge of energy erupted.$shroud.4970.desc.1$

$shroud.4970.desc.2$

entries.zh: 遍布了整个星系。随着最后一个恒星系被光环腐化，一股不可估量的能量爆发了。
entries.en: has spread throughout the galaxy. As the final star system succumbed to the Aura's corruption, an incalculable surge of energy erupted.

entries.zh: 仿佛来自现实以外的其他维度，这种巨大的灾难之力摧毁了一切。
entries.en: As if from some other dimension of reality, this immense force of cataclysmic power destroyed everything.

entries.zh: 出于对虚境的深切反感，该组织提供技术服务来抵消灵能行为的强烈影响。
entries.en: Motivated by a deep antipathy toward the Shroud, this organization provides services and technology to counteract the powerful effects of psionic practices.

entries.zh: $MINDWARDEN_plural$的一位技艺精湛的指挥官，以擅长重型防御工事和精神抵抗而闻名。
entries.en: A masterful commander of the $MINDWARDEN_plural$, renowned for expertise in heavy fortifications and psychic resistance.

entries.zh: 此前，[GetScientistPlural]们观测到了一种异常的现象：遥远的恒星系带着未知来源的能量流运行，这些能量流还逐渐扩散到了其他星系。
entries.en: Some time ago, our [GetScientistPlural] observed an unusual phenomenon: distant star systems coursing with energy flows of unknown origin, which gradually spread into other systems.

entries.zh: $shroud.4190.desc.intro$这种称为§H“$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$”§!的能量流，由于其来源还未理论上确证，我们还不能确定其是否构成威胁。\n\n这种光环现在也在§H[from.GetName]§!恒星系内探测到了，如果它继续蔓延有可能会侵犯我们的边境。
entries.en: $shroud.4190.desc.intro$ Termed §H'$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$'§!, on the basis of unconfirmed theories about their sources, we have yet to confirm whether they pose a threat or not.\n\nSuch an Aura has now been detected in the §H[from.GetName]§! system, which might encroach within our borders if it continues to spread.

entries.zh: 关于这种现象是由灵能引起的理论如果正确的话，§H[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§!或许知道如何反制其效果。
entries.en: If theories about the psionic origin of this phenomenon are correct, the §H[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§! may know methods of counteracting its effects.

entries.zh: 我们很快就会知道它有什么作用了。
entries.en: We might know their effects soon enough.

entries.zh: 我们在§H[from.GetName]§!恒星系探测到了高浓度灵能能量。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]通过倾听§H虚境§!中的回声得知，这一现象是由
entries.en: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the §H[from.GetName]§! system. Listening to echoes within the §HShroud§!, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities of

entries.zh: $shroud.4191.desc_1.common$一个外星文明的灵能活动引起的。
可观测现实的物质和意识。我们还观测到这些光环可以在恒星系之间传播。
entries.en: matter and consciousness in observable reality. Our observations demonstrate that these Auras can spread between star systems.

entries.zh: 它被称为§H“$PSIONIC_AURA$”§!，是由一个强大虚境实体的意志发出，影响着$shroud.4191.desc_2.common$
entries.en: Termed a §H'$PSIONIC_AURA$'§!, it emanates from the will of a powerful Shroud entity, influencing $shroud.4191.desc_2.common$

entries.zh: 看起来这个帝国似乎开发出了一种从强大虚境实体的意志导出§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!的方法，它能影响$shroud.4191.desc_2.common$
entries.en: It would appear that this empire has developed methods to channel a §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!, which emanates from the Shroud and influences $shroud.4191.desc_2.common$

entries.zh: 我们预期它在我国境内的影响应该是[GetPositiveRivalAdj]的——只要我们和发出者之间的关系没有改变就是如此。
entries.en: we expect its effects within our territory to be [GetPositiveRivalAdj] - as long as our relations with the emitter remain unchanged.

entries.zh: 据[GetTelepathPlural]的说法，它能释放[GetBenevolentRivalAdj]的意志，因此$shroud.4191.desc_3.common$
entries.en: According to our [GetTelepathPlural], it radiates [GetBenevolentRivalAdj] intent, so $shroud.4191.desc_3.common$
Greetings. I speak to you as a representative of the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName].

entries.zh:
$shroud.4205.common$

我们的使命是保护大家免受§H虚境§!以及所有传播其恶意效应者的威胁。我们信仰心灵神圣不可侵犯，巩固星系抵御灵能。

我们根据灵能传感器读数判断出你们不会造成这种威胁。太好了。我们很乐意提供帮助，保护你不受伤害。

$shroud.4205.desc.end$
entries.en:
$shroud.4205.common$

Our mission is to protect against the menace of the §HShroud§! and all those who spread its ill effects. We believe in minds free from invasion, and a galaxy fortified against psionics.

Judging by our psi-sensor readings, you do not contribute to these threats. Excellent. We would be pleased to help you protect against anyone that does.

$shroud.4205.desc.end$

entries.zh: 如果你需要反灵能军事服务，或有多余的§H$zro_lower$§!需要处置，可以尽管来找我们。
entries.en: If you need anti-psionic military services, or have §H$zro_lower$§! to dispose of, let us assist you.

entries.zh:
欢迎回来。[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]很重视我们的持续合作。

我们的灵能传感器读数清晰。你们没有被§H虚境§!玷污。很好，很好……

$shroud.4205.desc.end$
entries.en:
Welcome back. The [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] value our continued cooperation.

Our psi-sensor readings are clear. You remain unsullied by the §HShroud§!. Good, good...

$shroud.4205.desc.end$

entries.zh: 严峻的时刻到了。尽管我们竭尽全力，$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$还是到来了。它在群星之间四处恐怖地显灵……\n\n$shroud.4205.desc.eotc.end$
entries.en: These are grave times. Despite our efforts, $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$ is upon us. Its dreadful manifestation stalks among the stars...\n\n$shroud.4205.desc.eotc.end$

entries.zh: 我们是时候团结一致阻止灵能天灾了。
entries.en: Now is the time for us to stand together and prevent a psionic apocalypse.

entries.zh: 督察朋友们，我们有个好消息：第一个§H$gov_mindwarden_enclave$§!成立了。$shroud.shared_combating_the_shroud$
entries.en: Fellow wardens, we deliver good news: the establishment of the first §H$gov_mindwarden_enclave$§! is complete. $shroud.shared_combating_the_shroud$

entries.zh: 督察朋友们，我们有个好消息：我们的§H$gov_mindwarden_enclave$§!成立了。$shroud.shared_combating_the_shroud$
entries.en: Fellow wardens, we deliver good news: the establishment of our §H$gov_mindwarden_enclave$§! is complete. $shroud.shared_combating_the_shroud$

entries.zh: 欢迎回来，督察朋友。§H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§!很重视我们的持续合作。\n\n$shroud.4205.desc.end$
entries.en: Welcome back, fellow wardens. The §H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§! values our continued cooperation.\n\n$shroud.4205.desc.end$

entries.zh: 我们知道一个不错的灵能目标……
entries.en: We know of a good psionic target...
We need help with £crime£ §Y[GetCrimeDeviancy]§! among us.

entries.zh: 我们可以借用你们的士兵。
entries.en: We could make use of your soldiers.

entries.zh: 你们愿意派一位§Y督查§!来吗？
entries.en: Would you be willing to send us a §Ywarden§!?

entries.zh: 作为你们的§Y赞助方§!，我们有个提案。
entries.en: As your §Yfounding patron§!, we have a proposal.

entries.zh: 从今天起，§H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§!将肩负起与§H虚境§!还有各种灵能滥用行为对抗的重任。\n\n如果你需要，我们能够提供各种反灵能服务——从§H$zro_lower$§!处置到军队雇佣——迅速而且高效。
entries.en: From today, the §H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§! shall carry on the vital work of combating the §HShroud§! and all forms of psionic wrongdoing.\n\nShould you need it, we are already capable of rendering diverse counter-psionic services - from §H$zro_lower$§! disposal to military recruitment - promptly and effectively.

entries.zh:
§H虚境§!可以说是一种存在于普通感知之外的维度现实。它完全由有害的§H“灵能”§!能量组成。它触及我们物质星系的每一个部分，然而多数人无法主动感知到它。

虚境的能量可以通过感性众生的认知活动在物质领域显现。这些力量极其危险且不可预测。

为了确保大众安全需要对虚境采取防护措施。在这方面，我们可以提供帮助。
entries.en:
The §HShroud§! can best be described as a dimension of reality that exists beyond ordinary perception. It is composed entirely of harmful §H'psionic'§! energy. It touches every part of our physical galaxy, yet many do not actively perceive it.

The Shroud's energies can manifest in the physical realm through the cognitive activity of sentient beings. These forces are extremely dangerous and unpredictable.

Ensuring your population's safety requires protective measures against the Shroud. To that end, we can provide help.

entries.zh: 这种复杂的机械可以逐渐消解$PSIONIC_AURA$，直至完全抑制——生效范围包括其本身以及通过超空间航道直接相连的恒星系。
entries.en: These sophisticated machines will gradually dissipate any $PSIONIC_AURA$ until it is suppressed entirely - in both the host system and those in direct connection via hyperlanes.

entries.zh:
抑制§H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!主要有两种方法。

在行星上建造§H$building_psionic_suppressor$§!可以逐渐减少整个恒星系的光环强度，并且防止进一步污染。

更强大的解决方法是§H$SHROUD_SEAL$§!。$shroud.shared_text_shroud_seal$
entries.en:
There are two principal methods of suppressing §H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!.

Building a §H$building_psionic_suppressor$§! on a planet will gradually reduce Aura intensity throughout the star system and prevent any further encroachment.

An even more powerful solution is a §H$SHROUD_SEAL$§!. $shroud.shared_text_shroud_seal$

entries.zh: 乐意效劳。数据将会直接传过去。\n\n愿这些科技在光环浩劫中给你带去和平。
entries.en: Gladly. The data will be transmitted forthwith.\n\nMay these technologies bring you peace from the auric scourge.

entries.zh: 雇佣[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.species.GetNamePlural]去袭击一个已知的灵能帝国。
entries.en: Pay the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.species.GetNamePlural] to raid a Psionic Empire we know of.

entries.zh:
是这样吗？好吧，他们还在用灵能荼毒这个星系，我们就永远不得享受真的安宁……

有针对性的袭击可以表达我们对这种危险行为的反对。而在你们的经济支持下，我们愿意执行这次行动。

如果你们同意，就告诉我们目标吧。
entries.en:
Is that so? Well, we will never know true peace and security while they infect the galaxy with psionics...

A targeted raid would demonstrate our opposition to these dangerous practices. With your financial support, we are willing to conduct such an operation.

Let us know the target, if you agree.

entries.zh: §R在§Y[root.mindwarden_raid_timer]§!之前我们不能请求灵督再发起一场袭击。§!
entries.en: §RWe will not be able to request another raid from the Mindwardens until §Y[root.mindwarden_raid_timer]§!.§!

entries.zh: 雇佣[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]向该帝国派遣袭击舰队。
entries.en: Pay the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] to send a raiding fleet to attack this empire.

entries.zh: 啊，好的。我们知道他们在实践灵能了。展示力量是正当的。\n\n感谢你的支持。行动将会很快开始。
entries.en: Ah, yes. We are aware of their psionic practices. A show of force is justified.\n\nThank you for your support. The operation will commence shortly.

entries.zh: 拦截到的通讯表明他们受某个敌对势力雇佣来进攻我们的恒星系。
entries.en: Intercepted communications indicate that they have been hired by a rival power to attack our systems.

entries.zh: 正在通过公开频道传递信息，直接通知了我们。
entries.en: are transmitting a message via an open channel, addressing us directly.

entries.zh: 一支来自§H[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetSpeciesName]§!的军事舰队正在逼近我们的国境！$shroud.4246.common_1$他们$shroud.4246.common_2$
entries.en: A military fleet from the §H[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetSpeciesName]§! is approaching our borders! $shroud.4246.common_1$ They $shroud.4246.common_2$

entries.zh: 一支来自此前未知的军事势力的舰队正在逼近我们的国境！$shroud.4246.common_1$他们自称§H[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!，$shroud.4246.common_2$
entries.en: A fleet from a previously unknown military power is approaching our borders! $shroud.4246.common_1$ Identifying themselves as the §H[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!, they $shroud.4246.common_2$

entries.zh: 棒极了。把$zro_lower$委托给我们，可以对这种强大而被大规模滥用的物质进行关键的研究——这项研究将使整个星系受益。\n\n这也是我们以高于星系标准的价格购买的原因。
entries.en: Excellent. Entrusting us with $zro_lower$ enables crucial research into this powerful and widely abused substance - research that will benefit the whole galaxy.\n\nThis is why our rate for its purchase is well above the galactic standard.
Sell up to 100 §Y$sr_zro$§! for 5 times the standard $resolution_category_galactic_market$ price.

entries.zh: §R在§Y[root.mindwarden_zro_timer]§!之前我们不能再向灵督递交$sr_zro$。§!
entries.en: §RWe will not be able to give $sr_zro$ to the Mindwardens until §Y[root.mindwarden_zro_timer]§!.§!

entries.zh:
§Y$sr_zro$§!是一种高度不稳定的稀有物质，它的具体效用难以控制和预测。无论是有意或是无意，它可能引发剧烈的能量爆炸，造成大规模破坏。

这些性质是通过一种与§H虚境§!的反应产生的，这使其在灵能实践者中非常受欢迎——有些人甚至把这东西当成药来磕。

我们希望能进一步研究$zro_lower$，找出安全处置的方法；这也是我们对回购泽珞出手如此阔绰的原因。
entries.en:
§Y$sr_zro$§! is a rare, highly unstable substance, the effects of which are difficult to control and predict. Intentionally or not, it can cause violent bursts of energy that wreak destruction on a mass scale.

These properties are produced through reactions with the §HShroud§!, making it popular among psionic practitioners - some of whom ingest it as a drug.

We aim to learn more about $zro_lower$ and to research methods for its safe disposal; that is why we pay handsomely for any quantity brought to us.

entries.zh: 那就让我们来提供一些有用的§Y$decision_thought_police$§!，这可以在[GetCriminalDeviant]意图演变成实际行为之前将其探测到。\n\n他们使用一种专门开发的安全灵能替代方法，以科学技术来监测人群的认知活动。他们提供对精神状态的洞见，而不使用§H虚境§!的危险能量。
entries.en: Then let us provide you with an effective §Y$decision_thought_police$§!, which can detect [GetCriminalDeviant] intent before it manifests in actual behavior.\n\nTheir methods were developed as a safe alternative to psionic practices, using scientific techniques to monitor a population's cognitive activity. They provide insights on mental states without employing the dangerous energies of the §HShroud§!.

entries.zh: §R我们在§Y[root.mindwarden_decision_timer]§!之前无法发出该请求。§!
entries.en: §RWe will not be able to request this until §Y[root.mindwarden_decision_timer]§!.§!

entries.zh: 很好。我相信你会发现这种方法非常地有效。
entries.en: Excellent. I think you will find their methods quite efficacious.

entries.zh: 确实。通过合作我们发现了你们军事部署战略有一些可以改进的方面。\n\n当然，我们这么说并不是有意侮辱；不过是术业有专攻罢了。如果你们能给出足够的价码，我们很荣幸能和如此有价值的客户就此合作。
entries.en: Indeed. Our collaborations have already revealed to us some areas of improvement that could be made to your military deployment strategies.\n\nWe mean no insult by this, of course; we simply specialize in these fields. We would be honored to assist such a valued partner in this matter, should you provide us adequate compensation.

entries.zh: §R在§Y[root.mindwarden_logistics_timer]§!之前我们不能向灵督再申请后勤援助。§!
entries.en: §RWe cannot request more logistical assistance from the Mindwardens until §Y[root.mindwarden_logistics_timer]§!.§!

entries.zh: 您好，尊贵的合作伙伴。\n\n我们的舰队后勤运作协助协议已经到期。如果您考虑的话，我们非常愿意继续合作。
entries.en: Greetings, valued partner.\n\nOur contract to assist in the logistical operations of your fleets has expired. We would be more than willing to continue this partnership, should you deem it worth your while.

entries.zh: 很好。我们的舰队支援运作会立刻开始。
entries.en: Very good. Our fleet support operations will commence at once.

entries.zh: 我们的$NAME_Mindwarden_Army$是非常强大的震慑部队。他们有能应对各种威胁的装备，但对使用灵能的对手特别有效。\n\n我觉得你会发现物有所值的。
entries.en: Our $NAME_Mindwarden_Army$ make excellent shock troopers. They are equipped to tackle diverse threats, but are especially effective against psionic opponents.\n\nWe think you will find them worth their price.

entries.zh: §R在§Y[root.mindwarden_army_timer]§!之前我们不能向灵督再请求一支新的陆军。§!
entries.en: §RWe will not be able to request a new army from the Mindwardens until §Y[root.mindwarden_army_timer]§!.§!

entries.zh: 招募一支§Y$mindwarden_army$§!陆军，乘坐$transport$运抵首都恒星系。
entries.en: Enlist an §Y$mindwarden_army$§! army, arriving by $transport$ at our capital system.

entries.zh: 你走运了；我们正好有一支连队准备好部署。就等着他们的运输船立即到达吧。
entries.en: You are in luck; we already have a company ready for deployment. Expect the arrival of their transport ship presently.

entries.zh: 我们非常乐意。\n\n高效的领导是战胜§H虚境§!的关键，我们的督查们正精于利用严格的管理来压制灵能活动。
entries.en: We would be more than willing.\n\nEffective leadership is key to combating the §HShroud§!, and our wardens are well-versed in suppressing psionic activity through firm governance.

entries.zh: \n我们将雇佣一位等级5的灵督$subclass_commander_governor$。
§R我们已经为一位灵督$subclass_commander_governor$的效力付了钱。§!
entries.en: §RWe have already purchased the services of a Mindwarden $subclass_commander_governor$.§!
§RMust not have a leader from the [event_target:shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName].§!

entries.zh: §R在§Y[root.mindwarden_commander_timer]§!之前我们不能向灵督再申请领袖。§!
entries.en: §RWe will not be able to request another leader from the Mindwardens until §Y[root.mindwarden_commander_timer]§!.§!

entries.zh: 这位领袖从$gov_mindwarden_enclave$雇佣而来，对灵能活动采取强硬立场，保护大众免受虚境的有害影响。
entries.en: Recruited from a $gov_mindwarden_enclave$, this leader promotes an unyielding stance against psionic activities, protecting the populace from the deleterious effects of the Shroud.

entries.zh: 虚境在哪里渗透，就要烧灼哪里的伤口。
entries.en: Where the Shroud seeps through, the wound must be cauterized.

entries.zh: 明智的决定。愿他们的管理能保障你们的人民在未来的岁月里的安全。
entries.en: A wise decision. May their stewardship keep your population safe for years to come.

entries.zh: §L“你最近对$gov_mindwarden_enclave$的袭击不合情理。无论以何种身份，继续留在你的领土内工作，在道德和伦理上都站不住脚。我强烈建议你们停止这种毫无意义的敌对行动——但是，无论你们将来作何选择，我都不会留在这里坐以待毙了。”§!
entries.en: §L\"Your recent attack upon a $gov_mindwarden_enclave$ is unconscionable. Working within your territory, in any capacity, would be morally and ethically indefensible. I strongly recommend that you desist from these senseless hostilities - but, whatever your future choices, I shall not stay here to enable them.\"§!

entries.zh: 说实话，这是个严峻的东西。星系中没有比$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$更大的灾难了。
entries.en: A grave matter, indeed. There is no greater scourge in the galaxy than that of $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$.

entries.zh: 根据我们的情报，$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$是一种来自§H虚境§!内的灾害性的力量。它的力量可以通过一些渴望力量的心灵入侵者同谋在物理现实中显现。\n\n终末通过§R$NAME_Reckoning$§!给星系带来毁灭——那是一种由纯灵能构成的邪恶实体。它的终极目标就是完全抹杀本现实的存在。
entries.en: According to our intelligence, $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$ is a cataclysmic force from within the §HShroud§!. Its power can manifest in physical reality through the complicity of power-hungry mind-invaders.\n\nThe End inflicts ruin upon the galaxy through the §R$NAME_Reckoning$§! - a vicious being composed of psionic energy. Its ultimate goal is the complete annihilation of this existence.

entries.zh: 愿你们对这场巨大威胁凯旋而归。它威胁到了居住在这个星系中的所有人的生死存亡。
entries.en: May you triumph against this great threat. It threatens the existence of everyone who calls this galaxy home.

entries.zh: 我们开发出了一种算法可以增强你们对§R$NAME_Reckoning$§!的进攻能力。这可以提升你们武器系统在对特定灵能实体时的效率。\n\n在目前阶段，这份代码的每次改进都需要大量重构，才能与各个军事基础设施兼容。因此，这是一项高级服务，但我们认为您能认可它的物超所值。
entries.en: We have developed an algorithm that can augment your offensives against the §R$NAME_Reckoning$§!. It tunes your weapons' targeting systems for increased effectiveness against this specific kind of psionic entity.\n\nIn its current state, each deployment of the code requires extensive refactoring for compatibility with individual military infrastructures. This is therefore a premium service, but we think you will find it worth the outlay.

entries.zh:
$shroud.4205.common$

我们最初对与你们“$building_materiality_engine_plural$”有关的消息感到担忧。然而，经过进一步的分析，我们认为这种装置是在对所谓§H“虚境”§!的非灵能开发方面颇具潜力的新发展。

我们鼓励你们继续部署这项技术，并期待在未来一同合作。
entries.en:
$shroud.4205.common$

We were initially concerned by reports of your '$building_materiality_engine_plural$'. However, upon further analysis, we consider these devices to be a promising development for non-psionic exploitation of the so-called §H'Shroud'§!.

We encourage your continued deployment of this technology, and look forward to working with you in the future.

entries.zh:
我谨代表[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]与你通话。

根据我们灵能传感器的读数，整个[Root.GetName]已经无可挽回地被§H虚境§!玷污了。

你们的所作所为是在自掘坟墓——我们不介意帮你们一铲子。
entries.en:
I speak to you as a representative of the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName].

Judging by our psi-sensor readings, the whole [Root.GetName] has been irremediably infected by the §HShroud§!.

Your actions have spelled your end - and we will hasten it.

entries.zh: 你们为什么这么害怕虚境？
entries.en: Why do you fear the Shroud?

entries.zh: 我们不害怕虚境，更不害怕它的走狗，因为我们知道如何对付这些东西。\n\n我不指望你们——这被虚境影响得失心疯了的社会——理解一丝一毫。
entries.en: We do not fear it, nor its corrupted agents, as we know how to fight it.\n\nI would not expect you - a society maddened by its influence - to understand.

entries.zh: 难道用灵能荼毒星系还不够吗？
entries.en: Was it not enough to poison the galaxy with psionics?

entries.zh: 我们是维护星系秩序的力量；攻击我们有什么好处？我们不会坐视你的好战行为。
entries.en: We are a force for order in this galaxy; what benefit is there in attacking us? We shall not idly tolerate your belligerence.

entries.zh: 在你们确认无条件停止敌对行为之前，我们没什么可谈的。
entries.en: Until you confirm the unconditional cessation of hostile attacks, we have nothing to discuss.

entries.zh: 我们知道你们和§H[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]§!的那些交易。你们这种行为不仅是在纵容他们的错误，更是在帮助§H虚境§!感染传播。\n\n只要你们还在与他们合作，我们就不会提供任何服务。
entries.en: We are aware of your dealings with the §H[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]§!. Your actions not only legitimize their wrongdoing, but help spread the infection of the §HShroud§!.\n\nWe will not render you any services while you remain their collaborators.

entries.zh: §H在他们的设施遭到摧毁后，我们至今无法与[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]再次取得联系。\n\n打开他们的通讯频道，我们只能听到宇宙的虚空寂静。§!
entries.en: §HWe have not been able to reestablish contact with the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] since the destruction of their facility.\n\nWhen we listen to their channel, we hear only the empty quietude of space.§!

entries.zh: 我们对[mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName]恒星系的进攻成功了；§H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§!现已不复存在。
entries.en: Our offensive in the [mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName] system was successful; the §H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§! is no more.

entries.zh: $shroud.4405.desc_common$尽管他们所鄙夷的东西对我们毫无意义，但他们对§H“虚境”§!的十字军式的讨伐代表了一种不应该在我们星系中存在的伪科学教条主义。
entries.en: $shroud.4405.desc_common$ Though the practices they despised were of little importance to us, their crusade against the §H'Shroud'§! represented the kind of pseudoscientific dogmatism that should have no place in our galaxy.

entries.zh: $shroud.4405.desc_common$他们不该再继续传播那种关于所谓§H虚境§!危险的无知教条，他们空间站的灵能衰减器现在已经是一堆破铜烂铁了。
entries.en: $shroud.4405.desc_common$ They shall no longer spread their ignorant dogma about the dangers of the §HShroud§!, and their station's psionic attenuators are now debris.

entries.zh: 我们的胜利是巨大的成功，甚至还可以从他们空间站的残骸打捞大量的资源。
entries.en: Our victory was doubly successful, as we were also able to salvage a sizable amount of resources from the wreckage of their station.

entries.zh: 我们获悉[mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName]恒星系内的§H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§!不复存在了。该$gov_mindwarden_enclave$无法抵御§H[mindwarden_destroyer.GetName]§!的猛烈攻击，他们的空间站化作碎片，没有找到任何幸存者。
entries.en: We have received reports that the §H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§! in the [mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName] system is no more. This $gov_mindwarden_enclave$ was unable to withstand an onslaught by the §H[mindwarden_destroyer.GetName]§!, which reduced their station to debris and left no known survivors.

entries.zh: 现在星系不用再遭受他们的反灵能十字军行为的骚扰了——只要没有人再冒出来扮演这个角色。
entries.en: The galaxy is now free from the torment of their anti-psionic crusade - as long as no one emerges to take their place.

entries.zh: 之后没有他们提供反灵能服务的日子，这个星系只得勉强应付了。
entries.en: The galaxy will have to make do without their anti-psionic services for the time being.

entries.zh: 请知悉。我们乐与[root.GetName]维持紧密的合作关系；我们的历史和目标永远紧密相连。
entries.en: Please make it known. We are glad to maintain close cooperation with the [root.GetName]; our histories and aims are forever bound.

entries.zh: 我们永远感谢您对[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]的贡献。只要灵能威胁还在肆虐，我们的关系便不可动摇。
entries.en: We are forever thankful for your contribution to the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]. For as long as the psionic threat remains, may our bond be unwavering.

entries.zh: 你大可放心，下一笔利润分红也将及时支付。
entries.en: You can trust that your next profit-share payment will be delivered in a timely fashion.

entries.zh: 我们希望帮你们升级太空城邦。
entries.en: We want to help expand your enclave.

entries.zh: 该太空城邦目前正在招募新的官员和船员。在§Y[mindwarden_enclave_country.upgraded_station_timer]§!之前无法对业务进行进一步升级。
entries.en: The enclave is currently recruiting new officers and crew. It cannot commence further operational improvements until after §Y[mindwarden_enclave_country.upgraded_station_timer]§!.

entries.zh: 我们希望能和你们共享科技。
entries.en: We want to share our technology with you.

entries.zh: 这个城邦仍在消化之前我们所分享的技术。我们可以在§Y[mindwarden_enclave_country.updating_databanks_timer]§!之后继续与他们分享新的科技。
entries.en: The enclave is still incorporating tech we provided previously. We can share new technologies with them after §Y[mindwarden_enclave_country.updating_databanks_timer]§!.

entries.zh: 我们希望能雇佣一支你们的§Y舰队§!为我们服务。
entries.en: We wish to hire a §Yfleet§! for our own purposes.

entries.zh: 我希望提升我们的灵督城邦容量。
entries.en: We wish to increase our Mindwarden enclave capacity.

entries.zh: 我们仍在实施与太空城邦有关的基础设施改革。到§Y[mindwarden_enclave_country.mindwarden_enclave_capacity_bought_timer]§!为止我们无法再提高灵督城邦的容量了。
entries.en: We are still implementing enclave-related infrastructural changes. We cannot increase our Mindwarden enclave capacity again until §Y[mindwarden_enclave_country.mindwarden_enclave_capacity_bought_timer]§!.

entries.zh: 有了更多资金，我们就能大幅度扩大行动。我们可以提升舰队的数量和质量，招募更多的科研人员来开发心灵防护科技。最终，整个星系都将从您的慷慨解囊中收益。
entries.en: With additional funds, we could greatly expand our operation. We could increase the number and capabilities of our fleets, and recruit more researchers to develop our mind-protective technologies. Ultimately, the whole galaxy would benefit from your patronage.

entries.zh: 我们必须对诡计多端的灵能威胁保持警惕。您的慷慨捐赠将使我们能够大大扩大业务规模以应对这种挑战。
entries.en: We must remain vigilant against the ever-changing threat of psionics. Your generous donation would allow us to significantly scale up our operations to meet this challenge.

entries.zh: 我们已取得了诸多成就，但现在休息还为时尚早。只要能支配更多资源，[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]的舰队就能在星系中部署得更远，守护更多被灵能所困扰的心灵。
entries.en: We have achieved much, but it is too soon to take rest. With more resources at our disposal, the fleets of the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] could be deployed even further across the galaxy, protecting even greater numbers of minds plagued by psionics.

entries.zh: 帮助我们踏上旅程的正是您提供的启动资金，而我们的目标仍然是一样的：通过彻底根除灵能来促进心灵健康。有了您的帮助，我们离目标越来越近了。
entries.en: Your patronage has defined our journey from the very outset, and our shared goals remain the same: fostering mental wellbeing by the complete eradication of psionics. With your aid, we are inching ever closer to our goal.

entries.zh: 如果您认为值得再次投资我们的行动，我们就将成为星系中最大的反灵能军——群星间所有国家抵抗精神入侵的最高堡垒。
entries.en: If you see fit to invest in our operations once again, we could become the largest anti-psionic force in the galaxy - the supreme bastion against mind invasion for all nations among the stars.

entries.zh: 谢谢。很荣幸我们能与您合作，保护所有智慧生命的精神完整性。
entries.en: Thank you. We are proud to work with you to protect the psychic integrity of all intelligent beings.

entries.zh: 一项伟大的事业。星系中$ENCLAVE_MINDWARDEN_PLURAL$的数量越多，所有人的灵魂就越不容易受到入侵。\n\n我们可以就提高基础设施效率提供建议，以便建立、管理更多的城邦。
entries.en: A fine undertaking. The more $ENCLAVE_MINDWARDEN_PLURAL$ there are in the galaxy, the safer all minds are from invasion.\n\nWe can provide counsel on improving your infrastructural efficiency to allow for the establishment and administration of more enclaves.

entries.zh: 我们很感谢您愿意分享这些研究成果。你传授给我们的所有知识都将有助于加强星系面对灵能威胁的保护。
entries.en: We appreciate your willingness to share the fruits of your research. Any knowledge you impart to us will help strengthen the galaxy's protection from psionic threats.

entries.zh: 我们很荣幸能肩挑重任。[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]的舰队位于反灵能科技与战术的最前沿；任何试图入侵心灵的敌人都无法在他们面前立足。每支舰队都配备了一名专门接受过对抗灵能作战训练的指挥官。
entries.en: We would be honored to oblige. Fleets from the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] are at the vanguard of anti-psionic technology and tactics; no mind-invading aggressor stands a chance against them. Each is deployed with a commander specially trained in operations against psionic opponents.

entries.zh: 接管这个太空城邦的§Y灵督舰队§!，时长为10年。
entries.en: Take control of the §YMindwarden fleet§! of this enclave for 10 years.

entries.zh: 我们相信§H[mercenary_fleet.GetName]§!在对付那些玩弄灵能毁灭性力量的家伙们时会是强有力的工具。
entries.en: We trust that the §H[mercenary_fleet.GetName]§! will be an effective tool in combating those who toy with the destructive power of psionics.

entries.zh: 取消或延长你的§Y灵督舰队§!合约。
entries.en: Cancel or prolong our §YMindwarden fleet§! contract.

entries.zh: 确实。我们希望§H[mercenary_fleet.GetName]§!令您如虎添翼。您打算终止或延长我们的协议吗？
entries.en: Certainly. We hope the §H[mercenary_fleet.GetName]§! has proven a valuable addition to your forces. Do you wish to terminate or prolong our contract?

entries.zh: 很好。合约已终止，§H[mercenary_fleet.GetName]§!会立即返回。我们的舰队在您需要的时候永远等待您的雇佣。
entries.en: Very well. The contract is void and the §H[mercenary_fleet.GetName]§! will return to us immediately. Our fleets are available to hire whenever you require them.

entries.zh:
$CHALLENGING_ORIGIN$§R警告：禁用['concept_psionic_ascension']。§!

这个文明的祖先受到入侵心灵的超自然力量的困扰，这促使他们投入巨量人力物力来开发反灵能技术。

他们的古老装置仍然可以使用，但尚未对来自星系更远处的灵能威胁进行测试。
entries.en:
$CHALLENGING_ORIGIN$§RWARNING: Blocks access to ['concept_psionic_ascension'].§!

This civilization's ancestors were plagued by otherworldly forces that invaded the mind, inspiring them to dedicate great effort and resources into developing anti-psionic technology.

Their ancient devices are still functional, but remain untested against psionic threats from the wider galaxy.

entries.zh:
—$ADDITIONAL_TECHNOLOGIES_STRING$£engineering£['technology:tech_starbase_3']
—$HOME_SYSTEM$初始拥有§H$tech_starbase_3$§!。
—$HOMEWORLD$£building£['building:building_ancient_ward_1']
—可以对灵能飞升帝国使用§Y$casus_belli_cb_psionics_containment$§!§H宣战理由§!。
—§Y$FE_GUARANTEED_COLONIES$§!不会出现。
—§Y$ENCLAVE_MINDWARDEN_PLURAL$§!不会在游戏开始时生成。
entries.en:
- $ADDITIONAL_TECHNOLOGIES_STRING$ £engineering£ ['technology:tech_starbase_3']
- $HOME_SYSTEM$ Start with a §H$tech_starbase_3$§!.
- $HOMEWORLD$ £building£ ['building:building_ancient_ward_1']
- Gain access to the §Y$casus_belli_cb_psionics_containment$§! §HCasus Belli§! against psionically ascended Empires.
- §Y$FE_GUARANTEED_COLONIES$§! do not appear.
- §Y$ENCLAVE_MINDWARDEN_PLURAL$§! are not generated at the start of game.

entries.zh:
我们先祖留下来的记录讲述了一场摧毁[GetHomeWorldName]的灵能瘟疫。超自然的力量攻击心智，毁灭性的辐射散布在大气中——而这都是[GetSpeciesAdj]社会中的灵能尝试引起的。

为了应对这些威胁，先祖们建造了$building_ancient_ward_1$来抵御入侵心智的力量。仅依靠日常维护，这座古老的建筑就已经强大到足以保护所有[GetSpeciesNamePlural]免受灵能干扰的威胁，它的核心技术也为其他心灵防御的发展提供了信息。

随着我们的文明准备扬帆越过[capital_scope.System.GetName]的轨道，等待我们的只有未知。在我们陌生的世界里又有什么样的灵能威胁在等待着我们呢？
entries.en:
The records of our ancestors tell of a psychic plague that once devastated [GetHomeWorldName]. Otherworldly forces attacked their minds, and destructive radiation was diffused throughout the atmosphere - all encouraged by psionic practitioners from within [GetSpeciesAdj] society.

In response to these threats, our ancestors built the $building_ancient_ward_1$ to protect against mind-invading forces. With only routine maintenance, this venerable structure has proven strong enough to defend all [GetSpeciesNamePlural] from the threat of psionic influence, and its core technology has informed the development of other defenses of the mind.

As our civilization prepares to voyage beyond the orbit of [capital_scope.System.GetName], we are faced with the unknown. What psychic threats might lurk beyond our ken?

entries.zh: 这将是选择$origin_mindwardens$起源时的固定起始恒星系。\n\n$system_initializer_DESC$
entries.en: This will always be the starting system when using the $origin_mindwardens$ Origin.\n\n$system_initializer_DESC$

entries.zh: $origin_mindwardens$起源可选的起始恒星系，以太阳系为基础。\n\n$system_initializer_DESC$
entries.en: Optional starting system for $origin_mindwardens$ Origin, using Sol as a base.\n\n$system_initializer_DESC$

entries.zh: 这座古老的结构使用一系列灵能衰减器来隔离整个星球免受精神入侵力量的侵害。
entries.en: This ancestral structure uses an array of psionic attenuators to insulate the entire planet against mind-invading forces.

entries.zh: 这座古老的结构对灵能衰减器进行了升级，现在可以在整个恒星系防御$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$了。
entries.en: This ancestral structure has been upgraded with enhanced psionic attenuators, which are capable of protecting against $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ throughout the star system.

entries.zh: 发动战争，防止星系遭受灵能感染的威胁。
entries.en: War is waged to defend the galaxy against the threats of psionic infection.

entries.zh: §H就在我们试图与他们取得联系时，舰桥乘员突然感到了间歇性头痛……§!
entries.en: §HAs we attempt to make contact, our bridge crew suffers intermittent pangs of head pain...§!

entries.zh: §H尽管反复尝试，[exiled_country.GetName]依旧没有回复我们的通讯。§!
entries.en: §HDespite repeated attempts, the [exiled_country.GetName] are not responding to our communications.§!

entries.zh: 我们用于压制灵能的§H$building_ancient_ward_1$§!正在发出异常的读数。这通常是来自[Root.GetHomeWorldName]的灵能活动激增的结果，但我们并没有找到任何这种堕落行为的迹象。\n\n那么答案也许就藏在我们的国境内。长距离遥感影像显示§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!系内最近出现了一次奇怪的能量流爆发，与$building_ancient_ward_1$发生异常时产生的读数互相相关。
entries.en: Our psi-suppressive §H$building_ancient_ward_1$§! is producing irregular readings. This would normally result from spikes in psionic activity on [Root.GetHomeWorldName], but we have found no evidence of such depravity.\n\nThe answer may lie beyond our borders. Long-distance imagery shows a recent burst of strange energy flows in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system, which correlates with the erratic measurements of the $building_ancient_ward_1$.

entries.zh: 情绪波动；令人衰弱的精神压力；反复出现难以形容的恐怖景象
entries.en: emotional turmoil; debilitating mental stress; recurrent visions of unspeakable horror

entries.zh: 这些现象与我们祖先记录的体验非常相符；非常有可能就是他们所说的“灵能辐射”，一种极具破坏力的能量发射形式。
entries.en: These phenomena closely match the experiences recorded by our ancestors; this is most likely what they referred to as 'psi-radiation', a particularly destructive form of energy emission.

entries.zh: 舰队的系统也受到严重故障的困扰，妨碍了多数正常的功能。
entries.en: The fleet's systems are also beset by severe malfunctions, effectively neutralizing most normal capabilities.

entries.zh:
新探索到的§H[from.GetName]§!恒星系中一种令人警惕的情况正在酝酿。[root.GetName]的船员遭受到了一系列精神症状：$shroud.shared_text_psy_symptoms$。他们的舰队系统也发生了怪异的故障。

$shroud.shared_text_psi_radiation$在§H$building_ancient_ward_1$§!的保护不到的§H[owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!上，我们第一次体验到了祖先所警惕的心智疾病。

在校准了我们的长程扫描仪探测了这种独特的能量形式以后，我们发现这些危险发射的来源是附近的§H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§!恒星系。$shroud.6100.desc.end$
entries.en:
An alarming situation is developing in the newly explored §H[from.GetName]§! system. The crew of the [root.GetName] is suffering a range of psychological symptoms: $shroud.shared_text_psy_symptoms$. Their fleet's systems are also experiencing strange, erratic malfunctions.

$shroud.shared_text_psi_radiation$ Outside of the protection of the §H$building_ancient_ward_1$§! on §H[owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!, we are for the first time experiencing the mental blight that our forebears warned of.

After calibrating our long-range scanners to detect this unique form of energy, we discovered the source of these dangerous emissions to be the nearby §H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§! system. $shroud.6100.desc.end$

entries.zh:
[root.GetName]的船员们岌岌可危。

在§H[from.GetName]§!恒星系里暴露到这种极高等级的灵能辐射后，他们开始产生比此前报道的更糟糕的精神压力。$shroud.shared_text_ship_malfunction$

长程扫描表明有更高等级的辐射在从§H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§!恒星系中释放出来。$shroud.6100.desc.end$
entries.en:
The crew of the [root.GetName] is in danger.

Upon exposure to the extremely high levels of psi-radiation in the §H[from.GetName]§! system, they began experiencing even worse psychological distress than was previously reported. $shroud.shared_text_ship_malfunction$

Long-range scanners indicate even higher levels of radiation in the nearby §H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§! system. $shroud.6100.desc.end$

entries.zh: 在更彻底评估其影响之前，我们强烈反对派遣任何舰船深入。
entries.en: Sending any of our vessels deeper is strongly discouraged until we evaluate its effects more thoroughly.

entries.zh: 出乎意料的是，§H[This.System.GetName]§!恒星系中存在许多似乎是由智慧生物所建造的大型物体。我们为了了解其创造者，将其代称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!，并尝试在保持安全距离的前提下进行直接的沟通工作。\n\n该恒星系内所有的生命形式必然都处在我们探测到的高水平灵能辐射的威胁下。
entries.en: Astonishingly, the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system appears to contain a number of large objects that appear to be of intelligent construction. We might learn more about their creators, code-named §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, by attempting direct communications from a safe distance.\n\nAny life forms in the system must be in great danger from the high levels of psi-radiation we detected.

entries.zh: 我们在§H[This.System.GetName]§!系发现了可能的外星智能证据。
entries.en: We have discovered possible evidence of alien intelligence in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system.

entries.zh: 进一步的研究确定在§H[This.System.GetName]§!恒星系中的物体是一艘外星飞船，但我们还未与任何船上人员建立任何沟通渠道。\n\n特使[exiled_envoy.GetName]汇报[exiled_envoy.GetHisHer]的团队开始遭受到超心灵学症状的困扰，包括[This.System.GetName]上出现奇特生物的无法解释的幻象。尽管有这些问题，我们的特使还是坚持投入[exiled_envoy.GetHisHer]的这项任务。
entries.en: Further study has confirmed the objects in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system to be alien spacecraft, though we have yet to make contact with any of the vessel's occupants.\n\nTroublingly, envoy [exiled_envoy.GetName] reports that [exiled_envoy.GetHisHer] team has begun suffering from parapsychological symptoms, including unexplained visions of strange beings present in [This.System.GetName]. Despite these concerns, our envoy remains steadfast in [exiled_envoy.GetHisHer] dedication to the mission.

entries.zh: 我们尚未与§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!建立联系。特使报告了对他们团队的担忧。
entries.en: We have yet to make contact with the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. Our envoy reported concerns about their team.

entries.zh: 在数个月的寂静后，我们收到了一份来自[exiled_envoy.GetName]的通讯。这位通常冷静而直率的特使发来了一份离奇而混乱的报告。[exiled_envoy.GetSheHeCap]杂乱无章地描述了一些奇怪的意象——显然是纠缠在一起的梦境和幻觉。[exiled_envoy.GetHisHer]团队的所有人也都一样神志不清。\n\n目前他们已经解除了职务，该任务也无限期搁置了。无论§H[This.System.GetName]§!里的到底是什么东西，目前我们都暂时没有办法安全地调查。
entries.en: After months of silence, we received a transmission from [exiled_envoy.GetName]. Usually sober and direct, the envoy gave a bizarre, muddled report. [exiled_envoy.GetSheHeCap] submitted rambling descriptions of strange imagery - apparently a tangle of dreams and delusions. No member of [exiled_envoy.GetHisHer] team proved to be any more coherent.\n\nThey have been relieved of their duties, and this mission has been suspended indefinitely. Whatever presence is in §H[This.System.GetName]§!, it is currently beyond our means to safely investigate.

entries.zh: 在这场令人痛苦的任务之后，我们的团队在没有与§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!达成联络便启程回家了。
entries.en: Following a traumatic mission, our team has returned home before making contact with the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!.

entries.zh:
悬浮在翻滚的水流之上。是§H[Root.Capital.GetName]§!，还是……？

§H……呼叫……§!

水面扭转着分开。恶臭的瘴气从无底的深处喷涌而出。

§H……回复……没有……§!

无休无止。令人窒息。

这太糟糕了。
entries.en:
Suspended above the roiling current. §H[Root.Capital.GetName]§!, or...?

§H...calling...§!

The surface twists open. A fetid miasma belches from unseen depths.

§H...answer...nothing...§!

Ceaseless. Suffocating.

It is terrible.

entries.zh: 我们与$COUNTRY|H$的$first_contact$流程已被行政命令终止。
entries.en: Our $first_contact$ process with the $COUNTRY|H$ has been aborted by executive fiat.

entries.zh: 近处的灵能“感染”已经传播进了§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!恒星系中。\n\n尽管有§H$building_ancient_ward_1$§!提供保护，这种侵蚀导致我们在§H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§!上的人口也开始表现出可能与灵能辐射荼毒有关的一些症状了。预测显示，这种心灵瘟疫可能很快会传播至§H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§!，我们的母星也会因此受到进一步的威胁。
entries.en: The nearby psionic 'infection' has spread into the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system.\n\nDespite the protections offered by the §H$building_ancient_ward_1$§!, this encroachment has caused our population on §H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§! to experience mild symptoms suggestive of psi-radiation poisoning. Projections show that the mind-plague may soon expand into §H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§!, where it will pose an even greater danger to our homeworld.

entries.zh: 尽管有风险，但是我们想彻底地学会如何保护自己，最好的办法就是接近现象的源头进行研究。
entries.en: Despite the risks, our best hope of learning to protect ourselves more thoroughly is to study this phenomenon closer to the source.

entries.zh:
§H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§!中一种令人警惕的情况正在酝酿。大众正在遭受一系列精神症状：$shroud.shared_text_psy_symptoms$。

$shroud.shared_text_psi_radiation$那些在§H$building_ancient_ward_1$§!保护之外的人第一次体验到了祖先所警惕的心智疾病。

在校准了我们的长程扫描仪探测了这种独特的能量形式以后，我们发现这些危险发射的来源是附近的§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!恒星系。$shroud.shared_text_aura_study$
entries.en:
An alarming situation is developing on §H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§!. The population is suffering a range of psychological symptoms: $shroud.shared_text_psy_symptoms$.

$shroud.shared_text_psi_radiation$ Those outside of the protection of our §H$building_ancient_ward_1$§! are for the first time experiencing the mental blight that our forebears warned of.

After calibrating our long-range scanners to detect this unique form of energy, we discovered that these dangerous emissions spread from beyond the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system. $shroud.shared_text_aura_study$

entries.zh:
$shroud.shared_text_aura_spread$

自从暴露在极高等级的灵能辐射中之后，[exiled_system_border.GetName]星系内的§H[event_target:ship_in_border.GetName]§!船员就开始承受比以往报道都更加严重的心理压力。$shroud.shared_text_ship_malfunction$

$shroud.shared_text_aura_study$
entries.en:
$shroud.shared_text_aura_spread$

Since being exposed to extremely high levels of psi-radiation, the crew of the §H[event_target:ship_in_border.GetName]§! in [exiled_system_border.GetName] is experiencing even worse psychological distress than was previously reported. $shroud.shared_text_ship_malfunction$

$shroud.shared_text_aura_study$

entries.zh: 让我们学会怎么阻止这种感染吧。
entries.en: Let us learn to stop this infection.
