entries.zh: §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!恒星系内的灵能辐射等级突然提升，甚至在§H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!上都能感受到这种效应。我们必须近距离研究这种不断恶化的现象，不能再让它威胁到我们的人口了。
entries.en: Levels of psi-radiation in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system have suddenly increased, and the effects are being felt on §H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!. We must study this developing phenomenon up close before it further endangers our population.

entries.zh: 我们的研究者们在§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!恒星系内的剧毒灵能辐射中备受煎熬，但他们的任务带来的重要的发现。\n\n我们将这种危险的现象归类为§H“$PSIONIC_AURA$”§!，这是一种巨大破坏性能量的积聚体，它不仅会扰乱我们的思想，也能干扰我们的技术装备。它是从§H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§!恒星系传播而出，那里的灵能能量增长到能够跨越恒星系进行传播的强度了。
entries.en: Our researchers suffered greatly amid the poisonous psi-radiation in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system, but their mission led to important findings.\n\nWe have classified this alarming phenomenon as a §H'$PSIONIC_AURA$'§!, a vast accretion of destructive energy that disrupts not only our minds but our technology as well. It has spread from the §H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§! system, where the psionic energies grew to such intensity that they expanded across star systems.

entries.zh: $shroud.6205.desc.start$\n\n它已经沾染了§H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§!恒星系，造成了毁灭性的影响。$shroud.6205.desc.end$
entries.en: $shroud.6205.desc.start$\n\nIt has already reached the §H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§! system, where the effects have been devastating. $shroud.6205.desc.end$

entries.zh: $shroud.6205.desc.start$\n\n如果它沾染上§H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§!恒星系，后果会是毁灭性的。$shroud.6205.desc.end$
entries.en: $shroud.6205.desc.start$\n\nIf it reaches our §H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§! system, the effects would be devastating. $shroud.6205.desc.end$
The §H$building_ancient_ward_1$§! on §H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§! only offers limited protection.

entries.zh: 我们祖先建造在§H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!的§H$building_ancient_ward_1$§!是用来保护我们不受灵能辐射伤害的。§H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!的入侵大大超出了它的防护能力。如果用上目前为止所学到的知识，我们应该就有能力提升其防御性能。
entries.en: The §H$building_ancient_ward_1$§! built by our ancestors on §H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§! was designed to protect us from psi-radiation. The incursion of §H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§! threatens to overwhelm its current capacity. By applying what we have learned so far, we should be able to enhance its resistant properties.

entries.zh: 我们孜孜不倦的研究者们开发出了一种增强§H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§!上§H$building_ancient_ward_1$§!的方法。通过改进灵能衰减器，它的防护效果不仅可以覆盖到整颗行星，还能保护§H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§!系。\n\n这项研究激发了在该失落的科技领域内更广泛的研究。我们现在知道灵能辐射和[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]意识之间存在着相互联系：不止是这种能量发射可以影响我们的精神状态，我们的精神状态也同样能影响灵能辐射等级。看来我们对“灵能”实践的古老禁忌是有科学依据的。
entries.en: Our tireless researchers have developed a method for strengthening the §H$building_ancient_ward_1$§! on §H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§!. By enhancing its psionic attenuators, the protection can be extended to cover not only the whole planet, but the entire §H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§! system.\n\nThis research has stimulated broader study into this lost technology. We now know that the link between psi-radiation and the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] mind is reciprocal: not only can these emissions affect our mental states, but our mental states can influence psi-radiation levels. It would seem that our immemorial taboo against 'psionic' practices has a scientific basis after all.

entries.zh: §H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!上的§H$building_ancient_ward_1$§!已经到功能的极限了。为了应对附近的灵能威胁，很有必要进一步提升它的性能。这种新的§H$building_ancient_ward_2$§!应该可以保护我们的人口不受§H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!侵染。
entries.en: The §H$building_ancient_ward_1$§! on §H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§! has reached its functional limits. In order to deal with the nearby psionic threat, it will be necessary to enhance its capacities even further. This new §H$building_ancient_ward_2$§! shall be capable of protecting our population against the blight of §H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!.

entries.zh: 我们的§H$building_ancient_ward_2$§!建好之后，§H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§!星系内的灵能辐射水平降低到了可控的范围之内。§H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§!上，大众的各种症状逐渐缓解了过来。
entries.en: With our §H$building_ancient_ward_2$§! now complete, psi-radiation in the §H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§! system has been reduced to manageable levels. The population of §H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§! is gradually recovering from its adverse effects.

entries.zh: 随着我们§H$building_ancient_ward_2$§!的完工，§H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§!星系内的灵能辐射水平降低到了可控的范围之内。大众的各种症状逐渐缓解了过来。
entries.en: With our §H$building_ancient_ward_2$§! now complete, psi-radiation on §H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§! has been reduced to manageable levels. The population is gradually recovering from its adverse effects.

entries.zh: 无论如何，这个§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!以及可能存在着的其他同类都依旧在荼毒着这个恒星系。我们的科学家认为，$building_ancient_ward_2$的科技可以用于开发更强大的§H“$SHROUD_SEAL$”§!。这些硕大无比的装置可以抑制一整个星团的光环。在§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!恒星系建造一个$SHROUD_SEAL$将能大幅度提升控制灵能威胁的能力。
entries.en: Nevertheless, this §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!, and potentially others, still poisons the wider galaxy. Our scientists hypothesize that the technology of the $building_ancient_ward_2$ could be applied to the development of a more powerful §H'$SHROUD_SEAL$'§!. These massive structures should be able to suppress Auras in entire star clusters. Building a $SHROUD_SEAL$ in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system will be a significant advancement in controlling the psionic menace.
This is research worthy of pursuit.

entries.zh: 在完成§H$tech_psionic_suppression$§!科技的研究后，我们就能用$constructor$在恒星引力井内建造§H$SHROUD_SEAL$§!了。这种装置可以抑制整个恒星系以及通过超空间航道毗邻的其他恒星系内的§H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!。
entries.en: After researching §H$tech_psionic_suppression$§! technology, we can use a $constructor$ to build a §H$SHROUD_SEAL$§! within a stellar gravity well. This will suppress §H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§! throughout the star system and adjacent systems connected via a hyperlane.

entries.zh: 科学家们认为，更先进的§H$tech_psionic_suppression$§!科技可以进一步发展，用于抑制整个星团的§H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!。\n\n这项科技将使我们得以建造§H“$SHROUD_SEAL$”§!。在§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!恒星系建造如此强大的装置将会显著提高对灵能威胁的控制能力。
entries.en: Our scientists theorize that more advanced §H$tech_psionic_suppression$§! technology can be developed to suppress §H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§! in entire star clusters.\n\nThis technology will allow us to construct a §H'$SHROUD_SEAL$'§!. Building such a powerful device in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system will be a significant advancement in controlling the ongoing psionic menace.

entries.zh: 自从暴露在极高等级的灵能辐射中之后，§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!星系内的§H[Root.GetName]§!船员就开始承受比以往报道都更加严重的心理压力。$shroud.shared_text_ship_malfunction$
entries.en: Upon exposure to the extremely high levels of psi-radiation in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system, the crew of the §H[Root.GetName]§! is experiencing even worse psychological distress than was previously reported. $shroud.shared_text_ship_malfunction$

entries.zh: 灵能辐射荼毒的不良影响在整个§H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§!的人口中已经非常明显，我们舰船的功能也受到严重影响。
entries.en: The adverse effects of psi-radiation poisoning are already evident throughout the population of §H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§!, and our ships' functionality is severely impaired.

entries.zh: §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!已经散播进§H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§!系。$shroud.6225.desc.shared$\n\n升级§H$building_ancient_ward_1$§!已经比以往更加迫在眉睫了。
entries.en: The §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§! has spread to the §H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§! system. $shroud.6225.desc.shared$\n\nThe urgency of strengthening the §H$building_ancient_ward_1$§! is greater than ever.

entries.zh: 灵能瘟疫已经传播到了§H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§!系。$shroud.6225.desc.shared$\n\n弄明白这种污染比以往更加迫在眉睫了。
entries.en: The psionic blight has spread to the §H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§! system. $shroud.6225.desc.shared$\n\nThe urgency of understanding this contamination is greater than ever.
The §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§! of the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§! has the following effects:\n$effect_exiled_aura$

entries.zh: 该灵能现象具有如下效果：\n$effect_exiled_aura$
entries.en: This psionic phenomenon has the following effects:\n$effect_exiled_aura$

entries.zh: 我们失去了对母星§H[root.GetHomeWorldName]§!的控制。作为我们主要的知识储备地和所有社会活动的中心，如果不夺回它，我们将无法继续推进我们的反灵能事业。
entries.en: We have lost control of our homeworld, §H[root.GetHomeWorldName]§!. As our primary storehouse of knowledge, and the nexus of all our society's endeavors, we cannot hope to further our anti-psionic efforts without reclaiming it.

entries.zh: 我们必须重新夺得控制权，片刻不能耽误。
entries.en: We must regain control without delay.

entries.zh: 我们必须重新夺得§H[root.GetHomeWorldName]§!控制权，片刻不能耽误。
entries.en: We must regain control of §H[root.GetHomeWorldName]§! without delay.

entries.zh: 我们失去了对母星§H[root.GetHomeWorldName]§!的控制。作为我们主要的知识储备地和所有社会活动的中心，如果不夺回它，我们将无法继续推进我们的反灵能事业。
entries.en: We have lost control of our homeworld, §H[root.GetHomeWorldName]§!. As our primary storehouse of knowledge, and the nexus of all our society's endeavors, we cannot hope to further our anti-psionic efforts without reclaiming it.

entries.zh: 我们重新获得了母星§H[root.GetHomeWorldName]§!的控制权。[root.GetName]可以继续全力推动反灵能事业。
entries.en: We have regained control of our homeworld, §H[root.GetHomeWorldName]§!. The [root.GetName] can resume anti-psionic endeavors in full force.

entries.zh:
我们的科学家们完成了对先进§H$tech_psionic_suppression$§!科技的研发。现在可以在我们控制的任何一个殖民地内建造$building_psionic_suppressor$来复现$building_ancient_ward_2$的效果了。

然而，要在其他恒星系内控制§H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!的传播，我们还需要建造一种被称为§H$SHROUD_SEAL$§!的更加强大的装置。$shroud.shared_text_shroud_seal$

这项研究也证实了一个令人不安的理论：存在着一个被称为§H“虚境”§!的空灵领域！古代神秘文献中描述的那种灵能维度很有可能是真的。该理论认为，感性众生的认知活动可以使能量从虚境内传递到可观察现实中——这种过程就是$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$的一般性来源。

这意味着我们不仅仅只是在与宇宙的客观力量作斗争，而是与某种潜在的未知意图的可疑行为对抗。
entries.en:
Our scientists have completed the development of advanced §H$tech_psionic_suppression$§! technology. We can now replicate the effects of the $building_ancient_ward_2$ on any colony under our control by building a $building_psionic_suppressor$.

However, to control the spread of §H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§! in other systems, we will need to construct a more powerful device known as a §H$SHROUD_SEAL$§!. $shroud.shared_text_shroud_seal$

This research has also given credence to a disturbing theory: an ethereal realm known as the §H'Shroud'§!, a dimension of psionic energy described in occult texts of old, appears to truly exist. The theory posits that the cognitive activity of sentient beings can cause energy to pass from the Shroud into observable reality - and this process is the root cause of $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ in general.

This means that we are not merely contending with objective forces of the universe, but potentially calculated actions of unknown intent.
So the §H'Shroud'§! is real after all...?

entries.zh: 我们从§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!系之外接收到了一份意料之外的通讯。§H[exiled_country.GetName]§!莫名其妙地完全掌握了我们的语言和通讯系统。
entries.en: We are receiving an unexpected transmission from beyond the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system. The §H[exiled_country.GetName]§! have inexplicably gained complete mastery of both our language and communication systems.

entries.zh:
§H屏幕上的人物以一种稳定、催眠的节奏与人交流，不时会作很长时间的停顿。§!

遥远的邻居们，鉴于你们对直接接触不予回应，我们只好诉诸于粗糙的技术通信。

我是§H乌克霍格拉斯·斯卡拉特§!，§H[exiled_country.GetName]§!的灵主。事态很紧急；原谅我的仓促。
entries.en:
§HThe figure on screen communicates with a steady, hypnotic rhythm, punctuated by extended pauses.§!

Far neighbors, given your non-response to direct contact, we have resorted to the drudgery of crude techcomms.

I am §HUk-Hogolath Scarat§!, Psiarch of the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§!. The matter is urgent; forgive the lack of formalities.

entries.zh: 正在影响我们光环的流动。我们暂且认为这种不可接受的局面只是你方的无心之过。\n\n这种光环利人利己，应当照耀整个星系。为了证明你们对上上善道的承诺，我们要求你们立即拆除所谓的
entries.en: is inhibiting the spread of our auric flow. We assume this intolerable situation is the result of an ignorant mistake on your part.\n\nThe aura benefits all. It should shine throughout the galaxy. To demonstrate your commitment to the greater good, we demand the immediate dismantling of your so-called

entries.zh: 灵主乌克霍格拉斯·斯卡拉特
我们之前可没收到过什么通讯。
entries.en: We received no prior communication from you.

entries.zh: 我们用真音和你们沟通。你们听到了，你们肯定能听到内心的传音。你们有这种天赋的，但你们选择了压制。
entries.en: We spoke with the true voice. Had you listened, you would have heard the call within. You have the gift, though you choose to suppress it.

entries.zh: 这光环具有破坏性，是一种瘟疫。
entries.en: The aura is destructive. A plague.

entries.zh: 你的理解有问题。光环是我们守护神赐予的神圣礼物。它能打倒一切带来毁灭之物。
entries.en: Your understanding is faulty. The aura is a sacred gift of our protector. It casts down that which seeks to destroy.

entries.zh: 如果我们拒绝你们的要求呢？
entries.en: What if we refuse your demands?

entries.zh: 损害光环者无论是谁，都要镇压。如果你们拒绝，我们就要被迫采取军事行动了。
entries.en: Whoever harms the aura must be subdued. If you refuse, we will be forced to take military action.

entries.zh: 我们绝不会摧毁自己的遗产。
entries.en: We will never destroy our heritage.
We agree to dismantle the Seal.

entries.zh:
为了避免与§H[exiled_country.GetName]§!发生直接冲突，我们默认了他们对拆解§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!系内$SHROUD_SEAL$的要求。

与那些散布灵能瘟疫的家伙们的接触已经在§H[this.GetName]§!引起了严重关切。移除$SHROUD_SEAL$似乎也只能是一种暂时的绥靖政策。他们很定还会想要对我们的§H$building_ancient_ward_2$§!做一样的事情的——这就是我们绝对不能接受的事情。

无论如何，一战在所难免。
entries.en:
In order to avoid immediate conflict with the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§!, we acquiesced to their demands to dismantle the $SHROUD_SEAL$ in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system.

Exposure to those responsible for the psionic pestilence has caused grave concern throughout the §H[this.GetName]§!. Removal of the $SHROUD_SEAL$ is only likely to be a short term appeasement. They will eventually expect the same of our §H$building_ancient_ward_2$§! - and that is something we cannot accept.

In any case, future hostilities seem inevitable.

entries.zh: §H灵主的图像一出现，便开始冷漠地、无声地指责。§!\n\n[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我很失望还要打这通通讯。
entries.en: §HAs soon as their image appears, the Psiarch launches into a cold, toneless rebuke.§!\n\n[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural], I am disappointed to be making this transmission.

entries.zh: 你们用行为证明了自己有多无知。你们对我们的光环流横加阻挠，对整个灵能事业无端蔑视，这都与整个跨星系的和平水火不容。我们别无选择。\n\n等着见我们的舰队吧。
entries.en: Your actions have confirmed your ignorance. Your disdain for our auric flow, and psionic betterment in general, is incompatible with intragalactic peace. We are left with no other choice.\n\nBe prepared to meet our fleets.

entries.zh: $shroud.shared_psiarch_transmission$尽管你们已经同意拆除了$SHROUD_SEAL$，但我们知道你们还在§H[capital_scope.GetName]§!维持这一座与之功能相似的建筑。你们的意图路人皆知。$shroud.shared_auric_flow_disdain$
entries.en: $shroud.shared_psiarch_transmission$ Though you agreed to dismantle the $SHROUD_SEAL$, we are aware that you have maintained a building on §H[capital_scope.GetName]§! with similar capabilities. Your intent is clear. $shroud.shared_auric_flow_disdain$

entries.zh: 这话该说给你们自己听。闭嘴吧。
entries.en: You should do likewise. End transmission.

entries.zh: $shroud.shared_psiarch_transmission$你们重建$SHROUD_SEAL$的行为彻底浇灭了我们对救赎你们的一切期望。$shroud.shared_auric_flow_disdain$
entries.en: $shroud.shared_psiarch_transmission$ Your rebuilding of the $SHROUD_SEAL$ has extinguished any hopes we had for your redemption. $shroud.shared_auric_flow_disdain$

entries.zh:
随着巨大的灵能衰减器闪耀着启动，我们的§H$SHROUD_SEAL$§!开始逐渐将§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!驱赶出§H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§!恒星系。

跨星系扫描确认了帝国领土的其他部分都直接通过超空间航道连接到[exiled_center_system.GetName]。只需要一座$SHROUD_SEAL$就能打消整个§H[exiled_country.GetName]§!境内的$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$。

我们胜利的关键就在于保护封印了。
entries.en:
With its colossal psionic attenuators flared into action, our §H$SHROUD_SEAL$§! is now in the process of driving out the §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§! from the §H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§! system.

Interstellar scans have confirmed that the rest of our enemy's territory is directly connected to [exiled_center_system.GetName] via hyperlane. This single $SHROUD_SEAL$ is therefore capable of dissipating $PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$ throughout the entire territory of the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§!.

Our victory hinges on the protection of the Seal.

entries.zh:
我们征服了§H[current_planet.GetName]§!上造成灵能威胁的殖民地。

我们了解到在该恒星系内出现的§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!受到了人口与§H虚境§!的心灵交互的增强。这些举措是由一群称为§H灵道会§!的精英灵能者们领导的。这个灵能邪教在宣导他们对所谓“超主”的忠诚，而这超主据称是虚境内一个强大实体，我们仅知道其被称为§H$r_the_lost_patron$§!。

他们的经文反复提到与这个存在有关的灵器——显然仍然存在于这颗星球§H[other_planet.GetName]§!上。找到这个东西就可以帮助我们阻止他们继续传播影响。
entries.en:
The colony of the psionic menace on §H[current_planet.GetName]§! has been conquered.

We have learned that the §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§! present in this system was being amplified by the population's psychic interactions with the §HShroud§!. These practices are led by a group of elite telepaths, the §HAssembly of Mindways§!. This psionic cult promotes devotion to their 'patron', allegedly a powerful entity from within the Shroud, known only as §H$r_the_lost_patron$§!.

Their sacred texts make repeated mention of an artifact related to this being - apparently still extant on the planet §H[other_planet.GetName]§!. Acquiring this object will aid us in preventing further spread of their influence.

entries.zh:
我们完成了对§H[current_planet.GetName]§!的殖民，这曾是一颗[exiled_country.GetName]的行星。

从他们残留的记录中我了解到，该恒星系内此前存在的$PSIONIC_AURA$是由人口和§H虚境§!的心灵互动造成的。带领这种行为的灵能邪教鼓吹诡异所谓的“超主”，据说是虚境里的一个叫做§H$r_the_lost_patron$§!的强大实体。

他们经文的残片中反复提到与这个存在有关的某件灵器——显然仍然存在于这颗星球§H[other_planet.GetName]§!上。要实现这个目标，就需要更慎重地征服[other_planet.GetName]，留下一部分人口。
entries.en:
We have completed our colonization of §H[current_planet.GetName]§!, a former world of the [exiled_country.GetName].

From the remains of their records, we have learned that the $PSIONIC_AURA$ previously present in this system was caused by the population's psychic interactions with the §HShroud§!. These practices were led by a psionic cult that promoted devotion to their 'patron', allegedly a powerful entity from within the Shroud known as §H$r_the_lost_patron$§!.

Fragments of their sacred texts refer to an artifact related to this being, apparently still extant on the planet §H[other_planet.GetName]§!. Securing this object would require a more measured conquest of [other_planet.GetName], leaving some of its population intact.

entries.zh:
我们已立即对这些星球上的所有灵能活动进行了严厉打击，彻底消除了其可憎的§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!。

在该星球的主要城市里，矗立着一座名为§H$SANCTUM_OF_THE_LOST$§!的废弃高塔，它曾是前帝国现已声名狼藉的灵能邪教的至高神殿。我们的士兵形容它散发着一种神圣而令人不安的气息。

该建筑的最深处密室中，有一个密封严密的“茧”，散发出强大的局部灵能辐射。事实证明，标准弹药无法穿透其外部。要消除该物体对我们持续安全构成的潜在威胁，还需要进一步调查。
entries.en:
We have instituted an immediate crackdown on all psionic practices on these worlds, completely neutralizing their abominable §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!.

In the planet's principal metropolis lies a ruined tower known as the §H$SANCTUM_OF_THE_LOST$§!, once the high temple of the former empire's now-disgraced psionic cult. Our soldiers describe it as radiating a numinous, unsettling presence.

The innermost chamber of the structure houses a tightly sealed 'cocoon' emanating powerful levels of localized psi-radiation. Standard munitions have proven ineffective in breaching its exterior. Further investigation will be required to eliminate the potential threat this object poses to our continued safety.

entries.zh: 对§H[current_planet.GetName]§!的征服标志着我们对§H[exiled_country.GetName]§!的最终胜利。$shroud.6700.desc.common$
entries.en: The conquest of §H[current_planet.GetName]§! marked our final victory against the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§!. $shroud.6700.desc.common$

entries.zh: 在征服了§H[current_planet.GetName]§!之后，我们获得了曾经由一个名为§H[exiled_country.GetName]§!的帝国统治的领土。$shroud.6700.desc.common$
entries.en: In conquering §H[current_planet.GetName]§!, we gained control of territory once ruled by an empire known as the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§!. $shroud.6700.desc.common$

entries.zh: 在征服§H[current_planet.GetName]§!时，我们夺取了曾由心灵虔诚信徒统治的领土。$shroud.6700.desc.common$
entries.en: In conquering §H[current_planet.GetName]§!, we gained control of territory once ruled by psionic zealots. $shroud.6700.desc.common$

entries.zh: 令人不安的消息……继续调查。
初步调查显示，该星球上存在一个庞大的建筑网络，很可能是灵能浩劫的力量中心。如今，只剩下残垣断壁。\n\n我们可能永远无法得知这些建筑曾隐藏着怎样堕落的秘密，也无法得知其居住者卑劣行径的真实性质。尽管如此，该星系现已清除其残余的$PSIONIC_AURA$，使我们免受其曾造成的伤害。
entries.en: A preliminary survey showed evidence of an extensive network of buildings on the planet, likely the power center of the psionic scourge. Now, only crumbling vestiges remain.\n\nWe may never know what degenerate secrets these structures housed, or the true nature of their occupants' craven practices. Nevertheless, the system is now cleansed of the last traces of its $PSIONIC_AURA$, leaving us safe from the harm it once caused.

entries.zh: 对§H[current_planet.GetName]§!上人口的彻底清除，标志着§H[exiled_country.GetName]§!帝国的终结。\n\n$shroud.6705.desc.common$
entries.en: The eradication of the population on §H[current_planet.GetName]§! marked the end of the empire known as the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§!.\n\n$shroud.6705.desc.common$

entries.zh: 对§H[current_planet.GetName]§!上人口的彻底清除，标志着一场毁灭性灵能威胁的终结。\n\n$shroud.6705.desc.common$
entries.en: The eradication of the population on §H[current_planet.GetName]§! marked the end of a devastating psionic threat.\n\n$shroud.6705.desc.common$

entries.zh: 愿所有此类威胁都被消除。
entries.en: May all such threats be vanquished.

entries.zh: 一个灵能帝国的覆灭使他们的$PSIONIC_AURA$从星系中消失，给我国人民带来了心灵的平静。
entries.en: The eradication of a psionic empire has banished their $PSIONIC_AURA$ from the galaxy, bringing peace of mind to our population.

entries.zh: 在§H[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]§!上的$SANCTUM_OF_THE_LOST$遗迹里，我们找到了一颗被紧紧包裹着的“茧”，它正在散发出极高等级的灵能辐射。我们必须进行现场调查来消除这个物体可能带来的威胁。
entries.en: Within the ruined $SANCTUM_OF_THE_LOST$ on §H[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]§!, we found a tightly sealed 'cocoon' emanating dangerous levels of psi-radiation. We must conduct on-site research to eliminate any threat this object might pose.

entries.zh:
我们的研究者对§H[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]§!上的“茧”进行了全面的分析。

对这座宏伟建筑的外部扫描显示，它是一个专门设计用于容纳强大灵能实体的高规格安全容器。尽管该容器有重合金绝缘层，但高水平的灵能辐射还是透过外壳渗漏了出来。

茧的周围安装有一组灵能衰减器；激活的时候时，周边地区的所有人都受到了严重的神经损伤。

茧的表面随之扭曲，从卵型变成了不断变化的螺旋形。其上的孔穴洞窟，我们接到了来自内部的直接通信……
entries.en:
Our researchers conducted a thorough analysis of the 'cocoon' on §H[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]§!.

External scans of this imposing structure revealed it to be a highly secure receptacle designed to contain a powerful psionic entity. Despite the container's insulative layers of heavy alloys, high levels of psi-radiation are permeating through the enclosure nonetheless.

A group of psionic attenuators were installed around the cocoon; when activated, everyone in the vicinity was struck with searing levels of neural distress.

The surface of the cocoon then twisted, its ovoid form becoming a shifting helix. The aperture has opened, and we are receiving direct communication from within...

entries.zh: 必须已经确保了帝国的精神安全。
entries.en: Must have secured the psychic safety of the empire

entries.zh: 我们已经积累了大量关于§H虚境§!的知识，开发出了能抑制其恶劣影响的先进科技。在讨论如何将这种技术大规模应用到全星系的过程中，我们的舰队司令提出了一项有趣的提案。\n\n他们建议将我们的一支舰队设立为一个独立的§H“$gov_mindwarden_enclave$”§!，这样就能向全星系的客户提供反灵能服务了。$shroud.shared_enclave_investement$
entries.en: We have amassed great knowledge of the §HShroud§!, and developed advanced technologies to suppress its pernicious effects. While debating how to apply this mastery galaxy-wide, our fleet commanders have put forward an interesting proposal.\n\nThey suggest setting up one of our fleets as an independent §H'$gov_mindwarden_enclave$'§!, which would provide anti-psionic assistance throughout the galaxy. $shroud.shared_enclave_investement$

entries.zh: 现在可以将§Y30§!以上规模的舰队转化为§H$gov_mindwarden_enclave$§!。
entries.en: Any fleet of size §Y30§! or more can now be converted into a §H$gov_mindwarden_enclave$§!.

entries.zh: §H[This.GetName]§!已经找到了一位适合创建我们第一个独立§H$gov_mindwarden_enclave$§!的候选者。如果审核通过，这支舰队将会在§H[This.Solar_System.GetName]§!设立一座新的设施，并立即开始提供反灵能服务。
entries.en: The §H[This.GetName]§! has been identified as a suitable candidate to form the basis of our first independent §H$gov_mindwarden_enclave$§!. If authorized, the fleet would establish a new facility in §H[This.Solar_System.GetName]§! and begin providing anti-psionic services forthwith.

entries.zh: 我们正在考虑将§H[This.GetName]§!设立为一座独立的§H“$gov_mindwarden_enclave$”§!以向整个星系提供反灵能服务。$shroud.shared_enclave_investement$
entries.en: We are considering setting up the §H[This.GetName]§! as an independent §H'$gov_mindwarden_enclave$'§!, which would provide anti-psionic assistance throughout the galaxy. $shroud.shared_enclave_investement$

entries.zh:
与§H虚境§!以及灵能滥用的斗争让我们的人民变得更加强大，也更明确了我们的目标。第一座§H$gov_mindwarden_enclave$§!的建立正标志着一个康复和抵抗的新纪元。

在整个星系中，心智不再被灵能侵犯，所有星球都不再受到虚境力量的折磨。

这就是$MINDWARDEN_plural$时代。
entries.en:
Contending with the §HShroud§! and the irresponsible use of psionics has strengthened our people and clarified our goals into sharper focus. The foundation of the first §H$gov_mindwarden_enclave$§! is the advent of a new age of healing and resistance.

Throughout the galaxy, no mind need be invaded by psionic aggressors, and no world tormented by forces from the Shroud.

It is now the age of the $MINDWARDEN_plural$.

entries.zh: 我们的旅程才刚刚开始
我们的前期投入将会用于建设一座空间站；而作为回报，我们可以获得其未来盈利的分红。他们的行动自由就能便于这类设施的大规模利用。\n\n我们自然也能利用他们的服务——当然价格可以打折。
entries.en: Our initial investment would fund the construction of a space station; in return, we would receive a share of future revenues. Their operational independence will allow for a larger-scale deployment of such facilities.\n\nNaturally, we too could make use of their services - and receive back a cut of our own payments.

entries.zh: 对§H[exiled_country.GetName]§!的战争迫在眉睫。\n\n这场灵能浩劫必须从根源上解决。我们必须先在§H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§!恒星系内建造一座$SHROUD_SEAL$，以此中和掉$PSIONIC_AURA$；只有这样我们才能踏足，并将其从这个星系里净化掉。
entries.en: War against the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§! is now upon us.\n\nThe psionic scourge must be quelled at its source. We must first construct a $SHROUD_SEAL$ in the §H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§! system, thereby neutralizing the $PSIONIC_AURA$; only then can we move in and purge this menace from this galaxy.

entries.zh: 在§H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§!建造一座§H$SHROUD_SEAL$§!可以抑制该恒星系以及通过超空间航道毗邻的恒星系内的§H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!。
entries.en: Constructing a §H$SHROUD_SEAL$§! in §H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§! will suppress §H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§! in the star system and others directly connected via hyperlane.

entries.zh: §H[exiled_country.GetName]§!被迫结束了灵能攻击。征服他们的星球是确保他们未来不再搞出§H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!的唯一方法。
entries.en: The §H[exiled_country.GetName]§! are unwilling to cease their psionic assault. Conquering their worlds is the only guarantee against the future reemergence of their §H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!.

entries.zh: §H[exiled_country.GetName]§!被迫结束了灵能攻击。征服他们的星球是确保他们未来不再搞出§H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!的唯一方法。
entries.en: The §H[exiled_country.GetName]§! are unwilling to cease their psionic assault. Conquering their worlds is the only guarantee against the future reemergence of their §H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!.

entries.zh: 拆除§H$SHROUD_SEAL$§!是为了安抚§H[exiled_country.GetName]§!的必要牺牲，但该举措也只是缓兵之计。如果我们想再次踏足他们的领土并净化§H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!就必须把这座建筑重建起来。\n\n§P重建将会视为冒犯行为。我们必须做好一切反扑的准备。§!
entries.en: Dismantling our §H$SHROUD_SEAL$§! was a necessary sacrifice to placate the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§!, but this measure was only a ploy for time. The structure must be rebuilt before we can enter their territory and purge it of §H$PSIONIC_AURA_PLURAL$§!.\n\n§PReconstruction will be seen as an act of aggression. We must be ready for any retaliation.§!

entries.zh: 发动战争，清除星系中的灵能侵略者。
entries.en: War is waged to purge the galaxy of a psionic aggressor.
§HYou hear, but do not listen. Why?§!

entries.zh: 我们不会让你荼毒我们的心智的！
entries.en: We will not let you poison our minds!

entries.zh: §H荼毒？不是毒……\n\n这是一首歌。唱歌就要先听见。敞开心扉，共享美好吧。§!
entries.en: §HPoison? Not poison...\n\nA song. To sing, you must listen. Let go of your self, and share its beauty.§!

entries.zh: §H轮回飞转……我们倾听。\n\n星辰飞旋……我们歌唱。§!
entries.en: §HAs the wheel spins... we listen.\n\nAs the stars spin... we sing.§!

entries.zh: §H转个不停。在上面，也在下面。是被叫做“虚境”的和声。§!
entries.en: §HEver-turning. Above and beneath. A harmony known as the 'Shroud'.§!

entries.zh: §H我在……做梦。梦见了一首歌。但歌声沉默了。合唱声去了哪里呢？§!
entries.en: §HI am... dreaming. Dreaming of a song. But the voices have gone silent. Where did the chorus go?§!

entries.zh: 把你关在这里的人走了。
entries.en: The ones who kept you here are gone.

entries.zh: §H是醒与梦之间的细流……是此方与彼方之间的道路。\n\n你听不见……你们的心智无法理解……§!
entries.en: §HA flow between waking and dreaming... A path between here and there.\n\nYou cannot hear them - your minds lack the understanding...§!

entries.zh: §H我想听见歌声……但万籁俱寂……为什么？§!
entries.en: §HI want to hear singing... Everything is so quiet... Why?§!
What can you offer us in return?

entries.zh: §H可以让你们看看……我的梦。星球的诞生。§!
entries.en: §HI can show you... my dreams. The making of worlds.§!
How do we know we can trust you?

entries.zh: §H你只需听着。这首歌是真理，只因它的美。这是一首美丽的真理。\n\n但你的心关着。可以敞开的。§!
entries.en: §HYou need only listen. The song is true because it is beautiful. A beautiful truth.\n\nBut your minds are closed. They can be opened.§!

entries.zh: §H我还在这……听着两个世界的歌。但这边的一首失声了。§!
entries.en: §HI am there still... I listen to the songs of two worlds. This one is muted.§!

entries.zh:
我们在§H[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]§!上发现的茧里寄宿着一个强大的异次元实体。它在某种意义上似乎就是威胁到我们心智健全的$PSIONIC_AURA$的源头。

我们的灵能衰减器暂时减轻了它的危险，但目前还不清楚还能抑制它多久。如果能够妥善控制，我们甚至有可能利用它可怕的力量来实现自己的目的。

然而我们社会的多数人呼吁立即将其摧毁。这种东西光是存在就已经站在我们长久以来价值观的对立面上了。
entries.en:
The cocoon we discovered on §H[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]§! harbors a powerful interdimensional entity. It is likely that this being was somehow responsible for the $PSIONIC_AURA$ that threatened the sanctity of our minds.

Our psionic attenuators are mitigating the danger it poses for now, but it is unclear how long our devices can restrain its influence. It is possible that, under controlled circumstances, we can harness its terrible power for our own purposes.

Nevertheless, many in our society are calling for its immediate destruction. Its very existence stands against our long-held values.

entries.zh: 想方设法利用这个……东西。
entries.en: Find a way to make use of this... thing.

entries.zh: 获得§Y$living_standard_shroud_inoculation$§!生活标准的权限，在此标准下§Y灵能§!能力将被移除。
entries.en: Grants access to the §Y$living_standard_shroud_inoculation$§! Living Standard, under which §YPsionic§! abilities are removed.

entries.zh: 击败了一个灵能仇敌并摧毁了他们$PSIONIC_AURA$的源头，在经历了多年磨难后，现在全国士气高涨。
entries.en: Defeating a psionic enemy, and destroying the apparent source of their $PSIONIC_AURA$, boosted morale in our empire after enduring years of torment.

entries.zh: 该物种正接受接种以对抗灵能辐射的有害影响。\n\n§R为预防进一步伤害，所有灵能特质将被移除。§!
entries.en: This species is being inoculated against the harmful effects of psi-radiation.\n\n§RTo prevent further harm, any Psionic traits will be removed.§!

entries.zh: §L我们应确保这一物种的灵能安全。§!
entries.en: §LWe shall ensure the psionic safety of this species.§!

entries.zh:
思想穿透了灵能屏障。

我们听到了一段旋律，明亮但刺耳。

我们知道这种痛苦，强烈而熟悉。

§H你听见了。这梦是你的……唱吧，唱吧……§!
entries.en:
Thoughts penetrate our minds.

We hear a melody, bright and abrasive.

We know this pain, great and familiar.

§HYou listened. The dream is yours... Sing, sing...§!

entries.zh: §H我兑现了承诺。我为你们做了个梦。§!
entries.en: §HJust as I promised. I have dreamt for you.§!

entries.zh: §H星球。新的星球，在我和你之间。§!
entries.en: §HWorlds. New worlds, between mine and yours.§!

entries.zh: 这些星球对我们有什么用？
entries.en: What use are these worlds to us?

entries.zh: §H让我对它们歌唱吧。唱最明亮的歌。§!
entries.en: §HLet me sing to them. The brightest of songs.§!

entries.zh: 在我国境内最多可添加三颗§H虚境星球§!，每个星系最多一颗。
entries.en: Adds up to three §HShrouded Worlds§! within our borders, with a maximum of one per system.

entries.zh: 这个灵体是虚境中一位存在的实体形态——某个已消亡灵能帝国曾经的“超主”。它究竟如何显化于现实世界尚不可知，但其与灵能领域独特的联系赋予了它深不可测的力量。
entries.en: This numinous entity is the physical form of a being within the Shroud - the former 'patron' of a nonextant psionic empire. Exactly how it materialized in this physical reality is unknown, but its unique connection to the psionic realm grants it profound power.

entries.zh: 我们不知道会发生什么。
entries.en: We do not know what may happen...
Number of neighbor systems $VAL0|2Y$ is NOT $COMPARE$ $VAL1|2Y$

entries.zh: $CHALLENGING_ORIGIN$§R警告：禁用除['concept_psionic_ascension']以外所有飞升路线。§!\n\n该文明长久以来都一直沉迷于一场将邻近的星球变成荒凉的虚境星球的神秘灾难。如今他们初涉星海，终于得以一探究竟，以及确定是否会有相似的命运降临在自己头上。
entries.en: $CHALLENGING_ORIGIN$§RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_psionic_ascension'].§!\n\nThis civilization has been long-obsessed with a mysterious calamity which turned a neighboring planet into a desolate and shrouded world. Now, as they take to the stars, they can finally explore its secrets and find out if a similar fate awaits them too.

entries.zh: —帝国初始拥有['concept_paranoia_modifier']修正\n—无法组建或加入['concept_federation']
entries.en: - Empire starts with the ['concept_paranoia_modifier'] modifier\n- Cannot form or join a ['concept_federation']

entries.zh: 在目击了一场远古天灾后，一代又一代的人对灾难的恐惧与日俱增。\n\n随时间逐渐恶化的幸福度修正：§R-5%§!到§R-50%§!
entries.en: After witnessing an ancient catastrophe, successive generations suffer from an ever-worsening sense of cataclysmic dread.\n\nHappiness modifier worsens over time: §R-5%§! to §R-50%§!

entries.zh: 在目击了一场远古天灾后，一代又一代的人时时刻刻保持着对灾难的恐惧。我们会步它的后尘吗？
entries.en: After witnessing an ancient catastrophe, successive generations suffer from a pervasive sense of cataclysmic dread. Will we be the next to suffer this fate?

entries.zh:
我们是末日的先锋。

在[GetSpeciesAdj]文明的诞生伊始，一场神秘的灾难就降临在我们的邻近天体上。它突然而剧烈的变化让夜空被邪恶的紫光笼罩，在我们的人民心中激起恐惧，担心这种命运也有一天会降临到自己身上。一代又一代，对灭绝的窒息恐惧紧紧地抓着我们。

如今，[GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经步入群星，“$pc_shrouded$”也吸引着我们去探索。我们几个世纪以来渴望的答案近在咫尺。尽管如此，许多人警告说，我们对这种破坏性力量来源的痴迷最终可能导致自己的灭亡。

很快，我们就会拉开最后的帷幕。
entries.en:
We are the harbingers of cataclysm.

During the dawn of [GetSpeciesAdj] civilization, a mysterious calamity befell our nearest celestial neighbor. Its sudden and brutal transformation filled the night skies with a malevolent purple light, stirring within our people a dread that we will one day suffer a similar fate. With each passing generation, the suffocating fear of potential annihilation tightened its grip upon us.

Now, as [GetSpeciesNamePlural] take to the stars, we are drawn to explore this '$pc_shrouded$.' The answers we have craved for centuries are tantalizingly within reach. Still, many among us warn that our obsessive fascination with the source of this destructive power may ultimately lead to our own end.

Soon enough, we will lift the final veil.

entries.zh:
环绕着§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!的探测卫星为我们的载人登陆这颗“$pc_shrouded$”的任务识别出了一个可行的目的地。着陆区散发出一种奇怪的辐射，携带着紫外线风暴在整个星球上荡漾。

有很多[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]反对这项任务，害怕这种同样的诅咒会释放到我们的母星上。他们的担忧并非没有道理，但理解这种遥远现象的重大必要性压过其他的所有需求。

如果我们注定有一天要遭受同等劫难，至少也死得明明白白。
entries.en:
Exploratory satellites orbiting §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! have identified a promising target for our first crewed mission to the surface of this '$pc_shrouded$.' The landing zone emanates a strange radiation that ripples across the planet, carried forth on ultraviolet winds.

There are many [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] who protest against this mission in fear of unleashing the same curse upon our homeworld. Their concerns are not without justification, but the overriding need to understand this distant phenomenon must take precedence.

If we are fated to one day suffer this same calamity, at least we will die knowing why.
The search for answers begins now.

entries.zh: 终于，我们能够抵达并接触被称为§H[planet.GetName]§!的“$pc_shrouded$”。那里有一种声音在呼唤着我们，这声音如今比以往任何时候都更加响亮。\n\n席卷这个星球的灾难所蕴含的秘密，将揭示我们自身星系历史的诸多真相，并有望缓解我们社会对自身预言中毁灭的执念。轨道扫描显示，南半球某一点正聚集着漩涡状的强烈能量——那是一只令人不寒而栗的眼睛，正凝视着我们。
entries.en: At long last, we are able to reach out and touch the '$pc_shrouded$' known as §H[planet.GetName]§!. Something there calls to us, a voice stronger now more than ever before.\n\nThe secrets of the cataclysm that befell this world will reveal much of our own system's history, and hopefully ease our society's obsession with its own predicted destruction. Orbital scans indicate swirling patterns of intense energy isolated to a point in the southern hemisphere - an ominous eye staring back at us.

entries.zh:
§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!的地貌正如预料般险象环生。暮色粒子形成的漩涡在空中肆虐，拖慢了§H[Leader.GetName]§!及其[Leader.GetHisHer]的组员的初步探索进度。

令人警觉的是，我们的研究小组开始报告感官异常现象——他们描述风中传来遥远的嚎叫，雾霭中潜行着阴影般的轮廓。选择登陆此地是否真是错误？

着陆画面的首次公开在§H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!引发了大规模恐慌。许多人担心我们可能会招致那股曾造访[shrouded_planet.GetName]的神秘破坏力量。“终末将临”的抗议势力正在组织起来，抗议活动席卷我们的母星，导致大量基础设施停摆。

遥测扫描显示，附近山脉深处存在一个释放极高辐射水平的空洞。我们决心不惜一切代价继续推进。
entries.en:
The terrain on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! is as treacherous as predicted. Swirling vortices of gloaming particles carve through the air, slowing the initial progress of §H[Leader.GetName]§! and [Leader.GetHisHer] crew.

Alarmingly, our research team has begun to report sensory inconsistencies; they describe distant howls carrying on the winds and shadowed figures stalking in the mists. Is it truly a mistake to be here?

The first public broadcasts of the landing have triggered widespread panic on §H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!. Many are fearful that we may be courting the mysterious destructive powers that once visited [shrouded_planet.GetName]. Organized protests proclaiming that 'The End is Nigh' are sweeping across our homeworld, shutting down much of our infrastructure.

Telemetric scans have revealed a cavity emanating particularly high radiation levels deep within a nearby mountain range. We are determined to push farther, whatever the cost.

entries.zh: 突破表层。我们必须找到等待着我们的东西。
entries.en: Breach the surface. We must find what awaits us.

entries.zh: 一种末日将临的预感笼罩着我们的社会。
entries.en: A sense of impending doom looms over our society.

entries.zh:
我们并非第一批访客。

突破了§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!上山脉中的空洞后，一座在灾难中被遗弃的外星建筑赫然出现。我们认为最好将此信息列为机密，以防止进一步的恐慌。

初步分析证实，该设施建造所使用的材料与星球上现有矿物的分子构成不符，这表明一个星际文明使用了奇异材料建造了这座设施。这个地方的确切用途仍然不明，但其功能似乎已基本自动化。

与此同时，队员们的心理症状正在恶化。有人报告说听到通过加密频率传来的耳语声，另一些人则描述他们对周围物理环境的感知扭曲。偶尔发作的阵阵笑声令人感到不安。

我们已经走得太远，现在无法回头了。
entries.en:
We are not the first.

The mountainous cavity on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! has been breached, revealing an abandoned alien structure lost to the cataclysm. We find it best to keep this information classified in order to prevent further panic.

Preliminary analysis confirms that materials used in the facility's construction do not match the molecular composition of available minerals on the planet, suggesting that a spacefaring civilization built this installation using exotic materials. The exact purpose of this place remains unclear, but its functionality appears to have been mostly automated.

Meanwhile, the team's psychological symptoms are worsening. Some report voices whispering through encrypted frequencies, while others describe distorted perceptions of their surrounding physical environment. Occasional fits of laughter are becoming uncomfortably commonplace.

We have gone too far to turn back now.

entries.zh:
他们都死了。

在这座设施核心的每个工作站座椅上，都蜷缩着某种未知外星种族的干瘪尸体，他们苍白的复眼齐刷刷凝视着天花板。尽管形貌可怖，§H[Leader.GetName]§!能基本确定这些生物并非幻觉产物。目前这些生命体的影像资料被列为绝密信息。

现场未发现任何使用武器的痕迹，表明§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!上的存在并无敌意。该设施很可能是个观测站，其精密监测设备曾直接对准§H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!。碳同位素测定显示，其活动时间远早于大灾变降临之前。

我们已破译大量记录：除常规通讯日志外，主要内容均与我们一族文明的早期历史相关。
entries.en:
They are all dead.

At the seat of each station in the heart of this facility slumps the desiccated corpses of an unknown alien race, their many pale eyes staring toward the ceiling. Despite their frightening appearance, §H[Leader.GetName]§! is reasonably certain these figures are not a product of hallucinations. Images of these life forms are currently classified as strictly confidential.

No weapons of any form can be found, suggesting that their presence on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! lacked hostile intent. This facility was likely an observation post, with sophisticated monitoring equipment trained directly on §H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!. Radiocarbon dating places their activity here long before the cataclysm struck.

We have decoded many of their records; aside from routine communication logs, they largely concern our civilization's early history.

entries.zh:
§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!上的数据库已被破译，那些曾被我们视为无稽之谈的传说竟被证实为真。我们曾是一项名为“$tech_psionic_theory$”的精神科学实验的对象。

我们一族被认定具有这种天赋的潜势。许多先祖或许曾在梦境中感知到这种形式的连结，或将其误认为遥远的声音——这类现象通常会被归为精神疾病或妄想症。但他们的实验戛然而止；在最后的日子里，此地已非观测站，而是避难所。

他们关于我们社会的报告在发生了一场灾难性实验之后戛然而止——那场在其母星进行的实验鲁莽地操纵了被称为§H“虚境”§!的次元屏障。其科学家将此事变称为“大清算”，我们怀疑这一切正是大灾变的真正源头。

无论这场事变本质为何，其影响很快蔓延至§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!。他们最后的时刻被记录在一条简短的日志中：

§L终焉已至。§!
entries.en:
The database on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! has been deciphered, proving many of our discredited legends to be true. We were the subject of an experiment in the mental science known as '$tech_psionic_theory$'.

Our species was determined to have this latent potential. Many of our ancestors would have sensed these communications in dreams or as distant voices, phenomena that might otherwise indicate mental illness or paranoia. However, their experiment was cut short; in its last days, this place was no observation post, but a survival shelter.

Their reports on our society cease after a disastrous experiment on their capital world involving the reckless manipulation of the barrier between realities known as §H'the Shroud'§!. Their scientists referred to this incident as 'The Reckoning', and we suspect this was the true source of the cataclysm.

Whatever this incident was, its influence soon extended to §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!. Their last moments are recorded in a single log entry:

§LThe End has come.§!

entries.zh:
我们已找到引发这场灾变的确凿证据。其踪迹并不难寻；§H[Leader.GetName]§!声称能感知到它在召唤着[Leader.GetHimHer]。

在这座设施深处，存在着超越常规认知的脉动虚体。这个既非物质亦非能量的存在，§H[Leader.GetName]§!将其描述为，被吞噬意志聚集而成的怨念残响，并称之为§H“$fragment_of_reckoning$”§!。

该物体原本旨在收集并导引来自§H虚境§!的灵界能量，作为对抗“大清算”的防御手段。但这项计划仅取得部分成功。在这个星球迎来终末的最后时刻，这个饱含恶意的存在被强行驱逐出本维度，同时裹挟走了研究人员们不甘的意志。如今唯余这片残骸。

这个物体会强化研究人员的幻觉与灵视，赋予他们超越现实局限的第二视觉。这既是危险的诱惑，却也蕴含着无限可能。
entries.en:
We have found definitive evidence of the cataclysm's source. It was not difficult to find; §H[Leader.GetName]§! claims it called out to [Leader.GetHimHer].

Deep within the facility, defying conventional analysis, a pulsing intangible mass has been identified. Existing neither as matter nor energy, §H[Leader.GetName]§! has described it as the lingering resentment of consumed wills, referring to it as a §H'$fragment_of_reckoning$'§!.

In a misguided effort to contain and channel the ethereal energies of the §HShroud§!, this object was intended to be used as defense against the Reckoning. However, it was only partially successful. In the last moments of this world, the malevolent entity was forcibly banished from this dimension, taking the unwilling minds of the scientists with it. This fragment is now all that remains.

This object amplifies the visions and hallucinations of our researchers, granting them a second sight beyond this limited reality. It is a dangerous but promising proposition.

entries.zh: 我们还有许多要学习的……
entries.en: We still have much to learn...

entries.zh: 我们在§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!上发现的灵能碎片蕴藏着诸多必须破解的奥秘。\n\n阻碍我们的正是自身思维的局限。
entries.en: The fragment of psionic energy we discovered on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! holds secrets we must unlock.\n\nWe are held back by the limitations of our own mind.

entries.zh:
灵能领域的最近研究进展证实，现实存在迄今不可见的维度，而我们的意识正是通往这些维度的门户。在这层帷幕之外，是一片我们难以理解的混沌领域。

从领域的最深处，一个§R心声§!在召唤。它许诺的不是救赎，而是一个新的开端。若要驾驭其不可知的力量，就必须抛弃我们原有的全部存在，在疯狂本身编织的命理中锻造新的命运。

§R“时机已至。”§!
entries.en:
Research into the recently discovered field of Psionics has confirmed the existence of hitherto unseen dimensions of reality, to which our minds are the gateway. Beyond this veil lies a realm of chaos we struggle to understand.

From within the depths, a §RVoice§! beckons. Its promise is not of salvation, but of a new beginning. To wield its unknowable power would be to abandon all we were, and to forge a fate inscribed in the fabric of madness itself.

§R"IT IS TIME."§!

entries.zh: 我们的帝国由唯一一个目标驱动着：追寻§R心声§!。在找到之前我们的内心绝不会停歇。
entries.en: Our empire is driven with singular focus and purpose: the pursuit of the §RVoice§!. Our minds will not rest until we find resolution.

entries.zh: 我们的帝国越来越靠近§R心声§!。驱使我们的冲动减弱了。
entries.en: Our empire draws closer to the §RVoice§!. Our driven impulses are lessened in their intensity.

entries.zh: 我们的帝国几乎要听到§R心声§!了。很快我就就能理解。
entries.en: Our empire can almost hear the §RVoice§!. Soon, we will understand.

entries.zh: 心声一旦得以聆听，就不能置之不理。我们唯有屈从它的意志。
entries.en: Once the Voice is heard, it cannot be ignored. We yield to its will.

entries.zh: 来自帝国各地的灵能个体被带至此地，在隔绝干扰的静默密室中与虚境进行对话。
entries.en: From all across our empire, psionic individuals are brought here to commune with the Shroud in chambers of protective silence.
Reduces the negative effects of ['modifier:endbringers_madness_1'] by §G$@chamber_of_silence_effect_mult|0%$§!.
Reduces the negative effects of ['modifier:endbringers_madness_2'] by §G$@chamber_of_silence_effect_mult|0%$§!.
Reduces the negative effects of ['modifier:endbringers_madness_3'] by §G$@chamber_of_silence_effect_mult|0%$§!.
Reduces the negative effects of ['modifier:endbringers_paranoia'] by §G$@chamber_of_silence_effect_mult|0%$§!.

entries.zh: §R如果失去该殖民地，该建筑将会被摧毁。§!
entries.en: §RThis building will be destroyed if this colony is lost.§!

entries.zh:
我们被召唤去往更高的存在层次。为了维护我们飞升的神圣性，顽固进行徒劳抵抗的人正在被逐步清除。我们的命运已注定；而我们身后的路已坍塌进$pc_shrouded$之影中。

§R心声§!以令人信服之清晰向我们开口。

§R“大道已定。”§!

祂渴望着自愿的献祭。
entries.en:
We have been called to higher levels of existence. Those among us who clung to fruitless resistance are being purged to preserve the sanctity of our ascension. Our fate is sealed; the way behind us has crumbled into the shadow of the $pc_shrouded$.

The §RVoice§! speaks to us now with compelling clarity.

§R"THE PATH IS SET."§!

It longs for willing sacrifice.

entries.zh: 我们要去的地方无需[Owner.Species.GetEyeNamePlural]便能看见。
entries.en: Where we are going, we won't need [Owner.Species.GetEyeNamePlural] to see.
Adds the ['trait:trait_blindness'] trait to $@nb_blinded_pop|0$ £pop£ §HPops§! per month

entries.zh: 肉体局限扼杀了我们的转变之路。
entries.en: The boundaries of our flesh stifle the path to transformation.

entries.zh: 我们将去之地无需[Species.GetEyeNamePlural]去看。
entries.en: Where we are going, we won't need [Species.GetEyeNamePlural] to see.

entries.zh: 随着我们逐渐掌握灵能，帷幕彼端的纷乱低语开始袭扰我们。§R心声§!，必以往更加响亮清晰，它盘旋着穿过这些思想之流，进入我们心智的影中。\n\n§R“打开道路。”§!
entries.en: As our psionic mastery grows, we are bombarded by a tangle of whispers from beyond the veil. The §RVoice§!, louder and clearer than ever before, spirals its way through these currents of thought and into the shadows of our mind.\n\n§R\"OPEN THE WAY.\"§!

entries.zh: 我们必须滤除这些噪声。
entries.en: We must filter through this noise.

entries.zh: 一座隔离设施，我们最有灵能天赋的人可以在里面以令人愉悦的清晰度听到§R心声§!的指令。
entries.en: an insulated facility where our most psionically gifted individuals will be able to listen to the instructions of the §RVoice§! in blissful clarity.

entries.zh: 我们的思想更加敞开了。
采纳§H$tr_psionics_endbringers_cult$§!传统并建造一座§H$building_chamber_of_silence$§!建筑以推进局势。
entries.en: Adopt the §H$tr_psionics_endbringers_cult$§! tradition and construct a §H$building_chamber_of_silence$§! building to progress the Situation.

entries.zh:
在$building_chamber_of_silence$里，我们以绝佳的清晰度听着§R心声§!的信息。

§R“一切将会重生。”§!

我们理解了。终末是一种新生，我们无需恐惧，因为我们将会被重塑，重塑比我们一切想象都要更好更强。

为了抓住这种命运，我们必须学会驾驭被称为§H虚境§!的精神界。我们不会重蹈$pc_shrouded$上发现的那些人的覆辙。他们抗拒恐惧，而我们欣然接受。
entries.en:
In the $building_chamber_of_silence$, we hear the message of the §RVoice§! with perfect clarity.

§R"ALL WILL BE REBORN."§!

We understand now. The End is a rebirth. We must not fear it. We will be remade. Better and more powerful than we ever imagined we could be.

To seize this destiny, we must learn to master the mental realm known as the §HShroud§!. We will not repeat the mistakes of those we found on the $pc_shrouded$. Where they rejected their fear, we will embrace it.

entries.zh: 我们的视野完全清晰了。

entries.en: Adopt the §H$tr_psionics_shroud_great_awakening$§! tradition to progress the Situation.

entries.zh:
§H[blinded_leader.GetName]§!为我们指明了方向。我们的外部感官会掩盖掉这种§R心声§!的呼唤。去掉一种感官，我们就能让心灵的力量进一步提升。

就此而言，放弃我们的[Species.GetEyeNamePlural]是最有效的。在物质界的视觉会阻碍我们的§H虚境§!视野。许多[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经以§H[blinded_leader.GetName]§!为模范，毫不犹豫地去掉了自己的[Species.GetEyeNamePlural]。

选择如此的人汇报称，那种§R心声§!赞许地充盈着他们的脑海，他们会随之感到一阵满足。
entries.en:
§H[blinded_leader.GetName]§! has shown us the way. Our extraneous senses muffle the call of the §RVoice§!. By removing one, we can elevate our psychic abilities even further.

Relinquishing our [Species.GetEyeNamePlural] is the most effective in this regard. Our vision in the physical realm obscures our view into the §HShroud§!. Many [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have already followed §H[blinded_leader.GetName]§!'s inspiring example, removing their [Species.GetEyeNamePlural] without hesitation.

Those who elect to do so report a surge of contentment as the §RVoice§! fills their mind with its approval.
There are such sights yet to be seen.

entries.zh:
§H[forsaken_leader.GetName]§!对肉体凡胎的限制感到沮丧，试着通过戏剧化地公开服下致命毒素加速[forsaken_leader.GetHisHer]的灵能转变。

[forsaken_leader.GetHeShe]一死去，[forsaken_leader.GetHisHer]的尸体就被一种鲜艳的紫色所吞噬，分解成纯灵能的细尘。这样的神迹正是通过§R心声§!的意志实现的。

我们认为这是一个很明显的信号；§H[forsaken_leader.GetName]§!去到哪里，所有人必然跟随。
entries.en:
Frustrated by the limitations of our flesh, §H[forsaken_leader.GetName]§! has sought to accelerate [forsaken_leader.GetHisHer] psionic transformation by imbibing a lethal toxin in dramatic public display.

As [forsaken_leader.GetHeShe] expired, [forsaken_leader.GetHisHer] body was consumed by a vivid purple hue and disintegrated into a fine dust of pure psionic energy. Such miracles become possible through the will of the §RVoice§!.

We have taken this as a clear sign; where §H[forsaken_leader.GetName]§! led, others must follow.

entries.zh: 不能让我们的身体拖了后退。
entries.en: Our physical form cannot hold us back.

entries.zh: 有些[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]难以与§R心声§!和谐共生。\n\n这些最弱者们绝望地乞求平静，最终采取了粗暴而违规的前额叶切除手术。如果不采取行动，这种做法可能会变得普遍。
entries.en: Some [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are struggling to live in harmony with the presence of the §RVoice§!.\n\nDesperate for peace, the weakest among us have resorted to crude and unregulated lobotomy procedures. Such practices threaten to become widespread if no action is taken.

entries.zh: 这些弱者就随他们便吧。
entries.en: Let the weak do what they must.

entries.zh: §R心声§!是份恩赐。禁止这种行为。
entries.en: The §RVoice§! is a gift. Ban this practice.

entries.zh: 心声开口时，我们唯有听从。
entries.en: When the voices speak, we have no choice but to listen.

entries.zh:
我们继续拥抱§R心声§!。祂开始阐述一些简单而无可拒绝的真理。

许多[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始找寻更多能增强§R心声§!以便更直地受到这种智慧佑助的方法。

黑市药物的使用量飙升。不受监管的医疗设施开始提供实验性服务，帮助个体最大化灵能敏感度。

这究竟会带来什么后果？
entries.en:
We continue to embrace the §RVoice§!. It speaks plain truths to us that cannot be denied.

Many [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are seeking further ways to amplify the §RVoice§! and benefit from its wisdom more directly.

The use of black-market drugs has increased dramatically. Unregulated medical facilities are offering experimental services to help individuals maximize their psionic sensitivity.

Where will this lead us?

entries.zh: 不惜一切代价带来§R心声§!。
entries.en: Do all we can to bring forth the §RVoice§!.

entries.zh: 必须警惕全面无政府状态。

随着我们的灵能力量与日俱增，[owner.GetSpeciesAdj]人口开始受到预兆着宇宙终结的恐怖梦魇的困扰。

我们的梦已经称为末世预言，加剧了人们的存在主义恐惧。睡眠已被不安的麻木所取代，许多人无法继续正常的日常生活。

在这些梦中，§R心声§!对我们说。

§R“接纳熵吧。”§!
entries.en:
As our psionic abilities have grown, the [owner.GetSpeciesAdj] population has become plagued by horrifying nightmares foreshadowing the end of the universe.

Our dreams have become apocalyptic prophecies, intensifying the existential dread felt among our people. Sleep has given way to unquiet stupor, with many unable to carry on their normal daily routines.

In these dreams, the §RVoice§! speaks to us.

§R"EMBRACE ENTROPY."§!
All beginnings must have an end.

entries.zh: 心声正在以天灾梦境干扰我们的睡眠循环。
entries.en: The Voice disturbs our sleep cycles with cataclysmic visions.

entries.zh: $building_chamber_of_silence$为遭受天灾梦魇的人提供庇护。
entries.en: The $building_chamber_of_silence$ provides shelter for those suffering from cataclysmic nightmares.

entries.zh:
民众中自残的趋势日益增长。

§R心声§!的极端虔诚者在的肉体上烙上了“终末”的标志。他们宣称这种图案会赐予承载者可怖的恩赐。

无论真假，进行这种仪式的人数正在迅速增加。这真的是§H虚境§!的旨意吗？
entries.en:
There is a growing trend of self-mutilation among the populace.

Extremely devout followers of the §RVoice§! have been branding their flesh with the symbol of 'The End'. They proclaim that these designs bestow a terrible blessing upon those who bear them.

Whether true or not, the number of practitioners engaged in such rituals is increasing rapidly. Is this truly the will of the §HShroud§!?

entries.zh: 我们自豪地背负起这个刻印。
entries.en: We bear this mark with pride.

entries.zh: 我国一半人口获得['trait:trait_marked']特质。
entries.en: Half of our population gain the ['trait:trait_marked'] trait.

entries.zh: 这个物种在肉体上烙上“终末”的刻印，作为一种可怕的效忠仪式。
entries.en: In a gruesome display of devotion, this species has branded its flesh with the mark of 'The End'.

entries.zh: 保持理智的强大决心使我们避免陷入疯狂的陷阱。
entries.en: A powerful determination to maintain sanity keeps us from spiralling into the traps of madness.

entries.zh:
$shroud.2800.intro$在它无形的深处，出现了一个力量不可估量的不祥实体。这就是§R心声§!，它以一种令人战栗的力量穿透我们最深处的心灵。

§R“认识我的名字。”§!

直到如今我们才意识到自己渺小的心灵究竟距离§R心声§!有多么地遥远。封印被击碎了，很快完整的自我将会显现出来。
entries.en:
$shroud.2800.intro$ From within its formless depths arises an ominous entity of immeasurable power. It is the §RVoice§!, and it pierces our innermost psyches with a shuddering force.

§R"KNOW MY NAME."§!

Only now do we sense how truly distant our small minds are from the §RVoice§!. The seal is fractured, and soon the full breadth of what we are shall be made manifest.

Our telepaths are now prepared to delve into the heart of the Shroud and discover the true name of our great patron.

entries.zh:
我们在[capital_scope.GetName]为着同一个目标汇聚一堂。

我们要深入§H虚境§!之中，让§R心声§!强大的力量可以认可我们，并与我们沟通。

我们称之为大灾。而其他人则叫祂清算。现在，祂将向我们揭示祂的真名，得知之后我们将成就伟业。
entries.en:
We have gathered on [capital_scope.GetName] with a singular purpose.

We will reach deep within the §HShroud§! and force the staggering power of the §RVoice§! to acknowledge and commune with us.

We have known it as the Cataclysm. Others called it the Reckoning. Now, it will reveal its true name to us, and with that knowledge we will achieve greatness.

entries.zh:
我们降入虚境，联合的意志压制住了混沌噪声，使我们专注于目标。§R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!。

但单凭目标可保护不了我们。无数心声低语着空洞的陈词滥调，意图让我们沉浸在一个比一个更没有意义，但都无比诱人的分神之事中。

我们的心神即将被撕裂时，那个实体回来了，丢下一道命令在虚空中回荡：

§R“闭嘴”。§!
entries.en:
We descend into the Shroud, our unified will helping to silence the chaotic noise that would distract us from our goal, the §R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!.

But purpose alone cannot shield us. Voices whisper empty platitudes, indulging us with paltry distractions, each more meaningless than the last, but all equally tempting.

As we begin to fracture, the entity returns. A single command reverberates through the void:

§R"SILENCE."§!

entries.zh:
这道命令劈开了混沌，扫清不和谐的噪音，荡平了那些试图吞噬我们的恼人混乱。我们在忍受着碎裂，而精神维系了下来。

§R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!退回了虚境深处。随之而来的清晰几乎同样震耳欲聋。它填补了内心的空白，留给我们了一份新的决心。

以及礼物。如此美妙的礼物。
entries.en:
This command cleaves through the chaos, scouring the discordant noise, purging the obtrusive disorder that sought to consume us. Our psyche holds as we endure the fragmentation.

The §R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§! recedes further into the Shroud. The clarity that follows is almost as deafening. It settles into gaps in our minds, leaving us with newfound resolve.

And gifts. Such wonderful gifts.

entries.zh:
当我们潜入虚境时，看到了感性的混沌正在腐败。

溃烂而懒惰的心灵产生了层层的灵能乱流，用腐臭污染着虚境。在这令人厌恶的混沌中，我们感受一种压倒一切的存在，§R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!。

随着祂逼近混沌，那种邪恶的意图饱和了我们的心灵。一道命令回响到虚空中，我们也为即将到来的赦免做好了准备：

§R“秩序。团结。”§!
entries.en:
As we delve into the Shroud, we observe a corruption of sentient chaos.

Festering, idle minds generate layers of psionic turbulence, polluting the Shroud with fetid rot. Within this odious mess, we begin to feel the overwhelming presence of our quarry, the §R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!.

The malice of its intentions saturates our psyche as it bears down upon the chaos. We brace for the impending absolution as a command resonates throughout the void:

§R"ORDER. UNITY."§!

entries.zh:
这道命令流过恶毒的混沌。

§R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!洗去那些正在荼毒虚境的感性的扭曲时，无数声音痛苦地呼喊起来来。在祂的身后留下了一片被赦免的不完美之境地。

这个实体潜回虚境的深处，只留下祂绝对净化的余波让我们观察研究。
entries.en:
The command courses through the malignant chaos.

Innumerable voices cry out in pain as the §R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§! washes away the sentient deformations plaguing the Shroud. A realm of absolved imperfections remains in its wake.

As the entity submerges itself deeper within the Shroud, we are left to observe and study the aftermath of its absolute purification.

entries.zh:
步入虚境，我们只余痛楚。翻腾的灵能迷雾化作炼狱，灼烧着我们心智的本质。

在煎熬中，我们目睹城市崩塌为熔融的废墟，行星被烈焰吞噬，无数生灵在幽火中扭曲挣扎，血肉之躯化为闷燃的灰烬。

在这焚毁万象的烈焰中心，我们感知到§R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!的存在。当它的力量即将吞噬现实时，此实体降下谕令：

§R“解禁。”§!
entries.en:
Entering the Shroud, we know only pain. The usual swirling psionic mists are an inferno, igniting the very essence of our minds.

Through the torment, we perceive cities crumbling into molten ruin, planets devoured by fire, entire populations writhing in agony as spectral flames reduce their corporeal forms to smouldering ash.

At the centre of the pyre, we detect the presence of the §R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!. As its power threatens to consume reality, the entity decrees:

§R"LIBERATION."§!

entries.zh: 灵能之火吞噬我们的思想，焚尽一切自满。只留下纯粹的决心。\n\n如今我们得以窥见§R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!的崇高使命，以及它所展现的壮丽简约。
entries.en: The psionic flames engulf our minds, burning away complacency. Leaving only a purified resolve.\n\nNow we can see the glorious purpose of the §R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§! and the magnificent simplicity it offers.

entries.zh:
一声宣告响彻寰宇：

§R“尔等皆知吾名。”§!

我们星际航行的终极目标，数个世纪疑问的答案，此刻揭晓。$end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$正召唤着我们。盟约已成。

§R“万物终焉始于斯。”§!

痛苦。扭曲。确信。当余音消散，命运已成定局。

此刻我们终得窥见。星系归于寂灭，浸没在§R$end_aura$§!无可违逆的宿命之中。
entries.en:
A declaration rings out:

§R"YOU KNOW MY NAME."§!

The culmination of our voyage to the stars, the answer to centuries of questions, is here. $end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$ compels us. Our Covenant is formed.

§R"THE END BEGINS."§!

Pain. Writhing. Certainty. As the words fade, our fate is sealed.

We see it now. A galaxy rendered silent, saturated in the inevitability of the §R$end_aura$§!.

entries.zh: 必然的命运在前方静候。
终于，我们目睹了终末之美。尽情释放吧。
entries.en: Finally, we see the beauty of the End. Let it come.

entries.zh:
我们与$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$签订契约，赐予我们无上伟力，并赋予我们神圣使命。

超主的意志要求彻底湮灭此方现实。§H$end_aura$§!每吞噬一个星系，便让慈悲的湮灭更近一步。

吾等将见证这必然的终局。

待征服星系数量：[Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]
entries.en:
Our Covenant with $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$ grants us untold power, and tasks us with glorious purpose.

The will of our patron demands complete annihilation of this reality. With each system the §H$end_aura$§! consumes, the closer merciful oblivion comes to pass.

We shall bear witness to inevitability.

Systems remaining to be conquered: [Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]

entries.zh:
动用$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$的力量需付出代价，而我们的时间所剩无几。

星海仍未浸润在我方超主净化的辉光之中。迄今为止的努力不过沧海一粟。

为见证这项伟业完成，一股新生能量正自帷幕之外奔涌而来。此乃应许之赐福！
entries.en:
The power of $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$ comes at a cost, and we are running out of time.

The galaxy remains unsaturated by our patron's cleansing Aura. Our efforts thus far amount to insignificance.

To see this monumental work completed, a surge of energy flows newly into us from beyond the veil. It is a promised blessing!

entries.zh: 我们超主的力量浩瀚无垠，但时间已所剩无几。此等渎职之举，断不为$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$的仁慈湮灭所容。\n\n尚存一线希望：我们必须不惜代价让$end_aura$吞噬整个星系。危亡之际，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]正从§H虚境§!中榨取每一分能量。
entries.en: The power of our patron is immense, but we are nearly out of time. Such flagrant incompetence will not be tolerated by the benevolent oblivion of $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$.\n\nA slim hope remains: We must engulf the galaxy in the $end_aura$, no matter the cost. In desperation, our [GetTelepathPlural] now draw every ounce of energy they can from within the §HShroud§!.

entries.zh: 星海参议院已废止将毁灭性§H$PSIONIC_AURA$§!发散器指定为防御重点的议案。因此，所有由星海共同体成员国针对§H[former_malevolent_aura.GetName]§!展开的军事行动都被立即叫停。现在，和平已经降临至星系的这一隅。
entries.en: The resolution designating the emitter of the destructive §H$PSIONIC_AURA$§! as a focus for defense efforts has been repealed by the Galactic Senate. As a result, all ongoing military operations being conducted by Community members against the §H[former_malevolent_aura.GetName]§! are to cease at once. For now, peace has returned to this corner of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 星海参议院已废止宣布将我方视为其“防御”目标的议案，所有共同体成员国均接到指令原地待命。针对我们的军事行动停止了……至少暂时如此。
entries.en: The Galactic Senate has repealed the resolution declaring us as a target for their 'defense' efforts, hence all Community members have been ordered to stand down. Military actions against us have ceased... for now.

entries.zh: 我们超主无可违逆的意志正将星海逐渐攥入掌心。此刻，我们已然知晓终焉降临的方式。\n\n必须将§R$end_aura$§!播撒至星系的每个角落。当物质界与这§H虚境§!的原始本质相融之时，真正的湮灭便将接踵而至。
entries.en: Our patron's inevitable will tightens its grip over the galaxy. We know now how the End will come.\n\nThe §R$end_aura$§! must be spread throughout the galaxy. Once the physical realm combines with this raw essence of the §HShroud§!, true annihilation will shortly follow.

entries.zh: 完成这项宏伟任务将成为我们的巅峰之作，也是通往终极救赎之门。
entries.en: Completing this monumental task will be our magnum opus and the gateway to ultimate salvation.

entries.zh: $shroud.8500.desc.intro$\n\n消灭这个星系中的所有生命将是一个令人欣慰的附带效果。$shroud.8500.desc.outro$
entries.en: $shroud.8500.desc.intro$\n\nThe eradication of all life in this galaxy will be a welcome side effect. $shroud.8500.desc.outro$

entries.zh: 这是我们的命运。\n\n§R$end_aura$§!吞噬了整个星系。我们[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上的人民正沉浸在狂热的喜悦之中，以庆祝这一时刻。
entries.en: This was our destiny.\n\nThe §R$end_aura$§! envelopes the galaxy. Our people on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] have entered a state of frenzied euphoria in celebration of

entries.zh:
一场辉煌的重生即将降临，这是我们自大觉醒时代便蒙受的应许。

眼前，万有皆被虚空吞噬。抹除与湮灭，已成为星海仅存的法则。世界接连崩塌，复归最初孕育它们的虚无。

我们终将步入终局。这景象……何其壮美。我们已窥见它在新生的脆弱形态中挣扎。终焉已至，此刻即是开端。
entries.en:
A glorious rebirth is upon us, promised from the time of our great awakening.

Before us, all of existence is consumed by the void. Erasure and annihilation have become the galaxy's only remaining laws. One by one, entire worlds collapse into the nothingness from which they once came.

We are the last to be taken. It is... beautiful. We see it already in its throes of a new, fragile form. The End has come. Now starts the Beginning.
$shroud.8600.desc.intro$ the obliteration of all that is not us. $shroud.8500.desc.outro$

entries.zh: 我们失败了。由于我们的软弱，$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$未能如期实现其辉煌的成果。现在，我们必须为自己的无能付出代价。\n\n它吞噬了一切。一瞬间，[Root.GetName]就……消失了。曾经繁荣的殖民地，如今只剩下废墟。曾经横渡虚空的强大的舰队，如今只有死寂和残骸。一切都被终结吞噬。一切都被§H虚境§!夺走。
entries.en: We have failed. As a consequence of our weakness, $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$ has not come to glorious fruition. The price we must now pay for this incompetence is upon us.\n\nIt took everything. In an instant, the [Root.GetName] was... gone. Where once there were thriving colonies, there is now only ruin. Where once mighty fleets crossed the void, there is only silence and debris. All devoured by the End. All taken by the §HShroud§!.

entries.zh: 此刻，我们的超主已在[former_capital.GetName]上空具现出一个庞大的虚境实体。通过吞噬我们灵能者的意识，它已获得无与伦比的力量，如今正游弋于星海之中，誓要完成我们未竟的使命。
entries.en: So it is now that our patron has manifested a massive Shroud entity in space above [former_capital.GetName]. Made immensely powerful by the devoured consciousnesses of our psionics, it now roams the galaxy seeking to finish the task we could not complete.

entries.zh:
$shroud.8610.desc.intro$

绝大多数[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都接受了这一命运，但仍有少数不虔者拒绝臣服于我们超主的终极意志。他们是由§H[Root.GetRulerName]§!领导的流亡者——这位强大的灵能者预见了即将降临的终局；如今这群人已躲藏到终末之威无法触及的某个星球。

$shroud.8610.desc.outro$当它完成使命之后，就会找到这群流亡者算总账。
entries.en:
$shroud.8610.desc.intro$

Most [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] embraced this destiny, but a small group of the unfaithful refused to submit to the ultimate will of our patron. They are the exiles led by §H[Root.GetRulerName]§!, a powerful psychic who knew what was to come; they have gone into hiding on a world outside the influence of the End.

$shroud.8610.desc.outro$ When it is done, it will come for the exiled as well.

entries.zh: 或许这就是我们命中注定的结局……
entries.en: Perhaps this was our fate all along...

entries.zh: 那些流亡之徒真能抵挡住它的权能吗？
entries.en: Can the exiles truly resist its might?

entries.zh:
大功告成。§R清算§!已被摧毁。

$end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$已撤退回§H虚境§!深处。它对我们物理现实构成的威胁暂时已被遏制。

当其化身的虚境残躯螺旋式地脱离此存在时，我们成功回收了其显现的物理残余物。即使在死亡中，我们的心灵感应者也能感觉到它散发出惊人的灵能，远比在§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!上回收的碎片强大。

这枚浓缩了必然性的核心可用于从幸存于此次清算的星系灰烬中重建。

末日已然降临又离去，但不知为何，我们依然存在。
entries.en:
It is done. The §RReckoning§! has been destroyed.

$end_of_the_cycle_color_article_cap$ has retreated back into the depths of the §HShroud§!. The threat it posed to our physical reality has been forestalled for now.

As the shrouded corpse of its avatar spiraled out of this existence, a physical remnant of its manifestation was successfully recovered. Even in death, our telepaths can feel it emitting staggering levels of psionic energy, vastly more powerful than the fragment recovered on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!.

This core of concentrated inevitability can be used to rebuild from the ashes of the galaxy that survived this Reckoning.

The End has come and gone, yet somehow we remain.

entries.zh: 难道这就是我们命中注定的结局吗？
entries.en: Was this to be our fate all along?

entries.zh: 从最终清算的残骸中回收而来的这枚核心仍散发着高水平的心灵能量。
entries.en: Recovered from the remains of the Reckoning, this core is still radiating high levels of psionic energy.

entries.zh: 任由虚境吞噬此地，即可恢复清算核心的平衡。
entries.en: By letting the Shroud consume this place, balance is restored to the Core of the Reckoning.

entries.zh: 把这颗星球放逐到虚境之中。
entries.en: Banish this planet to the Shroud.
Balance has been temporarily restored to the $r_core_of_the_reckoning$.
Double the passive effects of the §Y$r_core_of_the_reckoning$§!.

entries.zh: $the_cradle_of_souls_article$的一位虔诚弟子，渴望寻求祂的深刻真理，也渴望与能接受的人分享。
entries.en: A devout disciple of $the_cradle_of_souls_article$, eager to seek out and share its profound truths with those who have the means to receive them.

entries.zh: 我们依偎在月窠的怀抱里。
entries.en: We fold into the Cradle's embrace.

entries.zh: 我们观察得越多，知道的也就越多；随着我们观察邻居，$the_cradle_of_souls_article$变得愈发安全。
entries.en: The more we see the more we know, $the_cradle_of_souls_article$ grows more secure as we observe our neighbors.

entries.zh: $t$—指派给超主的特使每月产生§G+0.5§!£zro£§Y$sr_zro$§!
entries.en: $t$- Envoys assigned to Patrons generate §G+0.5§! £zro£ §Y$sr_zro$§! per month

entries.zh: §H我们与虚境的共鸣引来了一个向我们示好的新声音。它温暖、抚慰的语调在物质与精神领域同时回响。§!\n\n问候。我是甘图亚塔，前来寻找那些觉醒于真道的同路人。你可曾听闻$the_cradle_of_souls_article$的启示？
entries.en: §HOur communion with the Shroud has invited a new voice that reaches out to us. Its warm, soothing tones echo in both the physical and mental realms.§!\n\nGreetings. I am Ganthuata, and I have come seeking like-minded individuals who have awoken to the true path. Have you heard the message of $the_cradle_of_souls_article$?

entries.zh: 我们听到了$the_cradle_of_souls_article$的。你为什么这么问？
entries.en: We have heard $the_cradle_of_souls_article$. Why do you ask?

entries.zh: 为什么？你说，旅行者为什么要向路上遇见的人提问？当然是为了理解他们所问的人，朋友。你在多嘴时，我在虚心学习。
entries.en: Why? What compels any wayfarer to question those they meet along the path? To better understand the one they seek an answer from, friend. When you speak, I learn.

entries.zh: 你想要从我们这里得到什么？
entries.en: What do you want from us?

entries.zh: 受月窠哺育之人，所求为何？ 首先，我寻觅的是你的友谊。 我已寻觅了一个时代，只为找到与月窠的辉煌相契合的心灵。 如今，一个完整的文明在其光芒中萌动。
entries.en: What do those nurtured by the Cradle long for? I seek your friendship, to begin with. I have searched an age for minds attuned to the Cradle's splendor, and now, a whole civilization stirs within its light.

entries.zh: 我将帮助你把讯息传遍星海。让我们携手，迎接整个星系进入月窠的温柔怀抱。
entries.en: I will help carry your message across the stars. Together, let us welcome the galaxy into the Cradle's gentle embrace.

entries.zh: §Y$ganthuata$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入我们帝国。
一名曾遭[Root.GetHisHer]的敌人施加极端灵能折磨的退伍军人。如今，这位饱受折磨的海军上将已被永不餍足的毁灭欲望所驱使。
entries.en: A former soldier subjected to extreme psionic torture at the hands of [Root.GetHisHer] enemies long ago. Now a tormented admiral driven by an insatiable appetite for destruction.

entries.zh: 有些流血牺牲是必要的。
entries.en: There is blood to be spilled.
This leader has taken a blood vow with $the_eater_of_worlds_article$.
§G+$@disciple_of_the_eater_combat_attunement$§! Attunement to $the_eater_of_worlds_article$ per Fleet Combat won
$t$- §G+$@disciple_of_the_eater_zro_fleet_attack|1$§! $i_zro$ per 1% of devastation inflicted by orbital bombardment
$t$- §G+$@disciple_of_the_eater_zro_army_attack|0$§! $i_zro$ per 1% of devastation inflicted by assault armies

entries.zh:
§H战损的铠甲、血染的披风下是一个蒙面人。一阵嘶哑的咆哮声划破了寂静。§!

这个星系受苦是应得的。我感觉你们也是这么想的。

§H这位舰队司令一边说着，[shroud_leader.GetHeShe]抚摸着一把刀刃华丽的武器的刀柄。§!

我被召唤到你身边，但最终我还是效忠于$the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$。
entries.en:
§HBattle-worn armor and a blood-smeared cloak conceal a masked figure. A hoarse growl cuts through the quiet.§!

This galaxy deserves to suffer. I sense that you feel the same way.

§HAs the admiral speaks, [shroud_leader.GetHeShe] strokes the hilt of an ornate bladed weapon.§!

I have been called to you, but ultimately I serve $the_eater_of_worlds_color_article$.

entries.zh: 你们为什么要加入我们？
entries.en: Why do you wish to join us?

entries.zh: 我们携手便能扼住星海每个角落的星辰。单凭一己之力能播撒的苦难终究有限。
entries.en: Together we can choke the stars in every corner of this galaxy. There is only so much suffering one can sow on their own.

entries.zh: $the_eater_of_worlds_article_cap$主宰着我的每一次呼吸。我宣誓效忠于它，并已在梦中预见此刻。侍奉您正是它的意志。若遭拒绝，我的命运便将终结。
entries.en: $the_eater_of_worlds_article_cap$ commands my every breath. I am sworn to its service, and have seen this moment in my dreams. It is its will that I serve you. Your rejection would seal my fate.

entries.zh: 我曾遭人背叛，支离破碎，被抛入痛苦的深渊。$the_eater_of_worlds_article_cap$向我低语。它赐予我绝境求生所需之物——染血的布条覆上淋漓的伤口。它赋予我斩断施虐之手的权能。如今，我欠下了这笔血债。
entries.en: I was betrayed, broken, and cast into agony. $the_eater_of_worlds_article_cap$ spoke to me. It blessed me with what was needed to survive in that moment... a bloodied cloth over bloodied wounds. It gave me the power to sever the hands that wrought my suffering. Now, I am in its debt.

entries.zh: 我们将一同以涤荡之火洗礼无数星系，在哀嚎交响曲中喰饮饕餮盛宴。我们将目睹世界焚毁，一同向星海展示它永世难忘之景。此乃吾等宿命。
entries.en: Together, we will bathe countless systems in cleansing flames, and feast on a symphony of screams. We will watch worlds burn. Together, we will show the galaxy things it can never forget. This is our destiny.

entries.zh: §Y$koborokra$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
他曾经是一个卑微的勘探者，长期暴露在不稳定的$zro_lower$矿脉中，与$the_instrument_of_desire_article$建立了一种强大而令人疯狂的纽带。后来他利用这种关系获得了淫靡的财富，露天采矿星球，并以勒索般的价格出售战利品。
entries.en: Once a lowly prospector, their prolonged exposure to unstable $zro_lower$ veins forged a potent, maddening bond with $the_instrument_of_desire_article$. Now, they've leveraged that connection to obtain obscene wealth, strip-mining worlds and selling their spoils at extortionate prices.

entries.zh: 一切闪闪发光的都是我们的。
这位领袖与$the_instrument_of_desire_article$深度调和，甚至可以在星系最荒凉的角落预见资源的存在。
entries.en: Deeply attuned to $the_instrument_of_desire_article$, this leader can divine the presence of resources even in the most inhospitable corners of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 在$the_instrument_of_desire_article$的神秘引力的带领下，这个星球的总督找到了迷失已久的资源储藏。
entries.en: Guided by $the_instrument_of_desire_article$'s cryptic pull, this planet's governor unveils resource deposits long thought lost.

entries.zh: 随机添加一个资源类行星特征。
entries.en: Adds a random resource Planetary Feature.

entries.zh:
§H$morr$的眼光永远在扫视着，在光影之间游离，如同永恒的狩猎一般。§!

你也感受到了，对吧？$the_instrument_of_desire_article_cap$永恒变化。它渴望着、吞噬着、命令着。

我会夺走所见的一切。大自然的一切馈赠都逃不过我。我为你服务，不是出于忠诚，而是因为我们可以一起扫清群星，填补应有的虚空。
entries.en:
§H$morr$'s gaze never settles, flitting from shadow to shine, as if forever hunting.§!

You feel it too, don't you? $the_instrument_of_desire_article_cap$ is never still. It craves. It devours. It commands.

What I see, I take. No bounty of nature has withstood my will. I offer you my service, not out of loyalty, but because together, we can raze the stars and feed the void its due.

entries.zh: 你们为什么要加入我们？
entries.en: Why do you wish to join us?

entries.zh: $the_instrument_of_desire_article_cap$永不满足。祂需要许多双[root.species.GetHandNamePlural]的劳作才能取悦祂。
entries.en: $the_instrument_of_desire_article_cap$ is quenchless. It requires the work of many [root.species.GetHandNamePlural] to please it.

entries.zh: 我可以帮你提取自然界中每一个有利可图的分子。每一个原子都会被认领、标记、贩卖。\n\n知足就是懦弱。真是可悲。让那些人腐烂吧，让我们一起征服一切。
entries.en: I can help you extract every last monetizable molecule nature possesses. Not a single atom will go unclaimed, unbranded, or unsold.\n\nThose who whisper 'enough' are cowards. Pathetic. Let them rot. Together we will take it all.

entries.zh:
我曾经是一名勘探者，追逐着繁星能给予的一切矿物。灰尘弥漫的空气，坏掉的扫描仪，空洞的声明……然后$the_instrument_of_desire_article$开口了。

祂承诺带来难以想象的财富，所要求的只是忠诚。

如今我效忠、提取、供奉。债务是永恒的……但是财富？财富永无止境。
entries.en:
I was once a prospector, chasing every mineral rush the stars could throw at me. Dust-choked air, broken scanners, empty claims... until $the_instrument_of_desire_article$ spoke.

It promised wealth beyond comprehension. All it asked for was allegiance.

Now I serve. I extract. I deliver. The debt is eternal... but the riches? Oh, the riches never end.

entries.zh: §Y$morr$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
曾是一位远见卓识的天才，如今却沦为破碎的空壳，这位离群索居的科学家已被$the_composer_of_strands_article$的阴谋所扭曲。唯有其惊人的智慧尚存，如同黑暗中将熄的星辰般明灭不定。
entries.en: Once a visionary mind, now a fractured shell, this reclusive scientist has been twisted by the schemes of $the_composer_of_strands_article$. Only their staggering intellect remains, flickering like a dying star in the dark.

entries.zh: 此人塑造的血肉越多，自身的形态便崩解愈甚。$the_composer_of_strands_article_cap$以禁忌之术重塑所有胆敢研习此道者。
entries.en: The more flesh they shape, the more their own unravels. $the_composer_of_strands_article_cap$ remakes all who dare to learn its forbidden art.

entries.zh:
§H当我们的敏感器侦测到一艘飞船正突破边界时，一个紧绷的声音回荡在虚境——疲惫、尖锐，却带着令人不安的熟悉感，如同$the_composer_of_strands_article$的低鸣。§!

新生的……[GetKronenFlesh]？有趣。如此柔软。如此……可塑。还是说并非如此？难以断言。无数扭结在[GetKronenSkin]之下蠕动。今日$the_composer_of_strands_article$为我编织了何等形态？

§H通讯终于稳定，显露出一个由原生蠕动的肌肉构成的身影——痉挛着，癫狂书写。§!

你目睹了我的本相。或许我仍是$kronen$，或许已非。但我能感知你，如我一般，是铺展在织缕之主笔下的画布。来吧。让我们开始揭幕。
entries.en:
§HAs our sensors detect a vessel breaching our borders, a strained voice echoes across the Shroud - tired, shrill, yet disturbingly familiar, like the hum of $the_composer_of_strands_article$.§!

New... [GetKronenFlesh]? Intriguing. So soft. So... mutable. Or is it? Hard to say. So many knots shifting beneath the [GetKronenSkin]. What form has $the_composer_of_strands_article$ spun for me today?

§HThe comms finally stabilize, revealing a figure of raw, shifting muscle - convulsing, scribbling frantically.§!

You see me, as I am. Perhaps I am still $kronen$. Perhaps not. But I feel you, like me, a canvas stretched for the Composer's brush. Come. Let us begin the unveiling.

entries.zh: 为何，当然是蜕变了。抛弃这些粗糙、不完美的躯壳。解开将我们束缚于形态、束缚于确定的丝缕。织缕之主的刻印也在你身上。你早已开始……难道没感觉到它在你的[GetSkinType]下悸动吗？
entries.en: Why, the shedding, of course. The discarding of these crude, imperfect husks. The unweaving of the strands that bind us to shape, to certainty. The Composer's touch is upon you, too. You've already begun... haven't you felt it twitching beneath your [GetSkinType]?
Why do you want to join us?

entries.zh: 你感受不到吗？那印记，深烙在每一根颤动的丝缕中。我必须拆解自身，褪去旧我，见证自我崩解的过程，撕开缝合血肉的针脚。但你……你是一个帝国。浩瀚无垠。无所不能。若我们联手，便能牵动远超你我独自所能企及的宏大脉络。
entries.en: You don't feel it? The mark, pressed into every trembling strand. I must unravel, shed what I was, witness my unbecoming as I tear free the stitches that bind me to flesh. But you... you are an empire. Vast. Capable. Together, we could tug at threads far greater than either of us could grasp alone.

entries.zh: 我所给予的不只是帮助。我的血肉是一份礼物，一场关于痛苦与意义的实验，由$the_composer_of_strands_article$亲手雕琢。我的每一寸纤维都在嘶吼，但我承受着。我研究。我学习。而我所有苦难的结晶……皆由你来塑造。只要我们共同塑造它。
entries.en: I offer more than help. My flesh is a gift, an experiment in pain and purpose, sculpted by $the_composer_of_strands_article$. Every fiber of me screams, but I endure. I study. I learn. And all that my suffering yields... is yours to shape. So long as we shape it together.

entries.zh: §Y$kronen$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
§H随着人群开始肿胀，$kronen$变得愈发狂躁。他们的声音因紧绷而颤抖，形体抽搐、波动，血肉在剧变中翻腾，发出挫败的嘶吼。§!\n\n那些丝线，无穷无尽……它们扭动着，我拉扯，我撕扯，可编织纹丝不动！这具可憎的皮囊我还要忍受多久？还要剥落多少层，才能窥见其中真谛？
entries.en: §HAs our population swells, $kronen$ grows ever more frenzied. Their voice quivers with strain, their form twitching, rippling, flesh in flux as they rasp in frustration.§!\n\nThe strands, endless... they writhe, I pull, I tear, yet the weave holds! How much longer must I endure this wretched shape? How much more must I shed before the pattern reveals itself?

entries.zh: 问题？单数？哈，多么天真。我每撕去一丝，我们每扯断一缕闪亮的细线，那些丝线只会缠得更紧！而自始至终，$the_composer_of_strands_article$都在哼唱着它那令人作呕、直击内脏的旋律……
entries.en: Problem? Singular? Oh, how quaint. Every shred I slough away, every glistening strand we tear, the threads only tighten! And all the while, $the_composer_of_strands_article$ hums its sickening, visceral melody...

entries.zh: 休息？不，永不。我们绝不能停滞不前，绝不能让这具可悲的肉体在平庸中腐朽。我不需要休息……我需要实验对象。需要可塑的材料，需要雕琢的素材，需要蜕变的根基。
entries.en: A break? No, never. We must not stagnate, must not let this wretched flesh rot in mediocrity. I don't need rest... I need subjects. I need material to mold, to sculpt, to become.
Can we do anything to help?

entries.zh: 你能提醒我……我曾是什么模样吗？告诉我，当我们初次交谈时，我的肢体始终是这种颜色吗？我的角膜曾这般浑浊吗？每当试图回忆，我的血肉就在这条路上陷得更深。\n\n不……记忆在此毫无价值。启示藏于变化本身。对$the_composer_of_strands_article$而言，过往已毫无意义。退下吧。我必须……思考。
entries.en: Can you remind me... what I was? Tell me, when we first spoke, were my appendages always this color? Was my cornea ever this clouded? Each time I try to remember, my flesh shifts further along the path.\n\nNo... memory has no value here. Revelation lies in the change itself. What came before means nothing to $the_composer_of_strands_article$ now. Leave me. I must... think.

entries.zh: §H克罗南剧烈地抽搐着。那只独眼翻白，皮下血肉脉动、翻涌，随后突然……静止。这荒诞扭结的重组如同其开始时一样骤然停止。§!\n\n啊……你好。需要什么吗？
entries.en: §HKronen convulses violently. Their lone eye rolls back, flesh pulsing, bubbling beneath the surface, then, suddenly... stillness. The grotesque restructuring halts as abruptly as it began.§!\n\nAh... hello. Did you need something?

entries.zh: 当然。我为何不该如此？这些丝缕进一步开拓了我的思维，将这具低效的血肉之躯重塑，以更契合$the_composer_of_strands_article$的设计。现在，请恕我失陪……还有如此多的线头需要梳理。如此多的躯壳亟待抛弃。\n\n§H当通讯终止时，一阵共鸣在虚境中嗡鸣。无论此刻笼罩克罗南的灾厄为何……都绝非偶然。此乃$the_composer_of_strands_article$的意志§!
entries.en: Of course. Why wouldn't I be? The strands have opened my mind even further, reshaped this inefficient flesh to better fit $the_composer_of_strands_article$'s design. Now, if you'll excuse me... there are still so many threads to pull. So many husks to leave behind.\n\n§HAs the transmission ends, a resonance hums across the Shroud. Whatever affliction grips Kronen now... it is no accident. It is the will of $the_composer_of_strands_article$.§!

entries.zh: 织缕之主的馈赠不可等闲视之。
entries.en: A gift from the Composer should not be taken lightly.

entries.zh: 一位学者，摒弃了传统科学研究的局限，转而追寻$whisperers_in_the_void_article$的狂热回响中所揭示的秘密。
entries.en: A scholar who abandoned the limitations of conventional scientific study to chase the secrets revealed by the frenzied echoes of $whisperers_in_the_void_article$.

entries.zh:
§H通讯阵列突然刺啦作响，一个声音带着诡异的紧迫感低语道。§!

向你致意，同频的聆听者。我在喧嚣中听见了你的声音——不，是*众声*。你现在也听见它们了吧？$whisperers_in_the_void_color_article$的宏大合唱，他们窃窃私语的馈赠，他们呢喃的癫狂？

此等奥秘对无力参悟之人尤为凶险。但我可助你抽丝剥茧。当你面对撕扯思维的悖论洪流时，我愿施以援手。无意冒犯。曾几何时，就连我也难以参透其真意。
entries.en:
§HThe communication array crackles to life as a voice murmurs with eerie urgency.§!
