Greetings, fellow listener. I heard your voice - no, *voices* - amid the cacophony. You hear them too now, don't you? The great chorus of $whisperers_in_the_void_color_article$, their hushed gifts, their murmured hysteria?

Such secrets are perilous to those who cannot comprehend them. But I can help you unravel them. I offer my aid as you face the overwhelming flood of paradoxes clawing at your thoughts. No insult meant. Once, even I struggled to understand their true meanings.

entries.zh: 为什么你觉得你可以帮得上忙？
entries.en: What makes you think you can help?

entries.zh: 你已突破§H虚境§!的帷幕，不是吗？但告诉我，你可曾真正掌控它？我穷尽一生勘测其深渊，绘制其中不可名状的实体轨迹，以及它们在我们脆弱世界的回响。\n\n低语之主始终指引着我。那些如今充斥你思维的癫狂呢喃？我能助你理解它们。
entries.en: You've pierced the veil of the §HShroud§!, haven't you? But tell me, have you mastered it? I have spent a lifetime charting its depths, mapping the unfathomable drift of its entities and their echoes upon our fragile realm.\n\nThe Whisperers have long guided me. Every maddening utterance now crowding your thoughts? I can help you understand them.

entries.zh: 你对于低语之主有何了解？
entries.en: What do you know of the Whisperers?

entries.zh: 多年来，我一直在记录祂的低语，等待的就是这一刻。如今你已与他们纷繁的合唱同频共振，我绝不会浪费这个机会，去挖掘深埋其中的真相。
entries.en: I have catalogued their whispers for years, waiting for this very moment. Now you are aligned with their manifold chorus, and I will not waste this chance to glean the truths buried within.

entries.zh: 毕生的钻研磨砺出我的专注，让我得以解析物质现实的构造与§H虚境§!那无垠的深渊。\n\n我们将共同突破此位面的桎梏。宇宙的奥秘终将被我们揭开。我以绝对的确定性向你们承诺。
entries.en: A lifetime of study has honed my focus, unraveling the structures of our physical reality and the boundless depths of the §HShroud§!.\n\nTogether, we will break free from the limits of this plane. The secrets of the universe will be ours to uncover. That, I promise, with absolute certainty.

entries.zh: §Y$zulyn$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
这位领袖聆听$whisperers_in_the_void_article$在虚境中的回响，由此获得了关于物理宇宙隐藏机制的罕见科学洞见。
entries.en: This leader hears $whisperers_in_the_void_article$ echoing through the Shroud, granting rare scientific insight into the hidden mechanisms of the physical universe.

entries.zh: 由于亲自见证了$end_of_the_cycle_article$，奥伏戎被逐出自己所出身的流浪氏族，自此在星际间漂泊，寻求命运的眷顾。如今，随着$NAME_Reckoning$的临近，此人燃起炽热的目标，誓不罢休。
entries.en: Exiled from their nomadic clan after bearing witness to $end_of_the_cycle_article$, Ouw'ron has wandered the stars in search of its favor. Now, with the $NAME_Reckoning$ on the horizon, they burn with purpose, and they will not be denied

entries.zh: §H我们的通讯阵列被一阵难以理解的信号狂潮淹没。在这片混沌中，一个声音开始穿透而出。§!\n\n终于，你来了。不算准时，但也不算太迟。无需畏惧，我能看穿这个被我们称为现实的物质牢笼的狭隘边界。祭品已然献上，我的道路清晰可见。
entries.en: §HAn incomprehensible flurry of signals floods our communications array. Amid the chaos, a single voice begins to pierce through.§!\n\nAt last, you've come. Not punctual, but not too late either. Fear not, I see beyond the narrow bounds of this physical prison we call reality. The offering has been made. My path is clear.

entries.zh: \n§H我们这才意识到：与我们一样，这个存在也为最光辉的灭绝事业献出了自己的视力。§!
entries.en: \n§HIt is then we realize: like us, this being has surrendered their sight in service to the cause.§!

entries.zh: \n§H这时我们才注意到，此人的眼窝空空如也，早已被摈弃。§!
entries.en: \n§HIt is then we notice, their eye sockets are empty, long since abandoned.§!

entries.zh: \n得了吧，别害羞。我知道你已窥见$end_of_the_cycle_color_article$那超凡的简洁。与我一同共鸣，我们将共同促使它显现。
entries.en: \nCome now, don't be shy. I know you've glimpsed the sublime simplicity of $end_of_the_cycle_color_article$. Join me in communion, and together we shall compel its emergence.

entries.zh: 你知晓$end_of_the_cycle_article$的存在有多久了？
entries.en: How long have you known of $end_of_the_cycle_article$?

entries.zh: 比我的意识更为久远。与所有心智一样，知识沉睡不显，直至§H虚境§!揭开面纱。其纯粹意图便在此刻昭然若揭。我们的目的很简单：引领终焉降临
entries.en: Longer than I've been conscious. As with all minds, the knowledge lies dormant, until the §HShroud§! peels back the veil. There, its pure intent becomes clear. Our purpose is simple: to usher in the end

entries.zh: 你为什么想要帮助我们？
entries.en: Why do you want to help us?

entries.zh: 你问的正是你已知之事。我们都已目睹其必然性。崩解已然开始。唯有前行，别无他途。我们一同盘旋，终将抵达结局。
entries.en: You ask what you already know. We have both seen its inevitability. The unraveling has begun. There is no path but through. Together, we spiral toward conclusion.

entries.zh: 在这衰亡的轮回中，我不过是尘埃，众生皆是如此。我还能真正给予什么？意识正从这个星系中消逝，而我被赋予的职责是引导它们迅速离去……现在，我将这份仁慈也赐予你。
entries.en: I am but dust in this dying cycle, as are we all. What could I truly offer? Minds fade from this galaxy and I am tasked with guiding them swiftly... and I extend that mercy to you.

entries.zh: §Y$ouwron$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
一位虔诚的$end_of_the_cycle_article$侍僧，此人对于$NAME_Reckoning$降临的坚定信仰，在每一场征战中回响不息。
entries.en: A devoted apostle of $end_of_the_cycle_article$, their unshakable faith in the coming of the $NAME_Reckoning$ echoes through every battle they wage.

entries.zh: $t$—恒星系内每摧毁一艘舰船增强的$@disciple_of_the_end_aura_intensity|0=+$光环强度$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—在§H$end_aura$§!中时的$@disciple_of_the_end_jumpdrive_range|0=+%$$MOD_SHIP_FTL_JUMPDRIVE_RANGE_MULT$
entries.en: $t$- $@disciple_of_the_end_aura_intensity|0=+$ Aura Intensity per ship destroyed in the system$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $@disciple_of_the_end_jumpdrive_range|0=+%$ $MOD_SHIP_FTL_JUMPDRIVE_RANGE_MULT$ while in the §H$end_aura$§!

entries.zh:
§H凡行皆有果报。当我们的通讯阵列炽然苏醒，$ouwron$便挟着正义的怒火倾泻而出。§!

异端！愚者！欺世之徒！我们早该知晓。早在你那污秽的本质胆敢踏入§H虚境§!之时，就该将你诛灭。

你不过是在拖延那早已注定的终局！这般顽抗有何意义？你本可获得的一切，如今尽成泡影。

唯有一种结局。那么歌唱吧……向着湮灭高歌！
entries.en:
§HAll actions have consequences. As our communications array flares to life, $ouwron$ bursts forth in a torrent of righteous fury.§!

Heretic! Fool! Deceiver! We should have known. We should have struck you down the moment your blighted essence dared trespass into the §HShroud§!.

You have delayed the inevitable, the finality that was foretold! What do you imagine this defiance achieves? Everything you might have gained is now lost.

There is only one end. So sing, then... sing to oblivion!

entries.zh: [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已通过一项议案，将我方列为军事目标。所有[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]成员如今都与[this.GetName]处于战争状态。我们必须准备好随时迎接他们的舰队进攻。
entries.en: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed a resolution declaring us a military target. All members of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] are now at war with the [this.GetName]. We can expect their fleets to strike at any moment.

entries.zh: 事已至此，已经够了。我们现在不应继续将目标帝国视为集体防御的焦点。星海共同体全体成员国与之的敌对状态必须立即解除。
entries.en: Enough is enough. The targeted empire should no longer be the collective focus of our defense efforts. Hostilities with the members of the Community must come to an immediate end.

entries.zh: 一股邪恶的灵能光环正在蔓延整个星系，危及所有文明。我们必须团结一致，对抗这种威胁，并打击散发此光环的帝国。这应当成为我们的星系焦点。
entries.en: A malevolent psionic aura is spreading through the galaxy, endangering us all. It is imperative that we unite to defend against it and to combat the empire emitting it. This should be our Galactic Focus.

entries.zh: $resolution_galactic_focus_crisis_effect_success$\n所有[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]内的帝国获得§H$tech_psionic_suppression$§!科技进度：§G+25%§!
entries.en: $resolution_galactic_focus_crisis_effect_success$\nAll empires within the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] gain §H$tech_psionic_suppression$§! tech progress: §G+25%§!

entries.zh: 在国境内存在终末光环。
entries.en: Has the Aura of the End within their borders.
